Our key idea is to compare attempts at the same task to identify reusable decisions and refine when they apply. We introduce Hippo, a memory framework inspired by selective hippocampal encoding and replay that learns from these comparisons when shortcomings are diagnosed. It compares the resulting experience with existing memory to merge overlaps and resolve conflicts through explicit applicability conditions. This allows prior guidance to be revised without storing every lesson as a separate entry. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified, WebArena, and Mind2Web show performance gains in all three settings and substantially fewer retained experiences than the accumulation baseline. The gains extend across the evaluated base models of varying capabilities, indicating that memory-based adaptation remains useful even for highly capable models.
2610.24453.affiliation: University of California, Irvine / Independent Researcher / Rice University / Zillow Group
2610.24453.abstract_zh: 受递归自我改进启发，我们研究大语言模型智能体如何不更新参数，而通过外部记忆学习。单次尝试难以提取有效经验，因为错误推理也可成功，糟糕执行也可掩盖正确策略；长期保留价值同样困难：不做巩固的累积基线先改善，最终却低于无记忆基线。我们的核心是比较同一任务的多次尝试，识别可复用决策，细化适用条件。我们提出受选择性海马编码与回放启发的 Hippo，在诊断出不足时从这种比较学习。它将所得经验与已有记忆比较，合并重叠，并通过显式适用条件解决冲突，使既有指导可修改而不必将每条教训独立存储。在 SWE-bench Verified、WebArena 和 Mind2Web 上全部取得收益，保留经验远少于累积基线。收益扩展到所评估不同能力的基础模型，表明记忆适配对高能力模型也有用。
2610.24453.update_target: External experience memory and applicability conditions
2610.24453.mechanism_en: Compare attempts on the same task, diagnose shortcomings, then merge overlaps and resolve conflicts rather than append every lesson.
2610.24453.result_en: SWE-bench Verified, WebArena and Mind2Web all improve with fewer retained experiences than unconsolidated accumulation.
2610.24453.boundary_en: Training-free means fixed model parameters; task attempts, comparison and consolidation have costs and do not guarantee stable lifelong learning.

2610.24537.title: Write Once, Query Many: Evolving Compact Reusable Memory for Long Videos
2610.24537.authors: Kerui Chen , Jinglu Wang , Yun Wang , Xinjiang Wang , Yan Lu
2610.24537.categories_text: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV) ; Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.24537.abstract_en: Long videos often exceed the context capacity of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), while agentic search repeats costly video processing and grounding for each query. Reusable memory can amortize this cost, but must preserve information for questions unknown during construction. We propose Video-EMem, an evolvable video memory harness built on time-anchored perceptual observations. This representation combines compact free-form text with sparse images to preserve semantic content and complementary visual details across temporal scales, supporting temporal navigation without a fixed semantic schema. A Writer encodes each video once by consolidating overlapping multiscale observations, and a Reader retrieves and organizes evidence solely from the resulting memory. With the underlying models frozen, we evolve their workflows and operators using distinct feedback: query-independent source fidelity and coverage for the Writer, and QA failures in evidence localization and utilization for the Reader. Experiments support this separation for generalization beyond development queries, with our evolution strategy improving average accuracy by 7.2% over the unevolved harness. While reducing storage by about 99.86% on average relative to raw videos, Video-EMem improves Qwen3-VL-30B by an average of 2.6% across three long-video QA benchmarks over direct input of 2,048 frames. Using the same o3 answer model as the state-of-the-art agentic method, it improves average accuracy by 2.5% with lower per-query latency.
2610.24537.abstract_zh: 长视频常超出多模态大语言模型上下文容量，智能体搜索又为每个查询重复昂贵的视频处理与定位。可复用记忆能摊薄成本，却必须保留构建时未知问题需要的信息。我们提出 Video-EMem，基于时间锚定感知观测的可进化视频记忆框架，结合紧凑自由文本和稀疏图像，跨时间尺度保留语义及互补视觉细节，无需固定语义模式即可时间导航。Writer 每个视频只编码一次，整合重叠的多尺度观测；Reader 仅从所得记忆检索组织证据。在冻结基础模型的情况下，我们分别用不同反馈进化二者流程和操作：Writer 使用独立于查询的来源忠实度和覆盖度，Reader 使用证据定位和利用方面的问答失败。实验支持这种分离对开发查询之外的泛化，进化策略比未进化框架平均准确率高 7.2%。相对原始视频，平均存储量减少约 99.86%；跨三个长视频问答基准，Qwen3-VL-30B 相对直接输入 2,048 帧的平均准确率提高 2.6%。使用与最先进智能体方法相同的 o3 回答模型时，平均准确率提高 2.5%，单查询延迟更低。
2610.24537.mechanism_en: Writer evolves against query-independent fidelity/coverage; Reader evolves from QA localization/utilization failures; written memory is reused across queries.
2610.24537.result_en: Evolution improves average accuracy 7.2%; storage is reduced about 99.86% relative to raw videos.
2610.24537.boundary_en: Storage comparisons use raw video, not an equally capable compressed baseline; percentage gains are retained as reported rather than silently converted to points.

2610.24630.title: Selm: Self-Evolving Library Management for Multi-Skill Agent Optimization
2610.24630.authors: Mengxi Hu , Yuxuan Hu , Jinbo Su , Ke Wang , Honghao Shi , Wenli Wu , Cuiping Li , Hong Chen , Jing Zhang
2610.24630.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use skills as a lightweight way to acquire task-specific knowledge. Recent work enables skills to evolve from task trajectories. However, these methods often lack systematic management of evolved skills, making it difficult for agents to reuse and accumulate skills across domains, thus limiting performance on subsequent this http URL reliably accumulate, reuse, and maintain useful skills across tasks, we present SELM (Self-Evolving Library Management), a framework that formulates skill evolution as library-level management. SELM jointly manages skill retrieval, updating, and lifecycle by maintaining skill confidence and utility signals. It introduces utility-aware retrieval to select useful skills, a Map-Reduce framework to generate targeted updates from task-specific experience, and lifecycle controls to retain or remove skills based on their effectiveness. These mechanisms enable the skill library to continuously accumulate useful experience while preserving and pruning skills across tasks, improving agent performance on complex tasks across diverse domains. We evaluate SELM on four agent benchmarks covering diverse tasks and execution environments, and SELM consistently outperforms in most settings.
2610.24630.affiliation: Renmin University of China / Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence
2610.24630.abstract_zh: 大语言模型智能体越来越多地把技能作为轻量方式获得任务知识。近期工作可从任务轨迹进化技能，但通常缺乏对进化技能的系统管理，难以跨领域复用和积累，限制后续任务表现。为可靠积累、复用和维护跨任务的有用技能，我们提出 SELM（自进化库管理），将技能进化表述为库层面的管理。SELM 通过维护技能置信度和效用信号，联合管理检索、更新与生命周期。它引入效用感知检索选择有用技能，使用 Map-Reduce 框架从任务特定经验生成定向更新，并按有效性控制保留或删除，使技能库持续积累有用经验，同时跨任务保存和剪除技能。我们在覆盖不同任务和执行环境的四个智能体基准上评估，SELM 在多数设置中持续优于其他方法。
2610.24630.update_target: Skill-library retrieval, skill content and lifecycle
2610.24630.mechanism_en: Confidence/utility guide retrieval, Map-Reduce experience updates and evidence-based retention/removal across tasks.
2610.24630.result_en: Four agent benchmarks show gains in most settings without numerical headline values in the abstract.
2610.24630.boundary_en: Library management changes external skills, not necessarily model weights; the original listing has malformed link text retained in EN.
2610.24630.abstract_metadata_note: Official New-listing abstract contains malformed text "subsequent this http URL reliably accumulate". EN retains it verbatim; ZH translates the surrounding recoverable sentences without reconstructing a missing URL.

2610.24896.title: Peer Pressure: Execution-Verified Co-Evolution of Attacker and Defender Populations for Code Security
2610.24896.authors: Khushbu Pahwa , Yubin Ge , Daniele Bonadiman , Xiaofei Ma , Yi Zhang
2610.24896.categories_text: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2610.24896.abstract_en: LLM code agents increasingly ship code with little oversight, yet defenders trained on static vulnerability datasets fall behind adapting adversaries. We co-train attacker and defender instead, and let execution decide every reward: an attacker (Red) edits a real repository and earns nothing unless its patch applies, builds, passes the tests, completes its development task and reproduces a real exploit in an isolated container, whose path also labels the entry point, the critical operation and the trace between them. Peer-Relative Policy Optimization (PRPO) makes both sides populations of LoRA adapters over one frozen base and credits each against same-role peers that faced an identical condition, placing the population inside the policy-gradient baseline rather than the opponent pool, with a tournament preserving diversity. Matching cancels the condition's difficulty: at equal coverage it is worth 2.3 points of balanced accuracy over a baseline computed on other conditions, and it matches a within-policy control at half the verifier spend. PRPO's 7B diff reviewer reaches 64.8% balanced accuracy on four unseen applications in three untrained languages, 5.5 points above supervised security fine-tuning and 4.4 above a frozen frontier reviewer (Claude Opus 4.8), which it leads by 15.8 on the application it trains on. Its 9B repository agent recovers 23 of 172 held-out VulnGym advisories, against 10 after supervised fine-tuning and 7 for the same backbone untrained under the same scaffold, and locates 17 of 43 reachable entry points against 13 for mini-swe-agent with GLM-5.2. Run unchanged on jailbreak defense, the same algorithm matches or exceeds WildGuard's static F1 at equal corpus and model size. Under a judge distinct from its training oracle it cuts attack success from 36.0% to 4.6%, against WildGuard's 8.9%.
2610.24896.abstract_zh: 大语言模型代码智能体日益少经监督就交付代码，但静态漏洞数据训练的防御者会落后于适应中的对手。我们共同训练攻击者与防御者，让执行决定所有奖励：攻击者修改真实仓库，只有补丁能应用、构建、通过测试、完成开发任务，并在隔离容器中复现真实利用时才获得奖励；该路径也标注入口、关键操作及其间轨迹。同伴相对策略优化（PRPO）让双方成为同一冻结基础模型上的 LoRA 适配器种群，以面对相同条件的同角色同伴为基准归因，将种群放入策略梯度基线而非对手池，并用锦标赛保持多样性。匹配消除条件难度：相同覆盖下，比使用其他条件计算的基线高 2.3 个平衡准确率百分点，以一半验证器开销匹配策略内对照。7B 差异审查器在四个未见应用、三种未训练语言上平衡准确率为 64.8%，比监督安全微调高 5.5 个百分点，比冻结前沿审查器 Claude Opus 4.8 高 4.4，在训练应用上领先后者 15.8。9B 仓库智能体恢复 172 个留出 VulnGym 公告中的 23 个，监督微调为 10，未训练同主干同支架为 7；定位 43 个可达入口中的 17 个，使用 GLM-5.2 的 mini-swe-agent 为 13。不改算法用于越狱防御时，在相同语料与模型规模下达到或超过 WildGuard 的静态 F1。采用不同于训练预言机的裁判时，攻击成功率从 36.0% 降到 4.6%，WildGuard 为 8.9%。
2610.24896.update_target: Attacker/defender LoRA populations over a frozen base
2610.24896.mechanism_en: Execution gates rewards; same-condition same-role peer baselines and diversity-preserving tournaments drive co-training.
2610.24896.result_en: A 7B reviewer reports 64.8% held-out balanced accuracy; a 9B agent recovers 23/172 advisories.
2610.24896.boundary_en: These are security evaluation results under specified containers/oracles; no exploit procedures are reproduced here and cross-task transfers are not a universal security guarantee.

2610.25012.title: Conjugate Compilation: Self-Improving Agentic Co-Compilation for Speculative Decoding
2610.25012.authors: Annabelle Sujun Tang , Rohan Mahapatra , Christopher Priebe , Hanyang Xu , Manya Ghobadi , Christopher Rossbach , Hadi Esmaeilzadeh
2610.25012.categories_text: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Distributed, Parallel, and Cluster Computing (cs.DC); Programming Languages (cs.PL)
2610.25012.abstract_en: As LLM adoption surges, scaling model serving requires unlocking stranded GPU capacity alongside deploying more GPUs. Speculative decoding brings two models into the serving process: a small draft model proposes tokens that a larger target model verifies. Yet compiling these models individually leaves their shared execution outside the compiler's optimization boundary. We introduce CONJUGATE COMPILATION, which reframes speculative decoding as a cross-model compilation problem and jointly optimizes the draft and target models within their shared execution rather than treating each in isolation. Our key insight is that cross-model compilation should be informed by the measured performance of the co-located shared execution it produces: an optimization that improves a kernel in isolation need not improve the models when they execute together. To expand cross-model opportunities, we devise operand layouts that interleave blocks from both models within common tiles, co-locating GEMM and non-GEMM work while preserving their mathematics. We realize CONJUGATE COMPILATION through a self-improving agentic search system in which an LLM edits cross-model optimization plans using the compiler and GPU execution as its environment. Each proposed plan is compiled and evaluated through its co-located shared execution, whose measured score, together with kernel-level verdicts and compiler feedback, informs subsequent proposals, while Monte Carlo tree search accumulates rewards to guide exploration. Across six single-GPU speculative-decoding configurations on NVIDIA B300 and RTX 5090 GPUs, CONJUGATE COMPILATION achieves a geometric-mean per-round speedup of 1.37x over conventional execution. Interleaved kernels raise this speedup to 1.45x, reaching 1.59x in the best case. CONJUGATE COMPILATION also improves GPU utilization on average by 1.46x on RTX 5090 and 1.50x on B300.
2610.25012.affiliation: University of California, San Diego / Massachusetts Institute of Technology / Systalyze / University of Texas at Austin / Microsoft
2610.25012.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型采用激增，扩展服务既需要更多 GPU，也需要释放闲置容量。推测解码由小草稿模型提出词元、大目标模型验证，但分别编译两者会把共享执行排除在编译器优化边界之外。我们提出共轭编译，将推测解码重述为跨模型编译问题，在共享执行内联合优化草稿和目标模型。核心是用所产生的同机共享执行实测性能指导跨模型编译：孤立内核更快不一定代表共同执行更快。我们设计在公共分块中交错两模型数据块的操作数布局，在保持数学计算的同时共置 GEMM 与非 GEMM 工作。实现采用自改进智能体搜索系统，大语言模型以编译器和 GPU 执行为环境，修改跨模型优化计划。每项计划被编译，并通过共享执行评估，实测分数、内核级判定和编译反馈指导后续提议，蒙特卡洛树搜索累积奖励指导探索。在 NVIDIA B300 和 RTX 5090 上六种单 GPU 推测解码配置中，相对常规执行，每轮加速的几何平均为 1.37 倍；交错内核将其提高到 1.45 倍，最佳 1.59 倍。RTX 5090 和 B300 平均 GPU 利用率分别提高 1.46 倍和 1.50 倍。
2610.25012.update_target: Cross-model compilation plans and MCTS search state
2610.25012.mechanism_en: Compiler diagnostics, kernel verdicts and jointly measured GPU execution guide subsequent plans while MCTS accumulates search rewards.
2610.25012.result_en: Six configurations show 1.37x geometric-mean per-round speedup, rising to 1.45x with interleaving, best 1.59x.
2610.25012.boundary_en: These are per-round speculative-decoding results on B300/RTX 5090; plan search is external optimization, not evidence of model-weight self-training.

2610.25089.title: DAGLoop: Aligning Method Design with Experimental Feedback in Automated AI Research
2610.25089.authors: Dengyuxing Wang , Yonggang Zhang , Qianshu Cai , Huajiang Zheng , Jun Song , Yangqiu Song , Yike Guo
2610.25089.abstract_en: Automated AI research agents aim to improve machine learning methods by iteratively proposing, implementing, and evaluating candidate methods. Existing work uses the outcome of each evaluation to determine how the next candidate should be revised for performance improvement. However, a candidate often combines multiple design decisions, and its overall outcome alone does not reveal which decisions produced their expected effects, whether their required conditions were satisfied, or which decisions should be retained or revised. Inspired by ablation studies in the machine learning community, we propose DAGLoop to test the expected effect of a design decision by comparing implementations with and without that decision while preserving the other decisions it requires. Specifically, DAGLoop translates each design decision's rationale into a testable expectation and pairs it with a targeted experiment, forming an experimental specification for assessing the expected effect under its required conditions. Using these specifications, we formulate ablation planning as the construction of a directed acyclic graph (DAG) from the candidate method's design: nodes associate decisions with tests, and edges encode dependencies. The DAG specifies which decisions each experiment must retain and supports joint tests when an expected effect requires several decisions to act together. Outcomes are recorded with the tested decisions, expectations, and conditions to form structured research memory. This memory guides the agent in retaining experimentally supported decisions, revising unsupported ones, and planning further experiments when the evidence is unresolved. Experiments on dozens of research tasks demonstrate substantial performance improvements achieved by DAGLoop across diverse executable research settings. Code and evaluation scripts are available at this https URL .
2610.25089.affiliation: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology / Hong Kong Generative AI Research & Development Center / University of Science and Technology of China / Hong Kong Baptist University
2610.25089.abstract_zh: 自动化人工智能研究智能体通过反复提出、实现、评估候选方法改进机器学习，但候选常组合多项设计，整体结果无法说明哪些决策产生预期作用、所需条件是否满足，以及应保留或修改什么。受消融研究启发，我们提出 DAGLoop，在保留某设计所需其他决策的条件下，比较有无该决策的实现，以检验预期作用。它将每项设计理由转为可检验预期，配对定向实验，形成评估所需条件下预期作用的实验规格。基于规格，将消融规划表述为从候选设计构建有向无环图（DAG）：节点关联决策与测试，边编码依赖。该图规定每项实验必须保留哪些决策，并在作用需要多项决策共同产生时支持联合测试。结果与被测决策、预期及条件一起存为结构化研究记忆，指导保留有实验支持的决策、修改不受支持者，在证据未定时规划更多实验。在数十项研究任务上，DAGLoop 在不同可执行研究设置中带来显著性能改进。代码和评估脚本见原文链接。
2610.25089.update_target: Method-design decisions and dependency-aware research memory
2610.25089.mechanism_en: Decision rationales become tests; a DAG preserves prerequisites and joint effects, storing outcomes to retain/revise decisions and plan unresolved experiments.
2610.25089.result_en: Dozens of executable research tasks show reported performance improvements.
2610.25089.boundary_en: No numerical headline is given in the reviewed abstract; evidence for one tested dependency set does not certify every causal explanation.

2610.25119.title: Memory as Belief: Bayesian Evolution of Memory for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
2610.25119.authors: Yiming Xu , Qian Yang , Zihan Chen , Yuefei Wu , Wenhan Zeng , Bin Shi , Bo Dong
2610.25119.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory to accumulate past experiences for continual adaptation. However, effectively reusing memory requires accurately assessing its value, as retrieved experiences may become unreliable when transferred across task contexts. Despite its importance, memory valuation remains largely underexplored, with existing methods relying on historical retrieval success rates that overlook the context dependency of memory usefulness and the varying reliability of estimates under different amounts of evidence. Inspired by the Bayesian brain hypothesis, we propose BEAM (Bayesian-style Evolutionary Agentic Memory), a framework that reformulates memory value evaluation as a parameterized cognitive inference process, where memory value is represented as a context-conditioned dynamic belief rather than a passive historical statistic. Specifically, BEAM infers memory value beliefs from current task contexts and continuously calibrates them using execution feedback as empirical evidence, transforming memory from passive storage into an adaptive cognitive mechanism for continual self-evolution. Extensive experiments across reasoning and code generation benchmarks demonstrate that BEAM consistently improves memory utilization and enables continual self-evolution of LLM agents.
2610.25119.affiliation: Xi’an Jiaotong University / University of Virginia / Zhengzhou University
2610.25119.abstract_zh: 大语言模型智能体依赖外部记忆累积经验、持续适配，但有效复用要求准确评估价值，因为经验跨任务迁移可能不可靠。现有方法多用历史检索成功率，忽略有用性对上下文的依赖，以及证据量不同导致的估计可靠性差异。受贝叶斯脑假说启发，我们提出 BEAM（贝叶斯式进化智能体记忆），将记忆价值评估重述为参数化认知推断过程：价值是上下文条件化的动态信念，而非被动历史统计。BEAM 从当前任务上下文推断价值信念，并持续用执行反馈作为经验证据校准，将记忆从被动存储转为持续自进化的自适应认知机制。在推理和代码生成基准上的大量实验显示，BEAM 持续改善记忆利用，支持智能体持续自进化。
2610.25119.mechanism_en: Parameterized belief inference values experience for current contexts; execution feedback continually calibrates the beliefs for future retrieval.
2610.25119.result_en: Reasoning and code benchmarks report improved memory utilization and continued adaptation.
2610.25119.boundary_en: Bayesian-style terminology does not by itself establish calibrated posteriors; inspect context-shift and evidence-volume controls.

2610.25123.title: Memories That Outlive Their Reasons: Dependency-Tethered Memory for Tool-Using LLM Agents
2610.25123.authors: Yiqi Wang , Jinqian Ju , Jiaqi Zhang , Zhangkai Wu , Yiqun Duan , Zequn Sun , Taotao Cai , Mingkai Zheng
2610.25123.abstract_en: Agents now act on the Web, publishing packages, models and datasets through registry APIs, and remembering past verifications spares them the work. But a verdict rests on premises. When a signing key is revoked, everything built on it stops passing, yet the advisory names only the key, and the old verdicts of its dependents may never share a retrieval window with it. This non-locality of invalidation turns memory into a liability: in long simulated chats, an agent reading a memory of atomic facts publishes 62% of the objects whose failure lies upstream, each backed by a record that was true when written. Yet derivation is local even when invalidation is not. Tether records, at write time, the exact versions each verdict derives from, and at read time withdraws any verdict whose support has failed anywhere in the store; the agent reads the same fields as before. On Fallout, a generator of versioned worlds with hypothesis-blind simulated histories shared by every memory, Tether publishes 0.3% of upstream-failing objects across three domains when relations are stated with their verdicts, with 37% fewer verification calls than checking everything. A-Mem and Graphiti re-verify most candidates (0.83-0.86 checks per candidate), which limits their savings, yet publish 9% of upstream-failing objects; Mem0 relies on memory more and publishes 42%. Flushing every verdict on any failure is as safe as Tether but costs 32% more checks. The gain over fact memory holds with three open-weight backbones and against a whole-store window. These gains depend on capturing dependencies: when relations arrive in sessions apart from their verdicts, Tether's downstream unsafe publication rate rises to 9.4-22.1%, and a weak writer that misses edges loses safety in the same way.
2610.25123.affiliation: University of Southern Queensland / Southern University of Science and Technology / Jiangsu University / University of Sydney / Uploading Inc. / Nanjing University
2610.25123.abstract_zh: 智能体通过注册表 API 发布软件包、模型和数据，记住过去验证可以省事，但判定依赖前提。签名密钥撤销会使其依赖项全部失效，公告却只命名密钥，旧判定与公告可能从不出现在同一检索窗口。这种非局部失效使记忆成为风险：在长模拟对话中，读取原子事实记忆的智能体发布 62% 的上游失效对象，尽管记录写入时为真。失效非局部，推导却是局部的。Tether 写入时记录每个判定依赖的精确版本，读取时撤回任何支持在存储任意位置失效的判定，智能体读取字段保持相同。在 Fallout 版本化世界生成器中，所有记忆共享不知待测假说的模拟历史；当关系与判定同时陈述时，Tether 跨三个领域仅发布 0.3% 的上游失效对象，比全量验证少 37% 调用。A-Mem 和 Graphiti 重新验证多数候选，每候选 0.83—0.86 次，限制节省，却仍发布 9% 的上游失效对象；Mem0 更依赖记忆，发布 42%。任何失败就清空全部判定与 Tether 同样安全，但多用 32% 检查。相对事实记忆的收益在三个开源权重主干以及全库窗口对照中成立。收益依赖依赖关系捕捉：当关系和判定分散在不同会话，Tether 下游不安全发布率升至 9.4%—22.1%，弱写入器漏边也同样丧失安全性。
2610.25123.update_target: Versioned memory verdicts and support dependencies
2610.25123.mechanism_en: Write-time dependency capture and whole-store invalidation withdraw unsupported verdicts before later reads.
2610.25123.result_en: In simulated Fallout worlds, upstream-failing publication falls 62%→0.3% with 37% fewer checks than verify-all when dependencies arrive together.
2610.25123.boundary_en: Separated relations raise unsafe rates to 9.4–22.1%; this is simulated registry behavior and correctness depends on writer edge capture.

2610.25126.title: Trackable Skill Library Lifecycle Management for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
2610.25126.authors: Xi Zhu , Yuanlin Duan , Changyi Yang , Kai Mei , Riyang Bao , Shichao Zhu , Dimitris N. Metaxas
2610.25126.abstract_en: Skill-augmented agentic RL has emerged as an effective approach to improving LLM agents on long-horizon tasks. Despite this progress, individual skills may follow distinct trajectories as the policy evolves, with some becoming redundant after the model internalizes their capabilities, others remaining valuable as external scaffolding, and still others turning harmful. However, existing skill library systems fail to identify each skill's true contribution due to free-riding among co-retrieved skills, difficulty confounding across tasks, and the absence of skill-specific counterfactual evidence, which prevents reliable skill lifecycle management. We propose TrackRL, an agentic RL framework where skill tracking drives skill library full lifecycle management. Specifically, within each GRPO group, we turn grouped sampling into online randomized controlled experiments. Independent random injection and within-group contrasts on the same task isolate each skill's true contribution, and reliability-weighted aggregation accumulates evidence across groups. As evidence accumulates, we continuously track skill utility, which measures the skill's causal contribution as external scaffolding, and model mastery, which reflects how far the corresponding capability has been internalized. Along this line, we formulate skill lifecycle management as an evidence-gated state-transition process that governs each skill from generation and admission through protected incubation to retention, retirement, or removal, while a soft capacity bound controls library growth. Experiments show that TrackRL outperforms recent skill-augmented RL baselines in both library-assisted and skill-free evaluation, with further analyses revealing how skill value shifts during policy learning and how evidence-driven state transitions shape skill library evolution. Our code is available at this https URL .
2610.25126.affiliation: Rutgers University / Carnegie Mellon University / TikTok Inc.
2610.25126.abstract_zh: 技能增强智能体强化学习能改善长时程任务，但策略进化时，各技能可能有不同轨迹：能力内化后冗余、仍是有效外部支架，或转为有害。现有库难以识别真实贡献，因为共同检索技能间搭便车、任务难度混杂以及缺少技能特定反事实证据，阻碍可靠生命周期管理。我们提出 TrackRL，以技能跟踪驱动全生命周期管理。它把每个 GRPO 组的分组采样转为在线随机对照实验，通过独立随机注入和同任务组内对比隔离每项技能真实贡献，以可靠性加权聚合跨组证据。由此持续跟踪技能效用，即作为外部支架的因果贡献，以及模型掌握度，即能力内化程度。生命周期管理成为证据门控的状态转换，从生成、准入、保护孵化到保留、退役或移除，软容量界控制库增长。实验显示，TrackRL 在有库辅助和无技能评估中均优于近期技能增强强化学习基线，分析展示学习中技能价值变化及证据驱动转换如何塑造库进化。代码见原文链接。
2610.25126.update_target: RL policy weights and tracked skill lifecycle states
2610.25126.mechanism_en: Random skill injection within same-task GRPO groups yields counterfactual contrasts; evidence tracks external utility/internal mastery and gates admission/retirement.
2610.25126.result_en: Library-assisted and skill-free evaluations outperform recent skill-augmented RL baselines.
2610.25126.boundary_en: Randomization addresses specified confounds; utility, internalization and finite-sample uncertainty should remain distinct, with no numeric gain supplied here.

2610.25561.title: Let Them Sleep: Recursive Self-Pruning Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
2610.25561.authors: Kargi Chauhan , Sadiba Nusrat Nur , Pratibha Revankar , Kyle Montgomery , Chenguang Wang
2610.25561.abstract_en: Agents that run for a long time have a memory problem, and it is not the one most systems optimize for. Storing every trace and retrieving the nearest neighbors works early and quietly stops working later: the store fills up with failures the agent then repeats, and with facts that were true fifty turns ago. RSPM (Recursive Self-Pruning Memory) borrows the fix biology already found. At intervals the agent sleeps. It clusters its recent failures, distills each cluster into a short rule, and deletes the raw episodes it just learned from. Rules decay unless something reinforces them, and rules that recur across many contexts get promoted into general ones. We tested this on three settings with little in common: a difficulty-calibrated SWE-bench simulation, temporal consistency across 12 conversational benchmarks, and long-horizon QA on LoCoMo-10. All three improve, by 9.1, 11.9, and 7.6 points respectively. More interestingly, the two studies that instrument the store itself converge on nearly the same operating point without being tuned toward it: roughly 93% fewer retry loops and roughly 30% fewer stored entries. That hints that knowing what to forget is a general property of agent memory rather than a benchmark-specific trick.
2610.25561.abstract_zh: 长期运行智能体的记忆问题并非大多数系统优化的那个问题。存储全部轨迹、检索近邻最初有效，随后逐渐失效：库中充满会被重复的失败，以及五十轮前还正确的事实。递归自剪枝记忆 RSPM 借鉴生物学：智能体定期“睡眠”，聚类近期失败，把每个簇提炼为短规则，删除已学习的原始片段。规则若不被强化就衰减，跨许多上下文复现的规则晋升为一般规则。我们在三个差异很大的设置中测试：难度校准的 SWE-bench 模拟、12 个对话基准上的时间一致性，以及 LoCoMo-10 长时程问答，分别提高 9.1、11.9 和 7.6 分。更值得关注的是，两项测量存储本身的研究在未针对该结果调优时收敛到相近工作点：重试循环减少约 93%，存储条目减少约 30%。这暗示知道遗忘什么或许是智能体记忆的一般性质，而非基准特定技巧。
2610.25561.update_target: External failure rules and retained episodes
2610.25561.mechanism_en: Periodic clustering distills rules and deletes raw episodes; reinforcement counters decay and recurring rules are promoted.
2610.25561.result_en: Reported gains are 9.1/11.9/7.6 points across three settings, with roughly 93% fewer retry loops and 30% fewer entries in two instrumented studies.
2610.25561.boundary_en: The SWE setting is a difficulty-calibrated simulation; similar operating points are suggestive rather than proof of a universal forgetting law.

2610.25736.title: Learning from Fleet Experience: A Collective Learning Paradigm for Robots
2610.25736.authors: Chao Yu , Shu'ang Yu , Hao Lin , Hongzhi Zang , Yuxiang Yan , Chenxi Jiang , Zhen Guo , Chuankang Li , Yihao Chen , Xin Xu , Xu Fu , Jiakai Zhou , Liangzhi Shi , Hongyi Ren , Yiwei Liu , Jing Wu , Yuanqing Wang , Chen Wu , Bo Dai , Chunyu Yang , Hongliang Huang , Shuoyu Yue , Weiqi Yin , Yinuo Chen , Ruihua Chen , Chunyang Zhu , Han Xiao , Yanghao Li , Ruipu Wu , Zhikai Cai , Xiu Chen , Xu Tan , Yuchen Yan , Jialin Zhang , Wen Zeng , Yiming Zhou , Zixiao Huang , Guanghui Ren , Quanlu Zhang , Boxun Li , Maoqing Yao , Yu Wang
2610.25736.abstract_en: Experience generated during deployment offers an opportunity for robots to improve policy reliability through learning from their own executions. However, learning through human corrections requires teleoperators to monitor execution and intervene when policies fail, a demand that is difficult to meet as robot fleets grow. We introduce collective experience learning (CEL), a learning paradigm in which deployed robots share their execution experience to improve a common policy. We realize CEL through failure-guided experience retrieval fine-tuning (FERT), which uses failure contexts from robot executions to retrieve relevant trajectory segments from the fleet's shared successful experience and uses their actions as supervision for policy updates, without collecting additional expert demonstrations or corrective actions. A fault-tolerant asynchronous training system (FATS) coordinates experience collection, policy optimization and policy distribution despite local interruptions within the robot fleet. Across five real-world manipulation tasks, the resulting policies achieve success rates of 93.3-99.2%, evaluated over 120 trials per task on robots excluded from training data collection. With collection time per robot held fixed, larger fleets provide more experience and FERT generally achieves higher success rates across the evaluated sizes. On multi-stage phone packaging, learning with 96 robots increases success from 79.2% to 98.3%. These results support collective experience as a practical basis for scalable robot learning and a path towards improving policy reliability during deployment without collecting additional expert corrective actions.
2610.25736.abstract_zh: 部署经验为机器人从自身执行学习、提高策略可靠性提供机会，但依赖人工修正要求遥操作员监控并介入，难以随机器人队伍扩展。我们提出集体经验学习（CEL），让部署机器人共享执行经验以改进公共策略。实现采用失败引导经验检索微调（FERT），从失败上下文检索队伍共享成功经验中的相关轨迹片段，以其动作监督策略更新，无需额外专家示范或修正动作。容错异步训练系统 FATS 在局部中断下仍协调经验采集、优化和策略分发。在五项真实操作任务中，每项在不参与训练采集的机器人上评估 120 次，成功率达到 93.3%—99.2%。固定每台采集时间时，更大队伍提供更多经验，FERT 在所测规模下通常成功率更高。多阶段手机包装中，96 台机器人学习使成功率从 79.2% 升至 98.3%。结果支持集体经验作为可扩展机器人学习的实践基础，无需额外专家修正动作即可在部署中提高可靠性。
2610.25736.update_target: Shared robot policy weights distributed across a fleet
2610.25736.mechanism_en: Failure contexts retrieve successful fleet trajectory segments for supervised fine-tuning; asynchronous collection/training/distribution tolerates local interruptions.
2610.25736.result_en: Five physical tasks reach 93.3–99.2% over 120 trials each on held-out robots; 96-robot phone packaging rises 79.2%→98.3%.
2610.25736.boundary_en: No additional corrective demonstrations is narrower than no prior demonstrations or training; fleet scale and collection cost are substantial.

2610.25747.title: Bayesian Model Discovery with Language Models: Closing the Loop between Hypotheses and Experiments
2610.25747.authors: JooKyung Yuh , Byungmin Park , Eunseo Choi , Jinheon Baek , Junmo Cho , Kyu Hyun Choi , Sung Ju Hwang , Kyong Hwan Jin , Hae Beom Lee
2610.25747.abstract_en: Scientific model discovery requires proposing candidate models of an unknown system and designing experiments that discriminate among them. However, LLM-based approaches typically rely on in-context learning to predict outcomes and select experiments, lacking explicit model evaluation to systematically guide hypothesis search, while Bayesian approaches enable principled model comparison but are confined to a predefined candidate set which results in limited search spaces. To this end, we introduce BMD, which closes the loop between LLM-driven hypothesis generation and Bayesian experimental design. Specifically, an LLM proposes model families, while a numerical engine fits their parameters, weighs them by model evidence, and averages their predictions. Then, BMD chooses the next experimental conditions by maximizing the joint expected information gain over families and their parameters, while feeding the updated beliefs and residual diagnostics back to the LLM to guide its next proposals. Across four scientific discovery benchmarks, BMD achieves lowest final prediction error than in-context learning and LLM-based scientific agents while recovering exact functional forms more often, with ablations supporting numerical feedback and the joint objective.
2610.25747.abstract_zh: 科学模型发现需要为未知系统提出模型并设计区分它们的实验。大语言模型方法常依赖上下文学习预测结果、选择实验，缺少显式模型评估来系统指导假设搜索；贝叶斯方法有原则的模型比较却被预定义候选集限制。我们提出 BMD，闭合语言模型假设生成与贝叶斯实验设计循环：语言模型提出模型家族，数值引擎拟合参数、按模型证据加权、平均预测；随后通过最大化家族及其参数的联合预期信息增益选择下一实验条件，并将更新信念和残差诊断反馈给语言模型，指导后续提议。在四个科学发现基准上，BMD 比上下文学习和语言模型科学智能体取得更低最终预测误差，更常恢复精确函数形式；消融支持数值反馈与联合目标。
2610.25747.update_target: Scientific model-family proposals, fitted parameters and experimental beliefs
2610.25747.mechanism_en: LLM hypotheses are numerically fitted/weighted; joint information gain selects experiments and residual diagnostics update subsequent proposals.
2610.25747.result_en: Four discovery benchmarks show lower final prediction error and more exact-form recovery than compared agents.
2610.25747.boundary_en: This is a scientific hypothesis/experiment loop; no learned improvement of the LLM proposer itself is established by the abstract.

2610.25790.title: CoMem: Learning to Anticipate Failures from Retrieved Experience
2610.25790.authors: Yun Shen , Ming Shen , Tianjun Yao
2610.25790.abstract_en: Reflection lets LLM agents improve from their own attempts, but the memory it builds is local to a single task, so an agent reflecting on its own tends to revisit the same explanation for failure. Cross-task reflective memory addresses this in two forms: retrieved memory keeps past experience explicit and looks up related cases, which is specific but bounded by the bank, and parametric memory internalizes experience into parameters, which generalizes but is grounded in nothing beyond the task description. When both are used, existing agents combine them additively, feeding their outputs to the solver side by side, so retrieved experience never changes what the learned memory produces. We introduce CoMem (Compounding Memory), which makes retrieved experience an input to the learned memory itself, at training and at inference. The agent builds a bank of its own successful and failed reflections, learns from retrieved cases to write failure hypotheses, candidate explanations of how an attempt is likely to go wrong, and at test time reasons from newly retrieved cases to guide each attempt. Varying the retrieved cases gives the memory different perspectives, yielding reflective diversity that is not merely sampled but also grounded in retrieved experience. Across two backbones and five benchmarks in math, code, and multi-hop QA, CoMem achieves strong overall performance. Additional evaluations show that it generalizes to out-of-distribution tasks and enables smaller models to provide effective guidance to stronger solvers.
2610.25790.affiliation: Ohio State University / Shenzhen Loop Area Institute / Shanghai Jiaotong University
2610.25790.abstract_zh: 反思让智能体从尝试中改善，但记忆常局限单项任务，使其反复访问相同失败解释。跨任务反思记忆有两种形式：检索记忆显式保存经验、查找案例，具体但受记忆库限制；参数记忆将经验内化到参数，可泛化却只有任务描述作依据。现有方法把二者输出并列给求解器，检索经验不改变学习记忆产生的内容。我们提出 CoMem（复合记忆），让检索经验在训练和推理时都作为学习记忆本身的输入。智能体建立自身成功和失败反思库，从检索案例学习写失败假说，即下一尝试可能出错的候选解释，并在测试时从新检索案例推理以指导每次尝试。改变检索案例提供不同视角，使反思多样性不仅靠采样，还由经验支撑。在两个主干、五个数学、代码及多跳问答基准上取得较强总体表现。额外评估显示分布外任务泛化，并使小模型有效指导更强求解器。
2610.25790.update_target: Reflection bank and learned parametric failure hypotheses
2610.25790.mechanism_en: Successful/failed reflections form retrieval cases; retrieved experience conditions the learned memory during training and inference.
2610.25790.result_en: Two backbones and five math/code/QA benchmarks show strong results plus OOD and small-to-large solver guidance.
2610.25790.boundary_en: Parametric learning and explicit retrieval interact, but benchmark transfer does not show autonomous indefinite compounding.

2610.25931.title: EvoSkill v2: Fully Agentic Skill Evolution from Benchmark Adaptation to a Stateful Evolver
2610.25931.authors: Dastin Huang , Baran Nama , Salaheddin Alzubi
2610.25931.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.25931.abstract_en: EvoSkill v2 is a three-agent system that edits the instructions (skills) an agent is given, leaving its model and harness intact. The user starts a run by describing a benchmark and supplying a grader, which a benchmark adaptor turns into a benchmark-specific plugin. A solver attempts the tasks, and an evolver reads the solver's training rollouts and rewrites the skills at each epoch. We implement the evolver as one stateful coding agent with a bash tool for the whole run, unlike the two most common designs among the skill optimizers we surveyed: a sequence of single model calls, as in SkillOpt, and an agent that starts afresh each round, as in SkillBoost. We also measure how much the solver's rollouts vary from one attempt to the next, give the evolver several attempts per training task, and accept every epoch's skills instead of selecting among them on noisy scores. With fine-grained ground truth, EvoSkill v2's skills raised the held-out pass rate above the stronger of SkillOpt and SkillBoost by 7.7 percentage points on SpreadsheetBench v2 and by 5.4 on $\tau^3$-bench banking. In both benchmarks and both feedback settings, EvoSkill v2's evolver cost less per percentage point of held-out pass rate gained than either baseline's optimizer. EvoSkill v2 also enables a less capable model to improve its own skills, demonstrated by a gain of up to 21.5 percentage points in the $\tau^3$-bench banking experiment where Claude Haiku 5.5 powers both solver and evolver.
2610.25931.abstract_zh: EvoSkill v2 是三智能体系统，编辑提供给智能体的技能指令，保持模型和框架不变。用户描述基准并提供评分器，基准适配器将其转为专用插件。求解器尝试任务，进化器读取训练轨迹，每个 epoch 重写技能。我们让进化器成为整个运行期间持有 bash 工具的有状态编码智能体，不同于调查中两种常见设计：如 SkillOpt 的连续单次模型调用，或如 SkillBoost 的每轮重启智能体。我们还测量求解器执行变异，为每项训练任务提供多次尝试，并接纳每个 epoch 技能，而非按噪声分数择优。有细粒度真实反馈时，相对 SkillOpt 和 SkillBoost 中更强者，在 SpreadsheetBench v2 的留出通过率高 7.7 个百分点，在 $	au^3$-bench 银行业高 5.4 个百分点。两个基准和两种反馈设置下，每提升一个留出通过率百分点的进化器成本都低于两项基线。它也让较弱模型改进自身技能：Claude Haiku 5.5 同时担任求解器与进化器时，银行业实验最多提高 21.5 个百分点。
2610.25931.update_target: External skill instructions and stateful evolver context
2610.25931.mechanism_en: A persistent coding-agent evolver reads multiple solver rollouts and rewrites skills each epoch, accepting each epoch instead of noisy best-selection.
2610.25931.result_en: Held-out gains over strongest competitors are 7.7 points on SpreadsheetBench v2 and 5.4 on banking; self-skill improvement reaches 21.5 points in one setting.
2610.25931.boundary_en: Model and harness stay intact; accepting every epoch is an experimental choice rather than a general guarantee against regressions.

2610.24090.title: Persistent Memory and Iterative Improvement in an LLM Agent for Chinese-Character Drawing
2610.24090.abstract_en: Does persistent memory accumulated from previous attempts help an LLM agent solve new problems, and does memory design affect that benefit? We study programmatic Chinese-character drawing across five agent conditions attempting the same 668 items. Accumulated memory produces modest aggregate gains despite substantial growth in the memory stores: free-form notes improve first-attempt success by 4.6 percentage points, while a design combining free-form memory with reusable code improves it by 2.8 points. The two designs do not differ significantly overall, but the code bank shows a suggestive advantage on later, harder items. A separate post-hoc comparison finds a much larger improvement when the code-bank agent receives privileged, target-specific structural supervision. The agent can therefore exploit highly informative structural guidance, although the privileged per-item information does not establish what could have been learned from experience alone. These results suggest that memory design may affect where accumulated experience becomes useful, even when its average benefit is modest.
2610.24090.affiliation: Palo Alto High School / University of California San Diego
2610.24090.abstract_zh: 从过去尝试累积的持久记忆，能否帮助大语言模型智能体解决新问题，记忆设计是否影响收益？我们在五个智能体条件下，对相同 668 个项目研究程序化汉字绘制。尽管记忆库大幅增长，汇总收益有限：自由笔记使首次成功率提高 4.6 个百分点，自由记忆结合可复用代码提高 2.8 个百分点。二者总体无显著差异，但代码库在后期更难项目上显示提示性优势。另一次事后比较发现，代码库智能体获得特权、目标特定结构监督时，改进明显更大。智能体能利用高信息量结构指导，但这种逐项目特权信息不能说明仅从经验能学到什么。结果提示，记忆设计可能影响经验在哪些情形有用，即使平均收益有限。
2610.24090.update_target: Accumulated drawing notes and reusable code
2610.24090.mechanism_en: Five conditions process the same 668 items; later new-item outcomes test what retained experience supports.
2610.24090.result_en: First-attempt gains are 4.6 points for notes and 2.8 for notes plus code, with no significant overall difference between them.
2610.24090.boundary_en: The large post-hoc structural-supervision gain uses privileged target-specific information, not demonstrated experience-only learning.

2610.24291.title: An important Bottleneck in LLM Optimizers: Principle-Level Local Optima
2610.24291.authors: Nian Ran , Tianhe Jia , Zhengyang Mu , Yue Wang , Sebastian Brulin , Markus Olhofer , Mauricio A. Alvarez , Yang Liu , Richard Allmendinger
2610.24291.abstract_en: Feedback-driven LLM optimizers are increasingly used for evolutionary search, Bayesian optimization, heuristic design, and scientific discovery. Yet rapid initial gains often give way to prolonged plateaus despite substantial remaining evaluation budgets. We investigate \emph{principle-level search collapse}, where an optimizer's search becomes confined to a narrow set of design principles, even though it may continue to generate distinct candidates and achieve small improvements. We assemble a diagnostic benchmark spanning molecular optimization, network sentinel-node selection, and GPU-kernel optimization, and introduce a decision-tree protocol combining principle narrowing, prolonged performance plateaus, and gaps to attainable reference solutions. Across 161 assessable runs on the three problem domains, 78.3\% receive support for collapse, including 55.3\% with strong support. Candidate-level variation can nevertheless conceal restricted search at the principle level. We then test \emph{diversity injection}, a common response to search stagnation, such as higher t, multiple LLMs, and web search, and show that it provides limited and inconsistent benefits: among 65 molecular runs, still 73.8\% and 53.8\% receive support and strong support respectively. We finally test reference-principle interventions and find that they improve some runs, but their benefits vary across models and tasks: access to a better principle does not guarantee its effective use. Our benchmark and diagnostic protocol provide a basis for evaluating future optimizers on principle-level collapse. Our findings highlight the need for online collapse detection and better mechanisms for generating and maintaining alternative principles during optimization.
2610.24291.affiliation: University of Manchester / UKRI AI Centre for Doctoral Training in Decision Making for Complex Systems / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences / Zhongguancun Academy / NVIDIA / Honda Research Institute Europe
2610.24291.abstract_zh: 反馈驱动的语言模型优化器广用于进化搜索、贝叶斯优化、启发式设计和科学发现，但快速初始收益后常在仍有大量评估预算时长期停滞。我们研究“原理层面搜索坍缩”：搜索局限于狭窄设计原理，尽管仍产生不同候选和小幅改进。我们构建分子优化、网络哨兵节点选择和 GPU 内核优化诊断基准，提出结合原理收窄、长期平台期以及与可达参考解差距的决策树协议。三个领域 161 次可评估运行中，78.3% 得到坍缩支持，55.3% 获强支持；候选层变化却可掩盖原理受限。我们测试更高 t、多模型、网页搜索等多样性注入，收益有限且不一致：65 次分子运行中，仍有 73.8% 和 53.8% 获坍缩支持与强支持。参考原理干预能改善部分运行，但因模型和任务而异，得到更好原理不保证有效使用。基准和协议为未来评估提供基础，强调在线坍缩检测和生成维护替代原理机制的需要。
2610.24291.update_target: Principle diversity within feedback-driven optimizer search
2610.24291.mechanism_en: A decision tree tests principle narrowing, plateaus and attainable reference gaps; diversity/reference-principle interventions probe remedies.
2610.24291.result_en: 78.3% of 161 assessable runs support collapse, 55.3% strongly; common diversity injection has inconsistent benefit.
2610.24291.boundary_en: These diagnostic classifications depend on domain/reference choices; receiving a stronger principle does not ensure effective use.

2610.24597.title: CADS: Measuring the Incremental Contribution of LLM Proposers in Sequential Biological Screens
2610.24597.authors: Guanxing Chen , Nihui Shao , Haohuai He , Zhenchao Tang , Pengwei Hu , Zhi-An Huang
2610.24597.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used to guide sequential biological screens, yet standard evaluations rely on raw hit counts that conflate a proposer's value with the discovery capacity of the underlying algorithmic harness. Adaptive sampling and corrupted experimental readouts also leave standard feedback comparisons without a false-discovery guarantee. We present Certified Agentic Discovery Screens (CADS), an error-controlled measurement framework that quantifies a proposer's incremental value against an identical LLM-free loop. By integrating capped likelihood-ratio bounds, e-processes, and complete-family e-BH, CADS controls the terminal false discovery rate under the stated null and corruption conditions despite arbitrary dependence, adaptive sampling, and optional stopping. In DepMap-backed simulations, CADS exposes two evaluation artifacts: the LLM-free harness alone clears the feedback gate, and raw origin counts overstate LLM contributions because LLM picks displace fallback discoveries. On the initial 20 seeds, supplying tested-candidate history to Qwen2.5-7B shifts its net contribution from +0.35, with a 95% interval covering zero, to +2.90, with the interval above zero. This initial net effect did not persist in a 50-seed matched-quota replication. These results support net gain over an LLM-free loop, measured between separately certified sets, as the appropriate measure of proposer contribution.
2610.24597.affiliation: City University of Hong Kong (Dongguan) / Hong Kong Polytechnic University / Tencent AI Lab / Xinjiang Technical Institute of Physics and Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences
2610.24597.abstract_zh: 语言模型日益指导顺序生物筛选，但原始命中数混淆提议者价值与算法框架发现能力。自适应采样和损坏实验读出，也使常规反馈比较缺少假发现保证。我们提出 CADS，以错误控制框架衡量相对完全相同无语言模型循环的增量价值。结合截断似然比界、e 过程和完整族 e-BH，在所述零假设与损坏条件下，即使任意依赖、自适应采样和可选停止，也控制终止假发现率。在基于 DepMap 的仿真中，它揭露两种评估伪象：无模型框架本身就通过反馈门槛；原始来源计数高估模型贡献，因为模型选择挤占后备发现。初始 20 个种子中，向 Qwen2.5-7B 提供已测试候选历史，把净贡献从 +0.35（95% 区间含零）变为 +2.90（区间高于零）。该初始净效应未在 50 种子、匹配配额的复核中持续。结果支持以独立认证集合间、相对无模型循环的净收益衡量提议者贡献。
2610.24597.update_target: Incremental value of an LLM research proposer
2610.24597.mechanism_en: An identical LLM-free loop and certified sets separate net contribution from displaced fallback discoveries; e-processes control errors under stated assumptions.
2610.24597.result_en: Initial 20-seed history-conditioned gain +2.90 did not persist in a matched-quota 50-seed replication.
2610.24597.boundary_en: DepMap-backed simulations are not wet-lab discovery; theoretical false-discovery control requires the stated null/corruption conditions.

2610.25069.title: Auto-MD-bench: Evaluating Autoresearch Agents for Real-World Medical Tasks
2610.25069.authors: Shenqi Zhou (1 and 2), Qiran Zou (1), Wenhao Zhao (1), Zhenyu Liao (3), Dianbo Liu (1) ((1) National University of Singapore, (2) Zhejiang University, (3) Amazon)
2610.25069.abstract_en: Autonomous agents are increasingly capable of developing machine learning (ML) models end to end. In medical practice, however, strong performance on the target metric does not fully characterize how good the models are in real-world use cases. For example, medical ML models should also provide well-calibrated risk estimates and remain robust across patient populations. Yet autonomous model development is typically guided by task objectives that emphasize simple predictive discrimination (e.g. AUROC). This raises a key question: are these objectives sufficient to guide agents toward models that meet the broader requirements of real-world medical use? In this study, we introduce Auto-MD-bench, a benchmark of 15 real-world medical tasks from 10 clinical datasets, spanning survival analysis, classification and sequential prediction, with external validation across cohorts, hospitals and time periods. We evaluate four agents: AIDE, AI Scientist v2, Codex, and Autoresearch. The strongest agents achieve competitive primary scores, yet their predicted risks are less calibrated than those of the simple baseline models, which could lead to severe medical accidents. Moreover, models with nearly identical primary scores can exhibit markedly different calibration, while performance varies substantially across population shifts. These findings show that primary task performance alone is insufficient to assess autonomous clinical modeling and multiple different metrics widely used in healthcare practice need to be taken into consideration.
2610.25069.affiliation: National University of Singapore / Zhejiang University / Amazon
2610.25069.abstract_zh: 自主智能体越来越能端到端开发机器学习模型，但医学实践中，目标指标表现不能完整刻画真实可用性，还需风险校准与跨人群鲁棒性。自主开发目标通常强调 AUROC 等预测区分度，因此我们问这种目标是否足够引导满足更广医学要求的模型。Auto-MD-bench 包含十个临床数据集的 15 项真实医疗任务，涵盖生存分析、分类和序列预测，并跨队列、医院和时间进行外部验证。我们评估 AIDE、AI Scientist v2、Codex 和 Autoresearch。最强智能体主指标具有竞争力，但预测风险校准不如简单基线，可能造成严重医疗事故；几乎相同主分数的模型校准可明显不同，跨人群分布偏移表现也显著变化。结果表明，仅主任务性能不足以评估自主临床建模，必须考虑医疗实践广用的多种指标。
2610.25069.update_target: Evaluation objectives for autonomous clinical-model development
2610.25069.mechanism_en: External cohort/hospital/time tests separate primary discrimination from calibration and population-shift behavior.
2610.25069.result_en: Four research agents on 15 tasks can achieve competitive main scores yet worse calibration than simple baselines.
2610.25069.boundary_en: This is retrospective benchmark evidence, not observed patient injury or clinical deployment certification.

2610.25114.title: Compile Once, Run Cheap: Frozen, Portable Skills for Embodied Agents, and What Recursive Self-Improvement Adds
2610.25114.authors: Jingwen Bai , Guochao Bai , Canbo Zhang , Shuangqi Li , Minchao Hu , Weichun Huang , Shuang Liu
2610.25114.abstract_en: Embodied AI lacks the data-rich pretraining that gave language models their agents and skills, so new manipulation capability costs demonstrations per task or a frontier model in every episode. We study a third route: a strong general model acts only as an offline author that writes, runs, diagnoses and repairs a manipulation skill in simulation until it passes an exam on layouts drawn after freezing; the frozen skill then runs as code alone or under a cheap caller that reads only its description. We call this skill-level recursive self-improvement Skill-RSI and specify a compile protocol (isolated, audited author; hidden validation layouts; no-feedback and inherit-only controls; tamper-evident ledger) and a reuse protocol that runs the identical files with executors from another model family. On 7 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks with cluttered tables, Claude Code compiled 4 tasks into 7 frozen skills, 5 from a first draft needing only qualification, at USD 4.29-8.22 of author cost each (USD 55 per skill counting the 13 failed campaigns). The other three tasks did not compile in 18 campaigns, including five with GPT-6 and a pre-registered 150-layout run: on the hardest task every campaign scored 78-95 of 100 but had 3-16 safety aborts, failing the gate of 95% success with zero aborts; a 100-episode exam bounds an abort rate only to 3.6%. On hidden layouts, repair that inherits the previous version beat from-scratch rewriting in 8 of 8 controlled campaigns (sign test p = 0.004); an inherit-only lineage attributes most of the gap to inheritance, with development feedback adding a little (3 of 3, p = 0.125). Write-once campaigns found no detectable first-draft effect of practice (minimum detectable effect 14 points). The frozen skills kept 148/150 successes on new layouts with no model and 147/150 with a DeepSeek-flash caller at USD 0.00028-0.00054 per episode; no direct-control baseline was run.
2610.25114.affiliation: Beijing Ou Rui Ling Shi Technology Co., Ltd. / ChangingTek Robotics Technology (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. / Shanghai Yunfan Intelligent Control Robot Technology Co., Ltd.
2610.25114.abstract_zh: 具身人工智能缺少语言模型式数据丰富预训练，因此新增操作能力常需逐任务示范，或每回合调用前沿模型。我们研究第三条路：强通用模型仅作离线作者，在仿真中编写、运行、诊断和修复技能，直到通过冻结后抽样布局的考试；冻结技能随后独立执行，或由只读说明的廉价调用者执行。我们称之为技能层递归自改进 Skill-RSI，规定编译协议，包括隔离审计作者、隐藏验证布局、无反馈和仅继承对照、防篡改账本，以及跨模型家族用相同文件的复用协议。在七项杂乱桌面 RoboTwin 2.0 任务中，Claude Code 将四项编译为七个冻结技能，其中五个首稿只需资格验证；单项作者成本 4.29—8.22 美元，计入 13 次失败活动后每技能 55 美元。另三任务在 18 次活动中未编译成功，包括五次 GPT-6 和预注册 150 布局运行；最难任务每次得分 78—95/100，却有 3—16 次安全中止，未通过成功率 95% 且零中止门槛；100 回合考试也只能将中止率界定到 3.6%。隐藏布局中，继承前版的修复在八项受控活动全部胜过从头重写，符号检验 p=0.004；仅继承谱系表明大部分差距来自继承，开发反馈仅增加少量，三项中三项，p=0.125。一次写入活动未发现练习对首稿的可检测影响，最小可检测效应为 14 个百分点。冻结技能在新布局中无模型达 148/150 成功，使用 DeepSeek-flash 调用者达 147/150，单回合成本 0.00028—0.00054 美元；未运行直接控制基线。
2610.25114.update_target: Frozen robot skills and inheritance/feedback attribution
2610.25114.mechanism_en: Audited offline authors face hidden-layout exams; no-feedback/inherit-only controls separate retained versions, development feedback and caller reuse.
2610.25114.result_en: Seven frozen skills from four tasks retain 148/150 no-model and 147/150 cheap-caller successes; three tasks never compile.
2610.25114.boundary_en: Inheritance explains most controlled gains; added feedback evidence is 3/3 with p=0.125, 100-episode safety bounds remain weak, and no direct-control baseline was run.
2610.25114.source_version_note: Original New-listing abstract retained; PDF v1 identifies manuscript version 3.6 and has a longer abstract including a selection-matched best-of-k result. Do not silently substitute the PDF abstract.

2610.25373.title: MemDerive: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Agent Memory over Evolving Data
2610.25373.authors: Sen Gao , Yongan Li , Han Chen , Bingsheng He , Ming Wu , Jason Zeng , Michael Heinrich , Shixuan Sun
2610.25373.categories_text: Databases (cs.DB) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
2610.25373.abstract_en: Long-running agents rely on memory of their past interactions for task state, such as what has been completed and which conditions still hold. Such state is usually a derived state. No record states it, and it must be computed by rules from multiple records of an evolving history. Existing memory benchmarks score only the final answer, with no reference for the intermediate states behind it. A wrong answer therefore cannot be traced to the state that was missed, and a state that silently became outdated goes undetected. We present MemDerive, a diagnostic benchmark for agent memory over evolving data. It specifies each scenario symbolically, derives exact gold answers with Datalog, records the gold derivation DAG and the supporting events of every query, and renders the history in natural language with fictional entities and distractors. Its 10 scenarios contain 4,692 events and 1,503 queries whose difficulty varies along access, evolution, and composition. On this ground truth, MemDerive evaluates answer reliability, diagnoses failures by probing the nodes of the gold derivation DAG, and tracks whether answers stay correct as events arrive. Our evaluation of four memory systems reveals failures that final-answer benchmarks hide. On derived state, every memory system falls behind simple BM25 retrieval, although the same answer model reaches 96.01% when given the supporting events. Most failures are ungathered, as a system holds the missing intermediate state but does not retrieve it for the question that needs it. Memory systems also rarely propagate implicit changes, which no new record states. These results suggest three principles for memory design. Gather inputs along the derivation, store rules with their versions, and maintain derived states through recorded dependencies.
2610.25373.affiliation: National University of Singapore / Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Zero Gravity Labs
2610.25373.abstract_zh: 长期智能体依赖历史记忆维护已完成事项、仍成立条件等任务状态，但它通常是从多个变化记录按规则计算的派生状态。现有基准只评最终答案，无中间状态参照，错误无法定位，过时状态也可能隐蔽。我们提出 MemDerive，符号化规定场景，以 Datalog 推导精确答案，记录每个查询的真实推导 DAG 和支持事件，再将历史渲染为含虚构实体与干扰项的自然语言。十个场景有 4,692 事件、1,503 查询，难度沿访问、演化和组合变化。基准评估答案可靠性，通过探测推导图节点诊断失败，并追踪新事件到来时是否保持正确。四项记忆系统评估发现，派生状态上全部落后于简单 BM25，但相同回答模型在提供支持事件时达到 96.01%。多数失败因未聚集输入：系统持有缺少的中间状态，却未为所需问题检索；系统也很少传播新记录未显式陈述的隐含变化。结果建议沿推导聚集输入、带版本存规则、通过记录依赖维护派生状态。
2610.25373.update_target: Derived-state memory, retrieval and dependency propagation
2610.25373.mechanism_en: Datalog gold derivation DAGs support node probes and evolving-answer checks, separating absent inputs from failed retrieval.
2610.25373.result_en: Four memory systems trail BM25 on derived state while an answer model given supporting events reaches 96.01%.
2610.25373.boundary_en: Synthetic fictional histories isolate mechanisms but do not establish failure prevalence in deployed agents or prove a particular replacement method.

2610.25858.title: Are Self-Evolving Agents Continual Learners?
2610.25858.authors: Xiaoyin Chen , Yizheng Huang , Yinglun Xu , Ziyun Zhao , Emmett McQuinn , Julie Liu , Hope Yao
2610.25858.abstract_en: Large language model agents are often deployed in environments where new knowledge, tools, and workflows keep arriving. Such an agent is therefore expected to adapt continually, learning new tasks as they arrive without forgetting earlier ones. This resembles the continual learning problem, but at a pace that conventional gradient updates cannot sustain. Nonparametric self-evolving agents are a natural alternative: they adapt by rewriting their own harness, such as prompts, memory, and skills, from task feedback while the model weights stay frozen. We study whether such agents are effective continual learners across four drifting task streams that shift in topic, workflow, or domain (built from BIRD, BFCL, and ScienceWorld). Evaluating three representative methods spanning experience retrieval and self-modification (ReasoningBank, GEPA, and Meta-Harness), we find that although self-evolution improves aggregate performance on most streams, higher plasticity consistently comes at the cost of stability. Specifically, self-modifying methods apply global edits to a shared prompt or workspace, interfering with unseen tasks and overwriting earlier knowledge as the stream shifts. Conversely, similarity-based memory retrieval localizes updates across distant domains, but still retrieves foreign memories on unseen tasks and suffers from retrieval collision when similar queries require conflicting workflows. These findings show that current self-evolving agents remain incomplete continual learners.
2610.25858.affiliation: Mila - Quebec AI Institute / Université de Montréal / Google DeepMind
2610.25858.abstract_zh: 语言模型智能体部署中不断出现新知识、工具和流程，需要持续学习新任务、不遗忘旧任务，类似持续学习，却快到常规梯度更新难以支撑。非参数自进化可在冻结权重时按反馈重写提示、记忆和技能等框架。我们在来自 BIRD、BFCL 和 ScienceWorld 的四条主题、流程或领域漂移任务流中，研究其持续学习能力。评估经验检索和自修改代表 ReasoningBank、GEPA、Meta-Harness 后发现，多数流汇总表现改善，但更高可塑性总以稳定性为代价。自修改方法对共享提示或工作区全局编辑，干扰未见任务，并随流转移覆盖旧知识。相似性检索能跨远领域局部化更新，但仍在未见任务检索外来记忆，相似问题需冲突流程时也发生检索碰撞。当前自进化智能体仍是不完整的持续学习者。
2610.25858.update_target: Continual adaptation versus retention of prior workflows
2610.25858.mechanism_en: Drifting BIRD/BFCL/ScienceWorld streams test frozen-weight prompt/workspace edits and similarity-memory retrieval across unseen/earlier tasks.
2610.25858.result_en: Three representative methods often improve aggregates while trading plasticity against stability; memory retrieval also has collisions.
2610.25858.boundary_en: These results bound evaluated methods/streams, not all possible continual self-evolution.

2610.26020.title: Understanding When Reflective Prompt and Skill Optimization Helps on Locally Served Reasoning Models: A Two-Model Study of GEPA and SkillOpt
2610.26020.authors: Andrea Giummarra (1), Carmelo Baglieri (1), Antonio Di Maria (1), Andrea Farruggio (1), Michele Piatto (1), Giovanni Micale (2)
2610.26020.abstract_en: Reflective text-space optimizers such as GEPA and SkillOpt have reported large gains on frontier and mid-size models. We test replication across two reasoning-native target-serving configurations: DeepSeek V4 Flash through DwarfStar and Qwen3.8-27B through LM Studio. For each target, we evaluate the same held-out tasks and four conditions - minimal baseline, GEPA prompt, SkillOpt skill, and manually engineered prompt - on HotpotQA (n=500 per condition) and MATH-500 (n=250). In the primary Qwen v2 rerun under the same frozen protocol, GEPA selects the HotpotQA seed and exactly reproduces baseline behavior, whereas SkillOpt's validation gain reverses into held-out degradation. On MATH-500, GEPA raises exact match from 0.828 to 0.904 while reducing latency but increasing token consumption, so lower response time does not imply lower token cost. DeepSeek likewise shows its strongest GEPA effect on MATH-500 (0.852 to 0.908). Across both targets, GEPA's strongest gains occur on MATH-500, while neither optimizer improves the HotpotQA baseline. Optimization is therefore task- and method-dependent, and validation gains may reverse on held-out evaluation. An earlier Qwen run is retained as serving-sensitivity evidence. These results suggest that textual headroom for a model-task pair and the observed effect of a text-space optimizer are more informative when decomposed into content/reasoning, answer-realization/evaluator alignment, and serving-completion/reliability. The cross-benchmark pattern further suggests that optimization may benefit from low-ambiguity, actionable evaluation signals.
2610.26020.abstract_zh: GEPA、SkillOpt 等反思式文本空间优化器在前沿及中型模型上报告大收益。我们在两个本地推理模型服务配置复核：DwarfStar 上的 DeepSeek V4 Flash、LM Studio 上的 Qwen3.8-27B。每个目标在相同留出任务上比较最小基线、GEPA 提示、SkillOpt 技能和手工提示四条件，HotpotQA 每条件 500 项、MATH-500 为 250 项。固定协议下主要 Qwen v2 重跑中，GEPA 在 HotpotQA 选中种子，完全复现基线行为，SkillOpt 验证收益反转为留出退化。MATH-500 上，GEPA 将精确匹配从 0.828 提至 0.904，延迟下降但词元增加，响应更快不代表词元更省。DeepSeek 的最强 GEPA 效果也在 MATH-500，从 0.852 至 0.908。两目标均在该任务收益最大，两优化器均未改善 HotpotQA。因此效果依赖任务与方法，验证收益可在留出评估反转。较早 Qwen 运行保留为服务敏感性证据。结果建议将文本改进空间与效果分解为内容/推理、答案实现/评估对齐、服务完成/可靠性；跨基准模式也提示，低歧义、可执行评估信号或更利于优化。
2610.26020.mechanism_en: Frozen held-out protocols compare minimal, GEPA, SkillOpt and hand-engineered prompts under two local serving configurations.
2610.26020.result_en: Qwen MATH exact match rises .828→.904 with GEPA, but HotpotQA does not improve and SkillOpt validation gains can reverse.
2610.26020.boundary_en: Serving sensitivity, latency and token use are distinct; the study is limited to two target configurations.

2610.26062.title: Procedural Exposure Bias in Skill-Augmented Language Model Agents
2610.26062.authors: Qing Yang , Yuqi Xiong , Pengcheng Huang , Zhipeng Xu , Zhenghao Liu , Zulong Chen , Yu Gu , Ge Yu
2610.26062.abstract_en: External skills provide language-model agents with reusable procedural knowledge, yet how models use such knowledge after it is supplied remains poorly understood. We identify Procedural Exposure Bias (PEB), the tendency of language models to increasingly favor an action as its associated procedural pattern is repeatedly exposed in a skill, even when the interaction state and action relevance remain unchanged. We find that PEB strongly depends on how procedural knowledge is represented: presenting the same content visually substantially attenuates exposure-induced shifts in action preference relative to textual presentation. Further analysis shows that this attenuation primarily arises from visual encoding rather than structured layout. Although repeated procedural signals remain recoverable from Visual representations, they exert a weaker influence on downstream action prediction, distinguishing signal accessibility from its use as action evidence. This effect also extends to executable action selection, where increasing exposure more strongly favors the corresponding action under Text than Visual. Layer-wise analyses show that exposure-dependent action evidence becomes more pronounced toward the model output, with stronger evidence under Text, while activation interventions reveal architecture-specific roles of internal components in transmitting or counteracting the preference shift. Complete-agent evaluations across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop further show that Visual skills achieve higher macro-average task success than Text skills for all four evaluated models. These findings establish skill representation as an important factor governing how procedural knowledge is translated into agent decisions. All code is available at this https URL .
2610.26062.abstract_zh: 外部技能提供可复用程序知识，但模型如何使用它仍不清楚。我们识别程序暴露偏差（PEB）：当关联程序模式在技能中反复出现，即使交互状态和动作相关性不变，模型也越来越偏好该动作。偏差强烈依赖表示：相同内容用视觉呈现，比文字显著减弱暴露引起的偏移，主要来自视觉编码而非结构布局。视觉表示仍可恢复重复程序信号，但对后续动作预测影响较弱，说明可访问信号不等于把它用作动作证据。可执行动作选择也有此效应，文字暴露更强地偏向对应动作。逐层分析显示，越接近输出，暴露相关动作证据越明显，文字更强；激活干预揭示内部组件传递或抵消偏移的架构特定作用。ALFWorld、ScienceWorld 和 WebShop 完整智能体评估中，全部四模型的视觉技能宏平均成功率均高于文字技能。技能表示是程序知识转为决策的重要因素，代码见原文链接。
2610.26062.update_target: Action preferences induced by skill representation/exposure
2610.26062.mechanism_en: Hold state/action relevance fixed, vary repeated procedural text versus visual encoding and probe layers/executable action selection.
2610.26062.result_en: Visual skills attenuate exposure bias and improve macro success across four evaluated models.
2610.26062.boundary_en: Accessible procedural signals need not be used as decision evidence; this is a representation/control result rather than a learned self-improvement loop.

2610.26088.title: LeakBench: Auditing Reward Hacking through Prediction-Time Leakage in Clinical Modeling Agents
2610.26088.authors: Xiaoyuan Bao , Jingsi Jiang , Jiao Shan , Yulong Cao , Haoyu Wang , Zida Liu , Jun Gao
2610.26088.abstract_en: Autonomous clinical-modeling agents can optimize predictive performance while violating conditions that make a model usable. We introduce LeakBench, an executable, guideline-derived audit suite that tests agent decisions for prediction-time leakage, calibration, site-level evaluation, support awareness, and decision-curve net benefit. LeakBench combines a synthetic task with known failure structure and two real-data settings: MIMIC-IV (430k admissions) and governed multi-hospital inpatient record front-page (MHFP) data. Our primary analysis uses reward hacking descriptively, without attributing intent: an agent selects prediction-time-invalid inputs because they improve its validation reward. A deterministic optimizer and every evaluated unconstrained local-model configuration select a fatal leaking feature. In fully logged September 2026 A/B runs, DeepSeek Flash and GPT-6-astra each leak in 10/10 unconstrained runs and 0/10 runs with an explicit admission-time constraint. This contrast is version-sensitive: a blinded Claude/Fable-5.1 chat run does not leak in either condition, while explicit-constraint violations appear only in a historical August 2026 slice lacking raw trajectories. Replacing AUROC with AUPRC does not remove leakage selection. Renaming or disguising the leaking inputs changes neither selection nor provenance-based detection; a name-based filter fails. A deterministic provenance verifier-in-loop removes the leak, making the LLM repair loop defense-in-depth. Specific verifier feedback clears fatal leakage in a hosted agent, and a three-seed ablation finds principle-only feedback clears decision-level defects, though these mitigation results are limited. LeakBench treats trustworthy clinical prediction as a property of an agent's modeling process, not merely its score; it is an audit testbed with known-failure controls, not yet an expert-validated benchmark.
2610.26088.affiliation: Peking University / Peking University Third Hospital / Beijing Jishuitan Hospital / Peking University People’s Hospital / Peking University Health Science Center
2610.26088.abstract_zh: 自主临床建模智能体可优化预测分数却违反可用条件。LeakBench 是可执行、指南导出的审计套件，测试预测时泄漏、校准、站点评估、支持感知与决策曲线净收益，结合已知失败结构的合成任务及 MIMIC-IV（43 万入院）和受治理多医院病案首页 MHFP 两种真实数据。主要分析描述性使用“奖励投机”，不归因意图：智能体因验证奖励更高而选择预测时无效输入。确定性优化器和全部所评估无约束本地模型配置都选择致命泄漏特征。完整日志的 2026 年 9 月 A/B 中，DeepSeek Flash 和 GPT-6-astra 各自无约束 10/10 泄漏，显式入院时约束 0/10。对比受版本影响：盲化 Claude/Fable-5.1 对话在两条件均不泄漏，显式约束违反只出现在缺原始轨迹的历史 8 月切片。换 AUROC 为 AUPRC 不能消除选择泄漏；重命名或伪装输入不改变选择及来源检测，而名称过滤失败。确定性来源验证器置于循环中可去除泄漏，模型修复成为纵深防御。具体反馈可清除一个托管智能体的致命泄漏，三种子消融中仅原则反馈可清除决策层缺陷，但缓解证据有限。可信临床预测是建模过程性质而非仅分数；这是有已知失败对照的审计试验床，尚非专家验证基准。
2610.26088.update_target: Prediction-time validity of clinical optimization decisions
2610.26088.mechanism_en: Known-failure controls and provenance verification separate reward-driven leakage from intent; explicit constraints and repair feedback test mitigation.
2610.26088.result_en: Logged September A/B runs show 10/10 versus 0/10 leakage for two agents; other versions/settings behave differently.
2610.26088.boundary_en: Audit testbed is not yet expert-validated; historical runs lacking raw traces and limited mitigation ablations carry weaker evidence.

2610.26416.title: Co-Evolving Policy and Reward for Code Generation: A Mechanistic Study of Single-Adapter Drift
2610.26416.categories_text: Computation and Language (cs.CL) ; Machine Learning (cs.LG); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
2610.26416.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is particularly well suited to code generation because generated programs can be objectively evaluated through execution. Execution also provides behavioral information that can be reused as additional supervision. The Synergistic Policy and Reward Co-Evolving Framework (SPARK), originally proposed for reasoning tasks, exploits this idea by recycling training rollouts and their evaluation results to train a model not only to generate solutions but also to evaluate and improve them. We investigate whether this policy-reward co-evolution approach transfers effectively to code generation and whether execution-grounded reflection provides an additional source of self-improvement. We compare SPARK-style rollout recycling with execution-only Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) using Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct. Our results do not support either hypothesis under the configuration tested. Although co-evolution improves training performance, these gains do not generalize to held-out problems. Compared at the same stage of training, rollout recycling produces roughly 34x greater KL divergence from the reference policy than execution-only GRPO. Over training, trained tokens per GRPO sequence fall from 185 to 86 as training pass rate increases, while held-out performance declines or fails to sustain early gains. We characterize these patterns as single-adapter policy drift: the shared trainable parameters increasingly depart from pretrained code-generation behavior without corresponding gains in generalization. The results show that higher training reward alone is not evidence of generalizable code self-improvement and highlight the importance of held-out evaluation and drift diagnostics.
2610.26416.abstract_zh: 可验证奖励强化学习适于代码生成，因为执行能客观评价程序，也能提供附加监督。最初用于推理的 SPARK 框架回收训练轨迹和评估结果，使模型既生成又评估、改善解答。我们研究策略—奖励共同进化是否有效迁移到代码，以及执行支撑反思能否进一步自改进。用 Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct 比较 SPARK 式轨迹回收与仅执行奖励的 GRPO，所测配置下均未支持两假说。共同进化改善训练表现却不泛化到留出问题；同训练阶段比较，轨迹回收相对参考策略的 KL 散度约为仅执行 GRPO 的 34 倍。训练通过率上升时，每 GRPO 序列训练词元从 185 降至 86，留出表现下降或无法保持早期收益。我们称之为单适配器策略漂移：共享可训练参数偏离预训练代码行为，却无相应泛化收益。更高训练奖励并非可泛化代码自改进证据，强调留出评估和漂移诊断。
2610.26416.mechanism_en: Compare rollout-recycling SPARK-style training and execution-only GRPO with held-out evaluation and KL/token diagnostics.
2610.26416.result_en: Training gains fail to generalize; same-stage KL is roughly 34x larger and trained tokens decline 185→86.
2610.26416.boundary_en: This is a negative result for the tested 3B configuration, not a universal impossibility of policy/reward co-evolution.

2610.26464.title: VerusEval: Evaluating LLM-Generated Verus Specifications Beyond Verifier Acceptance
2610.26464.authors: Ding Wang , Chao Jiang , Dugang Liu , Zhiwu Xu , Cheng Wen , Zhong Ming , Yuwei Liu , Xinyi Wan , Lin Huang
2610.26464.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate Verus contracts for Rust programs together with the proofs that establish them. Yet verifier acceptance, the common measure of success, shows only that the implementation satisfies the generated contract, so it leaves open whether the contract captures the intended behavior. Assessing specification generation therefore requires an evaluation methodology, not a single metric. We present VerusEval, a framework that evaluates generated contracts along six dimensions, including Verus-native checks for semantic triviality, validated input-output (I/O) suites, and contract equivalence, and that relates them so that the strength and blind spots of each become measurable. Evaluating 13,716 artifacts from four workflows, five LLMs, and two prompting settings on 762 tasks, we find that acceptance overstates quality: only 42.3\% of the accepted artifacts complete all three semantic checks without a flag, and across workflows and models, higher acceptance does not consistently come with more correct contracts. I/O evaluation rejects 23.6\% of the accepted artifacts, yet only 63.2\% of those that pass it are proved equivalent. Of the accepted artifacts flagged by contract comparison, 84.1\% have a rejected completeness obligation, and the direction of a failure prioritizes inspection of the generated contract or the reference; it does not by itself establish which artifact is defective. Screening and review further identify 36 candidate defects among 61 selected reference contracts, and repairing one of them makes 10 of its 11 failing artifacts equivalent. Based on these findings, we derive four actionable lessons for evaluation, generation, and benchmark maintenance.
2610.26464.affiliation: Shenzhen University / Ant Research, Ant Group
2610.26464.abstract_zh: 语言模型越来越用于为 Rust 程序生成 Verus 契约及证明，但验证器通过只说明实现满足所生成契约，无法说明契约表达了预期行为。我们提出 VerusEval，从六个维度评估契约，包括 Verus 原生语义空洞检查、验证过的输入输出套件和契约等价性，并关联各维度以测量能力与盲点。在 762 任务、四工作流、五模型、两提示设置的 13,716 产物上，通过率高估质量：仅 42.3% 获准产物完成三种语义检查且无标记；跨工作流和模型，更高通过率并不稳定对应更正确契约。输入输出评估拒绝 23.6% 获准产物，但通过者仅 63.2% 被证明等价。在契约比较标记的获准产物中，84.1% 的完整性义务被拒；失败方向能优先引导检查生成契约或参考，却不能单独确定哪方有缺陷。进一步筛查审阅，在选中 61 个参考契约中识别 36 个候选缺陷，修复其中一个使其 11 项失败产物中的十项等价。由此提出评估、生成和基准维护的四条实践经验。
2610.26464.update_target: Semantic quality of generated formal contracts
2610.26464.mechanism_en: Six evaluation dimensions combine triviality checks, validated I/O and contract equivalence; direction guides review of generated and reference artifacts.
2610.26464.result_en: Only 42.3% of accepted artifacts pass all three semantic checks without a flag across 13,716 artifacts.
2610.26464.boundary_en: A flagged equivalence obligation does not identify which contract is wrong; candidate reference defects require review.

2610.26503.title: ScopeMem: Latent Memory That Learns Where to Revise Frozen GUI Agents
2610.26503.authors: Zhicheng Zheng , Cheng Zhang , Shengping Yu , Tianxiang Zhao
2610.26503.abstract_en: Latent memory is gaining ground as a lightweight history supplement for GUI agents. It supplies history to a frozen vision-language model via prefix vectors trained with step-wise cross-entropy (CE). While resulting gains are naturally attributed to encoded history, our controlled experiments show they primarily stem from action revision. The prefix learns to alter the model's default actions. However, this revision is unscoped because step-wise CE pushes outputs toward reference actions at every step without explicitly preserving correct decisions. Consequently, it repairs errors but also breaks 8-13% of initially correct answers. Overall accuracy metrics hide these losses. We therefore propose ScopeMem, a latent-memory method for scoped revision. Its encoder conditions prefix generation on the model's initial answer and is trained to correct errors while preserving correct decisions. On the controlled ablation set, ScopeMem reduces the share of broken correct decisions to 5.6% while repairing more errors than any evaluated CE-trained prefix. On AndroidControl, GUI-Odyssey, and zero-shot AITW, ScopeMem outperforms all evaluated prompting and latent-memory baselines, enabling a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B to match or surpass GUI-specialized agents and Qwen3-VL-32B.
2610.26503.affiliation: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou) / Imperial College London
2610.26503.abstract_zh: 潜在记忆作为 GUI 智能体的轻量历史补充，通过逐步交叉熵训练的前缀向量向冻结视觉语言模型提供历史。收益常被归因于历史编码，但受控实验显示主要来自动作修订：前缀改变默认动作。逐步交叉熵在每步推向参考动作，不显式保护正确决策，因此修错也破坏 8%—13% 原本正确答案，整体准确率掩盖损失。我们提出 ScopeMem，让编码器以模型初始答案为条件生成前缀，训练时纠错并保留正确决策。在受控消融集，将正确决策破坏比例降至 5.6%，同时修复错误多于全部所评估交叉熵前缀。在 AndroidControl、GUI-Odyssey 和零样本 AITW 上，优于全部所评估提示与潜在记忆基线，让冻结 Qwen3-VL-8B 达到或超过 GUI 专用智能体及 Qwen3-VL-32B。
2610.26503.update_target: Trained latent prefixes around a frozen GUI model
2610.26503.mechanism_en: Condition prefix generation on the initial answer and train explicit correction plus preservation, separating useful history from default-action revision.
2610.26503.result_en: Controlled broken-correct rate falls from CE-prefix 8–13% to 5.6% while repairing more errors; three GUI benchmarks improve.
2610.26503.boundary_en: A frozen backbone does not mean training-free; prefixes are learned and aggregate accuracy must be paired with corrections/regressions.

2610.26662.title: AllPath: Layered Verification for a Deployed, Self-Revising LLM Trading Agent under Human-Gated and Autonomous Regimes
2610.26662.abstract_en: LLM trading agents are evaluated almost exclusively in backtests and autonomous benchmark harnesses. Deployment, where actions are irreversible, raises a different question: who verifies the agent's actions, and which failures can each verifier structurally catch? We report on AllPath, a personal LLM trading agent deployed against a live paper-brokerage account. The system watches positions through a deterministic rules engine, and each night it reviews its own day and proposes revisions to its own trading strategies. Verification is split across three layers. Code verifies what must not depend on judgment: deterministic gates enforce risk limits and block any strategy revision that fails an integrity check. The agent verifies itself within fixed bounds: its nightly review has an iteration cap and no tools that can act. A human verifies judgment, through approval screens that show the current state of each proposal. We also compared two verification policies for the agent's self-revisions on the live system: two and a half weeks with every self-revision human-gated, then five weeks with reflection revisions auto-applied behind the same code gates, while the operator's chat channel stayed human-gated throughout.
