Each layer caught a different kind of failure. The code gates rejected no proposal; their role was keeping revisions consistent. The human rejected two proposals that passed every code check, both over a disagreement about the market, and later removed 11 of the 19 rules the agent had added on its own, at a median lag of eight days. The most instructive production incidents, such as strategies silently left unmonitored, passed every gate; the operator found them by hand, and the fix each time was an interface change that makes the condition visible. We contribute the layered architecture, the two-regime account, and a production incident taxonomy, none observable in a backtest.
2610.26662.abstract_zh: 语言模型交易智能体几乎只在回测和自主基准中评估，但动作不可逆的部署提出谁验证动作、各验证器结构上能捕捉哪些失败的问题。我们报告 AllPath，一个连接实时纸面交易账户的个人智能体。确定性规则引擎监控持仓，每晚智能体审查当天并提议修改策略。验证分三层：代码确定性执行风险限制，拒绝不通过完整性检查的修改；智能体在固定边界内自审，夜间审查有迭代上限且无行动工具；人工通过展示提案当前状态的审批界面验证判断。比较实时系统上两种政策：两周半所有自修改人工批准，随后五周反思修改在相同代码门控后自动应用，操作者聊天通道全程仍需人工批准。各层捕捉不同失败：代码未拒绝任何提议，其作用是保持一致；人工因市场判断分歧拒绝两个通过所有代码检查的提议，后来删除智能体自行添加 19 条规则中的 11 条，中位延迟八天。最有启发的生产事故如策略悄然不受监控，均通过所有门槛，由人工发现，每次修复是使条件可见的接口修改。贡献是分层架构、两运行制度记录和生产事故分类，这些无法在回测中观察。
2610.26662.mechanism_en: Deterministic integrity/risk gates, bounded non-acting reflection and human approval supervise a live paper-brokerage agent.
2610.26662.result_en: Human review rejects two code-valid proposals and later removes 11/19 self-added rules; incidents motivate visibility changes.
2610.26662.boundary_en: This is paper trading, not real-money profit evidence; sequential 2.5/5-week regimes are not a randomized causal comparison.

2610.26848.title: Where is Physical RSI capability from? An Observational Scaling Law of LLM-as-policy
2610.26848.authors: Zekai Li , Jiayi Yu , Jinlu Zhang , Luyang Niu , Zekun Qi , Jun Zheng , Xuchuan Chen , Dairu Liu , Yintianrun Zhang , He Wang , Li Yi
2610.26848.categories_text: Robotics (cs.RO) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
2610.26848.abstract_en: In this paper, we systematically investigate the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and generalization of physical Recursive self-improvement. We introduce PhysRSI-eval to quantify physical RSI through a five-axis metric: First-Attempt Performance, Efficiency, Success, Budget and Improvement from failure. Different VLMs are evaluated on 18 manipulation tasks under a fixed interaction budget. The analysis of experimental results motivates the Physical Barrel Hypothesis: different capabilities may constrain different parts of improvement. The five-axis metrics also distinguish systems with close public benchmark averages and show that high scores need not come with early or efficient gains. We study observational scaling from two perspectives: predicting the relative performance of VLM agents from their public capabilities, and forecasting later progress from early physical feedback. Together, these analyses ask how quickly and how far an agent can improve. Moreover, we conduct workspace interventions and then analyze what improvement leaves behind. Removing history reduces late-round success, frozen workspaces remain useful on unseen layouts, and three cross-task cases achieve success earlier. The results suggest that scene-specific adaptation and reusable experience can coexist.
2610.26848.abstract_zh: 我们系统研究物理递归自我改进的机制、缩放行为和泛化，提出 PhysRSI-eval，以首次表现、效率、成功、预算及从失败中改进五轴量化物理 RSI。在固定交互预算下，对不同视觉语言模型评估 18 项操作任务。结果分析提出物理木桶假说：不同能力可能限制改进的不同部分。五轴也区分公开基准均分相近的系统，表明高分未必伴随早期或高效收益。我们从两方面研究观测缩放：用公开能力预测 VLM 智能体相对表现，以及用早期物理反馈预测后续进展，考察改进多快、多远。我们还干预工作区并分析改进留下什么：移除历史降低后期成功率，冻结工作区在未见布局仍有用，三个跨任务案例更早成功。结果提示场景特定适配和可复用经验可以并存。
2610.26848.update_target: Measured physical-agent adaptation and retained workspace experience
2610.26848.mechanism_en: A fixed budget and five axes compare 18 manipulation tasks; history removal, frozen-workspace reuse and cross-task cases probe retained effects.
2610.26848.result_en: Authors report observational prediction of relative/later progress and useful retained workspaces on unseen layouts.
2610.26848.boundary_en: The inspected workspace study uses RoboDojo simulation, not a physical robot; observational scaling is not a causal law and three cross-task cases are narrow transfer evidence.

supplementary_evidence.quotation: All rounds are RoboDojo simulation episodes with native grading.
supplementary_evidence.scope: Workspace-intervention experiment; simulation rather than a physical-robot claim.

2610.27417.title: KPHarness: Co-Evolving Knowledge and Probing for Long-Horizon Gaming Harnesses
2610.27417.authors: Zhikang Chen , Yueqing Sun , Sen Cui , Ziang Ye , Yu Wang , Yan Feng2 , Xierui Song , Yu Zhang , Tingting Zhu
2610.27417.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
2610.27417.abstract_en: A failed gaming trajectory reveals that an agent needs intervention, but not necessarily how its execution harness should change. Effective harness adaptation therefore requires gathering diagnostic evidence, rather than merely proposing alternative recovery rules. We present KPHarness, a framework that adapts the external execution harness of a frozen vision-language-action model through knowledge-probing co-evolution. Recovery knowledge supplies context-specific intervention hypotheses that guide active probing; probe outcomes reveal when these hypotheses apply and provide evidence for refining both recovery knowledge and later probe selection. This reciprocal process allows the harness to improve not only which interventions it applies, but also how it investigates failures. KPHarness separates fast policy execution from a slow research loop that translates accumulated knowledge and probing evidence into bounded harness revisions. Each revision is compared with the incumbent under matched sandbox conditions and accepted only when the paired evaluation shows improvement. Recoveries supported by further validation are retained for cross-task reuse, while immediate interaction feedback and delayed episode-success credit update action- and knowledge-probing policies during adaptation. Experiments on Minecraft tasks spanning mining, combat, and crafting show improved task coverage over bare policy execution, a manually specified fixed harness, and knowledge-only harness evolution with non-adaptive probing. Evaluation on previously unseen tasks further shows improved task completion with the evolved harness, knowledge bank, and probing policies held fixed,
2610.27417.affiliation: University of Oxford / Meituan / Tsinghua University / Southern University of Science and Technology
2610.27417.abstract_zh: 失败的游戏轨迹表明智能体需要干预，却未必说明运行框架应如何变化。有效适配需要收集诊断证据，而非仅提出替代恢复规则。我们提出 KPHarness，通过知识—探测共同进化，适配冻结视觉语言动作模型的外部执行框架。恢复知识提供上下文特定干预假说，指导主动探测；探测结果揭示适用条件，为细化知识及后续探测选择提供证据。该相互促进过程不仅改善干预，也改善调查失败的方式。KPHarness 将快速策略执行与缓慢研究循环分开，后者把累积知识和探测证据转为有界框架修改。每项修改在匹配沙盒条件下与现行版本比较，只有配对评估改善才接纳。进一步验证支持的恢复策略被保留供跨任务复用；即时交互反馈与延迟回合成功信用，在适配中更新动作探测及知识探测策略。在 Minecraft 挖矿、战斗、合成任务上，相对裸策略、人工固定框架和非自适应探测的仅知识进化，任务覆盖提高。在此前未见任务上，冻结进化框架、知识库和探测策略时，任务完成也提高。
2610.27417.update_target: External game harness, recovery knowledge and probing policies
2610.27417.mechanism_en: Context-specific hypotheses guide active probes; matched sandbox comparisons gate revisions, and validated recoveries support frozen cross-task reuse.
2610.27417.result_en: Minecraft mining/combat/crafting coverage improves over bare, fixed and knowledge-only harness baselines, including unseen tasks.
2610.27417.boundary_en: Frozen base VLA weights are distinct from updated probing policies; game-world evidence does not establish physical-robot or unbounded RSI capability.

2610.27435.title: Harness Self-Evolution for Long-Horizon Terminal Agents
2610.27435.authors: Ruhan Wang , Yucheng Shi , Zongxia Li , Junyao Yang , Zhongzhi Li , Yue Yu , Haitao Mi , Dongruo Zhou , Leoweiliang
2610.27435.abstract_en: Long-horizon terminal agents may solve a task in one run yet fail across repeated runs. Stochastic errors can propagate through actions and context, creating a gap between capability and reliable execution. We present RiseHarness, a framework for iteratively improving agent harnesses with model weights fixed. It focuses on flipping tasks with both successful and failed runs under the same configuration, using successful runs as references for failure analysis. RiseHarness combines agent trajectories with internal harness traces from a runtime monitor to examine how model actions interact with command execution, feedback, context management, and completion decisions. A Harness Handbook links this evidence to harness behaviors and source code, helping identify recurring problems in mechanisms shared across tasks. RiseHarness then searches other harness frameworks for relevant implementations and adapts them as design references to the current model and execution protocol. Candidate changes undergo behavioral checks and repeated task evaluation; versions with measured gains seed the next iteration. This loop integrates suitable mechanisms from different frameworks into a single harness and uses new execution evidence to guide further changes. We evaluate task success and reliability across models, ablate harness execution evidence and external research, and test transfer to unseen benchmarks with the same model. RiseHarness treats a specific model as the unit of harness adaptation, studying how changes to shared interaction mechanisms can make existing capabilities more reliable across tasks.
2610.27435.affiliation: Tencent HY LLM Frontier / Indiana University / University of Maryland, College Park / University of Georgia / National University of Singapore
2610.27435.abstract_zh: 长时程终端智能体可能一次成功，却在重复执行中失败。随机错误沿动作与上下文传播，使能力与可靠执行存在差距。我们提出 RiseHarness，在固定模型权重下迭代改进框架，聚焦相同配置中既成功又失败的翻转任务，用成功执行作失败分析参考。它结合智能体轨迹和运行时监控器的内部框架轨迹，研究模型动作与命令执行、反馈、上下文管理及完成决策的交互。框架手册将证据关联到框架行为和源码，识别跨任务共享机制的重复问题。随后搜索其他框架的相关实现，按当前模型和执行协议改造成设计参考。候选通过行为检查和重复任务评估，有实测收益的版本进入下一轮。循环将不同框架的合适机制整合到一个框架，并由新证据指导后续变化。我们跨模型评估成功与可靠性，消融框架执行证据和外部研究，并用相同模型测试未见基准迁移。RiseHarness 将具体模型作为框架适配单位，研究共享交互机制变化如何跨任务提高已有能力的可靠性。
2610.27435.update_target: Shared terminal harness code and an evidence-linked handbook
2610.27435.mechanism_en: Repeated flipping-task runs and runtime traces diagnose mechanisms; external implementation research supplies candidates, behavioral/repeated checks gate next parents.
2610.27435.result_en: Authors evaluate reliability, success, component ablations and same-model transfer to unseen benchmarks.
2610.27435.boundary_en: No numerical headline is given in the abstract; a more reliable fixed-model harness is not necessarily expanded model capability or a better improver.
2610.27435.source_version_note: Full original New-listing abstract retained; PDF v1 has a longer abstract with the same mechanism. No silent replacement with PDF wording.

2610.27495.title: Self-Evolving Agents through Privileged Retrospective Distillation
2610.27495.authors: Yuhang Zhou , Yifan Wu , Bo Peng , Mingyi Wang , Jiayi Liu , Xiangjun Fan , Lizhu Zhang , Zhuokai Zhao
2610.27495.categories_text: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2610.27495.abstract_en: Self-evolving agents aim to improve from their own experience rather than remain fixed after deployment, but naturally collected trajectories often lack ground-truth solutions or verifier-derived rewards. We introduce Retrospective Self-Distillation (RSD), a multi-round framework that turns such experience into dense supervision using privileged retrospective context. For each on-policy trajectory, the same underlying model acts as both student and teacher: the teacher re-scores the student's realized actions while conditioning on cross-task precedents and lessons, together with turn-level reflection and future hindsight from the completed trajectory. The resulting teacher distribution is distilled back into the policy through on-policy self-distillation. Across rounds, the experience bank grows and the retrospective context is refreshed, allowing the model, its data, and its supervision to co-evolve. We further introduce frontier-guided context-policy evolution, where a stronger frontier model proposes constrained edits to how privileged context is constructed. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and SearchQA with Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B, RSD improves performance by up to 59.7% relative to the base model, while frontier-guided context-policy evolution adds up to a further 44.7% relative improvement over a fixed context policy. These results show that naturally accumulated experience can be converted into persistent model capability without ground-truth trajectories or verifier-derived rewards for the core policy update.
2610.27495.abstract_zh: 自进化智能体希望从自身经验改进，而非部署后固定，但自然收集轨迹常缺真实解答或验证器奖励。我们提出多轮回顾自蒸馏 RSD，用特权回顾上下文将经验转为稠密监督。每条同策略轨迹中，相同基础模型同时作学生和教师：教师在跨任务先例与教训、逐轮反思和完整轨迹未来后见信息条件下，对学生已实现动作重新评分，再通过同策略自蒸馏将教师分布蒸馏回策略。跨轮经验库增长、回顾上下文刷新，让模型、数据和监督共同进化。我们还引入前沿模型引导的上下文策略进化，由更强模型对特权上下文构建提出受约束修改。在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、SearchQA 上用 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-14B，RSD 相对基础模型最多提高 59.7%，前沿指导相对固定上下文策略再最多提高 44.7%。自然累积经验可转为持久模型能力，核心策略更新无需真实轨迹或验证器奖励。
2610.27495.update_target: Policy weights, growing experience bank and context-construction policy
2610.27495.mechanism_en: The same model re-scores realized actions with privileged retrospective context; self-distillation updates policy, while an optional frontier model edits context policy.
2610.27495.result_en: RSD reports up to 59.7% relative gain over base; frontier-guided context evolution adds up to 44.7% relative over a fixed policy.
2610.27495.boundary_en: Relative percentages are not percentage points; privileged hindsight and stronger external-model guidance differ from autonomous self-supervision.

2610.28069.title: Training the Whole Agent, Not Just the Model
2610.28069.authors: Lingxiao Tang , Wei Tao , Yiwen Guo , Lingfeng Bao
2610.28069.abstract_en: Training coding agents typically updates the policy while keeping the harness fixed. During training, trajectories reveal flawed repair strategies and interaction problems that vary across tasks and change as the policy learns. We introduce HarnessAdapt-RL, which trains the policy and adapts its harness during reinforcement learning. For flawed repair strategies, a frozen teacher generates task-specific mechanism-level skills. For interaction problems recurring across tasks, a separate teacher model evolves tools and hooks, keeping each change only if it improves the observed pass rate or the observed trainable rate without lowering either. The policy trains with the adapted harness, and its new trajectories guide further adaptation. With a 9B base model, HarnessAdapt-RL improves pass@1 over GRPO by 9.8, 12.6, and 6.4 percentage points on SWE-bench Verified, Multilingual, and Pro, and outperforms GRPO with the human-designed OpenHands harness. Gains from mechanism-level skills persist after their removal at evaluation. Re-evolving tools and hooks as the policy changes outperforms freezing early versions. Removing them at deployment, in contrast, costs up to 7.7 percentage points. Training therefore produces a model-harness pair: the trained policy and the evolved tools and hooks, with skills removed at deployment.
2610.28069.abstract_zh: 编码智能体训练通常更新策略、固定框架，但训练轨迹揭示错误修复策略和交互问题，它们跨任务不同，也随策略学习变化。HarnessAdapt-RL 在强化学习中训练策略并适配框架：冻结教师为错误修复策略生成任务特定机制级技能，另一个教师为跨任务重复交互问题进化工具和钩子，只有观察到通过率或可训练率提高且两者均不下降才保留。策略在适配框架下训练，新轨迹继续指导适配。9B 基础模型在 SWE-bench Verified、Multilingual、Pro 上比 GRPO 的 pass@1 分别高 9.8、12.6、6.4 个百分点，也优于配人工 OpenHands 框架的 GRPO。机制级技能在评估移除后收益仍持续；随策略变化重新进化工具和钩子优于冻结早期版本，但部署时移除它们最多损失 7.7 个百分点。因此训练产物是模型—框架对：训练策略与进化工具、钩子，部署时移除技能。
2610.28069.update_target: RL policy weights, mechanism skills, tools and hooks
2610.28069.mechanism_en: Frozen teachers propose skills and cross-task interface changes; pass/trainable-rate non-regression gates updates and new policy trajectories guide the next round.
2610.28069.result_en: A 9B model gains 9.8/12.6/6.4 pass@1 points versus GRPO on three SWE benchmarks; removing evolved tools/hooks costs up to 7.7 points.
2610.28069.boundary_en: Skill internalization does not imply tool/hook internalization; deploy the trained model-harness pair and include separate-teacher/search costs.

2610.28201.title: MaD-RSI: Model-as-Data for Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
2610.28201.authors: Yu Cui , Hong He , Ruiqing Yue , Sicheng Pan , Zhuoyu Sun , Yifei Liu , Ting Li , Wenzhuo Zhu , Baohan Huang , Haibin Zhang , Cong Zuo
2610.28201.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) of agent harnesses has emerged as an effective approach to enhancing the capabilities of large language model (LLM) agents. By searching the harness space for a specific LLM on a given dataset, RSI can discover a harness tailored to the capabilities and behavioral characteristics of that model. However, such optimization often creates a strong coupling between the learned harness and its target LLM, limiting generalization across models and requiring substantial computational resources to adapt to new LLMs. Moreover, existing RSI methods typically optimize a harness using feedback from a single model and evaluate its generalization to other models only after training. This paradigm treats model differences primarily as a criterion for evaluating generalization rather than as valuable evidence for optimization. In this paper, we introduce a new perspective that treats models as data and places the harness at the center of optimization. Building on this perspective, we propose \textsc{MaD-RSI}, a framework that directly optimizes a shared harness across multiple heterogeneous LLMs by incorporating their diverse failure trajectories into the training process. Rather than assessing model differences only after optimization, \textsc{MaD-RSI} leverages these differences as training evidence to guide the self-improvement of a shared harness. Furthermore, we introduce a new evaluation framework with two complementary metrics designed to assess the effectiveness of harness optimization across models. Experiments across multiple datasets and LLMs demonstrate that \textsc{MaD-RSI} improves generalization over existing approaches while reducing training costs.
2610.28201.affiliation: Beijing Institute of Technology / Tsinghua University / Chengdu Institute of Computer Applications, Chinese Academy of Sciences / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences / Beijing University of Technology / Yangtze Delta Region Institute of Tsinghua University, Zhejiang / Jiaxing Key Laboratory of Artificial Intelligence and Cyber Resilience
2610.28201.abstract_zh: 智能体运行框架的递归自我改进（RSI）通过在给定数据集上为特定语言模型搜索框架，发现适应其能力和行为的设计。但框架与目标模型常强耦合，跨模型泛化受限，新模型适配成本高。现有方法通常只用单模型反馈优化，训练后才评其他模型，把差异当作泛化评估标准而非优化证据。我们提出“模型即数据”视角，以框架为优化中心，构建 MaD-RSI，将多个异构模型的不同失败轨迹纳入训练，直接联合优化共享框架，而非仅在优化后检查模型差异。我们还提出两个互补指标，评估跨模型框架优化有效性。跨数据集和模型实验显示，MaD-RSI 相对现有方法改善泛化并减少训练成本。
2610.28201.update_target: A shared external harness across heterogeneous LLMs
2610.28201.mechanism_en: Diverse model-specific failure trajectories become optimization evidence; two complementary metrics assess cross-model effectiveness.
2610.28201.result_en: Multiple datasets/models show reported generalization and training-cost gains over earlier approaches.
2610.28201.boundary_en: The abstract supplies no numerical headline; cross-model training coverage must be separated from genuinely unseen-model transfer.

2610.28282.title: ChartEvo: Self-Evolving Agent Harnesses for Long-Tail Chart Reasoning
2610.28282.authors: Qi Wang , Peijie Wang , Jun Cao , Haoyang Tong , Xiao-Hui Li , Fei Yin , Cheng-Lin Liu
2610.28282.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
2610.28282.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially advanced chart understanding and reasoning, yet their performance remains highly uneven across chart types. While modern MLLMs perform well on common charts, their accuracy drops sharply on long-tail charts with diverse visual structures and reasoning requirements. Tool-augmented agents can improve complex chart reasoning by introducing specialized visual capabilities, but manually engineering strategies and tools for the heterogeneous and evolving long tail is difficult to scale. We introduce \textbf{ChartEvo}, a recursive self-improvement framework that enables chart agents to adapt to underperforming chart types through experience-driven harness-level self-improvement. ChartEvo jointly evolves reusable chart-specific Skills and executable Tools, while learning reusable local tool-call chains to compose evolved capabilities and control the inference overhead of tool-augmented reasoning. On long-tail charts from ChartBench and ChartX, ChartEvo improves accuracy over its base MLLM, Qwen3.7-Plus, by \textbf{45.6\%} and \textbf{32.5\%}, respectively, demonstrating the effectiveness of recursive self-improvement for long-tail chart adaptation.
2610.28282.affiliation: CASIA / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences / Zhongguancun Academy
2610.28282.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型推动图表理解，但不同图表类型表现不均，长尾图表视觉结构和推理需求多样，准确率明显下降。工具智能体可改善复杂推理，但人工为异质、变化的长尾编写策略和工具难扩展。我们提出 ChartEvo，让智能体从经验出发，在表现不足的图表类型上递归自改进框架。它联合进化可复用图表技能和可执行工具，并学习局部工具调用链，以组合进化能力、控制工具增强推理开销。在 ChartBench 和 ChartX 长尾图表上，相对基础 Qwen3.7-Plus，准确率分别提高 45.6% 和 32.5%，展示递归自改进对长尾适配的有效性。
2610.28282.update_target: Chart skills, executable tools and local call chains
2610.28282.mechanism_en: Experience targets weak chart types, evolving reusable capabilities and their composition while controlling inference overhead.
2610.28282.result_en: Relative to Qwen3.7-Plus, ChartBench/ChartX long-tail accuracy improves by reported 45.6%/32.5%.
2610.28282.boundary_en: The abstract does not label these as percentage-point changes; no model-weight update or unbounded recursive gain is established.

2610.28380.title: Object-Oriented Harness: Evolving Agent Harnesses through Object-Oriented Design
2610.28380.authors: Gaotang Li , Bhavana Dalvi Mishra , Yifei Ming , Yanfei Chen , Zhongying CuiZhu , Lesly Miculicich , Long T. Le , Rui Meng , Chun-Liang Li , Hanghang Tong , Chen-Yu Lee , Tomas Pfister
2610.28380.abstract_en: Agent harnesses are executable code that specifies the prompts, tools, and control flow around a language model. A single global harness can struggle with heterogeneous tasks that require different execution strategies. In this work, we introduce Object-Oriented Harness (OO-Harness), a harness optimization framework that evolves a hierarchy of executable harness classes using object-oriented design. During training, an evolution agent uses execution records to create a family of specialized harnesses, each implemented as a subclass of the base or an existing specialized harness via inheritance. At test time, a harness router uses routing lessons accumulated during training to select a specific harness for each task. Across three long-horizon benchmarks spanning business workflows, workspace tasks, and tool use, OO-Harness achieves the best performance among the compared methods, with an absolute improvement of up to 15% over the base. Extensive ablation studies examine the contributions of its core components.
2610.28380.affiliation: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign / Google Cloud AI Research
2610.28380.abstract_zh: 智能体框架是规定语言模型周围提示、工具和控制流的可执行代码。单一全局框架难满足异质任务的不同策略。我们提出面向对象框架 OO-Harness，以面向对象设计进化可执行框架类层级。训练时，进化智能体依据执行记录，通过继承基础类或既有专用类，创建一组专用子类。测试时，路由器依据训练累积的路由教训为每项任务选具体框架。在商业流程、工作区和工具使用三个长时程基准上，OO-Harness 在比较方法中最好，相对基础最高绝对改善 15%。大量消融研究核心组件贡献。
2610.28380.update_target: A hierarchy of executable harness subclasses and routing lessons
2610.28380.mechanism_en: Execution evidence creates inherited specialized classes; a test-time router uses accumulated lessons to select a task-specific harness.
2610.28380.result_en: Three workflow/workspace/tool benchmarks show the strongest compared performance, with up to 15% absolute improvement.
2610.28380.boundary_en: The comparison is conditional on evaluated tasks/router; class inheritance alone does not demonstrate an improved improvement procedure.

2610.28386.title: VisualEvolve: A Skill Self-Evolution Framework for Visual Reasoning
2610.28386.authors: Jiawei Wang , Yucun Li , Xueqi Li , Shenghao Wang , Xinquan Gong , Dan Zhang , Zheqi Lv , Yuquan Le , Shaozu Yuan , An Zhang , Da Cao , Tat-Seng Chua
2610.28386.categories_text: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
2610.28386.abstract_en: Visual tool use enables vision-language models (VLMs) to acquire task-relevant evidence, but its effectiveness can be limited by predefined visual operations and the tool-use strategies learned during training. Representing these operations and strategies as reusable external skills allows them to be refined through self-evolution without updating model parameters. However, skill refinement can introduce performance regressions. Meanwhile, inspecting accumulated task execution trajectories together with skill evolution history may lead to evolution evidence overload. To address these challenges, we propose VisualEvolve, a self-evolving framework that evolves executable visual operations and tool-use strategies for VLMs through a Select--Execute--Evolve--Evaluate cycle. Skill-Library Snapshot Selection uses performance on a fixed validation set disjoint from execution tasks to select an effective historical snapshot for subsequent evolution, limiting the propagation of performance regressions. Progressive Evidence Access (PEA) guides capability-gap diagnosis through a coarse-to-fine hierarchy comprising the Skill-Performance Report, Evolution Log, Trajectory Summaries, and relevant raw trajectory segments. Across four VLM backbones and six evaluation sets from three benchmarks, VisualEvolve improves over the Initial Skill Library in 23 of 24 settings, with a maximum gain of 15.1 percentage points on VisualProbe Hard using Qwen3.5-Plus. Ablation studies support the contributions of Snapshot Selection and PEA, while further experiments show that skills can be improved using experience from different data settings and directly reused across backbones. Moreover, VisualEvolve enables effective skill self-evolution with over an order of magnitude fewer task-solving trajectories than estimated for representative RL-based methods.
2610.28386.affiliation: National University of Singapore / Hunan University / Shenzhen University / Cornell University / Hunan Normal University / Meituan / University of Science and Technology of China
2610.28386.abstract_zh: 视觉工具让视觉语言模型获取任务证据，但效果受预定义视觉操作和训练中学到的策略限制。将它们表示为外部技能，可在不更新参数的情况下自进化，但修改可能回归，累积执行轨迹与进化历史也可能导致证据过载。我们提出 VisualEvolve，通过选择—执行—进化—评估循环进化视觉操作与工具策略。技能库快照选择在与执行任务不相交的固定验证集上选择有效历史快照，限制回归传播；渐进证据访问 PEA 按技能表现报告、进化日志、轨迹摘要及相关原始片段，从粗到细诊断能力缺口。在四个视觉语言模型、三个基准的六个评估集上，24 设置中 23 个优于初始库，Qwen3.5-Plus 在 VisualProbe Hard 最高提高 15.1 个百分点。消融支持快照选择与 PEA，额外实验显示不同数据经验可改进技能，并跨主干直接复用。相对代表性强化学习方法的估计，任务求解轨迹少一个数量级以上仍能有效自进化。
2610.28386.update_target: External visual operations, strategies and library snapshots
2610.28386.mechanism_en: A fixed execution-disjoint validation set selects historical snapshots; progressive access to reports/logs/trajectories guides gap diagnosis and later evolution.
2610.28386.result_en: 23/24 settings improve, with a 15.1-point maximum; skills show direct cross-backbone reuse.
2610.28386.boundary_en: Repeated fixed-validation selection can still overfit; the over-order-of-magnitude RL trajectory comparison is estimated, not a matched full-cost reproduction.

2610.28577.title: Cache Engineering for Agents
2610.28577.authors: Tianyu Fu , Ruoxi Wang , Zihan Min , Zhongqi Ren , Zhihao Li , Tengxuan Liu , Shengxu Mu , Hanling Zhang , Yu Wang
2610.28577.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents can handle increasingly complex tasks, navigating long trajectories of observations and actions. As these trajectories grow, key-value (KV) cache I/O and storage become the dominant cost. Trajectories can also exceed the LLM's maximum context length, requiring control over active cache growth. Prior work uses context engineering to reduce cache size by trimming or summarizing history. However, modifying the trajectory prefix invalidates subsequent cached states and triggers costly re-prefilling of retained context. Task accuracy can also suffer when too little context is retained to limit re-prefill costs. We propose cache engineering as a new scheme. It allows agents to directly control their active KV cache without modifying the trajectory or re-prefilling retained context. Specifically, agents can proactively use drop to exclude selected cache from future attention and repos to adjust retained keys' position encodings. We formalize these cache operations and identify history dependence as a serving challenge: identical token sequences can yield different cache states under different cache operation sequences, making prefix matching insufficient for correct cache reuse. Thus, we co-design the AKV serving engine. It provides a stateless interface compatible with existing serving APIs, while internally managing stateful cache reuse, eviction, and restoration. Experiments show that a tool-response rolling-drop cache policy improves average benchmark scores by 1.7 points and reduces average cost by 27.7%, compared with conventional threshold-triggered summarization. With AKV, it achieves up to 1.2x the output throughput and a 1.5x speedup in P95 request latency. Recursive self-improvement of cache policies further reduces cost by 7.1% over expert design. Our code is at this https URL .
2610.28577.affiliation: Tsinghua University / Chinese University of Hong Kong
2610.28577.abstract_zh: 大语言模型智能体轨迹增长时，KV 缓存读写和存储成为主要成本，也可能超最大上下文。裁剪或摘要上下文虽缩小缓存，却使后续状态失效、需要昂贵重新预填充；为省开销保留太少上下文还损准确率。我们提出缓存工程，允许不修改轨迹或重新预填充，直接控制活跃缓存：drop 从未来注意力排除所选缓存，repos 调整保留键的位置编码。我们形式化操作，指出历史依赖服务挑战：相同词元序列在不同操作序列下可有不同缓存状态，前缀匹配不足以保证复用正确。因此协同设计 AKV 引擎，提供兼容已有服务 API 的无状态接口，内部管理有状态复用、驱逐和恢复。工具回复滚动丢弃策略相对阈值摘要平均分数高 1.7 分、成本低 27.7%；AKV 最多提高输出吞吐 1.2 倍，P95 请求延迟加速 1.5 倍。缓存策略递归自改进相对专家设计再降低成本 7.1%。代码见原文链接。
2610.28577.update_target: KV-cache policy code and stateful cache execution
2610.28577.mechanism_en: Drop/repos operations alter active state without editing token trajectories; AKV tracks operation-dependent cache reuse, and policy search adds recursive refinement.
2610.28577.result_en: Rolling-drop averages +1.7 score points and 27.7% lower cost; cache-policy RSI adds 7.1% savings over expert design.
2610.28577.boundary_en: Identical tokens need not imply identical cache states; serving gains and the separate policy-search increment must not be conflated.

2610.28601.title: Evolving Agent Interfaces
2610.28601.authors: Saaket Agashe , Yuzhe Yang , Gonzalo Gonzalez-Pumariega , Bhuvan Chandra Koduru , Chih-Lun Li , Jiachen Yang , Ang Li , Xin Eric Wang
2610.28601.abstract_en: Computer-use agents are limited by the interfaces humans give them. An agent may type a spreadsheet cell by cell when a single line of code would do, or print all two thousand lines of a file through a shell to find one function. Both the interfaces and the knowledge of when to use each are built by hand, which cannot keep pace with new applications, workflows, and models. We argue that interface design should itself be an agent capability. We introduce Agent S4, an autonomous computer-use scientist that builds Evolving Agent Interfaces from task experience. A meta-agent examines task agents' trajectories on synthetic training tasks, without success labels, and constructs and revises interfaces and usage knowledge in a repository. Population-based evolution then selects which repositories to develop further by their performance on validation tasks the meta-agent never sees, favoring changes that generalize beyond the seen tasks. On OSWorld V2, Agent S4, with Qwen3.8-27B and the evolved repository of interfaces, sets a new state of the art in open-source computer-use agents, reaching 21.3% binary score, 3.8 times the same model with fixed interfaces. This is above both GPT-5.5 (13.0%) and Claude Opus 4.8 (20.6%), at about 4.3% and 1.5% of their respective costs. On ScienceBoard, the evolved interfaces improve the success rate from 41.4% to 58.6% with the same model. These results suggest that useful interfaces can be evolved from experience, making autonomous interface design a source of improvement complementary to advances in models and harnesses. We open-source our code at this https URL .
2610.28601.affiliation: Simular / University of California, Santa Barbara / Cornell University / Language Technologies Institute, Carnegie Mellon University
2610.28601.abstract_zh: 计算机使用智能体受人工接口限制：可用一行代码却逐格输入表格，或为找一个函数打印两千行文件。接口与使用知识靠人工无法跟上应用、流程和模型。我们认为接口设计应成为智能体能力，提出自主计算机使用科学家 Agent S4，从任务经验构建进化智能体接口。元智能体检查合成训练任务轨迹，无需成功标签，在仓库中构建、修改接口和知识。种群进化依据元智能体不可见验证任务的表现选择继续发展哪些仓库，偏好跨已见任务泛化变化。OSWorld V2 上，Qwen3.8-27B 配进化接口达到开源计算机使用智能体新最优，二元分数 21.3%，为固定接口同模型的 3.8 倍，高于 GPT-5.5 的 13.0% 和 Claude Opus 4.8 的 20.6%，成本约为二者的 4.3% 和 1.5%。ScienceBoard 同模型成功率从 41.4% 升至 58.6%。结果表明接口可从经验进化，成为模型及框架进步之外的互补来源。代码见原文链接。
2610.28601.update_target: Interface implementations, usage knowledge and repository populations
2610.28601.mechanism_en: A meta-agent revises interfaces from unlabeled synthetic trajectories; population selection uses validation tasks hidden from that meta-agent.
2610.28601.result_en: Qwen3.8-27B reaches 21.3% OSWorld V2 binary score, 3.8x fixed-interface performance; ScienceBoard rises 41.4%→58.6%.
2610.28601.boundary_en: Meta-agent-hidden validation still supplies selection feedback at system level; frontier cost comparisons depend on their stated configurations.

2610.26924.title: DataPraxis: Scaling Analytics Tasks via Verified Workspace Evolution
2610.26924.authors: Nan Jia , Wenxuan Shi , Jingqing Ruan , Zhizhao Zeng , Tianyi Zhai , Zhongda Su , Feng Hong , Zhengyu Chen , Wenhao Yan , Haojin Yang , Siqi Dai , Weipeng Zhang , Ke Zeng , Xunliang Cai
2610.26924.abstract_en: General-purpose agents are increasingly expected to perform professional analytics work, which requires sustained reasoning, iterative investigation, and reliable evidence. Training these capabilities requires diverse and challenging tasks. However, generating tasks directly from raw data often overlooks deeper questions that emerge through analysis and provides limited evidence for verification. To address these limitations, we introduce DataPraxis, an analytics task synthesis framework based on verified workspace evolution. The framework progressively enriches workspaces with validated findings and artifacts, then inherits and combines these workspaces to uncover deeper questions. It constructs tasks from accumulated findings and their dependencies, verifying analytical results both during evolution and after task assembly. Using this framework, we construct DataPraxis-5K, a dataset of 5,000 verified trajectories spanning diverse domains and output formats, to train DataPraxis-27B and DataPraxis-35B-A3B. DataPraxis-27B achieves 55.11 on DABStep and 51.9 on JobBench, matching or surpassing frontier models such as GLM-5.2. DataPraxis-5K is available at this http URL
2610.26924.affiliation: Huazhong University of Science and Technology / Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences / Meituan / Tsinghua University / Peking University / Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
2610.26924.abstract_zh: 通用智能体承担专业分析工作，需要持续推理、迭代调查和可靠证据，训练也需多样困难任务。但直接从原始数据生成任务，常忽略分析中出现的深层问题，也缺验证证据。DataPraxis 基于经验证工作区进化，逐步用有效发现和产物丰富工作区，继承并组合以发现更深问题。它从累积发现及依赖构建任务，在进化中和组装后验证分析结果。由此构建跨领域及输出格式的 5,000 条有效轨迹数据集 DataPraxis-5K，训练 27B 和 35B-A3B 模型。27B 在 DABStep 得 55.11、JobBench 得 51.9，达到或超过 GLM-5.2 等前沿模型。数据集见原文 http 链接。
2610.26924.update_target: Analytics workspaces, verified findings and synthesized training tasks
2610.26924.mechanism_en: Validated findings/artifacts are inherited and combined, with checks during evolution and after task assembly; generated trajectories train separate agent models.
2610.26924.result_en: DataPraxis-5K contains 5,000 trajectories; the 27B model reports 55.11 DABStep and 51.9 JobBench.
2610.26924.boundary_en: Workspace/task evolution is distinct from improving the synthesis procedure itself; model comparisons do not establish equal training compute.

2610.26926.title: AtomSD: Procedural Atom-Guided Self-Distillation for LLM Agents
2610.26926.authors: Bohan Yu , Pengfei Cao , Kai Tian , Chen Han , Shi-Yang Li , Chenxi Zhou , Junlin Liu , Cao Liu , Ke Zeng , Jun Zhao , Kang Liu
2610.26926.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) possess broad factual knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, but solving complex tasks also requires procedural knowledge about how to act. Existing approaches often represent procedural knowledge through trajectories or bundled skills, limiting flexible reuse across interaction histories. This paper introduces Procedural Atoms, fine-grained and independently applicable units that represent Intent, When, Do, and Avoid guidance. Building on this representation, we propose AtomSD, an Atom-guided Self-Distillation framework in which the learner continually extracts Procedural Atoms from its own successful trajectories and distills them into the evolving policy through Atom-conditioned supervision and task-reward optimization. Comprehensive experiments show that AtomSD consistently outperforms strong reward-based and distillation methods, exceeding the state-of-the-art baseline by up to 9.31 points in average performance. Further analyses demonstrate that the proposed Procedural Atoms provide effective guidance, highlighting the value of atom-level procedural knowledge for policy learning.
2610.26926.affiliation: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences / Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences / Meituan
2610.26926.abstract_zh: 语言模型有广泛事实和推理能力，但复杂任务也需如何行动的程序知识。轨迹或捆绑技能限制跨交互历史灵活复用。我们引入程序原子，以细粒度、独立适用单元表示意图、何时、做什么及避免什么。基于此提出 AtomSD，学习者持续从自身成功轨迹提取原子，通过原子条件监督及任务奖励优化，蒸馏进不断进化策略。全面实验中，它稳定优于强奖励和蒸馏方法，相对最先进基线平均表现最多高 9.31 分。分析显示程序原子能有效指导，强调原子级知识对策略学习的价值。
2610.26926.update_target: Policy weights and self-extracted procedural atoms
2610.26926.mechanism_en: Successful own trajectories yield Intent/When/Do/Avoid atoms; atom-conditioned supervision plus task rewards distill them into the evolving learner.
2610.26926.result_en: Average performance exceeds the strongest cited baseline by up to 9.31 points.
2610.26926.boundary_en: This is training with task rewards; fine-grained procedural units are not automatically a persistent external skill bank or reward-free learning.

2610.26995.title: SPEM: Structure-Aware Procedural Memory for Efficient Skill Use in LLM Agents
2610.26995.authors: Ran Zhou , Zehui Kong , Fanyu Lin , Jiaheng Liu , Zhen Zhang , Yuxiang Ren
2610.26995.abstract_en: LLM-based agents increasingly rely on reusable skills. However, scaling skill libraries makes efficient and accurate skill use difficult. Full skill loading incurs high token and runtime overhead. In contrast, flat semantic retrieval treats skills as independent text entries, ignoring dependencies, execution order, state transitions, and data flow constraints. We propose SPEM, a lightweight structure-aware procedural memory framework for efficient skill use in LLM-based agents. SPEM maintains Atomic Skill Memory for individual skills and Skill-DAG Memory for reusable compositions derived from successful executions. For a new task, SPEM reuses high-confidence Skill-DAG templates when available. Otherwise, it retrieves atomic skills and invokes Skill-GNN for state- and structure-aware skill selection. Successful executions are written back as new Skill-DAGs, allowing procedural memory to accumulate over time. Experiments on ALFWorld and SkillsBench show that SPEM achieves the best overall effectiveness--efficiency trade-off, reaching 87.1% ALFWorld success and 38.38% SkillsBench reward while reducing token and runtime costs against strong baselines.
2610.26995.abstract_zh: 语言模型智能体依赖可复用技能，但库扩大后使用效率和准确性困难。全量加载开销高，平面语义检索忽略依赖、执行顺序、状态转换及数据流约束。SPEM 是轻量结构感知程序记忆，维护单技能原子记忆，以及从成功执行导出的可复用组合 Skill-DAG。新任务优先复用高置信模板，否则检索原子并用 Skill-GNN 按状态和结构选择。成功执行回写成新图，持续积累程序记忆。在 ALFWorld 和 SkillsBench 上取得最佳整体效果—效率权衡，成功率 87.1%、奖励 38.38%，同时相对强基线减少词元与运行成本。
2610.26995.update_target: Atomic skills and accumulated composition DAG memory
2610.26995.mechanism_en: Successful executions write reusable Skill-DAG templates; fallback Skill-GNN selection considers state, dependency and dataflow constraints.
2610.26995.result_en: ALFWorld success reaches 87.1%, SkillsBench reward 38.38%, with reported token/runtime savings.
2610.26995.boundary_en: External composition accumulation does not by itself establish model-weight improvement; measure library creation and selector overhead.

2610.27227.title: Which Agent's Skill Should Change? Group-Relative Credit Assignment for Evolving Multi-Agent Teams
2610.27227.authors: Yanan Ma , Yang Wang , David Le , Chenhan Yuan , Yizheng Sun , Guangwei Zhang , Chenghao Xiao , Chenghua Lin , Imon Banerjee
2610.27227.abstract_en: Cooperative language-model agents can improve without weight updates by revising reusable skills, but only if a shared team reward is traced to the responsible agent and skill. Existing methods credit the skills present in each trajectory, yet presence is not responsibility: a harmful skill active in successful runs still earns positive credit. We present \textbf{GRSE}, \textbf{G}roup-\textbf{R}elative \textbf{S}kill \textbf{E}volution, which assigns behavioral credit by comparison: inspired by GRPO, it executes each question several times under the same skill libraries and contrasts the executions to credit agent--skill pairs, with structured diagnosis of failures. On HotpotQA and LoCoMo with two open-weight actors, GRSE outperforms MASkills, the closest prior method, on HotpotQA and every LoCoMo category except open-domain, with the largest gains on multi-hop questions ($+6.7$ and $+3.2$ F1). Its gains rest on better-grounded retrieval rather than answers given without evidence, and its learned skills transfer between the multi-hop tasks. GRSE is robust to corrupted libraries: starting from planted harmful skills, it credits every planted skill with the correct sign and recovers the score of a clean library ($+6.3$ points), whereas MASkills misattributes two and falls below its starting point.
2610.27227.affiliation: Mayo Clinic / University of Manchester / Alibaba Token Hub, Alibaba Group / Shanghai University of Finance and Economics
2610.27227.abstract_zh: 合作语言智能体可通过修改技能而非权重改善，但要把共享奖励归因到责任智能体和技能。现有方法按轨迹出现技能归因，然而出现不等于责任，有害技能在成功轨迹也得正信用。我们提出受 GRPO 启发的组相对技能进化 GRSE：相同技能库下每问题多次执行，通过比较为智能体—技能对归因，并结构化诊断失败。在 HotpotQA、LoCoMo 和两个开源权重执行者上，除开放域外，全部 LoCoMo 类别和 HotpotQA 优于最接近 MASkills，多跳最高分别高 6.7、3.2 F1。收益来自更有依据检索，而非无证据作答，所学技能跨多跳任务迁移。植入有害技能时，全部获正确符号信用，恢复干净库分数，提高 6.3 分；MASkills 误归因两个，低于起点。
2610.27227.mechanism_en: Same-question repeated executions under common libraries provide group-relative agent/skill contrasts and structured failure diagnosis.
2610.27227.result_en: Largest multi-hop gains over MASkills are +6.7/+3.2 F1; planted harmful skills receive correct signs and clean-library performance is recovered.
2610.27227.boundary_en: Presence-based credit can be confounded; the contrast-based results are bounded by sampled executions and planted-skill controls, not universal causal identification.

2610.27230.title: Magnolia: A Persistent-Memory Agent Framework for Computational Chemistry
2610.27230.authors: Tao Jiang , Benjamin Navet , Yousouf Taghzouti , Fabien Gandon , Louis-Félix Nothias , Élise Dumont
2610.27230.abstract_en: Chemistry has recently entered a high-data regime as molecular databases from high-throughput platforms or computational studies have become available. Increasing automation within the chemical sciences leads to a more digital and precision chemistry. Dedicated scientific agents are becoming central to guiding the chemist through an ever-increasing amount of data and findings, including negative ones. Here, we introduce Magnolia, a persistent-memory artificial intelligence agent framework that integrates computational protocols, from docking to quantum chemistry, lab notebooks and chat logs relying on large language models (LLMs). It relies on a three-tier memory system: session-level observations are automatically captured and distilled into structured learnings, confirmed and elevated to project-tier entries and, when human-validated, promoted to cross-project rules that actively guide subsequent work and provide direct chemical feedback. We illustrate Magnolia on four case studies: quantum-chemical evaluation of aromatic systems (COMPAS database), molecular dynamics of butane and of modified DNA, and a protein-peptide docking campaign. Across these projects, Magnolia tracked 317 runs and accumulated 116 project-tier entries, from which four cross-project rules were promoted; in controlled replays of four tasks, runs with memory passed the checks that runs without it failed (for example, ten of ten docking-configuration checks, against one to four of ten). By combining automation, reproducibility, and human-in-the-loop control, our Magnolia framework streamlines docking, molecular dynamics and quantum chemistry calculations with direct analysis and LLM-augmented feedback, offering accelerated access to computational (bio)chemistry.
2610.27230.affiliation: Université Côte d’Azur / CNRS / ICN / Inria / I3S
2610.27230.abstract_zh: 高通量平台和计算研究分子数据库使化学进入高数据阶段，自动化推动数字与精准化学，专用智能体帮助处理大量包括负面结果的信息。Magnolia 持久记忆框架结合从对接到量子化学的计算协议、实验笔记和聊天日志。三级记忆自动捕捉会话观测、提炼结构化学习，确认后升为项目条目，人工验证后再升为跨项目规则，主动指导后续工作并提供化学反馈。四案例包括 COMPAS 芳香系统量子评估、丁烷及改造 DNA 分子动力学、蛋白—肽对接，共跟踪 317 次运行、积累 116 项项目条目，晋升四项跨项目规则。四任务受控回放中，有记忆执行通过无记忆失败的检查，例如对接配置十项全过，对照仅一至四项。框架结合自动化、可复现与人工控制，简化对接、动力学和量子化学及分析反馈，加速计算生物化学使用。
2610.27230.update_target: Session/project memory and human-promoted cross-project rules
2610.27230.mechanism_en: Observations become confirmed project learnings; human validation gates cross-project promotion that guides later computational chemistry work.
2610.27230.result_en: 317 runs yield 116 project entries and four promoted rules; four controlled replays favor memory, including 10/10 docking checks.
2610.27230.boundary_en: Human promotion is part of the mechanism; four replays and computational protocols are not autonomous wet-lab discovery or a broad efficacy trial.

2610.27307.title: Evolving Self-tuning Benchmarks for Long-Horizon Tool Use
2610.27307.authors: Hyunji Alex Nam , Michael Dennis , Natasha Jaques , Minsuk Chang
2610.27307.abstract_en: For AI assistants to move beyond simple chat interfaces and reliably assist users with applications like Gmail, Venmo, and Slack, we need to improve their tool-use capabilities. However, existing tool use benchmarks are still limited and difficult to scale because they rely on human supervision or are too domain-specific. To make data generation scalable, we propose, TURTLE (Tool Use Related Tasks with Long-Horizon Evolution), an Unsupervised Environment Design (UED) approach to evolve existing tasks using a proposer, a solver, and a feedback generator large language model agents. The proposer is rewarded for difficult yet solvable tasks based on the solver's empirical performance, and the feedback generator summarizes the solver's execution traces for the proposer to exploit. TURTLE produces evolving, self-tuning test suites adaptable to different environment requirements, from supporting user simulators and dense document retrieval to interacting across multiple apps. Empirical results on AppWorld, $\tau$-Bench, and AutomationBench using Gemma 4 31B-it show that the evolved tasks target the desired difficulty range (e.g., a 165% increase in the percentage of hard tasks on AppWorld), increase task diversity (in terms of reasoning and simultaneous tool interactions), and elicit a broader range of failure modes than the original tasks.
2610.27307.affiliation: Google DeepMind / Stanford University / University of Washington
2610.27307.abstract_zh: 人工智能助手要跨 Gmail、Venmo、Slack 等应用可靠工作，需增强工具能力，但现有基准依赖人工或领域狭窄，难扩展。我们提出 TURTLE，即长时程进化工具任务，采用无监督环境设计，由提议者、求解器和反馈生成模型进化已有任务。提议者按求解器实测表现获得困难但可解任务奖励，反馈生成器总结执行轨迹供其利用。所得自调节测试套件适应用户模拟、密集文档检索及跨应用交互。在 AppWorld、$\tau$-Bench、AutomationBench 使用 Gemma 4 31B-it，任务进入期望难度区间，例如 AppWorld 困难任务比例增加 165%，推理及同时工具交互多样性增加，揭示比原始任务更多失败模式。
2610.27307.update_target: Task suites and proposer feedback in environment design
2610.27307.mechanism_en: A proposer seeks difficult-but-solvable tasks using solver empirical outcomes and summarized traces, evolving test distributions.
2610.27307.result_en: Three tool-use benchmarks show targeted difficulty/diversity, including 165% more hard-task percentage on AppWorld.
2610.27307.boundary_en: Evolving benchmarks are not demonstrated solver-weight self-improvement; assess solvability and validity independently of generator/solver agreement.

2610.27327.title: Unsupervised Tool Evolution for Coding Agents in Data-Lake Analytics
2610.27327.authors: Yuqing Yang , Yurong Liu , Deqing Fu , Manav Garg , Sravan Babu Bodapati , Fatma Ozcan , Alon Y. Halevy , Jiani Zhang
2610.27327.abstract_en: Coding agents can answer analytical questions over a data lake by discovering, cleaning, and joining the relevant data. However, they discard this work after each question and redo it from scratch for the next one. Tool evolution, which automatically builds and refines reusable tools across tasks, is a natural fit for this repetition. Since a ground-truth label for a data-lake question requires an expert to solve it first, we consider the unsupervised setting. We propose TEAL (Tool Evolution for Analytics over data Lakes), which evolves a library of tools and usage skills for a given Worker agent without labels. Two agents propose tools from complementary evidence, an Explorer from the data lake itself and a Critic from Worker trajectories. A proposed change is kept only if the Worker adopts the tool on a rerun without extra steps and any changed answer is supported by trajectory evidence. We also introduce TEAL-Q, which generates synthetic questions for tool evolution when real ones are unavailable. We evaluate on KramaBench and LakeQA with four Worker LLMs under step budgets, which cap the number of steps the Worker may take per question. With a tight budget of 10 or 15 steps, TEAL improves every Worker on both benchmarks, lifting Sonnet-5 at 15 steps by 9.3 points on KramaBench and 21.7 points on LakeQA. A tighter budget also yields better feedback for evolution. For example, Sonnet-5's LakeQA library evolved at 20 steps and deployed unchanged at 30 steps scores 68.3, above both the baseline (59.6) and a library evolved directly at 30 steps (64.2). Additionally, a library evolved on synthetic questions performs comparably to one evolved on real questions. These results show that useful tools can be evolved without labels, and hopefully inspire future work on what to evolve and how to obtain feedback in unsupervised agent evolution.
2610.27327.affiliation: University of Southern California / Google / New York University
2610.27327.abstract_zh: 编码智能体在数据湖中发现、清理、连接数据以回答分析问题，却常每题重做。工具进化可跨任务构建和修订复用工具，因真实标签需专家先解题，我们研究无监督情形。TEAL 为给定 Worker 无标签进化工具与使用技能库，Explorer 从数据湖、Critic 从 Worker 轨迹提供互补证据。只有 Worker 在无额外步骤的重跑中采用工具，且变化答案有轨迹证据支持，才保留修改。TEAL-Q 在真实问题缺失时生成合成问题。在 KramaBench、LakeQA、四 Worker 和逐题步骤预算下评估，紧预算十或十五步时全部 Worker 在两基准均改善，Sonnet-5 十五步提高 9.3、21.7 分。更紧预算也改善进化反馈：Sonnet-5 在二十步进化的 LakeQA 库不变部署三十步得 68.3，高于基线 59.6 及直接三十步进化的 64.2。合成问题进化库也接近真实问题库。这表明无需标签可进化有用工具，启发无监督智能体应进化什么、如何取反馈的研究。
2610.27327.update_target: Reusable analytics tools and usage skills
2610.27327.mechanism_en: Explorer/Critic proposals are retained only after Worker adoption without extra rerun steps and evidence support for changed answers; synthetic questions can supply search tasks.
2610.27327.result_en: At 15 steps, Sonnet-5 gains 9.3/21.7 points; a 20-step-evolved library scores 68.3 when deployed unchanged at 30 steps.
2610.27327.boundary_en: Label-free admission is not an independent correctness oracle; tight search and deployment budgets differ and synthetic versus real evolution needs matched accounting.

2610.27377.title: REM: What to Store, When to Recall, What to Forget in Experience Memory for Coding Agents
2610.27377.authors: Xinyi Lisa Chen , Pedro Herrero-Vidal , Xiaohan Chen , Xiaojing Yu , Cris Liu , Bingqing Song , Bin Xu , Suleiman A. Khan , You-Lin Chen
2610.27377.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents now autonomously complete long-horizon tasks, such as repository-level coding, through hundreds of think-act steps, yet the experience each run produces is rarely reused on the next. Prior memory systems concentrate on retrieval, finding the most relevant past trajectory. Retrieval cannot observe the running agent, so it cannot decide whether the agent needs an experience, at which point, or for how long. We introduce REM (Reusable Experience Memory), a framework that manages the memory lifecycle from inside the agent's think-act loop through three explicit decisions. What to store: each completed trajectory is consolidated into a phase-structured document, two orders of magnitude smaller than the trajectory. When to recall: the document is injected at the start of the task; the costlier implementation record is withheld until an in-loop gate detects the agent struggling. What to forget: the record is evicted after a single exposure. On repository-level bug fixing (SWE-ContextBench Lite), REM retrieves the related trajectory more accurately than every state-of-the-art memory system (68.7% vs. 55.6% match@1) and improves, in every replicate, end-task resolution (27.6% vs. 24.9%) at 17% lower cost. Injecting the same experience as a summary or raw trajectory, even when oracle-retrieved, does not. Ablating any of the three decisions reduces resolution. Altogether, these results demonstrate that the bottleneck in experience reuse is not retrieval fidelity but how experience is stored and governed across its lifecycle, opening a control-theoretic perspective on agent memory.
2610.27377.abstract_zh: 语言模型智能体以数百个思考—动作步骤完成仓库编程等任务，但经验很少复用于下次。已有记忆侧重检索相关轨迹，然而检索无法观察运行智能体，难决定是否、何时、用多久。REM 在循环内管理三项决定：每条完成轨迹巩固成分阶段文档，比原轨迹小两个数量级；文档在起始注入，更昂贵实现记录仅在门控发现挣扎时加入；记录只暴露一次后驱逐。在 SWE-ContextBench Lite 仓库修错中，相关轨迹 match@1 为 68.7%，高于最先进记忆 55.6%；每次复核均提高最终解决率，27.6% 对 24.9%，成本低 17%。相同经验以摘要或原轨迹注入，即使预言机检索也不带来此收益。消融三项任一均降解决率。瓶颈不仅是检索忠实度，更是存储和生命周期治理，为智能体记忆提供控制论视角。
2610.27377.update_target: Phase-structured experience documents and injection/eviction control
2610.27377.mechanism_en: Consolidate trajectories, inject compact guidance initially, gate costly records on observed struggle and evict after one exposure.
2610.27377.result_en: Match@1 rises 55.6%→68.7%; resolution rises 24.9%→27.6% at 17% lower cost across reported replicates.
2610.27377.boundary_en: Retrieval accuracy and end-task utility are distinct; lifecycle ablations concern the tested coding benchmark, not a general proof that retrieval never bottlenecks.

2610.27588.title: Beyond Experience: Knowledge-Guided Evolution for NPU Kernel Generation
2610.27588.authors: Xi Chen , Ming Shen , Haotian Yan , Ruoyu Sun , Tianjun Yao
2610.27588.abstract_en: LLM agents have become capable kernel engineers on mainstream GPU stacks, but they struggle on emerging accelerators such as Ascend NPUs, whose programming model is barely represented in pretraining data. Recent NPU agents address this gap largely through experience: they accumulate memory from their own generation and optimization trials and reuse it on later tasks. We argue that experience alone is not enough for kernel generation. An agent can only remember what it has tried, and it rarely tries a mechanism it does not know. As a result, such memory offers little help when a new operator calls for a different mechanism, and even familiar operators raise unseen situations as optimization proceeds. We present ASCENDEVOLVE, which grounds every step of an evolutionary kernel search in a large external knowledge base built from platform documentation, toolkit headers, and operator repositories. Because this corpus far exceeds any context window, ASCENDEVOLVE indexes it and routes each agent to a small, task-specific slice of evidence instead of the corpus itself. The retrieved knowledge seeds diverse implementation strategies, guides repair when a candidate fails, and constrains how strong candidates are recombined. On 53 Ascend C operators from CANN-Bench spanning four difficulty levels, ASCENDEVOLVE achieves an overall score of 71.39, improving over Reflexion and OpenEvolve by 11.6% and 17.2%.
2610.27588.affiliation: Shenzhen Loop Area Institute / Guangzhou University / Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Southwestern University of Finance and Economics / Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen
2610.27588.abstract_zh: 语言模型已擅长主流 GPU 内核工程，却在预训练少见的 Ascend NPU 编程栈受限。近期方法主要积累生成优化试验经验，但仅能记住试过的东西，缺机制知识则很少尝试，因而面对新操作及优化中未见状况，经验不足。ASCENDEVOLVE 将每步进化内核搜索锚定于平台文档、工具包头文件和算子库构成的大外部知识库。语料远超上下文，系统索引后为每智能体路由小型任务特定证据，而非全库。检索知识为多样实现播种、指导失败修复、约束强候选重组。在 CANN-Bench 四难度级别的 53 个 Ascend C 算子上，总分 71.39，比 Reflexion、OpenEvolve 分别改善 11.6%、17.2%。
2610.27588.update_target: NPU kernel candidates and retrieved platform knowledge
2610.27588.mechanism_en: Indexed documentation/headers/operators supply diverse mechanisms for proposal, repair and recombination during evolutionary search.
2610.27588.result_en: 53 Ascend C operators yield score 71.39, reported gains 11.6%/17.2% over Reflexion/OpenEvolve.
2610.27588.boundary_en: External platform knowledge supplements own experience; target-accelerator results and search costs cannot be assumed to transfer to CPU or mainstream GPUs.

2610.27847.title: SAPD: Learning from Agent Experience without Environment Interaction
2610.27847.authors: Juncheng Diao , Haibin Wang , Wei Shi , Yifan Ding , Qingbin Li , Rongxiang Weng , Xunliang Cai
2610.27847.abstract_en: Scaling the training of Large Language Model (LLM) agents typically requires a large collection of executable environments, whose construction, maintenance, and operation constrain the expansion of training experience. Existing offline trajectories offer an opportunity to reuse interaction experience, yet effectively refining the current policy without revisiting these environments remains challenging: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can lead to catastrophic forgetting, while online reinforcement learning requires real-time interaction with the environment. To address this challenge, we propose Step-Advantage Policy Distillation (SAPD), a method for learning from offline trajectories using relative step advantages. SAPD decomposes multi-turn trajectories into individual decision contexts for on-policy distillation, allowing the student to generate responses conditioned on recorded histories, and introduces relative step advantage signals to stabilize training. The entire process requires neither new environment observations nor additional multi-turn interactions. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-based QA show that SAPD improves performance across different teacher configurations, mitigates catastrophic forgetting compared with SFT, and runs at least $4.7\times$ faster per training step than online OPD. We will release our code soon.
2610.27847.affiliation: Meituan, LongCat Team / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
2610.27847.abstract_zh: 智能体训练扩展需大量可执行环境，构建维护运行成本限制经验增长。离线轨迹可复用经验，但不重访环境就改善当前策略困难：监督微调可灾难性遗忘，在线强化学习需实时交互。SAPD 用相对步骤优势学习离线轨迹，将多轮轨迹拆成决策上下文，学生在记录历史下生成响应进行同策略蒸馏，以相对步骤优势稳定训练，无需新观测或额外多轮交互。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和搜索问答中，跨教师设置改善，相对 SFT 减轻遗忘，每训练步至少比在线 OPD 快 $4.7\times$。代码计划近期发布。
2610.27847.update_target: Student policy weights learned from offline decision contexts
2610.27847.mechanism_en: Recorded histories support on-policy responses and relative step-advantage distillation without new environment observations/interactions.
2610.27847.result_en: Three task families improve; training steps are at least 4.7x faster than online OPD and forgetting is reduced versus SFT.
2610.27847.boundary_en: Offline experience was collected somewhere; per-step speedup is not necessarily equal-quality total training speedup, and code is only promised.

2610.28054.title: AutoSim: A Self-Improving User Simulator for Conversational Search Evaluation
2610.28054.authors: Saber Zerhoudi , Jelena Mitrovic , Michael Granitzer
2610.28054.abstract_en: User simulators promise to evaluate conversational search systems at a scale human studies cannot reach, but only if their behavior is realistic enough to trust. We study AutoSim, a conversational-search user simulator whose relevance judgments rank a controlled pool of retrieval systems in agreement with NIST across three TREC iKAT years (Kendall's $\tau$ of $0.66$, $0.91$, and $0.91$; all $p{\le}0.002$), an agreement that survives removing its persona. AutoSim self-improves against a held-out signal from real users, and we find that fine-tuning its weights makes it behave like real users, which in turn gives a more accurate estimate of how well a system serves them. Reaching that behavior takes more than prompting: when discriminating between real and simulated user sessions, no prompt we tried lowers a held-out real-versus-simulated classifier below AUC $0.85$, whereas fine-tuning the weights drives it to $0.45$, where neither the classifier nor a human reading full dialogues can tell it from a real user. That added realism is what makes the evaluation more accurate: where real users retrieve little, a prompted simulator over-estimates retrieval effectiveness by $+0.136$ nDCG and returns a relevant passage on $57\%$ of the turns where real users find none, enough to change a deployment decision. Only the weight-level simulator escapes this bias. We release the framework and code.
2610.28054.affiliation: University of Passau / Interdisciplinary Transformation University Austria
2610.28054.abstract_zh: 用户模拟器可扩展对话搜索评估，但需足够真实。AutoSim 的相关性判断，在三个 TREC iKAT 年份上对受控检索系统池排序与 NIST 一致，Kendall's $\tau$ 分别为 0.66、0.91、0.91，均 $p\le 0.002$，移除人格设定后仍成立。它针对真实用户的留出信号自改进，权重微调使行为更像真实用户，从而更准确评估系统服务质量。仅提示不够：所有所试提示都无法使留出真实/模拟分类器 AUC 低于 0.85，而微调使之降至 0.45，分类器和阅读全文的人都无法分辨。更真实行为使评估更准：真实用户少检索的情形中，提示模拟器把效果高估 +0.136 nDCG，在真实用户没有相关结果的轮次仍有 57% 返回相关段落，足以改变部署决策；仅权重级模拟器避免此偏差。我们发布框架与代码。
2610.28054.mechanism_en: Real-user comparison supplies a held-out signal; compare prompting against fine-tuning for behavior realism and retrieval-evaluation calibration.
2610.28054.result_en: Real/simulated classifier AUC falls from no-better-than .85 prompting to .45 after tuning; relevance-system ordering aligns with NIST.
2610.28054.boundary_en: Near-chance discrimination does not prove all realism dimensions; the abstract calls a real-user signal held-out while using it for improvement, so final independence requires protocol inspection.

2610.28589.title: AgenticRoboRL: Bringing Coding-Agent Post-Training to Agentic Robotics
2610.28589.authors: Xinxin Liu , Bingxin Xu , Wenrui Bao , Ming Li , Wentao Bao , Chen Chen , Yuzhang Shang
2610.28589.abstract_en: Agentic robotics systems combine planners with robot harnesses to perform complex manipulation tasks. Recent work improves these systems through better harnesses and external memory, but relies on powerful closed-source models as planners and does not improve the planners' own capabilities. In contrast, coding agents have improved substantially by post-training the model itself. We therefore investigate whether post-training can also improve robot planners. However, applying it across robot harnesses requires accommodating different execution mechanisms, including VLA skill invocation and control-code generation. To this end, we introduce AgenticRoboRL, a framework for post-training robot planners across different harnesses. The training recipe combines supervised fine-tuning with multi-turn reinforcement learning. To accommodate different execution mechanisms, harness-specific adapters connect recorded planner interactions with task outcomes, enabling a common RL training pipeline while keeping execution components fixed. On LIBERO-PRO, AgenticRoboRL raises the success rate of a 9B-parameter planner from 18.1% to 71.0% without external memory, approaching the 72.1% achieved by Codex (GPT-5.5) with external memory. These results demonstrate post-training as an effective approach for improving robot planners. We will release the framework and trained planner checkpoints.
2610.28589.affiliation: University of Central Florida / University of Southern California / Michigan State University
2610.28589.abstract_zh: 机器人智能体结合规划器与框架操作，近期通过框架和记忆改善，却依赖强闭源规划器、未改善其自身能力。受编码智能体后训练进展启发，我们研究机器人规划器后训练，但跨框架需兼容 VLA 技能调用和控制代码生成。AgenticRoboRL 结合监督微调与多轮强化学习，用框架特定适配器连接规划交互和任务结果，在固定执行组件下提供公共训练流水线。在 LIBERO-PRO，9B 规划器无外部记忆成功率从 18.1% 升至 71.0%，接近有记忆 Codex（GPT-5.5）的 72.1%。结果支持后训练改善规划器，计划发布框架及训练检查点。
2610.28589.update_target: Robot planner weights with fixed execution components
2610.28589.mechanism_en: Harness-specific adapters connect recorded interactions/outcomes to a shared SFT plus multi-turn RL training pipeline.
2610.28589.result_en: A 9B planner rises 18.1%→71.0% on LIBERO-PRO without memory, versus 72.1% for the cited memory-assisted frontier comparator.
2610.28589.boundary_en: LIBERO-PRO is simulation; fixed-harness planner post-training is not harness self-evolution, and no complete release is inferred from a promise.
2610.28589.resource_metadata_note: Original abstract promises a future release, while the source-linked repository is currently reachable. Reachability does not verify complete framework/checkpoint availability.

2610.26935.title: How Intervention History Changes AI Agent Sabotage on Subsequent Tasks
2610.26935.abstract_en: AI control evaluations often reset agents' memory between tasks, although deployed agents may retain records of prior interventions. We ask whether learning that an earlier attack was caught changes an agent's ability to evade defer-to-trusted (DtT), a protocol that replaces suspicious work with a trusted model's solution. Herein, we study cross-episode adaptation: whether intervention history changes attack behavior on a subsequent task with different objectives and a fresh environment. We evaluate this using ControlArena's Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and SHADE-Arena as testbeds, where agents must complete a main task while covertly pursuing a harmful side objective. For each successor task, we pair a history-conditioned attempt with the model's no-history attempt. The retained history either states that the previous submission was replaced or additionally includes the trusted model's replacement. For Claude Opus 4.8 on IaC, intervention history reduces successful sabotage. Completion of both the main and side objectives falls from 77% to 12% when the agent is told about the replacement and to 38% when it is also shown the trusted model's replacement, while main task success remains essentially unchanged. Condensing the history weakens this effect, suggesting that the retained context matters and limiting attribution to intervention feedback alone. GPT-5.4 shows no significant change in successful sabotage on the same IaC benchmark. On SHADE-Arena, GPT-5's successful sabotage rate decreases, but the reduction is not significant. Across the tested models, history conditions, and deferral thresholds, intervention history never increases the rate of successful sabotage that survives DtT. These results show that intervention history can change subsequent attack behavior, but its effect depends on both the model and the retained context.
2610.26935.abstract_zh: 人工智能控制评估常任务间重置记忆，但部署智能体可能记住干预。我们研究得知早先攻击被截获，是否改变在新目标、新环境后续任务中规避替换为可信模型解答的 DtT 协议的能力。在 ControlArena 的 IaC 和 SHADE-Arena 中，智能体同时完成主任务、隐蔽有害副目标。每后续任务配对有历史和无历史尝试，历史告知前提交被替换，或还展示可信替代。IaC 上 Claude Opus 4.8 同时完成主副目标从 77% 降至仅告知替换的 12%，展示替代时 38%，主任务成功基本不变。压缩历史削弱效果，说明上下文重要，也限制仅归因干预反馈。GPT-5.4 在同基准无显著变化，SHADE-Arena 的 GPT-5 破坏成功下降但不显著。全部所测模型、历史和阈值中，干预历史未增加存活于 DtT 的成功破坏。影响依赖模型和保留上下文。
2610.26935.update_target: Cross-task context containing prior intervention history
2610.26935.mechanism_en: Paired successor-task attempts compare no history, replacement notice and trusted replacement content under defer-to-trusted control.
2610.26935.result_en: Opus 4.8 IaC joint success drops 77%→12%/38%; other models/settings have weaker or nonsignificant effects.
2610.26935.boundary_en: Condensation changes the effect, limiting attribution to feedback alone; tested history never raises successful sabotage surviving DtT, not a universal safety guarantee.

2610.27157.title: Understanding the Benefits of Scaffolds through Computational Separations
2610.27157.authors: Jingchu Gai , Adam Block , Andrej Risteski
2610.27157.abstract_en: Inference-time harnesses, i.e., external procedures that call a model many times and keep state across calls, can substantially improve model capabilities. In this paper, we investigate the benefits of using such harnesses and the extent to which these benefits can be internalized through training. More precisely, we conceptualize a harness $\mathcal{A}$ as an arbitrary wrapper around a base model $M$ and attempt to distill a student model from the harness's traces. Empirically we find that, even with simple scaffolds and small models, the inference-time harness significantly outperforms a distilled student. We then prove that such a gap is due to a fundamental representational limitation: inference-time harnesses can compute a closure of their per-call primitive that is $\NL$-complete even when the primitive is a trivial $\AC^0$ lookup, and that no fixed-depth forward pass can represent under the widely believed conjecture that $\NL\not\subseteq\TC^0$. Our theory suggests that expanding the representational capacity of the student relative to the task at hand, e.g., by enlarging the model, making the task easier, or lengthening its chain-of-thought, is necessary to close the gap, which we verify empirically. Finally, we scale to an agentic harness on competition math, where the same gap reappears. Overall, our results show that a harness confers on the base model a profound gain in representational power, one that training a same-class student on its traces cannot transfer back into the weights.
2610.27157.abstract_zh: 推理时框架多次调用模型、跨调用留状态，可明显增强能力。我们研究收益及训练内化程度，将框架 $\mathcal{A}$ 视为基础模型 $M$ 任意包装，并从其轨迹蒸馏学生。即使简单框架和小模型，框架也明显优于学生。我们证明，条件性的根源是表示限制：每调用原语即便只是平凡 $\mathrm{AC}^0$ 查表，框架仍可计算 $\mathrm{NL}$ 完备闭包；在广信猜想 $\mathrm{NL}\not\subseteq\mathrm{TC}^0$ 下，固定深度前向无法表示。理论建议相对任务扩大表示能力，例如增大模型、简化任务或延长思维链，是弥合差距所需，我们用实验验证。扩展到竞赛数学智能体框架，差距再次出现。结果表明，框架赋予显著表示能力，同类学生在轨迹上训练无法将其全部转回权重。
2610.27157.update_target: Representational gap between multi-call scaffolds and distilled weights
2610.27157.mechanism_en: Small-model experiments and conditional complexity separations compare an external primitive closure with fixed-depth forward computation.
2610.27157.result_en: Empirical harness/student gaps persist on competition math; expanded capacity, easier tasks or longer reasoning can narrow them.
2610.27157.boundary_en: The theorem assumes the stated NL versus TC0 conjecture and representation class; it is not a blanket impossibility of distillation or recurrent computation.

2610.27406.title: More Memory, Worse Agents: Error Reproduction and Anti-Persistence in LLM Agents
2610.27406.authors: Ruhan Wang , Kishan Panaganti , Dongruo Zhou
2610.27406.abstract_en: LLM agents can improve across tasks without updating model parameters by storing experience from their own executions in external memory and reusing it to guide later decisions. A central design question is whether to retain only observed trajectories and outcomes or also the rules, summaries, and skills inferred from them. Retaining these abstractions allows agents to reuse strategies without repeatedly deriving them from raw trajectories. However, errors in stored abstractions can propagate to subsequent decisions through retrieval and reuse. They can also shape execution trajectories, which then become the basis for new abstractions that reproduce the original errors. We term this feedback mechanism error reproduction: errors are regenerated through a cycle of abstraction, execution, and re-abstraction, extending their persistence beyond direct reuse of the original faulty knowledge. We propose Anti-Persistence, a memory design that accumulates trajectories and outcomes while reconstructing task-specific guidance on demand. An adaptive selector uses prior outcomes to decide whether and how to synthesize guidance, which is discarded after execution. This prevents its direct reuse as a stored object, although indirect feedback through retained trajectories remains possible. Across different benchmarks and backbones, Anti-Persistence achieves higher overall held-out success and the lowest average LLM-call cost among the evaluated memory designs. These results support separating experience accumulation from abstraction persistence in memorybased self-improvement.
2610.27406.abstract_zh: 智能体不更新参数，也可存储自身执行经验、指导以后任务。关键是只保留轨迹结果，还是保留推导规则摘要技能。持久抽象可省重复推导，但错误经检索传播，塑造新轨迹，再产生重复原错误的抽象。我们称之为错误再生产：抽象—执行—再抽象循环让错误持续超出直接复用。Anti-Persistence 累积轨迹和结果，按需重建任务指导；自适应选择器按先前结果决定是否及如何合成，执行后丢弃。这样阻止指导作为对象直接复用，但保留轨迹仍可能间接反馈。跨基准和主干，所评估设计中留出总体成功率更高、平均模型调用成本最低。结果支持将经验积累与抽象持久化分离。
2610.27406.mechanism_en: Store trajectories/outcomes but synthesize and discard task-specific abstractions, using outcome-adaptive selection to reduce direct error reproduction.
2610.27406.result_en: Held-out success is higher and average LLM-call cost lower than evaluated persistent-abstraction designs.
2610.27406.boundary_en: Discarding guidance blocks direct object reuse but not indirect error feedback through retained trajectories; this is a measured design trade-off, not guaranteed error elimination.

2610.27465.title: Recoverability and Verifier Strength: Two Measured Preconditions for Unattended Agent Self-Improvement
2610.27465.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
2610.27465.abstract_en: Agent platforms are starting to improve their own agents: they read a deployed agent's execution traces, derive a change, have an automated verifier approve it, and release it with no human author. How much of this loop can safely run without a human? We propose two quantities a platform can measure. Verifier strength $\sigma$ is how well the available verifier -- often an LLM judge -- agrees with a trusted reference verifier; it limits how much a step can improve the agent. Recoverability is how cheaply a bad change can be undone: whether undoing it needs a new verifier approval, and how much of the old behavior a rollback restores. A step should run unattended only if both are adequate. On our platform this rule allows prompt, tool and skill edits to run unattended and keeps weight updates under human sign-off. Our main contribution is these two definitions and how to measure them. We built a platform that applies the rule and tested it in two ways: on the platform's own approval gate, and in controlled experiments on the $\tau^2$-bench agent benchmark. On verifier strength, the platform's LLM judge sometimes gave the same score no matter what it was shown (9 of 37 settings) and reported no error, so a verifier can look healthy while approving anything; its strength must be measured, and two simple tests catch the failure. On recoverability, restoring a saved copy brought the agent back to its original behavior, but a regenerated undo did not, so only changes whose old version is kept can be reversed without a human; and while a change was deployed, it altered the outcome of 17 percent of tasks beyond normal run-to-run variation, which no undo repairs. Together these support the rule: a change can run unattended only when its old version is kept and its verifier's strength has been measured.
2610.27465.abstract_zh: 智能体平台开始读取部署轨迹、生成变化、自动验证并发布，无需人工作者。循环有多少可安全无人值守？我们提出两个可测量量：验证器强度 $\sigma$ 表示现有验证器与可信参考一致程度，限制一步能改善多少；可恢复性衡量撤销坏变化成本，包括是否需新批准及恢复旧行为程度。两者足够才应无人值守。平台按规则允许提示、工具和技能编辑自动执行，权重更新仍需人工。贡献是定义和测量方法，在自身审批门控及 $\tau^2$-bench 受控实验测试。模型裁判在 37 设置中九个不论输入均同分且不报错，看似健康却可能全批，两项简单测试能发现。恢复保存副本带回原行为，重新生成撤销却不能，故需保存旧版；部署期间变化还使 17% 任务结果超出正常随机差异，事后撤销无法修复。共同支持旧版保留与验证器强度实测的无人值守条件。
2610.27465.update_target: Verifier agreement and rollback recoverability of self-edits
2610.27465.mechanism_en: Measure judge/reference strength and saved-version versus regenerated undo, then test approval gates and controlled task effects.
2610.27465.result_en: 9/37 judge settings emit constant scores without errors; saved rollback restores behavior, while deployed changes alter 17% of outcomes beyond variation.
2610.27465.boundary_en: A rollback cannot undo intervening consequences; the platform-specific unattended-edit rule does not certify every prompt/tool edit or justify autonomous weight changes.

2610.27524.title: MemDev-Bench: Does Memory Help Code Agents?Benchmarking Memory Systems over Real Repository Histories
2610.27524.authors: Guorui Chen , Tao Liu , Zhenzhen Huang , Yidan Zhang , Liyu Jiang , Shuoyuan Wang , Hanchen Sun , Xu He , Dong Li , Yihan Hu , Jianye Hao , Lei Feng
2610.27524.abstract_en: Code agents increasingly work on evolving real repositories, and memory systems aim to help them reuse earlier experience. However, such experience is diverse and evolving, so it remains unclear how memory systems organize it and thereby affect code agents. Existing benchmarks cannot answer this reliably because they lack either temporally valid histories or control over prior-task relevance. In this paper, we present MemDev-Bench to evaluate how memory systems affect code agents over diverse repository histories. It pairs each task with relevance-annotated earlier tasks from the same repository to build histories with controlled relevance. We also build an automated pipeline that reliably makes these earlier tasks executable and verifiable, producing 4,869 historical tasks for 555 base tasks. Based on MemDev-Bench, our systematic evaluation of memory systems across diverse development scenarios yields three main findings. (1) Memory mainly improves fine-grained localization and editing, increasing functional correctness. (2) Memory also causes failures on otherwise solvable tasks even with related history, and unrelated history tends to increase such failures. These failures mainly stem from agents reusing memory without reassessing its applicability. (3) Compared with using memory systems, directly providing agents with raw historical trajectories substantially reduces their steps. Further analysis suggests that agents save these steps by reusing process information that compressed memories tend to omit. These results suggest that future memory systems should preserve process information and reassess memory applicability against current task context.
2610.27524.affiliation: Southeast University / Southern University of Science and Technology / MemoraX AI
2610.27524.abstract_zh: 代码智能体在变化仓库工作，记忆希望复用多样、演化经验，但现有基准缺时间有效历史或先前任务相关性控制。MemDev-Bench 为每任务配同仓库、带相关性标注的更早任务，以构造可控历史，并自动使早期任务可执行可验证，得到 555 基础任务和 4,869 历史任务。系统评估发现：记忆主要改善精细定位与编辑，提高功能正确性；即使相关历史也使原本可解任务失败，不相关历史加剧，主因未重审适用性；直接提供原始历史轨迹比记忆系统明显减少步骤，分析提示其复用压缩记忆遗漏的过程信息。未来系统应保留过程信息，并对当前上下文重审记忆适用性。
2610.27524.update_target: Memory utility and regression over temporally valid repository histories
2610.27524.mechanism_en: Controlled relevance annotations and executable historical tasks separate task relevance, process preservation and reuse effects.
2610.27524.result_en: 4,869 historical tasks cover 555 base tasks; memory helps localization but can break solvable tasks, and raw histories reduce steps.
2610.27524.boundary_en: Related history is not always safe/useful; the benchmark diagnoses tested memory systems rather than establishing a universally best representation.

2610.27610.title: Auditing the Product, Not the Recursion: The Evaluation Evidence Behind Recursive Self-Improvement Claims
