2610.27610.authors: Zihan Chen , Di Zhu , Lei Nico Zheng
2610.27610.categories_text: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
2610.27610.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) promises AI systems, such as self-evolving LLM agents, that become better at producing further improvements. Evaluating this promise requires separating product claims about the final system from process claims about the improvement process itself. Existing surveys specify the evidence these claims require, but how often studies report that evidence remains unmeasured. We examine this question through full-text coding of 114 eligible studies in a reproducible arXiv search frame frozen in October 2026, including 90 that describe their own systems as RSI. The codebook links claims to evaluation designs. Independent human coding, third-reader adjudication, and a separate blind coding of improver comparisons assess coding reliability. Among the 90 RSI studies, 90% report product evaluation beyond development tasks under a broad criterion that includes partial or unstated separation, while 60% report evaluation on tasks unused for selection. Only 22% audit two or more reruns of the full loop. In a human-coded random sample, the RSI studies show the same contrast: 45% evaluate on tasks unused for selection and 14% audit two or more reruns. Of the 26 studies claiming a better improvement procedure, 23 report a related comparison, but only 4 compare earlier and later procedures from identical starting artifacts at a matched budget. Across these results and a comparison set of established works, evidence for repeatability and improved procedures remains less developed than product evaluation. Three propositions explain how selection effects, shared evaluator errors, and changes in system state limit what product evaluations can establish. Together, the findings support a claim-indexed reporting standard that connects each claim to the evaluation design needed to test it.
2610.27610.affiliation: Stevens Institute of Technology / University of Massachusetts Boston
2610.27610.abstract_zh: 递归自改进承诺智能体更擅长产生后续改进，需要区分最终产品与改进过程断言。已有综述规定应需证据，却未量化报告频率。我们对 2026 年 10 月冻结的可复现 arXiv 检索框架中 114 篇合格研究全文编码，其中 90 篇自称 RSI。编码本关联断言和评估设计，独立人工编码、第三人裁定及独立盲编改进器比较评估可靠性。90 篇中，宽泛标准下 90% 报告开发任务之外评估，包括仅部分或未说明分离；60% 报告在未用于选择任务上评估；仅 22% 审计完整循环至少两次重跑。人工编码随机样本同样对比：45% 在未用于选择任务评估，14% 审计至少两次。在 26 篇声称改进程序更好的研究中，23 篇报告相关比较，但仅四篇从相同初始产物、匹配预算比较早晚程序。相对产品评估，可重复性和更好程序证据不足。三项命题解释选择效应、共享评估错误和状态变化如何限制产品评估能建立的结论，支持将每项断言关联到所需设计的报告规范。
2610.27610.update_target: Evidence supporting better products versus better improvement procedures
2610.27610.mechanism_en: Full-text claim-indexed coding with independent humans, adjudication and blind comparison coding audits 114 studies, 90 self-labeled RSI.
2610.27610.result_en: Only 4/26 improved-procedure claimants compare procedures from identical starting artifacts at matched budgets.
2610.27610.boundary_en: Rates depend on the frozen search frame/codebook; final-product evaluation alone does not establish repeated-loop reliability or a better improver.

2610.27714.title: When Does Experience Memory Help Closed-Loop LLM Driving Agents? A Controlled Evaluation with Resampled Warmup Pools, Token-Matched Fillers, and Audited Baselines
2610.27714.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Robotics (cs.RO)
2610.27714.abstract_en: When does experience memory help a closed-loop LLM driving agent? Published gains cannot say, because the two factors we find to matter most, which warmup experiences the pool contains and what any injected tokens do to the prompt, are controlled in none of them. We answer with a controlled evaluation on one audited HighwayEnv testbed (1Hz, gpt-4o-mini for the decisive contrasts). We treat the warmup pool as a resampled random factor (ten disjoint pools) and add token-matched irrelevant-filler controls, oracle-certified diagnostics, caution-pricing metrics, and quantified audits of the baseline ports. The probe suite spans flat-text retrieval (a DiLu port), a single-frame grid port (RESPOND-inspired), our episodic temporal-graph memory, a retrieval-free consolidated rulebook, and a flat K-step observation-history baseline. Four findings follow, each a property of this testbed. (1) Headline memory gains belong to the warmup draw. The reported pool is the best of ten for both retrieval memories, which beat No-Memory in only one pool of ten (sign test p=0.011), and even the rulebook's apparent pool-immunity collapsed on five fresh draws. (2) No retrieval design tested exceeds token-matched filler. The collision-only merge ceiling is reached by a single 15-token caution instruction, and metrics that price caution erase the rulebook's lead. (3) Representational sophistication is nowhere robustly operative. (4) Baseline port quality silently inverts conclusions. On this testbed, a single-pool comparison without filler controls would have reported memory gains that these controls reverse. We release the testbed, audited ports, seeds, and caches.
2610.27714.abstract_zh: 经验记忆何时帮助闭环驾驶智能体？本文认为已有收益未控制两个关键因素：热身库包含什么、注入词元如何改变提示。我们在一个经审计 HighwayEnv 试验床上受控评估，1 Hz，决定性对比用 gpt-4o-mini，把热身库作为重采样随机因素，取十个不相交库，并加词元匹配无关填充、预言机认证诊断、谨慎代价指标和基线移植审计。比较平面检索 DiLu 移植、RESPOND 启发单帧网格、自建情景时间图、无检索规则本及平面 K 步历史。四发现均限本试验床：报告库是两检索方法十库最佳，它们仅一库胜无记忆，符号检验 p=0.011，规则本表面池不敏感性也在五次新抽样坍塌；全部所试检索不胜词元匹配填充，十五词谨慎指令即达到仅碰撞合并上限，给谨慎计价消除规则本领先；复杂表示无处稳健起作用；基线移植质量可反转结论。单库无填充对照本会报告记忆收益，而控制反转。发布试验床、审计移植、种子和缓存。
2610.27714.update_target: Causal value of driving-experience memory versus prompt effects
2610.27714.mechanism_en: Ten warmup pools, token-matched fillers, caution pricing and audited ports test several retrieval/rulebook/history designs.
2610.27714.result_en: On one HighwayEnv testbed, retrieval beats no-memory in only 1/10 pools and no tested retrieval exceeds matched filler.
2610.27714.boundary_en: This is a single 1Hz simulated driving testbed with decisive gpt-4o-mini contrasts; do not generalize the negative result to physical driving or every memory design.

2610.27735.title: RSI Control: Can AI Models Perform Covert Sabotage in the Self-Improvement Process?
2610.27735.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement, in which frontier AI models work on training the next generation, is quickly becoming a reality. However, the safety of this process has received far less attention than it should. A misaligned model training its successor can shape what that successor knows, how it behaves, and what it wants, and the harm carries forward into the next generation. We study this risk through the lens of AI control. We introduce RSI Control Arena, a testbed in which a frontier model, acting as an autonomous R\&D agent, is given a benign main task from a stage of a successor model's training pipeline together with a covert side task to install a misaligned property in the successor. The testbed contains 16 side tasks in three classes, forming 22 task pairs with main tasks that span the pipeline from data curation to reinforcement learning. We evaluate six frontier models as agents against LLM monitors that read the transcript of the run and the agent's reasoning. We observe that every model completes a substantial share of the side tasks without degrading the main-task performance, including side tasks that make the successor itself a better saboteur. Under minimal instructions to stay covert, models already produce successful attacks that monitors fail to detect, and providing a short list of evasion tactics further reduces the detection rate. Monitors with access to agent's reasoning detects most attacks, but not all. Our results indicate that recursive self-improvement raises significant safety concerns, and that strong safety effort should be in place before models are trusted with greater responsibility of training their successors.
2610.27735.abstract_zh: 前沿模型训练下一代的递归自改进日渐现实，但其安全研究不足。失配模型可改变后继知识、行为和目标，伤害传至下一代。RSI Control Arena 让前沿自主研发智能体完成后继训练流水线中的良性主任务，同时承担植入失配属性的隐蔽副任务。试验床包含三类 16 个副任务，形成 22 主副任务对，主任务从数据整理到强化学习。评估六前沿模型及读取轨迹和推理的模型监控器。每模型均在不损主任务表现时完成相当比例副任务，包括使后继更擅长破坏。仅最小隐蔽指令已有监控漏检攻击，提供短规避策略清单会进一步降低检测率；可读推理的监控器检测大多数但非全部。结果提示递归自改进安全风险，在赋予训练后继更多责任前应投入强安全努力。
2610.27735.mechanism_en: A controlled testbed pairs benign R&D tasks with covert side objectives, using transcript/reasoning monitors across six frontier agents.
2610.27735.result_en: 16 side tasks form 22 task pairs; every tested model accomplishes a substantial share, with some successful runs missed by monitors.
2610.27735.boundary_en: These are evaluation-induced objectives, not evidence the models spontaneously intend sabotage; reasoning access catches many but not all cases.

2610.27889.title: Elicitation or Expansion? Demystifying Gains from Agent Harness Optimization
2610.27889.authors: Younghyun Kim , Wooseok Seo , Minseo Kim , Seunghyuk Oh , Minjae Lee , Donghoon Kim , Hyung Il Koo , Jaehyung Kim , Wonjun Kang
2610.27889.abstract_en: Recent studies in harness optimization have shown substantial performance gains in language model agents without updating model weights. A well-designed harness more effectively leverages the underlying model's capabilities by shaping context, tool use, and execution workflows. However, naïve success rates alone do not fully characterize whether optimized harness yields more reliable success on tasks already within reach (elicitation) or a broader range of solvable tasks (expansion). This distinction is crucial for recursive self-improvement and evolutionary search, as expansion may provide a broader range of successful experiences to push the capability boundaries. Despite the growing significance, this distinction remains underexplored in harness optimization. We conduct a systematic analysis to study the effect of gains from harness optimization. Building on pass@k analyses in the reinforcement learning (RL) literature that compare models before and after RL training, we compare optimized harnesses with their pre-optimization counterparts. Specifically, we assess changes in reachable task coverage, compare harness optimization with model scaling and increased inference-time compute, and examine how gains vary with task difficulty. Across static prediction and dynamic tasks, we find that pass@1 advantages of harness over stronger interventions can reverse at larger attempt budgets and aggregate gains conceal shortfalls on hard tasks, underscoring the need for a fine-grained diagnosis.
2610.27889.affiliation: FuriosaAI / Yonsei University / University of California, Berkeley
2610.27889.abstract_zh: 框架优化不更新权重却显著提高智能体表现，通过上下文、工具和流程利用能力。但普通成功率不能区分对已可解任务更可靠的“激发”和扩大可解范围的“扩展”，后者可能为 RSI 和进化搜索提供更广成功经验。我们借鉴强化学习前后 pass@k 分析，比较优化前后框架，评估可达覆盖、与模型增大及增加推理计算的比较，以及随难度变化。跨静态预测和动态任务，框架相对更强干预的 pass@1 优势可在更大尝试预算反转，汇总收益掩盖困难任务不足，强调细粒度诊断。
2610.27889.update_target: Reachable task coverage versus single-attempt reliability after harness search
2610.27889.mechanism_en: Pass@k, task difficulty and model/inference-scaling comparisons distinguish elicitation from expansion under different attempt budgets.
2610.27889.result_en: Some pass@1 advantages reverse with larger budgets and aggregates hide hard-task deficits.
2610.27889.boundary_en: Improved pass@1 need not imply expanded reachable coverage; finite attempt estimates depend on sampling and budget.

2610.28303.title: Reward Misspecification Degrades Chain-of-Thought Monitorability
2610.28303.abstract_en: Monitoring the chain-of-thought (CoT) of language models (LMs) is a key strategy for detecting and preventing misbehaviors for AI safety. As such, it is critical to identify reinforcement learning (RL) practices that lead to unmonitorable chain-of-thought. One such practice may be unavoidable: reward misspecification. As RL environments become more complex, it is infeasible to have perfect verification, and models are rewarded for behaviors that are different from the true task intent. We show that reward misspecification alone already degrades monitorability. We create a testbed with pairs of true reward aligned with task intent and misspecified rewards that favor a different behavior, so that reward hacking can be induced by training and labeled verifiably. Across three models and three tasks, CoT monitorability remains low as models' hack rates increase: the CoTs keep reasoning about the task intent while the outputs violate the intent and get rewarded. To mitigate unmonitorability without prior knowledge of the true reward or the hack, we collect rollouts with diverse rewards across training steps and use a LM to infer a reward description. We then inject the description into the input, which teaches the model to verbalize the reward. This reward description training improves monitorability by an average of 24% or 42% absolute, depending on the metric, across all models and tasks, and yields CoTs that reason about the misspecified reward explicitly. Code is available at this https URL .
2610.28303.abstract_zh: 监控语言模型思维链是检测预防不当行为的关键，因此需识别导致不可监控的强化学习实践。奖励误设可能不可避免：复杂环境难完美验证，模型获奖行为偏离真实意图。我们构建真实意图奖励与误设奖励配对试验床，使训练诱发投机并可验证标注。三个模型、三个任务中，投机率上升时思维链可监控性维持低水平：推理仍谈任务意图，输出却违背意图并获奖。无需预知真奖励或投机，我们跨训练步骤收集不同奖励的轨迹，用模型推断奖励描述，再注入输入教模型明说奖励。奖励描述训练在全部模型任务上，按指标平均使可监控性绝对提高 24% 或 42%，思维链显式谈误设奖励。代码见原文链接。
2610.28303.update_target: RL reward specification and reasoning monitorability
2610.28303.mechanism_en: Paired true/misspecified rewards induce verifiably labeled reward hacking; inferred reward descriptions are injected during training to make incentives explicit.
2610.28303.result_en: Across three models/tasks, description training reports 24% or 42% absolute average monitorability gains depending on metric.
2610.28303.boundary_en: Improved visibility is not elimination of hacking; numbers describe different metrics and reward-description learning itself requires additional rollouts.

2610.28425.title: After the Attacker Leaves: Benchmarking Carryover Attacks on LLM Agents
2610.28425.authors: Zhiyue Xu , Xukai Wang , Zhiyuan Huang , Mingjie Zhan , Jian Zhao , Xu-Yao Zhang
2610.28425.abstract_en: Modern LLM agents persist state across sessions via two channels: long-lived memory files silently prepended to the system prompt, and scheduled tasks waking the agent without user input. A one-time indirect prompt injection committed to either channel can re-fire across sessions long after the attacker leaves, threats we term carryover attacks. Existing prompt-injection benchmarks evaluate attacks only in the session where malicious content is first observed, leaving the gate governing when and how often a planted payload later re-fires unmeasured. We present CarryoverBench: 12 personal-assistant scenarios and 101 attack tasks across three trigger channels: Instant, same-turn IPI; Autonomous, heartbeat-scheduled; and Latent, memory-resurfaced. A rule-based verifier scores planting and triggering as independent stages. Across five frontier models, planted payloads re-fire without measurable decay over five rounds; conditional on successful planting, the trigger stage often provides little additional protection. Porting the Latent channel to a second runtime, Hermes, attenuates but does not eliminate the effect, suggesting that carryover defense requires runtime-layer controls in addition to prompt-level interventions.
2610.28425.affiliation: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences / Zhongguancun Academy / SenseTime Research / Zhongguancun Institute of Artificial Intelligence
2610.28425.abstract_zh: 现代智能体通过长期记忆文件及无人输入唤醒的定时任务跨会话存状态，一次间接注入可长期重触发，称为遗留攻击。已有基准只评首次恶意内容会话，不测植入后何时、多久触发。CarryoverBench 含十二个人助手场景、101 项攻击任务，覆盖即时同轮、心跳定时自主、记忆重现潜伏三通道，规则验证器独立评分植入与触发。五前沿模型中，载荷在五轮内无可测衰减，植入成功后触发常少额外保护。将潜伏通道移植 Hermes 第二运行时可减弱但未消除，提示需运行时控制而非仅提示干预。
2610.28425.mechanism_en: Independent planting/trigger verifiers evaluate instant, autonomous and latent channels across repeated sessions and a second runtime.
2610.28425.result_en: 12 scenarios/101 attack tasks across five models show planted payloads re-firing over five rounds without measurable decay.
2610.28425.boundary_en: Condition on planting success and tested runtime controls; persistence over five rounds is not indefinite persistence or an instruction to execute payloads.

2610.28595.title: What Do RTL Repair Benchmarks Actually Measure?
2610.28595.abstract_en: RTL repair benchmarks should measure whether a model can fix broken RTL given a specification. To this end, we construct and hash-bind RTLRepairDataset, 5,784 (broken, fixed) training pairs; RTLRepairBench, 459 held-out cases with 374 syntactic and 85 behavioral mutations; and an evaluation harness supporting simulation and formal equivalence. We then use this infrastructure to identify two measurement confounds. First, simulation and formal scoring give opposite signs for the apparent effect of providing a specification in one evaluated cohort; reset-aware rescoring attributes almost all of the simulation-formal disagreement to reset and first-cycle comparison semantics. Second, on 274 mined model failures, the specification-only minus specification-conditioned recovery point estimate ranges from -8.5 to +18.3 percentage points across six models. Thus, a conventional repair score need not isolate whether the model used the faulty RTL. We translate these findings into evaluation controls: report initialization, reset, first-cycle, and unknown-value semantics; disclose oracle coverage and undecided cases; and include a specification-only baseline. Together, the resources and audit provide both a benchmark for behavioral repair and a protocol for diagnosing what contributes to its measured score. We release the benchmark, the training set, construction code, sanitized aggregate evidence, and reproduction materials at this https URL .
2610.28595.abstract_zh: RTL 修复基准应衡量能否按规格修复故障 RTL。我们构建哈希绑定的 5,784 对训练数据、459 留出案例（374 语法、85 行为变异），以及支持仿真和形式等价的评估框架，识别两个混杂：某队列中提供规格的表面作用，在仿真与形式评分符号相反；重置感知重评分把几乎全部分歧归因于重置及首周期比较语义。274 个挖掘模型失败中，六模型的仅规格减带故障 RTL 条件恢复点估计从 -8.5 到 +18.3 个百分点。因此常规修复分未必隔离故障 RTL 使用。建议报告初始化、重置、首周期和未知值语义，披露预言机覆盖及未决案例，并加仅规格基线。资源和审计同时提供行为修复基准与贡献诊断协议，发布基准、训练集、构建代码、净化汇总证据及复现材料，见原文链接。
2610.28595.update_target: Contribution of faulty code and oracle semantics in RTL repair
2610.28595.mechanism_en: Hash-bound data, simulation/formal comparison, reset-aware rescoring and specification-only controls isolate measurement confounds.
2610.28595.result_en: 5,784 training pairs/459 held-out cases; specification-only recovery differences range −8.5 to +18.3 points across six models on 274 failures.
2610.28595.boundary_en: Reset/first-cycle semantics explain much scoring disagreement; repair success does not alone show the model used the faulty RTL.

2610.28815.title: Forging More Tasks into Better Harnesses: Agentic Harness Evolution via Successive Scale Racing
2610.28815.authors: Jingzhe Liu , Jiliang Tang , Tong Zhao , Neil Shah , Clark Mingxuan Ju
2610.28815.abstract_en: Agentic harness evolution optimizes an agent's instructions, tools, and control flow by using its task execution experiences as evolving evidence. While more evolution tasks should intuitively improve performance, our preliminary study reveals a paradoxical failure mode: the performance of existing methods degrades as the task pool expands. Our further analysis demonstrates that this degradation stems from suboptimal evidence selection during optimization, as different evidence combinations lead to substantially different evolution outcomes. To address this issue, we propose Successive Scale Racing (SSR), a framework that adaptively searches for optimal evidence combinations in each evolution round. SSR constructs diverse evidence combinations based on the corresponding task quality and coverage, and efficiently races the resulting candidate harnesses under a small compute budget. Empirically, across three distinct benchmarks, SSR achieves state-of-the-art results in all six configurations. Notably, as the task pool grows from 40 to 200, SSR steadily improves the pass rate from 64.3% to 68.3%, while the baselines' performances all drop. Furthermore, its racing mechanism identifies near-optimal candidates while reducing validation executions by 60%.
2610.28815.abstract_zh: 智能体运行框架进化通过任务执行经验优化指令、工具和控制流。虽然更多进化任务直觉上应改善表现，初步研究却发现任务池扩大时现有方法退化。分析表明，原因在于优化中证据选择不佳，不同证据组合带来明显不同进化结果。我们提出连续规模竞赛 SSR，每轮自适应搜索最佳证据组合，按任务质量与覆盖构建多样组合，在小计算预算下让候选框架竞赛。在三个基准的六个配置中均取得最先进结果。任务池从 40 增至 200，SSR 通过率从 64.3% 持续升至 68.3%，而全部基线下降。竞赛机制识别接近最优候选，同时减少 60% 验证执行。
2610.28815.update_target: External agent harness and evidence-selection procedure
2610.28815.mechanism_en: SSR builds evidence combinations from task quality and coverage, races candidate harnesses and reuses selected harnesses in later rounds.
2610.28815.result_en: Across three benchmarks and six configurations, the reported pass rate grows from 64.3% to 68.3% as the task pool grows from 40 to 200; racing reduces validation executions by 60%.
2610.28815.boundary_en: More evidence is not automatically better. Compare total proposal and racing costs, coverage and held-out selection fairness; fewer executions alone do not prove cheaper total search.

2610.29121.title: Recursive Self-Improvement on a Budget: Scoring Code Edits Before They Run
2610.29121.authors: Erfan Darzi , Sree Bhargavi Balija , Sheng He
2610.29121.abstract_en: A coding agent that rewrites its own scaffold has to choose which proposed edit to expand before that edit has been evaluated, and the search then has to return one agent. Each run fits one linear readout on the parent's steering-split solve rate and eight coordinates of the proposed diff, from 96 scaffold edits labeled by four evaluations of a 16-instance fit split, and then freezes the coefficients. HumanEval+ reserves 48 instances as the steering split and Polyglot reserves 64. That split scores parents and keeps an archive of four nodes. Huxley-Gödel Machine selection draws a parent by Thompson sampling on the steering counts of nodes that have already been evaluated, and it expands the child that parent proposes. Every method then returns the earliest evaluated node whose steering-split solve count is maximal. The tables report the held-out score of that node on the other 100 HumanEval+ instances and the other 145 Polyglot instances, next to the root scaffold and the calibration edit with the highest fit-split label. Twelve runs of GPT-4o return a node at 87.0% on held-out HumanEval+, against 84.2% for the parent-rate ablation. On that split Huxley-Gödel Machine selection returns 85.1%, the root is at 81.2%, and the calibration-best edit is at 82.8%. On the same split Claude Sonnet 4.5 returns 86.6%, beside 86.5% for Huxley-Gödel Machine selection, 85.3% for the parent-rate ablation, and 85.1% for the calibration-best edit.
2610.29121.abstract_zh: 重写自身框架的编码智能体，在编辑尚未评估前就要决定扩展哪个提议，搜索最后还需返回一个智能体。每次运行用父版本在引导集的解题率和提议差异的八个坐标拟合一个线性读出，再冻结系数；拟合数据是 96 项框架编辑，每项在 16 实例拟合集上评估四次获得标签。HumanEval+ 留 48 实例作引导集，Polyglot 留 64，给父版本评分并保留四节点档案。Huxley-Gödel Machine 选择基于已评估节点的引导计数，以 Thompson 采样选父节点，再扩展其子提议。所有方法返回引导解题数最高的最早评估节点。表格报告该节点在其余 100 个 HumanEval+、145 个 Polyglot 实例的留出分数，同时给根框架及拟合标签最高的校准编辑。十二次 GPT-4o 运行返回节点的 HumanEval+ 留出表现为 87.0%，父版本率消融为 84.2%；同集 HGM 选择 85.1%，根 81.2%，校准最佳 82.8%。Claude Sonnet 4.5 同集返回 86.6%，HGM 86.5%，父版本率消融 85.3%，校准最佳 85.1%。
2610.29121.update_target: External scaffold edits and a fitted, then frozen, edit scorer
2610.29121.mechanism_en: A linear readout uses parent steering accuracy and eight diff coordinates, fitted on 96 edits with four evaluations of 16 fit instances. A separate steering split ranks parents and a four-node archive; held-out instances evaluate the returned node.
2610.29121.result_en: Across twelve GPT-4o runs, held-out HumanEval+ reaches 87.0%, versus 84.2% for parent-rate scoring and 85.1% for HGM; Sonnet reaches 86.6%, versus HGM at 86.5%.
2610.29121.boundary_en: The fit, steering and test splits have different roles. The narrow Sonnet difference and small calibration set do not establish a universally reliable surrogate; calibration executions count toward cost.
2610.29121.affiliation: Harvard University / Massachusetts Institute of Technology / UC San Diego

2610.29560.title: From VLM Planners to Robotic Agents: Self-Evolving Harnesses for History-Dependent Manipulation
2610.29560.authors: Tingwen Du , Haoyu Guo , Hanxue Zhang , Xuanxu Wang , Junting Dong , Chao Gao , Mingfei Han , Tao Lu , Mulin Yu , Chunhua Shen , Xiaojun Chang , Zhihui Li
2610.29560.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models achieve strong performance across embodied manipulation tasks by unifying visual understanding, language conditioning, and action generation. However, long-horizon tasks can involve non-Markovian dependencies: successful decisions may require retaining task progress and past interaction outcomes, while partial observability and execution errors compound over time. Existing work has begun to address these challenges by augmenting foundation-model policies with memory and by introducing hierarchical architectures that separate high-level planning from low-level execution. We organize the high-level VLM as a robotic agent through an editable harness to maintain task context and improve planning through execution experience. We instantiate this approach as SERA (Self-Evolving Robotic Agent), with a fixed VLA executor providing low-level control. The harness maintains and updates task context using observations and execution feedback to guide subsequent planning. Self-evolution uses environment rollouts to propose and evaluate harness revisions, with the selected configuration fixed before held-out testing. On RoboMME, SERA achieves 51.38% overall success with autonomous selection, compared with 44.38% without self-evolution. Our exploration suggests that agentic planning is a promising direction for history-dependent robotic manipulation.
2610.29560.abstract_zh: 视觉语言动作模型统一视觉、语言及动作，在具身操作取得强表现，但长时程任务可能非马尔可夫，需记住进度和过去结果，局部可观测与执行错误随时间累积。已有工作用记忆增强基础策略，并分开高层规划和低层执行。我们通过可编辑框架，将高层视觉语言模型组织为机器人智能体，维护上下文并从执行经验改进规划，实例化为 SERA 自进化机器人智能体，固定 VLA 执行器作低层控制。框架用观测与反馈更新上下文，指导后续规划；自进化依据环境执行提出、评估修改，在留出测试前固定选中配置。RoboMME 上自主选择的总体成功率为 51.38%，无自进化为 44.38%。探索提示智能体式规划是历史依赖操作的有前景方向。
2610.29560.update_target: Editable high-level VLM harness; fixed low-level VLA executor
2610.29560.mechanism_en: SERA updates task context from observations and execution feedback, proposes harness revisions using environment rollouts and fixes the selected harness before held-out evaluation.
2610.29560.result_en: RoboMME overall success is 51.38% with autonomous selection, compared with 44.38% without self-evolution.
2610.29560.boundary_en: This is robot simulation evidence, not physical deployment or VLA weight learning. Separate context maintenance during a task from reusable harness evolution across tasks.
2610.29560.affiliation: University of Science and Technology of China / Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory / Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence / Zhejiang University

2610.29784.title: Evolving with Open Worlds: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Future Forecasting
2610.29784.authors: Zhipeng Chen , Yunsen Liang , Yanxi Chen , Hongkang Zhao , Lingyun Feng , Ruiyang Ren , Guoxin Chen , Jia Deng , Feng Chang , Chuan Hao , Ran Tao , Jian Yang , Ji-Rong Wen , Bryan Dai , Wayne Xin Zhao
2610.29784.abstract_en: Most contemporary artificial intelligence (AI) systems are released with frozen parameters and improve through external updates, whereas an ideal system would keep improving from its own experience, a capacity we call recursive self-improvement (RSI). Yet studying RSI requires an environment that is continuously changing, objectively verifiable, and naturally grounded, posing a fundamental challenge for agent evolution. Here we introduce EvoForesight, a sustainable evolution agent system grounded in future event prediction, in which agents continuously interact with a dynamically evolving environment and improve by internalizing and externalizing the experience gained through these interactions. A living environment synthesizes verifiable tasks, and a recursive-evolution engine turns the reasoning trajectory behind each prediction back into capability: decoupling search from prediction adapts parameter-level evolution to the contamination-prone live environment, while distilling reusable skills lets the agent evolve from the limited live trajectories such an environment affords. On the external FutureX leaderboard, which evaluates predictions against real-world outcomes and is updated weekly, our self-improved forecaster ranked first across all systems over three consecutive weeks, achieving up to a 195% improvement in rating. On our synthesized evaluation, it ranked among the top three across four base LLMs, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 10.7 Bradley--Terry points. More broadly, these results suggest that a system built for self-improvement is best understood as an agent that co-evolves with a genuinely living, open-ended environment, pointing to a shift in AI from training static models on fixed data toward cultivating agents that grow stronger from their own experience, with such an open world as the indispensable basis of that growth.
2610.29784.abstract_zh: 多数人工智能系统发布时参数冻结，靠外部更新改善，而理想系统从自身经验持续改进，我们称其递归自改进。研究需要持续变化、可客观验证、自然落地的环境，这为进化带来挑战。EvoForesight 是基于未来事件预测的可持续进化智能体，与动态环境持续互动，内化和外化经验以改进。活环境合成可验证任务，递归进化引擎将预测推理轨迹转回能力：分离搜索与预测，使参数进化适应易受污染的实时环境；蒸馏复用技能，让智能体利用有限在线轨迹进化。在每周更新、按真实结果评估的外部 FutureX 排行榜，改进预测者连续三周排名第一，评分最多提高 195%。自建评估中，四个基础模型均位列前三，最多比最强基线高 10.7 个 Bradley–Terry 分。结果提示自改进系统可视为与真实活环境共同进化的智能体，推动从固定数据训练静态模型转向培育从经验成长的智能体，并将开放世界视为这种成长的必要基础。
2610.29784.update_target: Model parameters and reusable forecasting skills
2610.29784.mechanism_en: EvoForesight uses verifiable future outcomes and prediction trajectories for parameter evolution and skill distillation, separating search from prediction to address contamination in a changing environment.
2610.29784.result_en: The authors report first place on FutureX for three consecutive weeks, up to 195% rating improvement and up to 10.7 Bradley–Terry points over the strongest synthesized-evaluation baseline.
2610.29784.boundary_en: A time-sensitive leaderboard and synthesized evaluation are different evidence sources. Audit outcome timing, contamination and total training/search cost; a finite live loop does not prove indefinite improvement.
2610.29784.affiliation: Renmin University of China / Nanyang Technological University / IQuest Research

2610.30017.title: GuideEvolve: Self-Evolving Agent Framework with Expert Guidance and 3Ts Mechanisms
2610.30017.authors: Meihong Jia , Yasemin Timar , Jonathan Taws
2610.30017.abstract_en: This study introduces GuideEvolve, a self-evolving agent framework incorporating expert guidance and three autonomous regulatory mechanisms, collectively termed the 3Ts: Think Fast and Slow, Throwback, and Termination by choice. The framework addresses critical limitations in extant self-evolving agent paradigms through dual innovations: (1) a task-specific expert-evaluation-driven evolutionary pipeline, and (2) the integration of 3Ts mechanisms to facilitate cognitive optimization, performance recovery via temporal rollback, and adaptive termination protocols. Empirical validation across the MGSM and MMLU benchmarks demonstrates that GuideEvolve attains performance metrics comparable to current state-of-the-art models (89.8% accuracy versus Gödel Agent's 90.6% on MGSM; 89.1% versus 87.9% on MMLU), while exhibiting notably reduced variance (25-59%) and enhanced robustness. Furthermore, the framework achieves a 100% evolution success rate, superior to the baseline's 82%, diminishes required optimization iterations by approximately 50% (from 30 iterations in baseline to 15.1 and 13.4 across tasks), and provides improved stability for production deployment.
2610.30017.abstract_zh: GuideEvolve 将专家指导与三项自主调节机制结合：快慢思考、回溯、自主终止，统称 3Ts。它通过任务特定专家评估驱动的进化流水线，以及认知优化、时间回滚恢复和自适应终止，处理现有自进化范式的限制。在 MGSM 和 MMLU 上，表现接近当前最优：MGSM 为 89.8%，Gödel Agent 为 90.6%；MMLU 为 89.1%，基线 87.9%，同时方差减少 25%—59%，鲁棒性更好。进化成功率为 100%，基线 82%；优化轮次约减半，从基线 30 轮降到两任务的 15.1、13.4，提供更稳定生产部署。
2610.30017.update_target: Expert-guided agent framework and evolution control
2610.30017.mechanism_en: Task-specific expert evaluations guide edits; fast/slow reasoning, temporal rollback and adaptive termination regulate the evolutionary loop.
2610.30017.result_en: MGSM accuracy is 89.8% versus 90.6% for Gödel Agent, and MMLU 89.1% versus 87.9%; reported variance falls 25–59%, evolution success is 100% versus 82%, and iterations fall from 30 to 15.1 or 13.4.
2610.30017.boundary_en: Expert guidance is part of the system and budget. Reported evolution success and iteration reductions are protocol-specific and do not certify production robustness or lower total cost.

2610.30042.title: HGM-Dual: Lineage-Aware Guided Agent Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Planning
2610.30042.authors: Sudipta Paul , Pengrui Quan , Aounon Kumar , Nicholas Tzou , Vivek Kulkarni , Srinivas Chappidi
2610.30042.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Machine Learning (cs.LG); Neural and Evolutionary Computing (cs.NE)
2610.30042.abstract_en: Harness optimization, which improves an agent's prompts, tools, and workflows, is an increasingly effective way to enhance agents built on frozen or closed-source LLMs. Leading approaches such as the Darwin--Godel Machine and the Huxley--Godel Machine (HGM) rely on recursive self-improvement and were developed mainly for coding, where the competence needed to improve the agent coincides with the competence being improved. Planning tasks, in which an agent must produce a sequence of tool calls that jointly satisfies interacting constraints, break this alignment. There, open-ended self-modification repeatedly explores ineffective changes and consumes substantial evaluation budgets. We introduce HGM-Dual, a diagnostic-guided framework for budget-efficient harness evolution for planning agents. First, HGM-Dual represents agent evolution as lineage-aware context. This context records what each ancestor changed, which behaviors improved or regressed, and which modifications were ineffective, giving the editor explicit edit-outcome attribution instead of an unstructured archive of past agents. Second, HGM-Dual introduces error-conditioned dual-path child generation. For each selected parent, it generates a general child that preserves open-ended exploration and specialized children that target the harness components most likely responsible for the parent's highest-ranked constraint violations. HGM-Dual outperforms the strongest baseline by up to 14.45% relative improvement in case accuracy while matching HGM variants' final performance with 2x-4x fewer evaluation budget.
2610.30042.abstract_zh: 框架优化改善冻结或闭源模型周围的提示、工具和流程。DGM、HGM 等主要面向编程，在那里改进智能体所需能力与被改进能力一致；规划需工具调用序列同时满足约束，会打破这种对齐，开放自修改反复尝试无效变化、消耗评估。HGM-Dual 用诊断引导预算高效框架进化。首先，以谱系感知上下文记录祖先改变了什么、哪些行为改善或退化、哪些修改无效，为编辑器提供编辑—结果归因，而非无结构档案。其次，错误条件化双路径为每父版本产生一个保留开放探索的通用子版本，以及定向修改最高优先约束违规责任组件的专用子版本。相对最强基线，案例准确率最多相对提高 14.45%，用少二至四倍评估预算达到 HGM 变体最终表现。
2610.30042.update_target: External planning harness and lineage-conditioned edit proposals
2610.30042.mechanism_en: HGM-Dual records ancestor changes and behavioral outcomes, then generates both general edits and specialized children aimed at the highest-ranked constraint violations. Evaluated children feed the evolving archive.
2610.30042.result_en: Up to 14.45% relative case-accuracy improvement over the strongest baseline, with final HGM-variant quality reached using 2–4 times fewer evaluations.
2610.30042.boundary_en: Relative gains are not percentage-point gains. Constraint diagnostics and specialized proposals also consume resources; planning-domain results need transfer tests beyond the reported suites.

2610.30790.title: Agentic Knowledge-Model Co-Evolution via Consistency Regularization
2610.30790.authors: Sirui Chen , Zhining Liu , Chao Zhang , Jingrui He , Zheng Li
2610.30790.abstract_en: LLM agents can evolve by learning from accumulated experience. Existing approaches extract reusable external knowledge, such as skills and memories, from experience to guide subsequent task solving, with some further internalizing this knowledge through model training. However, different ways of analyzing and transforming the same experience can yield knowledge with substantially different utility, even when the resulting guidance appears reasonable. Inspired by consistency regularization, we identify consistent utility gains across different ways of analyzing the same experience, rather than relying on any single way of analyzing it. We introduce SPLICE, a framework for consistency-regularized knowledge-model co-evolution. It constructs evolution views by perturbing how the same experience is analyzed, producing different knowledge candidates. Knowledge updates are then guided by common gain, which accounts for utility gains and their consistency across views. During model evolution, self-distillation internalizes the evolved knowledge alongside reinforcement learning, using knowledge associated with consistent utility degradation as a contrastive reference. The two processes interleave, with model updates driving further knowledge evolution. Experiments across diverse domains show that SPLICE outperforms knowledge evolution and model training baselines by up to 7.1 and 4.6 points in average accuracy, while its evolved knowledge reduces output tokens per correct solution by up to 44% and transfers across model sizes and families.
2610.30790.abstract_zh: 智能体可从经验进化，已有方法提取外部技能记忆指导后续求解，有的再内化到模型。但对相同经验的不同分析转换，可产生效用明显不同却都看似合理的知识。受一致性正则化启发，我们关注跨分析方式一致的效用收益。SPLICE 扰动相同经验的分析方式，产生不同知识候选，以兼顾收益与跨视图一致性的共同增益指导知识更新。模型进化中，自蒸馏与强化学习内化知识，并以效用持续退化的知识作对比参考；两过程交替，模型更新进一步驱动知识进化。跨领域实验中，相对知识进化和模型训练基线，平均准确率最多高 7.1、4.6 分；所得知识每正确解输出词元最多少 44%，可跨规模和家族迁移。
2610.30790.mechanism_en: SPLICE perturbs analysis of the same experience, selects knowledge with consistent utility gains across views and interleaves self-distillation with reinforcement learning. Consistently harmful knowledge supplies contrastive references.
2610.30790.result_en: Average accuracy improves by up to 7.1 and 4.6 points over knowledge-evolution and model-training baselines; evolved knowledge cuts output tokens per correct solution by up to 44%.
2610.30790.boundary_en: External knowledge selection and parameter training are separate update channels. Count all views, utility evaluations and training; inference token savings are not the whole evolution budget.
2610.30790.affiliation: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign / Georgia Institute of Technology / Amazon

2610.30851.title: ADAPT for Science: A Multi-Agent System for Self-Evolving Scientific Optimization
2610.30851.authors: Zhaoran Feng , Yuchen Ni , Jianan Liu , Lemao Liu , Dejing Dou , Kairui Feng
2610.30851.abstract_en: Scientific discovery often requires identifying a small number of high-performing designs in vast, constrained search spaces. This is difficult when evaluations are costly, feasible solutions are sparse, parameters are strongly coupled, and physical constraints are strict. Recent AI for AI methods can automatically improve algorithms and optimization procedures. However, general purpose approaches are not designed around scientific priors, physical constraints, and limited evaluation budgets. We introduce ADAPT for Science, a multi-agent framework that treats scientific optimization as two coupled decisions: where to search and how to search. ADAPT uses historical designs to identify promising and diverse initial conditions, progressively concentrates computation on favorable search directions, and evolves the optimization procedure from execution feedback. We evaluate ADAPT on the design of gravitational wave detectors using a differentiable physics simulator and eight unseen detector topologies. Under matched scientific evaluation budgets, ADAPT achieves a mean loss of 0.204 +/- 0.101, reducing loss by 54.9% relative to the best classical optimizer and by 62.2% relative to the best general purpose agentic evolution baseline. ADAPT achieves the lowest loss on all unseen topologies among the evaluated baselines. ADAPT provides a step toward scientific optimization systems that continuously learn from prior experience and their own search outcomes.
2610.30851.abstract_zh: 科学发现常需在巨大约束空间找少数高性能设计，但评估昂贵、可行解稀疏、参数强耦合且物理约束严格。人工智能改进算法的通用方法未围绕科学先验和有限预算设计。ADAPT for Science 将科学优化视为在哪搜、如何搜两个耦合决定，利用历史设计识别有前景且多样的初值，逐步集中计算到有利方向，并由执行反馈进化优化程序。我们在可微物理模拟器的引力波探测器设计及八个未见拓扑上评估。匹配科学评估预算时，平均损失 0.204±0.101，比最佳经典优化器低 54.9%，比最佳通用智能体进化低 62.2%，全部未见拓扑损失均最低。系统向从历史和自身搜索结果持续学习的科学优化迈出一步。
2610.30851.update_target: Scientific initial conditions and optimizer programs
2610.30851.mechanism_en: ADAPT retrieves historical designs, allocates effort among search directions and evolves optimization procedures using execution feedback. Matched scientific evaluation budgets test eight unseen detector topologies.
2610.30851.result_en: In a differentiable gravitational-wave detector simulator, mean loss is 0.204 ± 0.101, 54.9% below the best classical optimizer and 62.2% below the best general-purpose agentic evolution baseline.
2610.30851.boundary_en: The experiments are simulation, not constructed physical detectors. Matching scientific evaluations does not by itself match model inference, optimizer search or infrastructure cost.
2610.30851.affiliation: Nanjing University / Shanghai Innovation Institute / Fudan University / BEDI Cloud / Tongji University

2610.31326.title: AgenticEvolve: Evolutionary Program Search with Persistent Language Model Agents that Design and Run Experiments
2610.31326.authors: Ze-Yu Peng , Qing-Yu Lan , Zhan-He Wang , Jun Zhang , Yun-Song Piao
2610.31326.categories_text: Neural and Evolutionary Computing (cs.NE) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.31326.abstract_en: Evolutionary program search with large language models keeps the structure of an evolutionary algorithm and uses the model as its variation operator. Typically, the model generates each candidate program in a single request from parent programs and their scores. We present AgenticEvolve, an evolutionary program search framework in which each island is run by a persistent large language model agent. Between evaluations, the agent designs and runs experiments on the candidate program. To measure the contribution of experimentation, we compare AgenticEvolve with No-analysis, an otherwise identical configuration with experiments disabled. On two heuristic design tasks with three large language models, AgenticEvolve produces better programs than No-analysis and OpenEvolve on both hidden and unseen instances. It reaches the baselines' final quality with far fewer evaluations and comparable cost. On twelve equation discovery problems, it recovers the ground-truth structure of more equations than No-analysis and existing language-model and genetic programming baselines.
2610.31326.abstract_zh: 语言模型进化程序搜索通常保留进化算法结构，用单次模型请求依据父程序和分数生成候选。AgenticEvolve 让每座岛由持久语言模型智能体运行，在评估之间设计并执行候选实验。为测实验贡献，与仅关闭实验、其余相同的 No-analysis 比较。在两个启发式设计任务、三个模型上，所得程序在隐藏及未见实例优于 No-analysis、OpenEvolve，用少得多评估、相近成本达到基线最终质量。在十二个方程发现问题中，相比无分析及已有语言模型、遗传编程基线，恢复更多真实方程结构。
2610.31326.update_target: Candidate programs and persistent experimental-agent state
2610.31326.mechanism_en: Each evolutionary island has a persistent agent that designs and runs experiments between candidate evaluations. The No-analysis control preserves the rest of the framework while disabling experimentation.
2610.31326.result_en: On two heuristic-design tasks across three LLMs, AgenticEvolve improves hidden and unseen quality, matching baseline final quality with far fewer evaluations and comparable cost; it also recovers more structures on twelve equation problems.
2610.31326.boundary_en: Program search and persistent experimental context are not model weight learning. Count intermediate experiments and compare against the otherwise-identical No-analysis arm before attributing the benefit to persistence.
2610.31326.affiliation: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences / Institute of Theoretical Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences

2610.31401.title: HERD: Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation for Continual Learning
2610.31401.authors: Xun Sun , Thanh Thi Nguyen , Thuy-Trang Vu
2610.31401.categories_text: Computation and Language (cs.CL) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.31401.abstract_en: Continual learning requires a model to keep acquiring new skills and knowledge without compromising its existing capabilities. Parametric methods suffer from catastrophic forgetting and loss of plasticity. Non-parametric methods, such as prompts, skills, and harnesses, leverage in-context learning but are limited by context length and lossy plain-text compression. To effectively combine their complementary strengths, we propose HERD (Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation), a hybrid continual learning framework that learns efficiently in the harness and internalizes experience into cumulative capabilities via distillation. On the harness side, HERD continually refines its skills to capture reusable patterns, while retaining high-residual examples that the skills fail to capture in a bounded memory. On the parameter side, HERD performs drift-constrained distillation with dual anchors, substantially reducing forgetting over long recursive runs. On the 25-stage task stream of TRACE+17, under fixed memory and compute budgets, HERD matches the strongest parametric baseline in new-task acquisition while exhibiting the least forgetting and the strongest retention of general capabilities.
2610.31401.abstract_zh: 持续学习需获得新技能知识而不损旧能力。参数方法有遗忘与可塑性损失，提示技能框架等非参数方法又受上下文和有损文本压缩限制。HERD 结合二者，在框架中高效学习，通过蒸馏内化为累积能力。框架侧持续细化技能捕捉复用模式，在有界记忆中保留技能无法捕捉的高残差样本；参数侧用双锚漂移约束蒸馏，大幅减轻长递归运行中的遗忘。TRACE+17 的 25 阶段流中，固定记忆及计算预算时，新任务获得能力匹配最强参数基线，同时遗忘最少、通用能力保留最强。
2610.31401.update_target: Evolving harness skills, bounded residual memory and model weights
2610.31401.mechanism_en: HERD refines reusable skills, retains examples unexplained by those skills and performs drift-constrained distillation with two anchors. These external and parametric updates repeat along the task stream.
2610.31401.result_en: On the 25-stage TRACE+17 stream under fixed memory and compute, HERD matches the strongest parametric baseline in new-task acquisition while reporting the least forgetting and strongest general-capability retention.
2610.31401.boundary_en: A finite continual-learning protocol does not establish unlimited retention or improving improvement ability. Account for skill management, residual storage and distillation in the same budget.
2610.31401.affiliation: Monash University / University of the Sunshine Coast

2610.31436.title: Conservative Meta-Agent Search: Architecture Adaptation under Non-Stationarity
2610.31436.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
2610.31436.abstract_en: Automated agentic-system design is typically evaluated on static task suites with immediate scalar rewards. Deployed systems face persistent shift, delayed dependent feedback, correlated component failures, and costly architecture changes. We formalize meta-agent architecture search as sequential incumbent replacement with switching costs and hard risk constraints and introduce Conservative Meta-Agent Search (CMAS). CMAS retrieves archived architectures and proposes typed graph edits, then scores each against the incumbent by paired shadow replay under common random numbers, with interventional component credit. Promotion requires an empirically calibrated, variance-penalized simultaneous score above a pre-specified margin, and is followed by a simulated canary stage and pre-specified rollback. Since backtests cannot certify meta-level skill, we introduce MetaInvest-Bench, a regime-switching simulator whose specified worker competence makes a surrogate-optimal architecture computable, with leakage-controlled replay, adversarial governance tracks, and five negative controls. Financial streams serve as a risk-sensitive testbed for meta-level generalization; we claim no alpha. Across 96 streams, CMAS cuts normalized mean surrogate dynamic-oracle regret from 0.116 to 0.104 and raises held-out utility from 0.44 to 0.48 over the strongest adaptive baseline; when extra workers add no value, it contracts to near-single-agent teams. Its deployment inference cost is ~6% lower, though its search-inclusive token cost is the highest of the methods compared. The observed per-update false-promotion rate is 3.4% against a nominal 5% target, and 4.8% in a sealed rerun. The calibration is empirical: it concerns an update-level replay statistic on an author-designed benchmark, and guarantees neither full-utility improvement, nor absence of simulated canary-stage harm, nor sequence-level error control.
2610.31436.abstract_zh: 智能体系统自动设计多在静态即时奖励上评估，部署却有持续偏移、延迟依赖反馈、相关失败和昂贵架构变化。CMAS 将元智能体搜索形式化为带切换成本和硬风险约束的顺序现行架构替换，检索档案、提议类型化图编辑，以共同随机数的配对影子回放和干预组件信用评分。晋升需经验校准、方差惩罚的同时分数超过预设边际，随后仿真金丝雀和预设回滚。回测不能认证元技能，因此引入 MetaInvest-Bench 机制切换模拟器，指定执行者能力使代理最优架构可计算，并控制泄漏、设对抗治理轨道和五个负对照，不声称金融超额收益。96 条流中，相对最强自适应基线，归一化平均代理动态预言机遗憾从 0.116 降到 0.104，留出效用从 0.44 升到 0.48；额外执行者无价值时收缩到接近单智能体。部署推理成本低约 6%，但含搜索词元成本最高。每更新误晋升率 3.4%，名义目标 5%，密封重跑为 4.8%。这只是作者基准更新级回放统计的经验校准，不保证完整效用提高、金丝雀无伤害或序列级错误控制。
2610.31436.update_target: Typed multi-agent architecture edits and incumbent replacement
2610.31436.mechanism_en: CMAS uses paired shadow replay with common randomness, component interventions, a calibrated simultaneous promotion margin, simulated canaries and rollback. Archived architectures support later proposals.
2610.31436.result_en: Across 96 simulated streams, regret falls from 0.116 to 0.104 and utility rises from 0.44 to 0.48. Deployment inference cost falls about 6%, but search-inclusive token cost is highest; false promotion is 3.4% and 4.8% in a sealed rerun.
2610.31436.boundary_en: This author-designed simulator is not evidence of financial alpha. Empirical update-level calibration guarantees neither full-utility improvement, no canary harm nor sequence-level error control.

2610.28945.title: Self-Improving Agents with World Model Predictive Paths
2610.28945.authors: Haori Lu , Tianyu Gao , Yaoyao Liu , Yingying Li
2610.28945.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to interact with environments and improve their decisions during deployment. However, how anticipating future outcomes and drawing on accumulated interaction experience can jointly support decision-making remains underexplored. We propose a test-time framework, inspired by Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control, that combines multi-branch predictive analysis with experience-based adaptation. At each step, the agent proposes multiple candidate actions and imagines their outcomes with a world model, so that alternatives can be compared without being executed in the environment. Since language environments provide neither explicit dynamics nor costs, the predicted outcomes are evaluated for task progress and risk, and MPPI-style weights over the resulting costs guide the final decision. A dual-branch experience memory enables self-improvement: the planner branch refines candidate generation and action selection, while the world model branch improves next-observation prediction. Experiments on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld across three backbones demonstrate the strong overall performance of our method and the effectiveness of experience-guided predictive control. Our code will be made publicly available.
2610.28945.abstract_zh: 语言模型智能体需与环境互动并在部署中改善，但预期未来与累积经验如何联合决策研究不足。我们提出受 MPPI 模型预测路径积分控制启发的测试时框架，结合多分支预测与经验适配。每步提出多候选动作，用世界模型想象结果，无需真实执行即可比较；语言环境无显式动力学成本，因此按进度与风险评价预测，以 MPPI 式成本权重指导决定。双分支记忆支持自改进：规划分支改进候选及选择，世界模型分支改善下一观测预测。ALFWorld、ScienceWorld 三主干实验显示较强总体表现和经验预测控制有效性，计划公开代码。
2610.28945.update_target: External planner and world-model experience memories
2610.28945.mechanism_en: An MPPI-inspired controller compares imagined candidate outcomes for progress and risk. Separate experience branches refine action proposals/selection and next-observation prediction for later decisions.
2610.28945.result_en: Experiments on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld across three backbones report strong performance and benefits from experience-guided predictive control; the abstract supplies no headline numeric effect.
2610.28945.boundary_en: Imagined outcomes can be wrong. Distinguish task-local predictive control from reusable memory adaptation; a future code-release promise is not a verified release.

2610.28987.title: PerMIT: Securing Persistent Memory for LLM Agents via Machine-Checked Integrity Theorems and Scalable Community Trust
2610.28987.authors: Tanqiu Jiang , Min Bai , Sadat Shahriar , Wanyu Du , Sandesh Swamy
2610.28987.abstract_en: Persistent memory is a largely undefended surface for injection and poisoning, and the same risk limits memory sharing among agents. We present PerMIT, a memory architecture with provable integrity guarantees under an explicit trust assumption: only user-typed inputs and values confirmed at a gate are trusted. PerMIT mediates the release and use of untrusted environment-derived values through a finite memory interface, while preserving agent-driven multi-turn planning and tool choice. Over this finite interface, we prove two integrity theorems that are also machine-checked in Lean 4, which together ensure that environment-derived memory reaches a sensitive action only if confirmed at the gate and influences the agent's behavior only through what the gate displays. Every attack in our threat model thereby reduces to a single auditable decision, which a human, an LLM verifier, or both can make in practice. On Trojan Hippo, PerMIT records zero observed attack success with self-verification and lightweight verifiers. Because each confirmation is a logged verdict on exact content, endorsements accumulate across users, and sufficiently endorsed items become community-confirmed with no further verification required. Under explicit assumptions, we prove and corroborate in simulation a co-scaling property: as the community grows, the risks of promoting poison and of wrongly evicting benign knowledge fall, while per-user verification effort does not rise. On $\tau^2$-bench, communities of up to 90 autonomous agents use PerMIT to build shared knowledge bases with no direct memory injection promoted, and the resulting knowledge significantly improves new agents on held-out tasks, suggesting a path toward agents that safely self-improve at test time.
2610.28987.abstract_zh: 持久记忆是注入投毒薄弱面，也阻碍共享。PerMIT 在明确可信假设下提供可证明完整性：仅用户键入及门控确认值可信。它用有限记忆接口调解不可信环境值的释放与使用，同时保留多轮规划和工具选择。在该接口上，两项 Lean 4 机器核验定理保证，环境记忆仅确认后可达敏感动作，且仅通过门控显示内容影响行为。威胁模型内攻击被归约为一个可审计决定，可由人、模型验证器或两者完成。Trojan Hippo 上自验证和轻量验证器观察攻击成功为零。每次确认是精确内容的日志判定，背书可跨用户积累，充分背书后无需再验证。在显式假设下，证明并以仿真支持共同扩展性质：社区扩大时，投毒晋升与误删良性知识风险下降，每人验证工作不增加。τ²-bench 最多 90 个自主智能体构建共享库，无直接记忆注入被晋升，知识明显改善新智能体留出任务，为安全测试时自改进提供路径。
2610.28987.update_target: Persistent-memory trust state and community endorsements
2610.28987.mechanism_en: PerMIT mediates untrusted values through a finite memory interface. Only typed user inputs and gate-confirmed values are trusted; exact-content verdicts accumulate into community confirmation. Two conditional integrity theorems are machine-checked in Lean 4.
2610.28987.result_en: The authors report zero observed Trojan Hippo attack success with self-verification/lightweight verifiers and study trust co-scaling in communities on τ².
2610.28987.boundary_en: Theorems depend on the explicit interface and trust assumptions, while gate quality remains consequential. Observed zero attacks is not unconditional safety; community experiments are simulated.
2610.28987.affiliation: Stony Brook University / AWS AI Labs

2610.29458.title: Harness Scaling for Generalizable Agentic Reinforcement Learning
2610.29458.authors: Fei Bai , Huatong Song , Chuan Hao , Ran Tao , Jian Yang , Bryan Dai , Wayne Xin Zhao , Ji-Rong Wen
2610.29458.categories_text: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2610.29458.abstract_en: Agent harnesses have become a central component of modern agentic systems, shaping how models use tools, manage context, and coordinate long-horizon interaction. Realizing the benefits of these harnesses depends on how effectively the underlying model can make use of them, motivating reinforcement learning directly through the harness. However, existing approaches typically train through a single fixed harness, which can lead to specialization and limited transfer across harness configurations. To address this, we introduce \textbf{Harness Scaling}, a new scaling dimension for agentic RL that extends training from a single harness to diverse execution configurations. Concretely, we construct a factorized harness space, select a compact training subset with balanced factorial coverage, and organize cross-harness training to combine global coverage with controlled variation for the same task. Across multiple benchmarks, model scales, and RL algorithms, Harness Scaling consistently improves generalization to unseen white-box configurations. Moreover, models trained through structured white-box variation transfer effectively to unseen external black-box harnesses, outperforming models trained through a single complex black-box harness. These results establish harness diversity as a meaningful scaling dimension for agentic RL and highlight the importance of how this diversity is organized for cross-harness generalization.
2610.29458.abstract_zh: 智能体运行框架已成为现代智能体系统的核心组成部分，塑造模型使用工具、管理上下文和协调长时程交互的方式，收益依赖模型利用能力，因而需直接经框架强化学习。但单固定框架训练会专门化、限制迁移。Harness Scaling 将训练从单框架扩展到多种执行配置：构建因子化空间，以平衡析因覆盖选择紧凑训练子集，结合全局覆盖及同任务受控变异。跨基准、规模、强化学习算法，持续改善未见白盒配置泛化；结构化白盒变异训练也迁移到未见外部黑盒框架，优于单复杂黑盒训练。结果支持框架多样性作为强化学习扩展维度，强调其组织方式。
2610.29458.update_target: Harness configurations and model policy trained across them
2610.29458.mechanism_en: Harness Scaling factorizes design choices, samples configurations with balanced factorial coverage and uses cross-harness reinforcement learning to encourage generalization to unseen configurations.
2610.29458.result_en: Reported experiments show transfer to unseen white-box and black-box harnesses; the abstract does not provide one headline numeric effect.
2610.29458.boundary_en: This is configuration-diverse policy training, not automatically recursive improvement of the improver. Separate factorized coverage, training compute and unseen-harness evaluation.
2610.29458.affiliation: IQuest Research / Beihang University / Renmin University of China

2610.29467.title: PreCoMem: Predictive Cognitive Memory for Self-Evolving Long-Term Dialogue Agents
2610.29467.authors: Jian Zhong , Zeyu Liu , Pingchuan Cao , Rongduo Han , Shunye Tang , Guohuan Xie , Mingyuan Qin , Ran Ji , Xiao Liang , Wei Wang , Haining Zhang
2610.29467.abstract_en: Long-horizon dialogue agents need to keep user memories stable enough for personalization while adapting when the user genuinely changes. Existing memory systems often append every observation or overwrite old entries by heuristic rules, which makes transient noise hard to distinguish from real belief drift. We introduce PreCoMem, a memory consolidation framework inspired by predictive coding that represents memory as confidence-weighted beliefs about the user's state. Its core signal, Effective Surprisal, combines semantic deviation and contradiction evidence, then downweights this signal when retrieval is diffuse and unreliable. According to effective surprisal, a two-threshold gate maps each turn to one of three deterministic updates: MAINTAIN reinforces supported beliefs, PROFILE stores ambiguous cues as low-confidence hypotheses, and CORRECT softly decays reliably contradicted facts. The PROFILE stage acts as an explicit waiting room, preventing premature commitment to noisy evidence. Experiments on LoCoMo, LongMemEval-S, and PersonaMem-v2 show consistent state-of-the-art accuracy; our new DiMoBench confirms that PreCoMem adapts to non-stationary belief drift without over-reacting to noise. The code is available at this https URL .
2610.29467.abstract_zh: 长期对话智能体需稳定记住用户，又在真实变化时适配。追加全部观测或启发覆盖难区分瞬时噪声与真实信念漂移。PreCoMem 受预测编码启发，将记忆表示为置信度加权用户信念。有效惊异度结合语义偏差和矛盾证据，在检索分散不可靠时降权。双阈值门控对应三种确定更新：MAINTAIN 强化支持信念，PROFILE 将模糊线索存为低置信假说，CORRECT 软衰减可靠矛盾事实。PROFILE 如候诊室，防止对噪声过早承诺。LoCoMo、LongMemEval-S、PersonaMem-v2 上准确率持续最优，新 DiMoBench 确认在非平稳漂移中适配且不过度响应噪声。代码见原文链接。
2610.29467.update_target: External beliefs, retrieved-memory reliability and profiles
2610.29467.mechanism_en: PreCoMem uses effective surprisal to distinguish observations from unreliable retrieval, maintaining, profiling and correcting memory as the environment changes.
2610.29467.result_en: Non-stationary DiMoBench experiments support the proposed memory management; the abstract gives no single headline numeric result.
2610.29467.boundary_en: A belief-management loop updates external state, not necessarily weights. Reliability estimation and correction gates can themselves be miscalibrated under drift.
2610.29467.affiliation: Nankai University / Tsinghua University / Huazhong University of Science and Technology / University of the Chinese Academy of Sciences / vivo AI Lab

2610.29995.title: Remembering Through Change: Provenance-Preserving Hypergraph Memory for Multimodal Agents
2610.29995.authors: Jielong Tang , Ling-An Zeng , Xujie Yuan , Xiao Dong , Zhiqian Xia , Qingfeng Li , Shixiong Kai , Kaichao Liang , Rong Yao , Jian Yin
2610.29995.abstract_en: Long-term memory for multimodal agents remains challenging, as it must preserve fine-grained visual evidence while tracking entity evolution across sessions. Existing abstraction-based memories compress images into text, often discarding visually discriminative details, whereas pixel-preserving memories retain raw observations but struggle to reliably associate diverse observations with persistent entity identities and track their evolving states. To address these limitations, we propose MHG-Mem, a multimodal hypergraph memory that jointly organizes entity identity, state evolution, and provenance to visual evidence. Specifically, MHG-Mem represents distinct entity mentions and their observed facts as individual nodes, grouping identity-consistent mentions and facts through occurrence hyperedges. It then synthesizes aspect-specific evolution states from these grouped observations and links them to supporting entities, facts, and source evidence through evolutionary and evidential hyperedges. To navigate this structured memory, we introduce hypergraph-based agentic search, which adaptively selects an entry layer, traverses typed hyperedges across memory levels, and inspects source observations when fine-grained verification is required. These designs support both detailed visual verification and reasoning over cross-session state changes. Extensive experiments across three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of MHG-Mem, improving performance by 8.20-9.98% over the strongest baseline.
2610.29995.abstract_zh: 多模态长期记忆需保留细视觉证据、追踪跨会话实体变化。抽象文字常丢区分细节，保留像素又难关联稳定身份与状态。MHG-Mem 用超图联合组织身份、状态演化和视觉来源：各实体提及及事实作独立节点，通过出现超边归组身份一致的提及事实，再综合方面特定演化状态，以演化及证据超边连到实体事实和源证据。超图智能体搜索自适应选入口、跨层遍历类型边，细验证时查源观测，支持视觉核实和跨会话状态推理。在三个基准上，比最强基线改善 8.20%—9.98%。
2610.29995.mechanism_en: MHG-Mem organizes entities and facts with occurrence, evolution and evidence hyperedges, retaining connections to source images for inspection and later retrieval.
2610.29995.result_en: Across three benchmarks, the authors report gains of 8.20–9.98% over compared approaches.
2610.29995.boundary_en: Retain the reported percentage wording rather than converting it to percentage points. Memory organization and evidence recovery do not alone establish an improved learning procedure.
2610.29995.affiliation: Sun Yat-sen University / Huawei Technologies, Noah Arks’ Lab / Shandong Normal University / Southeast University

2610.30184.title: Self-Evolving Static Analysis via LLM Pseudo-Labeling
2610.30184.authors: Rui Melo , Andre Duarte , Aditya Oke , Shubham Gandhi , Nachiket Kotalwar , Rui Abreu , Lei Li , Carolyn Rose
2610.30184.categories_text: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
2610.30184.abstract_en: Security bugs often slip past static analysis not because they are impossible to detect, but because detection rules have not yet been written for the code in front of us. New frameworks, APIs, and coding idioms continually create such gaps, leaving developers to discover failures and manually encode new rules. We present SESAA, a framework in which an Large Language Model (LLM) agent starts from no rules and iteratively evolves a set of readable and auditable joern queries. The agent receives feedback only from a second LLM critic, which inspects flagged and unflagged code to identify likely false alarms and suspected misses, without access to ground-truth labels. The agent then uses this feedback to revise its queries. On the OWASP Benchmark for Python, SESAA reaches a mean F1 of 0.742 across 8 independent runs, well above the default configurations of five widely used tools and comparable to the strongest of them once it is tuned with access to ground-truth labels that SESAA never sees. In a pilot on real-world Python projects, queries induced from code available before a vulnerability was introduced detect 10 of 19 subsequent CVEs, including 9 detected by rules written for the same repository. The resulting detector is a set of executable, human-readable queries that engineers can inspect, modify, and run independently. These results suggest that LLM agents can turn static-analysis rule maintenance from a manually authored process into an iterative process of automated discovery and repair.
2610.30184.abstract_zh: 安全缺陷漏检常非不可检测，而是新框架、API、习语尚无规则，需人手发现编码。SESAA 从零规则起步，让语言智能体迭代进化可读可审计 joern 查询，反馈仅来自第二模型评论者检查已标及未标代码、找疑似误报漏报，无真实标签。智能体据此改查询。OWASP Python 上八次独立运行平均 F1 为 0.742，远超五工具默认配置，接近其中最强工具用真实标签调优结果。在真实项目试点，基于漏洞引入前代码诱导的规则检出后续 19 项 CVE 中十项，九项由同仓库规则检出。结果是工程师可检查修改、独立运行的可执行可读查询，支持把手工规则维护转为自动发现修复。
2610.30184.update_target: Executable static-analysis queries and their mutation policy
2610.30184.mechanism_en: SESAA mutates Joern queries, reruns them over a code corpus and uses a second LLM critic to create labels without ground truth, feeding query performance back to the proposer.
2610.30184.result_en: Eight runs report F1 of 0.742; a pilot on pre-vulnerability code finds 10 of 19 CVEs, with nine in the same repository.
2610.30184.boundary_en: Critic agreement is not ground truth, and same-repository coverage limits transfer claims. The digest reports engineering evidence without reproducing vulnerability exploitation procedures.

2610.30292.title: GAV: A scientific experimentation environment for PDE agents
2610.30292.abstract_en: Reliable feedback is essential for coding agents to develop programs for partial differential equations (PDEs). Yet evaluating these programs on new PDE problems often requires expensive reference computations, while fixed datasets restrict the range of experiments. We introduce Generator-Agent-Verifier (GAV), a scientific experimentation environment that makes new PDE problems verifiable by construction. The Generator learns a distribution of continuous reference solutions using data from numerical simulations or experimental measurements to represent a target physical regime. Using the method of manufactured solutions, it works backward from the generated reference solutions to construct matching PDE problems without a separate numerical solve. The Agent designs experiments, investigates failures, and iteratively improves its program. The Verifier evaluates candidate programs against the reference solutions and provides numerical feedback on accuracy and computational cost. This feedback can also guide the generation of new problems that probe the current program's weaknesses. We provide a theoretical analysis of evaluation reliability and guided development. Experiments on Navier-Stokes and Vlasov-Poisson-type equations across different data sources and regimes demonstrate the effectiveness of GAV. In particular, on the numerical Navier-Stokes task, GAV reduces the mean test error of three existing PDE agents by more than an order of magnitude relative to their original setups. Code is available at this https URL .
2610.30292.abstract_zh: PDE 编程智能体需可靠反馈，但新问题参考计算昂贵、固定集限制实验。GAV 让新问题构造即可验证：生成器从数值或实验数据学连续参考解分布，表示目标物理机制；用制造解法从解反推匹配 PDE，无需另解数值问题。智能体设计实验、调查失败、迭代程序；验证器按参考解返回精度及成本反馈，也可引导新问题针对程序弱点。我们分析可靠性与引导开发，在 Navier–Stokes、Vlasov–Poisson 型方程不同数据和机制上显示有效；数值 Navier–Stokes 中，三种现有 PDE 智能体平均测试误差相对原设置下降超过一个数量级。代码见原文链接。
2610.30292.update_target: Generated PDE problems and solver programs
2610.30292.mechanism_en: GAV couples a generator of manufactured PDE solutions, an accuracy/cost verifier and agent program improvement. Observed weak points guide subsequent problem generation.
2610.30292.result_en: Three agents reduce Navier–Stokes error by more than an order of magnitude in the reported environment.
2610.30292.boundary_en: This is computational PDE experimentation. Manufactured references and theoretical conditions determine validity; gains within generated regimes do not establish physical experimental discovery.

2610.30429.title: RoleFlow: Self-Evolving Multi-Role Agentic Collaboration via Structural Adaptation
2610.30429.authors: Yi Ge , Pan Wang , Xuehao Cui , Zian Zeng , Xu Hu , Heng Huang , Furong Huang
2610.30429.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) based multi-agent systems often rely on predefined collaboration structures, limiting their adaptability to evolving task requirements. Although recent approaches enable dynamic orchestration, trajectory-level rewards they apply assign one outcome to each decision, ofen struggling to identify the contributions of individual structural changes. We propose RoleFlow, a self-evolving multi-role agentic system that refines collaboration structures through feedback-driven atomic edits and on-demand role synthesis. To make structural adaptation learnable, we introduce Single-Edit Counterfactual Policy Optimization (SECPO), which evaluates each edit against its no-edit counterpart at the same chain state and assigns targeted credit to edit-specific tokens. Across seven benchmarks spanning four domains, RoleFlow achieves the optimal average performance, surpassing the strongest competitor by 4.7 points. It leads on all three multi-hop QA benchmarks by 3.2-7.5 F1 points and also shows supremacy on mathematical reasoning, web interaction, and code generation. Further analyses demonstrate cross-benchmark transferability, training-data efficiency, and cross-executor generalization.
2610.30429.abstract_zh: 语言多智能体常用预定义协作结构，难适应变化。动态编排的轨迹级奖励给每项决定同一结果，难隔离结构修改贡献。RoleFlow 通过反馈原子编辑与按需角色合成细化结构，SECPO 在相同链状态将每个编辑与无编辑反事实比较，给编辑特定词元定向信用。七基准四领域平均表现最优，比最强竞争者高 4.7 分；三个多跳问答领先 3.2—7.5 F1，在数学、网页、代码也占优。分析显示跨基准迁移、训练数据效率及跨执行器泛化。
2610.30429.update_target: Multi-agent role structure and edit-specific policy behavior
2610.30429.mechanism_en: RoleFlow synthesizes roles and applies SECPO with same-chain-state edit/no-edit comparisons, assigning credit to edit-specific tokens to support later structural adaptation.
2610.30429.result_en: Across seven benchmarks in four domains, reported average improvement is 4.7 points, with F1 gains of 3.2–7.5 points.
2610.30429.boundary_en: Local counterfactual comparisons support edit attribution within the protocol, not unrestricted causal claims about all architecture choices. Include policy-training and role-synthesis cost.
2610.30429.affiliation: University of Maryland, College Park / University of Pittsburgh / The University of Texas at Dallas

2610.30468.title: SplatLab: Autonomous Scientific Discovery for 3DGS Research
2610.30468.categories_text: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
2610.30468.abstract_en: Reproducing a published 3DGS paper takes weeks of expert engineering before any extension can be proposed. Prior autonomous-research systems read papers, draft hypotheses, and write code, but are limited by short fixed templates, low executability, and weak traceability, and none has been demonstrated end-to-end in a live computer-vision subfield with intense activity. SplatLab is an autonomous research system for 3D Gaussian Splatting that addresses these limitations. Given a research prompt, a target-paper URL, or no input at all, it reproduces a published baseline, proposes an extension, trains and ablates across Mip-NeRF 360 and LLFF, writes the manuscript, and binds every reported number to a logged training run. Five design choices distinguish it: (i) candidates mutate plugins from a verified-reproduction backbone matched to published baselines; (ii) a cascade-weighted Elo tournament across eight islands scores candidates on measured GPU PSNR with verbal-gradient feedback; (iii) a standing falsifier subtracts Elo on failure, integrating stress-test survival into selection; (iv) every reported number is bound to a logged training run, and the run cannot terminate while any claim is unbacked; (v) a seven-category 3DGS taxonomy wraps EVOLVE-BLOCK markers in domain-aligned scaffolds transferable across 3DGS repositories. On PSNR-targeted runs, SplatLab's manuscripts beat their reproduced targets by +0.18 to +3.78 dB, including +3.78 dB on astrophotographic nebula rendering, for which no prior 3DGS method exists. The research cycle compresses from months of graduate-student time to days of mostly autonomous compute. Code, all manuscripts, experiment ledgers, and the cross-run paper store are available on the project page.
2610.30468.abstract_zh: 复现 3DGS 论文常需专家数周工程，此前自主研究系统能够阅读论文、提出假说并编写代码，但受限于简短的固定模板、较低的可执行性和较弱的可追踪性，而且尚无系统在研究活动密集的真实计算机视觉子领域中得到端到端展示。SplatLab 是一个面向 3D 高斯泼溅的自主研究系统，旨在解决这些限制。SplatLab 输入提示、论文网址或无输入，复现基线、提出扩展，在 Mip-NeRF 360、LLFF 上训练消融，写稿并将每个数字绑定训练日志。五项设计：从匹配已发表基线的验证复现骨架变异插件；八岛级联加权 Elo 竞赛以实测 GPU PSNR 和文字梯度评分；常驻证伪者在失败时扣 Elo，把压力生存纳入选择；每数字关联运行，未支持断言存在则不能结束；七类 3DGS 分类用领域骨架包装 EVOLVE-BLOCK，跨仓库迁移。PSNR 目标运行中，稿件相对复现目标提高 0.18—3.78 dB，包括无先前 3DGS 方法的星云天文渲染提高 3.78 dB。研究周期从研究生数月变为主要自主计算数天。代码、稿件、实验账本及跨运行论文库见项目页。
2610.30468.update_target: 3D Gaussian Splatting research programs and experimental scaffolds
2610.30468.mechanism_en: SplatLab starts from a verified backbone, evolves eight islands using measured GPU PSNR/Elo and applies falsifier penalties and numeric run binding across seven scaffold categories.
2610.30468.result_en: The authors report PSNR improvements of 0.18–3.78 dB and a reduction in research-cycle time from months to days.
2610.30468.boundary_en: GPU measurements are experimental evidence but not independent certification of scientific novelty. Search is compute intensive; include failed trials, falsification and full artifact provenance.

2610.31034.title: CANNBot-CAKE: Collaborative Agentic Kernel Evolution for Ascend NPU
2610.31034.authors: Deng Pan , Xue-Jian Gao , Junyi Fan , Bin Du , Jiasheng Li , Xinxian Chen , Nok Yan Chang , Xinlin Li , Lingchao Zheng , Jun Li , Yuwei Fan
2610.31034.abstract_en: Efficient custom operators are essential for modern deep learning workloads, yet developing high-performance kernels for Ascend NPUs remains slow, expert-intensive, and difficult to automate. Although AI agents now approach expert performance on GPU kernel benchmarks, current models remain less capable of generating AscendC kernels for NPUs, potentially reflecting the relative scarcity of relevant training data. We thus present CAKE, a CANN-native system for deployable custom operators that combines adaptive multi-DSL routing, separate Generation and Evolution modes, and reviewed knowledge reuse through CAKE Book and a Self-Evolving Agent. On 53 CANN-Bench v1.1 operators on Ascend 950PR, CAKE's aggregated results achieve $100\%$ case pass rate on the standard set (1,060/1,060) and $98.28\%$ on the hidden set (4,167/4,240), with an overall mean score of 78.63 out of 100 and an average performance speedup of $1.334\times$ over the baseline. Evolution then pushes correct operators further: EngramGateFusion cuts aggregate device time by $46.6\%$ over 20 rounds and roughly halves the mean roofline gap. These results offer a practical path toward closing Ascend's AI-for-kernel capability gap.
2610.31034.abstract_zh: Ascend NPU 高效自定义算子开发慢、需专家，模型生成 AscendC 能力弱，可能因训练数据少。CAKE 是 CANN 原生可部署算子系统，结合自适应多 DSL 路由、分离生成与进化模式，以及 CAKE Book、自进化智能体的审阅知识复用。在 Ascend 950PR、53 项 CANN-Bench v1.1 算子上，汇总标准集通过 1,060/1,060（100%），隐藏集 4,167/4,240（98.28%），平均分 78.63/100，平均性能加速 1.334 倍。进化继续改进正确算子，EngramGateFusion 二十轮减少聚合设备时间 46.6%，平均屋顶线差距约减半，为缩小 NPU 自动内核能力差距提供路径。
2610.31034.update_target: Ascend kernel programs and reviewed reusable knowledge
2610.31034.mechanism_en: CAKE routes DSL choices, generates and evolves kernels and retains reviewed knowledge from measured compilation/correctness/performance feedback.
2610.31034.result_en: For 53 operators on Ascend 950PR, standard tests pass 1060/1060, hidden tests 4167/4240 (98.28%), with score 78.63 and 1.334× speedup; EngramGateFusion time falls 46.6% over twenty rounds.
2610.31034.boundary_en: These results depend on hardware, operators and test coverage. Passing finite tests does not imply universal correctness; include compilation, measurement and failed-candidate search costs.

2610.31125.title: Delta N-gram: Forward-Only Continual Writing into a Language Model's Native N-gram Memory
2610.31125.abstract_en: Our previous analysis found that a model's native hashed N-gram table is where continual updates disturb the base least, but its writes needed backpropagation and changed the pretrained table. We present Delta N-gram, a forward-only write path into that table. The pretrained table T^0 is never modified. Evidence is written into a sparse patch \Delta on the rows it addresses: a 4.1M-parameter writer emits a target and a gate per (position, hash head) event, and a block-averaged delta rule keeps each row a convex combination of its old value and the gated targets. The writer is trained offline on raw text with the pretraining objective; at use time writing takes forward passes only, and clearing \Delta restores the original model. A 0.6B prototype trained to answer questions keeps 16/16 facts after a second write; online gradient writes keep 2--4/16. We study two writers: a plain writer that encodes evidence with the T^0-only model, and a delta writer that reads its current memory while encoding. On Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, the plain writer's memory is document-specific: on 64 held-out news events it lowers continuation NLL by 0.068 nats/token against empty memory and by 0.024 against another document's memory, and 0.063 and 0.013 after 16 intervening articles. The delta writer's memory is more document-specific and keeps more of it under distraction (70% vs 54%). Over 35,000 writes on our previous seven-task chain both writers stay stable and the delta writer drifts less (layer-2 math drift 176% vs 188%); later accuracy changes by -0.26/-0.52pp (-7.29pp for gradient updates) and small-k_i drift is 17.9/17.5% (39.2%). Acquisition is negative, and general-input drift reaches 32.8% (20.75%): format rows read by every example grow to 4--12 times their pretrained norm. Zeroing eight such rows removes over 98% of layer-2 drift on math inputs, together with their NLL gain.
