We challenge this assumption empirically by measuring whether performance-optimized code produced by LLM self-refinement pipelines is also energy-efficient relative to canonical human reference solutions, and whether the energy cost of the optimization process can be offset by subsequent execution-time savings. We evaluate 11 open-source models across four decoding configurations on all 1,000 problems of EffiBench, a state-of-the-art performance benchmark, while collecting per-process, hardware-level energy measurements throughout. Inference energy spans 0.79 to 8.68 MJ across model-variant pairs, which is roughly equivalent to the energy of 250 to 2800 GPT-4.1 queries. Limiting the maximum number of output tokens has the largest impact, reducing energy use by up to 69% compared to the default configuration. On the execution side, 42 of 44 configurations produce code that consumes more energy per problem than the canonical human reference, with overheads ranging from +4% to +886%. The two exceptions achieve only marginal gains, with break-even points on the order of 10^6 to 10^7 executions. Mixture-of-Experts architectures consume substantially less inference energy than equivalently-sized dense models without sacrificing correctness, making architectural choice a more consequential sustainability lever than decoding parameters. Performance optimization and energy efficiency are not always aligned goals: LLM self-refinement consistently produces faster-seeking but energy-heavier code relative to what a human engineer would write. All artifacts are available at this https URL .
2610.32891.abstract_zh: LLM 越来越多地用于性能优化代码，常假定执行变快自然意味着总体能耗降低。我们通过测量自细化流水线代码相对标准人工参考是否省能，以及优化过程能耗能否由以后执行节省抵消，实证挑战此假设。对 11 个开源模型、四种解码配置，在 EffiBench 全部 1,000 题上评估，全程收集逐进程、硬件级能耗。模型—变体对的推理能耗为 0.79—8.68 MJ，约相当于 250—2800 次 GPT-4.1 查询。限制最大输出词元影响最大，相比默认配置最多省能 69%。执行端，44 配置中的 42 个比人工参考每题耗能更多，增加 +4% 至 +886%；另两项仅边际节省，需约 10⁶—10⁷ 次执行才能回本。混合专家架构比同规模稠密模型推理能耗低得多且不损正确性，故架构选择比解码参数是更重要的可持续性杠杆。性能优化与能效并不总一致：LLM 自细化相对人工参考持续产生追求速度却能耗更高的代码。全部产物可经原文链接获取。
2610.32891.update_target: Energy accounting for iterative code self-refinement
2610.32891.mechanism_en: Eleven open models and four decoding configurations optimize all one thousand EffiBench problems while process/hardware measurements count both generation and later code execution.
2610.32891.result_en: Forty-two of 44 configurations consume more execution energy than human references (+4% to +886%). Two marginal gains need about 10⁶–10⁷ executions to break even; token caps cut inference energy up to 69%.
2610.32891.boundary_en: Faster-seeking optimization need not reduce lifecycle energy. Results depend on hardware, workloads and canonical references; query-equivalent energy figures are context-dependent comparisons, not universal conversions.
2610.32891.affiliation: University of Augsburg / King’s College London

2610.33024.title: Evolving to Match Capabilities: Improving Harness Self-Evolution via Skill Adaptation
2610.33024.authors: Zhihao Yang , Haojin Wang , Juncheng Wu , Kuan Zhang , Yukun Chen , Run Luo , Yaojie Lu , Yuyin Zhou , Lu Wang , Xianpei Han
2610.33024.categories_text: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2610.33024.abstract_en: Harness self-evolution offers a practical route for LLM agents to improve from execution experience without updating model parameters. Its effectiveness depends on whether models can successfully act on the guidance provided by their harnesses. However, we find that harness benefits are not uniform across model capabilities: skills that improve stronger models can provide little benefit or even degrade performance for weaker ones. Across seven models and three benchmarks, we identify 103 task-skill pairs where skills improve GPT-5.6-luna by 31.1 points but degrade Gemma-4-E4B by 8.8 points. In 86% of failed weak-model runs, the violated requirement is already stated in the skill. This motivates skill adaptation: reformulating existing skills to match the executor's capabilities and make their guidance easier to execute. To achieve this, we diagnose failures in tool execution, context management, instruction following, and verification, and distill these diagnoses into a fixed meta-skill that guides adaptation during harness self-evolution. Guided by the meta-skill, a capable external rewriter, Kimi-K3, adapts skills without execution evidence, improving the three weak executors by 5.1-14.1 points over the original skills. We then incorporate this adaptation into a five-round self-evolution loop, where each model revises its own skill from execution trajectories and verifier feedback. Across seven executors, from Gemma-4-E4B to Kimi-K2.5, the meta-skill consistently improves final scores by 2.0-5.1 points over the same loop without the meta-skill. Our findings provide practical design guidance for developing more effective harness self-evolution methods.
2610.33024.affiliation: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; University of California, Santa Cruz; Tsinghua University; National University of Singapore; Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences; Independent Researcher
2610.33024.update_target: External task skills guided by a fixed capability-adaptation meta-skill; model weights stay fixed
2610.33024.mechanism_en: Execution traces and verifier feedback drive five rounds of skill revision. The meta-skill diagnoses whether the executor can follow the procedure, and the revised skill is reused in the next round.
2610.33024.result_en: Across seven executors, adaptation raises final scores by 2.0–5.1 points over the same evolution loop without the meta-skill. An external-rewriter experiment is a separate setting.
2610.33024.boundary_en: The adaptation meta-skill is fixed, not recursively learned here. Skills useful to strong models can hurt weaker models; rewriting without execution evidence differs from verified self-revision.
2610.33024.abstract_zh: 运行框架自进化为 LLM 智能体提供了一条无需更新模型参数、便可从执行经验中改进的实用途径。其有效性取决于模型能否成功执行运行框架提供的指导。然而，我们发现，运行框架带来的收益并不在不同能力的模型间均匀分布：能够改善强模型的技能，可能对弱模型几乎无益，甚至降低其表现。在七个模型和三个基准上，我们找出了 103 个任务—技能配对，其中技能使 GPT-5.6-luna 提高 31.1 个百分点，却使 Gemma-4-E4B 降低 8.8 个百分点。在弱模型的失败运行中，86% 所违反的要求其实已经写在技能中。这促使我们提出技能适配：重新表述现有技能，使之匹配执行器的能力，让指导更容易执行。为此，我们诊断工具执行、上下文管理、指令遵循和验证方面的失败，并将这些诊断提炼为一个固定的元技能，在运行框架自进化期间指导适配。在该元技能引导下，一个能力较强的外部改写器 Kimi-K3 在没有执行证据的情况下适配技能，使三个弱执行器比使用原始技能提高 5.1—14.1 个百分点。随后，我们把这种适配纳入一个五轮自进化循环，每个模型根据执行轨迹和验证器反馈修订自己的技能。在从 Gemma-4-E4B 到 Kimi-K2.5 的七个执行器上，与不使用该元技能的相同循环相比，元技能始终使最终得分提高 2.0—5.1 个百分点。这些发现为开发更有效的运行框架自进化方法提供了实用设计指导。

2610.33024.evidence_note: Title and complete official abstract reviewed; author header, figure and selected method passages inspected. No independent reproduction.

2610.33046.title: Organon : From Evolutionary Search to Recursive Self-Improving Agents for Scientific Discovery
2610.33046.authors: Cheikh Ahmed , Zhiyu Zhang , Kun Mao , Yong Zhang , Zirui Zhou
2610.33046.categories_text: Neural and Evolutionary Computing (cs.NE) ; Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.33046.abstract_en: Scientific discovery does not follow a single fixed methodology: research methods vary across domains and evolve through experimentation as investigations unfold. Although LLM-guided evolutionary search has advanced automated discovery, existing frameworks typically rely on fixed search procedures or restrict adaptation to predefined components, limiting their ability to address diverse research problems and adapt to challenges that emerge at runtime. We introduce Organon, a recursively self-improving agent for scientific discovery. During execution, a single persistent agent analyzes its accumulated experience and autonomously revises its own search strategies, population management, diagnostic tools, memory, and worker coordination. These revisions take effect at runtime, allowing the agent to continuously adapt its approach as research progresses. Importantly, the agent can also diagnose and correct flaws in its own adaptation procedures, enabling recursive improvement of the mechanisms that guide its future self-improvement. We evaluate Organon across 21 computational discovery tasks spanning algorithm design, GPU kernel optimization, mathematical construction, and systems optimization. On ALE-Bench Lite, Organon achieves the best performance among competing search frameworks on all 10 tasks, improving mean held-out performance by 20.5% over EvoX. On KernelBench, it achieves the best results on three of four workloads, with speedups of up to 1.67x over the strongest competing method. Analysis of the search trajectories further reveals how the agent develops task-specific search strategies, builds new diagnostic capabilities, and corrects or reverses its own earlier revisions. We implement Organon using DeepSeek Harness and Cordis's spatiotemporal composability. Code is available at this https URL .
2610.33046.update_target: Runtime search strategies, population management, diagnostic tools, memory and worker coordination
2610.33046.mechanism_en: A persistent agent inspects search experience and swaps executable search mechanisms during the run. It can reverse earlier revisions and revise procedures governing later adaptation.
2610.33046.result_en: Across 21 computational discovery tasks, Organon leads all ten ALE-Bench Lite tasks and reports 20.5% better mean held-out performance than EvoX; KernelBench gains reach 1.67× over its strongest comparator.
2610.33046.boundary_en: These are finite computational searches with task evaluators. Runtime self-modification and trajectory examples do not establish unlimited improvement or universal transfer.
2610.33046.abstract_zh: 科学发现并不遵循单一固定的方法：研究方法因领域而异，也会在调查推进时通过实验而演变。尽管 LLM 引导的进化搜索推动了自动发现，现有框架通常依赖固定的搜索流程，或将适配限制在预定义组件中，从而限制了它们应对不同研究问题及运行时新挑战的能力。我们提出 Organon，一个用于科学发现的递归自改进智能体。在执行期间，单个持久运行的智能体分析积累的经验，自主修订自己的搜索策略、种群管理、诊断工具、记忆和工作智能体协调方式。这些修订在运行时生效，使智能体能够随着研究推进持续调整方法。重要的是，该智能体还能诊断并纠正自身适配流程的缺陷，从而递归地改进指导其未来自改进的机制。我们在涵盖算法设计、GPU 内核优化、数学构造和系统优化的 21 个计算发现任务上评估 Organon。在 ALE-Bench Lite 上，Organon 在全部 10 个任务上都取得竞争搜索框架中的最佳表现，相比 EvoX 的平均留出集表现提高 20.5%。在 KernelBench 上，它在四个工作负载中的三个上取得最佳结果，相比最强竞争方法的加速最高达 1.67 倍。搜索轨迹分析进一步揭示，该智能体如何发展针对任务的搜索策略、构建新的诊断能力，以及纠正或撤销自己此前的修订。我们使用 DeepSeek Harness 和 Cordis 的时空可组合性实现 Organon。代码可在原文所附的 HTTPS 链接获取。

2610.33487.title: ReSight: Task-Driven Self-Improving Memory for Embodied Agents
2610.33487.authors: Lirong Che , Yang Chen , Yimeng Su , Daqi Liu , Zhenyu Huang , Jiong Wang , Yuzhe Yang , Xu Cao , Chuang Wang , Jian Su , Xueqian Wang
2610.33487.categories_text: Robotics (cs.RO) ; Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
2610.33487.abstract_en: Robots can use historical observations to answer spatiotemporal queries in familiar environments, but the presence of relevant evidence does not imply that existing tools support the operations a task requires. We introduce ReSight, a task-driven self-improving memory system for embodied agents that expands the capabilities for processing and accessing historical observations as task demands arise. ReSight retains keyframes and their spatiotemporal associations, separating observation evidence from extensible derived fields so that stored observations can be reprocessed for new needs. An execution agent and a coding agent share this memory through different interfaces: the former calls registered tools within a bounded online budget, while the latter uses a programmable workspace and a larger exploration budget to inspect evidence, write programs, and acquire models as needed. To realize capability expansion in ReSight, we develop Explore-Distill-Mount (EDM), which identifies capability gaps from execution and exploration records without task reference answers and converts exploration-derived solutions into reusable memory builders, query tools, and skills, extending memory representations and access capabilities as needed. Experiments on three public benchmarks demonstrate effective base memory access and capability expansion. With the execution model and online budget held fixed within each benchmark, EDM reduces mean position error on OC-NaVQA from 33.10 m to 24.72 m and improves high-level success on FindingDory from 38.3% to 63.8%. With the tools and skill frozen, success still improves by 28.3 percentage points on FindingDory episodes excluded from exploration and distillation. Experiments on real robot patrol memories further demonstrate reuse of these capabilities for subsequent queries and new memories, with fewer online tool calls on average.
2610.33487.affiliation: Tsinghua University; AGIBOT; Nanjing University; Nanyang Technological University
2610.33487.update_target: External memory builders, derived fields, query tools and reusable skills over retained observations
2610.33487.mechanism_en: Explore–Distill–Mount identifies capability gaps from execution and exploration records without task reference answers, then mounts reusable programs and skills; raw observations remain revisitable.
2610.33487.result_en: With execution model and online budget fixed, OC-NaVQA position error falls from 33.10 m to 24.72 m and FindingDory high-level success rises from 38.3% to 63.8%. Frozen tools/skill also improve excluded episodes.
2610.33487.boundary_en: Capability development has a larger exploration budget and may acquire models; deployment savings exclude neither that work nor acquisition cost. Robot patrol-memory queries differ from autonomous physical control.
2610.33487.abstract_zh: 机器人能够利用历史观测回答熟悉环境中的时空查询，但存在相关证据，并不意味着现有工具支持任务所需的操作。我们提出 ReSight，一个任务驱动的自改进记忆系统，用于具身智能体；它随着任务需求出现，扩展处理和访问历史观测的能力。ReSight 保留关键帧及其时空关联，将观测证据与可扩展的派生字段分离，使存储的观测能够针对新需求重新处理。执行智能体和编码智能体通过不同接口共享这一记忆：前者在有界在线预算内调用已注册工具，后者则使用可编程工作区和更大的探索预算，按需检查证据、编写程序和获取模型。为在 ReSight 中实现能力扩展，我们开发 Explore-Distill-Mount（EDM，探索—提炼—挂载），它无需任务参考答案，就能从执行和探索记录中识别能力缺口，并将探索得到的解决方案转化为可复用的记忆构建器、查询工具和技能，按需扩展记忆表示与访问能力。在三个公开基准上的实验表明，基础记忆访问和能力扩展均有效。在各基准内固定执行模型和在线预算时，EDM 将 OC-NaVQA 的平均位置误差从 33.10 米降至 24.72 米，并将 FindingDory 的高层成功率从 38.3% 提高到 63.8%。即使冻结工具和技能，在未参与探索与提炼的 FindingDory 回合上，成功率仍提高 28.3 个百分点。真实机器人巡逻记忆上的实验进一步展示，这些能力可复用于后续查询和新记忆，平均在线工具调用次数也更少。

2610.33539.title: CoEvolve: Counterfactual-Guided Co-Evolution of Memory and Collaboration in Multi-Agent Systems
2610.33539.authors: Xufei Shi , Derong Xu , Wei Chen , Yanyu Yao , Zhi Zheng , Tong Xu
2610.33539.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across diverse tasks. Yet their memory and collaboration architectures often remain static, constraining continued adaptation and improvement over time. Recent work addresses this limitation by evolving memory or collaboration based on interaction experience. However, updates to these interdependent components are not necessarily aligned: an evolved workflow may require experience that memory does not provide, while evolved memory may encode guidance that the workflow cannot use. To address this problem, we propose CoEvolve, a skill-centered framework for aligned memory--collaboration evolution. CoEvolve represents reusable local collaboration patterns as skills that link evolving collaboration decisions to their supporting memories. It further compares original and counterfactual trajectories to identify local evolution signals, which coordinate updates to the skill library, skill memory, and executor memories across rounds. Experiments on the ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks confirm that CoEvolve achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated baselines, while ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of aligned co-evolution and counterfactual-guided evolution.
2610.33539.affiliation: University of Science and Technology of China, State Key Laboratory of Cognitive Intelligence
2610.33539.update_target: Collaboration skills, skill memory and executor memories
2610.33539.mechanism_en: Local skills connect workflow choices with supporting memory. Original and counterfactual trajectories supply evolution signals that coordinate all three persistent components across rounds.
2610.33539.result_en: ALFWorld and WebShop experiments report the best overall performance among evaluated baselines, with ablations supporting aligned updates and counterfactual guidance.
2610.33539.boundary_en: This evolves external collaboration and memory, not model weights. Counterfactual sampling adds search cost; two interactive benchmarks do not establish open-ended cooperation.
2610.33539.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统已在多种任务中展现出卓越能力。然而，它们的记忆与协作架构往往保持静态，限制了随时间持续适配和改进。近期工作通过依据交互经验演化记忆或协作来应对这一局限。但这些相互依赖组件的更新不一定对齐：演化后的工作流可能需要记忆无法提供的经验，而演化后的记忆也可能编码工作流无法利用的指导。为解决这一问题，我们提出 CoEvolve，一个以技能为中心、使记忆与协作演化相互对齐的框架。CoEvolve 把可复用的局部协作模式表示为技能，将演化的协作决策与其支持记忆连接起来。它进一步比较原始轨迹与反事实轨迹，识别局部演化信号，以此协调跨轮次的技能库、技能记忆和执行器记忆更新。ALFWorld 和 WebShop 基准上的实验确认，CoEvolve 在被评估基线中取得最佳总体表现；消融研究进一步验证了对齐的共同演化和反事实引导演化的有效性。

2610.33845.title: Build, Don't Play: Self-Improving LLM Research Agents Develop a Hearthstone Battlegrounds AI That Rivals Top Players
2610.33845.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
2610.33845.abstract_en: Can LLM agents carry a hard real-world problem from raw data to a system that holds its own against people? We study this in Hearthstone Battlegrounds, an eight-player auto-battler with stochastic shops and battles, hidden information and nearly a thousand interacting cards. We present AutoTavern, a self-improving research system: specialised LLM research agents share a typed research memory, every claim passes verification gates, and live games close the loop, so the agents improve the simulator, opponents and policy and, from the same feedback, their own research process; a human sets goals and rules on ambiguous mechanics. In 20 days AutoTavern built TavernGym, the first faithful, full-content reproduction of the live game, and delivered 23 versions of TavernAgent, trained with PPO against opponents calibrated to real games. TavernAgent plays complete games on the live ladder by itself: its rating rose from 6,000 to about 15,000 and, on the public leaderboard's measure, its last 20 records average a placement of 1.60 with 80% first places, better than the server's ten highest-rated players on every statistic (2.34, 59%). TavernBench, 960 tasks in 40 scenarios, shows that the system the agents built is the strongest player: TavernAgent answers 91% of the play tasks against at most 63% for frontier LLMs, and decides in 0.03 s where they need up to 26 s; within the second a live turn allows, it keeps 90% and no LLM more than 26%. LLM agents build far better than they play. We will open-source TavernBench and TavernGym at this https URL .
2610.33845.update_target: Simulator, opponents, PPO-trained game policy and external research-process memory
2610.33845.mechanism_en: Specialized research agents share typed claims, verification gates and live-game feedback. The same evidence revises the game system and subsequent research workflow; humans set goals and adjudicate ambiguous rules.
2610.33845.result_en: Over 20 days the authors build TavernGym and 23 player versions, reporting a ladder rise from 6,000 to about 15,000. The last 20 records average placement 1.60 with 80% first places.
2610.33845.boundary_en: A live ladder snapshot is not a controlled causal test of research self-improvement. Human adjudication, simulator fidelity and policy training matter; the release excludes trained-player weights and training code.
2610.33845.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体能否把一个困难的真实问题，从原始数据推进到能够与人类抗衡的系统？我们在《炉石传说：酒馆战棋》中研究这一问题：这是一个八人自动战斗游戏，具有随机商店与战斗、隐藏信息，以及近千张相互作用的卡牌。我们提出 AutoTavern，一个自改进研究系统：专门化的 LLM 研究智能体共享带类型的研究记忆，每一项主张都经过验证关卡，在线实战形成闭环，使智能体改进模拟器、对手和策略，并利用同样的反馈改进自身研究流程；人类设定目标，并对含糊的机制作出规则裁定。在 20 天内，AutoTavern 构建了 TavernGym，即首个忠实、完整内容的在线游戏复现，并产出了 23 个版本的 TavernAgent，使用依据真实对局校准的对手通过 PPO 训练。TavernAgent 能独立在在线天梯上完成整局游戏：评分从 6,000 升至约 15,000；按照公开排行榜的统计方式，其最近 20 条记录的平均名次为 1.60，第一名占比 80%，所有统计指标均优于服务器评分最高的十位玩家（2.34、59%）。TavernBench 包含 40 个场景中的 960 个任务，显示智能体构建的系统是最强玩家：TavernAgent 正确回答 91% 的实战任务，前沿 LLM 最高为 63%；其决策耗时 0.03 秒，而后者最高需 26 秒；在在线回合允许的一秒内，它保持 90% 的正确率，而任何 LLM 都不超过 26%。LLM 智能体构建系统的能力远强于自己玩游戏的能力。我们将在原文所附的 HTTPS 链接开源 TavernBench 和 TavernGym。

2610.34921.title: PhysEvolve: Verifier-grounded Self-evolution for Physical Reasoning with Executable Worlds
2610.34921.authors: Jinyuan Hu , Yilei Jiang , Chen Tang , Minghong Cai , Xinran Liu , Xiangyu Yue
2610.34921.abstract_en: Physical reasoning underpins how embodied systems understand and act in the physical world, yet vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable on questions about dynamics and physical causality. Progress is critically constrained by the scarcity of grounded counterfactual training data, as observational videos capture only the factual trajectory that occurred. The self-evolving paradigm offers a route beyond fixed datasets by enabling models to construct their own training problems. Extending this paradigm to physics, however, requires an external source of truth that can both validate model-proposed environments and verify alternative physical outcomes under intervention. We introduce \physevolve{}, a verifier-grounded self-evolving framework that trains VLMs for causal physical reasoning from model-proposed executable worlds and simulation-authored tasks. At each round, a shared VLM proposes executable world programs and evidence schemas; a deterministic physics engine freezes each valid world, simulates matched baseline and body-elided counterfactual branches, and synthesizes discrete, answer-bound visual tasks. Exact verifier feedback from task solving updates both the shared policy via GRPO and an adaptive curriculum over physical intents. Starting from Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, \physevolve{} achieves targeted gains across PhysBench, CausalPhys, and ContPhy without human intervention data, improving PhysBench Throwing by $8.8$ points and ContPhy Counterfactual Removal and Goal-Pit by $7.4$ and $24.4$ points. These gains concentrate on interaction-sensitive and altered-world questions, demonstrating zero-shot transfer of causal principles to unseen complex dynamics (cloth, fluid, soft bodies) and real-world video.
2610.34921.affiliation: MMLab, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
2610.34921.update_target: Shared VLM policy weights via GRPO and an adaptive physical-intent curriculum
2610.34921.mechanism_en: The model proposes executable worlds; a deterministic physics engine validates and freezes them, simulates matched interventions, and creates answer-bound tasks. Verified solving feedback updates the policy and future curriculum.
2610.34921.result_en: From Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, reported gains include 8.8 points on PhysBench Throwing and 7.4/24.4 on ContPhy Counterfactual Removal/Goal-Pit, with transfer tests on unseen dynamics and real videos.
2610.34921.boundary_en: Training uses simulator-authored truth, not human intervention labels; that does not remove simulator assumptions or compute. Selected benchmark gains are not uniform physical competence or real-robot improvement.
2610.34921.abstract_zh: 物理推理支撑具身系统理解并作用于物理世界的方式，但视觉语言模型（VLM）在动力学与物理因果关系问题上仍不可靠。进展受到有依据的反事实训练数据稀缺这一关键因素制约，因为观测视频只能记录实际发生的事实轨迹。自进化范式使模型能够构建自己的训练问题，提供了超越固定数据集的途径。然而，将这一范式扩展到物理领域，需要一个外部真实依据，既能验证模型提出的环境，也能检验干预下的其他物理结果。我们提出 PhysEvolve，一个以验证器为依据的自进化框架，通过模型提出的可执行世界和模拟生成的任务，训练 VLM 进行因果物理推理。每一轮中，共享 VLM 提出可执行世界程序和证据模式；确定性物理引擎冻结每个有效世界，模拟匹配的基线分支与移除物体的反事实分支，并合成离散的、答案绑定的视觉任务。任务求解的精确验证器反馈通过 GRPO 同时更新共享策略和针对物理意图的自适应课程。从 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 出发，PhysEvolve无需人工干预数据，便在 PhysBench、CausalPhys 和 ContPhy 上获得针对性提升，使 PhysBench Throwing 提高 8.8 个百分点，ContPhy 的 Counterfactual Removal 和 Goal-Pit 分别提高 7.4 和 24.4 个百分点。这些提升集中于对交互敏感和改变世界条件的问题，展示了因果原理向未见过的复杂动力学（布料、流体、软体）及真实世界视频的零样本迁移。

2610.35051.title: VISTA: Active Exploration for Self-Improvement in Embodied Agents
2610.35051.authors: Zhang Zhang , Shengjun Zhang , Simin Huang , Min Chen , Chong Xia , Xin Fei , Yueqi Duan
2610.35051.abstract_en: Agentic embodied intelligence plays a foundational role in open-ended, dynamic physical environments. Rather than treating policy learning as an end-to-end mapping from instructions to actions, recent studies reveal that embodied systems depend not only on pre-trained foundation models, but also on harness. Prior approaches largely treat rollouts as static logs for post-hoc reflection, producing harness updates without autonomously testing and refining them through subsequent embodied interaction. To address this challenge, we propose VISTA, a meta-agent framework that transforms post-hoc rollout reflection into active self-exploration for embodied harness improvement. Specifically, VISTA maintains a harness graph that records the lineage of proposed harnesses, which enables the meta-agent to retrieve prior hypotheses, build on effective mechanisms, and avoid repeatedly exploring failed directions. Each iteration begins from a retained harness version and its execution evidence. Rather than directly committing an update from these historical trajectories, the meta-agent actively explores in the environment. It autonomously generates new rollouts, probes execution failures and recovery behaviors, and iteratively modifies the harness based on the resulting evidence. The refined harness is then evaluated afresh and added to the harness graph. We evaluate VISTA on the LIBERO-Pro, RoboCasa, and RoboTwin benchmarks. Experimental results demonstrate that VISTA progressively improves task success and is more rollout-efficient than static reflection, achieving higher success rates with fewer simulator rollouts.
2610.35051.affiliation: Tsinghua University; National University of Singapore
2610.35051.update_target: Executable embodied-agent harness code, skills, memory and decision logic; underlying models fixed
2610.35051.mechanism_en: A meta-agent retrieves harness lineage, actively probes a simulator, revises the harness and submits a frozen candidate for fresh autonomous evaluation. The code and evidence become later development inputs.
2610.35051.result_en: On LIBERO-Pro, RoboCasa and RoboTwin, the authors report progressive task-success gains and better simulator-rollout efficiency than static reflection.
2610.35051.boundary_en: Active exploration and evaluation consume simulator rollouts and model calls. The public code currently covers LIBERO-Pro T/S, not all three benchmark integrations or the evolved task-specific harnesses.
2610.35051.abstract_zh: 智能体式具身智能在开放、动态的物理环境中发挥基础作用。近期研究并非将策略学习仅视为从指令到动作的端到端映射，而是揭示具身系统不仅依赖预训练基础模型，也依赖运行框架。以往方法大多将 rollout 视为供事后反思的静态日志，产生运行框架更新，却不通过后续具身交互自主测试和完善这些更新。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 VISTA，一个元智能体框架，将事后 rollout 反思转变为用于改进具身运行框架的主动自探索。具体来说，VISTA 维护一个记录候选运行框架谱系的框架图，使元智能体能够检索以往假设、基于有效机制继续构建，并避免反复探索失败方向。每次迭代都从一个保留的框架版本及其执行证据开始。元智能体不会直接根据这些历史轨迹提交更新，而是主动在环境中探索。它自主生成新 rollout，探查执行失败与恢复行为，并根据所得证据迭代修改框架。完善后的框架随后重新接受评估，并加入框架图。我们在 LIBERO-Pro、RoboCasa 和 RoboTwin 基准上评估 VISTA。实验结果表明，VISTA 逐步提高任务成功率，且比静态反思更节省 rollout，能够使用更少的模拟器 rollout 获得更高成功率。

2610.35316.title: RSIV-Harness: A Recursive Self-Improvement Harness Framework for Open-Domain Conversational Text-to-Visualization
2610.35316.authors: Jiawei Lu , Chen Zhang , Jinwei Lu , Yuanwei Song , Yuanfeng Song , Raymond Chi-Wing Wong
2610.35316.abstract_en: Users often request charts without knowing which database or table holds the relevant data. Such requests may be ambiguous, and users may ask follow-up questions to deepen their analysis or iteratively refine existing charts. A useful assistant must therefore discover relevant data sources among heterogeneous databases, ask clarifying questions when needed, and track evolving user intent while preserving constraints established in earlier turns. Yet recent text-to-visualization agents typically rely on static agent harnesses that are predefined and remain unchanged despite recurring failures across tasks. To address this limitation, we introduce RSIV-Harness, which keeps the language model weights fixed and applies Recursive Self-Improvement to revise the surrounding harness from the agent's own failure traces. To balance flexible self-improvement with stability, we introduce a four-layer framework that evaluates proposed harness revisions through anchor and memory checks, refining those that pass and restoring the best validated harness otherwise. We further introduce ODAC-Vis, a benchmark with 640 tasks for Open-Domain, Ambiguous, and Conversational text-to-visualization that jointly evaluates open-domain data discovery, ambiguity resolution, multi-turn visualization refinement, and executable chart generation. Experiments show that a single round of RSIV-Harness improves all six evaluation metrics relative to the seed harness, with particularly large gains in executability (+28.02 points) and chart structure (+34.01 points), demonstrating the ability to learn from task-solving experience and turn recurring failures across tasks into substantial performance improvements.
2610.35316.affiliation: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University; The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
2610.35316.update_target: External text-to-visualization harness revisions with fixed language-model weights
2610.35316.mechanism_en: Failure traces propose harness changes. Anchor and memory checks gate revisions; accepted variants are refined, while failed proposals restore the best validated harness for subsequent work.
2610.35316.result_en: On 640-task ODAC-Vis, one reported round improves all six metrics, including executability by 28.02 points and chart structure by 34.01 points.
2610.35316.boundary_en: A single demonstrated round supports local harness improvement, not sustained recursive gains. Executable charts and structural accuracy are separate from semantic analytical correctness.
2610.35316.abstract_zh: 用户往往在不知道哪个数据库或数据表包含相关数据时，就提出图表请求。这类请求可能含糊不清，用户也可能继续提问以深化分析或迭代完善现有图表。因此，一个实用助手必须在异构数据库间发现相关数据源，在需要时请求澄清，并在保留前几轮约束的同时跟踪用户意图的演变。然而，近期文本到可视化智能体通常依赖预先定义的静态运行框架，即使跨任务反复失败，也保持不变。为克服这一局限，我们提出 RSIV-Harness，固定语言模型权重，根据智能体自身的失败轨迹，对外围运行框架应用递归自改进。为了平衡灵活自改进与稳定性，我们引入四层框架，通过锚点检查和记忆检查评估候选框架修订，继续完善通过检查的修订，否则恢复表现最佳的已验证框架。我们进一步提出 ODAC-Vis，一个包含 640 个任务的开放域、含糊及对话式文本到可视化基准，联合评估开放域数据发现、歧义消解、多轮可视化完善及可执行图表生成。实验表明，单轮 RSIV-Harness 就能相对种子框架改善全部六项评估指标，尤其在可执行性（提高 28.02 个百分点）和图表结构（提高 34.01 个百分点）上提升显著，展示了从任务求解经验中学习、将跨任务反复失败转化为大幅性能改进的能力。

2610.35434.title: Skill$^{\infty}$: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Skill Optimization
2610.35434.authors: Wangcheng Tao , Zhanglu Yan , Han Wu , Weng-Fai Wong
2610.35434.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI), in which a system also improves the way it improves, is a long-standing aspiration on the path to AGI. Language agents increasingly store procedural knowledge in reusable skills. Optimizing skills offers a direct way to achieve RSI, because the optimization procedure itself can be encoded as a skill. Existing skill optimizers, however, follow a hand-designed procedure. Even methods that evolve a meta-skill confine it to a fixed pipeline and relearn it for each task. We present Skill$^{\infty}$, which makes skill optimization recursively self-improving: a meta agent follows a meta-skill to optimize task skills and optimizes the meta-skill itself using the same procedure. The optimization is agent-led. The meta agent diagnoses execution traces, proposes candidates, requests independent reviews, and allocates the search budget. The meta-skill defines these steps, allowing self-improvement to rewrite them. This meta-skill is also decoupled from task skills, refined on multiple skill optimization tasks and then reused to optimize task skills across diverse domains. As in deployment, skills at both levels are standard packages loaded through native skill discovery. On 83 SkillsBench tasks, Skill$^{\infty}$ reaches a pass rate of 60.7%, compared with 56.4% for human-curated skills and 54.5% for SkillEvolver.
2610.35434.affiliation: National University of Singapore; City University of Hong Kong
2610.35434.update_target: Task-skill packages and the reusable meta-skill defining their optimization procedure
2610.35434.mechanism_en: A meta-agent follows the meta-skill to diagnose traces, propose edits, obtain independent reviews and allocate budget. The same procedure optimizes the meta-skill across tasks before transfer to new skill optimization.
2610.35434.result_en: Across 83 SkillsBench tasks, pass rate is 60.7%, versus 56.4% for human-curated skills and 54.5% for SkillEvolver.
2610.35434.boundary_en: The infinity notation is a method name, not evidence of infinite improvement. Independent review remains model-based; the inspected repository promises a future code release and is linked as Project only.
2610.35434.abstract_zh: 递归自改进（RSI），即系统也改进自己的改进方式，是通向 AGI 的一个长期愿景。语言智能体越来越多地将过程知识存储为可复用技能。优化技能为实现 RSI 提供了直接途径，因为优化流程本身也能编码为技能。然而，现有技能优化器遵循人工设计的流程。即使演化元技能的方法，也把它限制在固定流水线中，并为每项任务重新学习。我们提出 Skill∞，使技能优化能够递归自改进：元智能体按照元技能优化任务技能，并用同一流程优化元技能本身。优化由智能体主导。元智能体诊断执行轨迹、提出候选方案、请求独立审查并分配搜索预算。元技能定义这些步骤，因此自改进能够重写这些步骤。该元技能还与任务技能解耦，在多个技能优化任务上完善后，复用于不同领域的任务技能优化。与部署时一样，两个层级的技能都是通过原生技能发现加载的标准包。在 SkillsBench 的 83 个任务上，Skill∞ 的通过率达到 60.7%，相比之下，人工整理技能为 56.4%，SkillEvolver 为 54.5%。

2610.35616.title: Hierarchical Skill Evolution for Coding Agent
2610.35616.authors: Jun Gao , Yun Peng , Changhai Zhou , Yuhan Zhu , Xiangyu Zeng , Shiyang Zhang Yuhua Zhou , Luozheng Qin , Qian Qiao , Xiaoteng Ma , Baian Chen Weiyi Shang , Zhen Ming Jack Jiang , Lizhi Liao , Xiaoxue Ren
2610.35616.abstract_en: Skills provide agents with reusable experience to guide future decisions without modifying the underlying model. However, coding trajectories are often entangled with task- and repository-specific contexts, making it challenging to distill procedural skills that generalize across diverse coding environments. To address this challenge, we present Hierarchical Skill Evolution (HSE), which progressively distills procedural knowledge from coding trajectories through hierarchical evidence aggregation. HSE first extracts task-level evidence from individual trajectories, then aggregates recurring evidence within the same repository to form repository-specific skill candidates, and finally consolidates consistent patterns across repositories into transferable skills across repositories. The evolution is driven by an external writer-evaluator loop that generates and assesses skills while keeping the underlying coding model frozen. The loop externally updates the writer and evaluator policies to improve subsequent skill generation and assessment. This hierarchy progressively filters task-specific details while preserving procedures that generalize across diverse coding environments. Successful trajectories yield reusable guidance for future tasks, while failed trajectories reveal recurring failure modes that guide avoidance and recovery. We evaluate HSE on SWE-bench Verified and DeepSWE, using GLM-5.2 across Pi and Claude Code harnesses and GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.8 with Pi. Across both benchmarks, 10 skills evolved solely from SWE-Gym improve coding performance across all evaluated settings, demonstrating transfer across benchmarks, coding models, and agent harnesses. We further evolve the skill library from target-benchmark trajectories without verifier feedback, relying solely on the learned evaluator for candidate assessment and achieving additional gains through benchmark-tailored skills.
2610.35616.update_target: Hierarchical external skills, writer rules and evaluator feature weights; coding model frozen
2610.35616.mechanism_en: Task evidence is aggregated within and across repositories. Training updates writer rules and small evaluator evidence coefficients, then validates the joint evolution state on held-out tasks; target adaptation freezes those controllers.
2610.35616.result_en: Ten SWE-Gym-derived skills improve all tested model/harness settings on SWE-bench Verified and DeepSWE. Target-benchmark trajectories yield further tailored gains without exposing their verifier outcomes to the controller.
2610.35616.boundary_en: Evaluator feature-weight changes are not coding-LLM fine-tuning. Static transfer and eight-round target-benchmark adaptation are different protocols; evaluation labels used for reporting are separate from adaptation feedback.
2610.35616.abstract_zh: 技能为智能体提供可复用经验，在不修改底层模型的情况下指导未来决策。然而，编码轨迹往往与具体任务和仓库的上下文纠缠，使得提炼可泛化到不同编码环境的过程技能具有挑战性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出分层技能演化（HSE），通过分层证据聚合，从编码轨迹中逐步提炼过程知识。HSE 首先从单条轨迹提取任务级证据，再聚合同一仓库中反复出现的证据，形成仓库特定的技能候选，最后整合跨仓库一致的模式，形成可跨仓库迁移的技能。演化由外部写作者—评估器循环驱动，在固定底层编码模型的同时生成和评估技能。该循环从外部更新写作者与评估器策略，以改进后续技能生成和评估。这一层次结构逐步过滤任务特定细节，同时保留可泛化到不同编码环境的流程。成功轨迹产生可复用于未来任务的指导，失败轨迹则揭示反复出现的失败模式，用于指导规避和恢复。我们在 SWE-bench Verified 和 DeepSWE 上评估 HSE，使用 GLM-5.2 配合 Pi 和 Claude Code 运行框架，以及 GPT-5.5、Opus 4.8 配合 Pi。在两个基准上，仅从 SWE-Gym 演化出的 10 个技能就在所有被评估设置中改善编码表现，展示跨基准、编码模型和智能体运行框架的迁移。我们进一步利用目标基准的轨迹演化技能库，不使用验证器反馈，仅依靠学习得到的评估器评估候选，并通过面向基准定制的技能获得额外收益。

2610.33245.title: AdaPRA: Process Reward Agents with Adaptive Rubrics for Data Science
2610.33245.authors: Atharva Naik , Vivek Chari , Pol Llado , Daniel Fried , Carolyn Rosé , Benjamin Van Durme , Sam Thomson , Justin Svegliato
2610.33245.abstract_en: Data science agents can automate end-to-end machine learning workflows, yet they remain far from competitive on human leaderboards. Agents make process errors such as insufficient exploration, unsound validation, coding bugs, and poor use of a fixed budget (re-running the same exploratory data analysis and baseline models in every attempt). We propose AdaPRA to address these issues: a persistent coding agent harness that accumulates knowledge across attempts on the same task, with rubric-guided process supervision that identifies and corrects errors. Our process reward agent audits the agent's trajectory and workspace by executing checks, and adapts its rubrics to each task. We find that rubrics seeded from easier tasks generalize to harder tasks, with rubric adaptation further improving performance. With five attempts per task, AdaPRA improves an 80B Qwen model's leaderboard percentile by 24.5 points on DSPredict-Easy and 14.8 points on DSPredict-Hard while reducing process errors. We also show that supervision with rubrics mined from one base model's runs improves another (DeepSeek-V3.2), and that AdaPRA beats DataPRM, a competitive PRM for data science. We also share our code for reproducibility.
2610.33245.update_target: Persistent same-task workspace knowledge and adaptive process-supervision rubrics
2610.33245.mechanism_en: A process reward agent executes checks over trajectories and artifacts, adapting rubrics that correct later attempts. Rubrics seeded on easier tasks or one model can be reused elsewhere.
2610.33245.result_en: With five attempts per task, an 80B Qwen model gains 24.5 leaderboard-percentile points on DSPredict-Easy and 14.8 on DSPredict-Hard, with fewer process errors.
2610.33245.boundary_en: These are leaderboard percentiles, not accuracy points. Same-task accumulation is distinct from cross-task learning; the auditor and five-attempt budget must be counted.
2610.33245.abstract_zh: 数据科学智能体能够自动执行端到端机器学习工作流，但在人工排行榜上仍远未达到有竞争力的水平。智能体会出现探索不足、验证不可靠、代码错误和固定预算利用不当等流程错误，例如在每次尝试中重新运行相同的探索性数据分析和基线模型。为解决这些问题，我们提出 AdaPRA：一个在同一任务的多次尝试间积累知识的持久编码智能体运行框架，并配以基于评分细则的过程监督来识别和纠正错误。我们的过程奖励智能体通过执行检查，审计智能体轨迹和工作区，并针对各任务适配评分细则。我们发现，从较简单任务初始化的细则可以泛化到较难任务，而适配细则能够进一步提升表现。每项任务尝试五次时，AdaPRA 使一个 80B Qwen 模型在 DSPredict-Easy 和 DSPredict-Hard 上的排行榜百分位分别提高 24.5 和 14.8 个点，同时减少过程错误。我们还展示，使用从一个基础模型运行中挖掘出的细则进行监督，可以改进另一个模型 DeepSeek-V3.2；AdaPRA 也优于具有竞争力的数据科学过程奖励模型 DataPRM。我们同时分享代码以支持复现。

2610.33465.title: LegoSR: A Unified Framework for Self-improving Agent-Guided Scientific Discovery
2610.33465.authors: Hao Mao , Xu T. Liu , Peng Zhao , Shuai Lu , Yuntian Chen
2610.33465.abstract_en: Equation discovery solvers often use different data interfaces, equation representations and evaluation criteria, making their results difficult to compare. We present LegoSR, a unified framework for algebraic symbolic regression and differential equation discovery. LegoSR integrates seven solvers through a common equation representation and evaluation process, and supports searches constrained by partially known equations. Researchers can run solvers directly or use LegoSR Agent, which selects solvers and adapts searches based on solver knowledge, intermediate results and lessons from earlier tasks. On noisy ordinary and partial differential equation benchmarks, LegoSR Agent recovers nearly as many equations as the union of seven expert-tuned solvers and outperforms a generic agent with the same model, tools and budget by up to 29 percentage points. Three examples demonstrate basic use, adaptive solver selection and discovery guided by partial physical knowledge.
2610.33465.affiliation: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University; Eastern Institute of Technology; Amazon Web Services; University of Washington; Beijing EEO Education Technology; Jiangxi University of Finance and Economics
2610.33465.update_target: Solver choices, constrained searches and reusable lessons in a scientific-discovery agent
2610.33465.mechanism_en: Seven solvers share an equation representation and evaluation interface. The agent uses intermediate results and earlier-task lessons to choose and adapt later searches, including partially known equations.
2610.33465.result_en: On noisy ODE/PDE benchmarks it nearly matches the union of seven expert-tuned solvers and beats a generic agent with matched model/tools/budget by up to 29 points.
2610.33465.boundary_en: Equation recovery is benchmark evidence, not a new physical law certified by the digest. A reusable solver-selection mechanism is not recursive revision of the entire research system.
2610.33465.abstract_zh: 方程发现求解器经常使用不同的数据接口、方程表示和评估标准，使得结果难以比较。我们提出 LegoSR，一个统一的代数符号回归与微分方程发现框架。LegoSR 通过共同的方程表示和评估流程集成七个求解器，并支持以部分已知方程约束搜索。研究人员可以直接运行求解器，也可使用 LegoSR Agent，后者依据求解器知识、中间结果及先前任务的经验教训选择求解器并调整搜索。在带噪声的常微分与偏微分方程基准上，LegoSR Agent 恢复的方程数量几乎达到七个专家调优求解器的并集，并在模型、工具和预算相同的条件下，比通用智能体最多提高 29 个百分点。三个示例展示了基本用法、自适应求解器选择，以及利用部分物理知识引导的发现。

2610.33799.title: MTA-Zero: Self-Improving Multimodal Deep Search via Online QA-Solver Co-training
2610.33799.authors: Xiangyu Peng , Jiaxin Zhang , An Yan , Yu Li , Ran Xu , Zeyuan Chen , Chien-Sheng Wu
2610.33799.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become strong visual reasoners, yet remain limited in open-world, multi-step search that requires grounding images, selecting tools, and integrating web evidence. Existing approaches typically construct and filter fixed offline corpora whose question distributions cannot adapt as the target deep-search agent improves. Building on MTA-Agent's image-grounded QA construction, we present MTA-Zero, an online multimodal QA-Solver co-training framework for self-improving multimodal deep-search agents that requires no precomputed multi-hop corpus. Starting from image-grounded VQA seed contexts, a trainable QA Generator retrieves evidence and constructs verified multi-hop questions online. A separate deep-search Solver then selects tools, gathers evidence, and answers the generated questions. To focus generation on the Solver's learning frontier, we derive a Goldilocks reward for the QA Generator from the Solver's group-wise rollout success rate: questions solved by all rollouts or by none receive zero reward, whereas questions near the current frontier are favored. We optimize the two policies independently with GRPO, without sharing parameters or gradients. Across six multimodal deep-search benchmarks, MTA-Zero improves a Qwen3-VL-8B Solver from 36.91% to 51.58% mean accuracy and achieves performance comparable to GPT-5 under the same agent workflow. The same framework also improves a newer Qwen3.6-27B Solver by 10.82 points. These results show that verified online question generation provides a policy-specific curriculum for continually improving multimodal deep-search agents.
2610.33799.update_target: Separate trainable QA-generator and search-solver policies
2610.33799.mechanism_en: Image-grounded seeds initiate online verified multi-hop generation. A Goldilocks reward favors intermediate solver success, and independent GRPO objectives update the two policies without shared parameters or gradients.
2610.33799.result_en: Across six benchmarks, Qwen3-VL-8B mean accuracy rises from 36.91% to 51.58%; a Qwen3.6-27B solver gains 10.82 points.
2610.33799.boundary_en: No precomputed multi-hop corpus does not mean no seed data, retrieval or training cost. Frontier difficulty depends on rollout success and on the correctness of question verification.
2610.33799.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）已成为强大的视觉推理器，但在需要图像依据、工具选择及网页证据整合的开放世界多步搜索中仍有局限。现有方法通常构建并筛选固定离线语料，其问题分布无法随着目标深度搜索智能体的进步而调整。基于 MTA-Agent 的图像依据问答构建，我们提出 MTA-Zero，一个用于自改进多模态深度搜索智能体的在线问答生成器—求解器共同训练框架，不需要预先计算的多跳语料。从以图像为依据的 VQA 种子上下文出发，一个可训练问答生成器检索证据，并在线构建经过验证的多跳问题。一个独立的深度搜索求解器随后选择工具、收集证据并回答生成的问题。为使生成集中在求解器的学习前沿，我们根据求解器分组 rollout 的成功率，为问答生成器推导 Goldilocks 奖励：所有 rollout 都能解答或全都无法解答的问题奖励为零，而接近当前能力前沿的问题更受偏好。我们使用 GRPO 独立优化两个策略，不共享参数或梯度。在六个多模态深度搜索基准上，MTA-Zero 将 Qwen3-VL-8B 求解器的平均准确率从 36.91% 提高到 51.58%，并在相同智能体工作流下获得与 GPT-5 相当的表现。同一框架还使更新的 Qwen3.6-27B 求解器提高 10.82 个百分点。这些结果表明，经过验证的在线问题生成，能够为多模态深度搜索智能体的持续改进提供针对策略的课程。

2610.33861.title: ReGE: Stronger Agents through Experience Synthesis
2610.33861.authors: Jiarong Liang , Yubo Wang , Zijie Liu , Yuxuan Zhang , Ping Nie , Wenhu Chen
2610.33861.abstract_en: Repeated attempts at interactive tasks uncover facts, useful operations, and failures that can inform subsequent execution. We introduce ReGE, a framework for turning this recorded experience into guidance for a fresh attempt. Its main implementation, ReGE-Syn, uses a single coach call to jointly synthesize bounded execution records and available artifacts into self-contained guidance, connecting task-specific findings with proposed actions and relevant pitfalls. A student starts from the task's initial environment state and adapts this guidance to current observations. Source generation, synthesis, and student execution use the same base model, without parameter updates or a stronger teacher. Across four benchmarks, ReGE improves accuracy by an average of 9.9 percentage points for GPT and 8.8 percentage points for Claude compared with unguided execution. On matched BrowseComp-Plus subsets, ReGE-Syn reduces guidance-construction tokens by 98.2\% on GPT and 95.5\% on Claude relative to adapted AggAgent, with observed success. Combined construction and execution tokens decrease by 15.7\% and 35.4\%, respectively, counting input plus output and excluding source generation. BrowseComp-Plus ablations further associate access to process information with fewer student steps and show that joint synthesis produces substantially shorter guidance than Direct history or Independent summaries, with observed success. These results demonstrate how agents can use their own recorded experience to improve subsequent task completion, and suggest a low-cost way to consolidate the execution records of parallel agent systems such as agent swarms.
2610.33861.affiliation: University of Waterloo; University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill; University of British Columbia
2610.33861.update_target: Task-specific synthesized guidance for a fresh execution; no parameter updates
2610.33861.mechanism_en: One coach call jointly consolidates bounded source attempts and artifacts. A student restarts from the original environment and adapts the guidance to observations using the same base model.
2610.33861.result_en: Mean accuracy gains are 9.9/8.8 points for GPT/Claude across four benchmarks. BrowseComp-Plus guidance-construction token savings reach 98.2%/95.5% versus adapted AggAgent.
2610.33861.boundary_en: The combined construction/execution savings in the abstract exclude source generation. Same-task re-execution is not proof that a persistent cross-task learner improves; count the source pool for lifecycle cost.
2610.33861.abstract_zh: 反复尝试交互任务能够发现事实、有用操作和失败，为后续执行提供信息。我们提出 ReGE，一个将这些记录经验转化为全新尝试指导的框架。其主要实现 ReGE-Syn 使用单次教练调用，将有界的执行记录与可用产物联合综合为自包含指导，将任务特定发现与建议行动及相关陷阱联系起来。学生从任务的初始环境状态开始，并根据当前观测调整这些指导。来源生成、综合和学生执行均使用同一个基础模型，不更新参数，也不使用更强教师。在四个基准上，相比无指导执行，ReGE 使 GPT 和 Claude 的准确率分别平均提高 9.9 和 8.8 个百分点。在匹配的 BrowseComp-Plus 子集上，相比适配后的 AggAgent，ReGE-Syn 在观察到成功的情况下，将 GPT 和 Claude 的指导构建 token 分别减少 98.2% 和 95.5%。将构建与执行合计，token 分别减少 15.7% 和 35.4%；这里计算输入加输出，不含来源生成。BrowseComp-Plus 消融进一步表明，能够访问过程信息与更少的学生步骤相关；与直接历史记录或独立摘要相比，联合综合在观察到成功的情况下生成显著更短的指导。这些结果展示智能体如何利用自身记录经验改善后续任务完成，并提示一种低成本方法，可整合智能体群等并行智能体系统的执行记录。

2610.33876.title: FlashScript: Compiling Recurring Agent Workflows into Reusable Neuro-Symbolic Programs
2610.33876.authors: Sadra Sabouri , Hosein Hasanbeig , Adam Sage , Shreya Sinha , Cale Darling , Ashish Tiwari , Katie Garms , Souti Chattopadhyay , Sumit Gulwani
2610.33876.categories_text: Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
2610.33876.abstract_en: Many agent tasks recur with new data or small changes, yet agents regenerate their reasoning and actions on each run, producing different results. Distilling a prior run into a skill helps the agent avoid earlier mistakes, but it still re-runs the full process each time, so runs can vary and incur that cost. We compile a successful agent run into a reusable neuro-symbolic program (NSP) with a set of guidelines we call FlashScript. Actions and data transformations become code, instance-specific values become parameters, and decisions that need model judgment become LLM calls. We identify three layers where these calls belong and three techniques that replace most of them with code. The compilation does not remove nondeterminism; it localizes it, so the deterministic program and its neural calls can be reviewed and tested separately. Across 120 WorkBench analytics tasks with Claude Haiku 4.5, the NSPs were correct and made identical tool calls on every run, using about 70 times fewer input tokens and a third of the runtime of a skill-guided agent whose runs were inconsistent. In a composite version of the tasks, the skill-guided agent's accuracy fell to 23%, and its output inconsistency increased, while the NSPs remained correct and identical across all runs. The NSPs successfully generalized to all 108 unseen instances of the same templates. Our findings suggest that NSPs from agent trajectories can be considered cumulative software assets for end-users to test, maintain, and reuse in their recurring workflows.
2610.33876.update_target: Reusable neuro-symbolic programs compiled from successful workflows
2610.33876.mechanism_en: Actions become code, instance values become parameters and irreducible judgments remain localized model calls. Deterministic code and neural calls can be tested separately before recurring reuse.
2610.33876.result_en: Across 120 WorkBench tasks, programs remain correct with identical calls and use about 70× fewer input tokens and one-third the runtime of skill-guided agents; all 108 unseen same-template instances succeed.
2610.33876.boundary_en: Template-instance transfer is narrower than arbitrary workflow generalization. Compilation localizes nondeterminism rather than removing it; maintenance and compilation cost require separate accounting.
2610.33876.abstract_zh: 许多智能体任务会随着新数据或小幅变化反复出现，但智能体每次运行都重新生成推理和行动，导致结果不同。将先前运行提炼为技能有助于规避旧错误，但仍需每次重跑完整流程，因此运行可能变化并产生相应成本。我们用一组名为 FlashScript 的指导原则，将成功的智能体运行编译为可复用神经符号程序（NSP）。行动和数据变换转化为代码，实例特定值转化为参数，需要模型判断的决策转化为 LLM 调用。我们识别这些调用应处于的三个层次，以及用代码替代其中大多数调用的三种技术。编译不会消除非确定性，而是将其局部化，使确定性程序及其神经调用能够分别接受审查和测试。在使用 Claude Haiku 4.5 的 120 个 WorkBench 分析任务上，NSP 每次运行都正确，且工具调用完全一致；相比运行不一致的技能引导智能体，输入 token 约少 70 倍，运行时间为其三分之一。在任务的组合版本上，技能引导智能体的准确率降至 23%，输出不一致性增加，而 NSP 在所有运行中仍然正确且一致。NSP 成功泛化到相同模板的全部 108 个未见实例。这些发现表明，从智能体轨迹得到的 NSP 可以被视为累积的软件资产，供最终用户测试、维护，并在反复出现的工作流中复用。

2610.34043.title: Holding a Steady Course: Knowledge Evolution from Expertise and Lessons for Continual Agent Learning
2610.34043.authors: Wenzhe Fan , Benjamin Steenhoek , Gaurav Mittal , Yu Hu
2610.34043.abstract_en: Autonomous agents are increasingly deployed across sequences of related tasks, yet they often fail to retain and improve their knowledge over time. Existing approaches convert interaction trajectories into memories or reusable skills, but experience is not automatically reliable knowledge. Automatically collected skills and memories can propagate errors, mislead, and corrupt useful knowledge. To address this gap, we introduce Knowledge Evolution from Expertise and Lessons (KEEL), an agent-agnostic framework that uses verifier evidence to transform successful behavior into reusable skills and failures into corrective lessons. As new evidence accumulates, individual skill claims can be supported, contradicted, replaced, or retired. On SkillFlow benchmark, KEEL improves task success by 4.2 to 21.7 percentage points over the no-knowledge baseline, compared with gains of 2.4 to 9.6 points from SkillFlow's default method. Ablations show that skills and lessons are complementary. These results show that reliable continual agent learning depends not simply on accumulating experience, but on continually validating and evolving the knowledge derived from it. Our code is available at: this https URL .
2610.34043.update_target: External skill claims and corrective lessons with support, contradiction, replacement and retirement states
2610.34043.mechanism_en: Verifier evidence turns successful behavior into skills and failures into lessons. New evidence changes claim status, allowing validated knowledge to guide subsequent tasks instead of merely accumulating summaries.
2610.34043.result_en: SkillFlow success gains over no knowledge are 4.2–21.7 points, compared with 2.4–9.6 for its default method; ablations find skills and lessons complementary.
2610.34043.boundary_en: Reliability depends on verifier and claim scope. The inspected release is the main Terminus-2 experiment and omits benchmark tasks; it does not independently reproduce all agent-agnostic claims.
2610.34043.abstract_zh: 自主智能体越来越多地部署于一系列相关任务中，但它们往往无法随时间保留和改进知识。现有方法将交互轨迹转化为记忆或可复用技能，但经验并不自动成为可靠知识。自动收集的技能和记忆可能传播错误、误导智能体并损坏有用知识。为弥补这一缺口，我们提出 Knowledge Evolution from Expertise and Lessons（KEEL），一个与智能体无关的框架，使用验证器证据，将成功行为转化为可复用技能，将失败转化为纠错经验。随着新证据积累，单条技能主张可以获得支持、被反驳、替换或退役。在 SkillFlow 基准上，相比无知识基线，KEEL 使任务成功率提高 4.2—21.7 个百分点，而 SkillFlow 默认方法的增益为 2.4—9.6 个百分点。消融表明技能与经验教训相互补充。这些结果显示，可靠的持续智能体学习不仅依赖经验积累，还依赖对由经验得到的知识持续验证和演化。代码可在原文所附的 HTTPS 链接获取。

2610.34260.title: MultiEvoSkill: Structure-Aware Multi-Agent Skill Evolution for Generalizable Skill Artifacts
2610.34260.authors: Kounianhua Du , Jianxing Liu , Ruoshui Shan , Yucheng Zhang , Ke Li , Xing Sun , Weinan Zhang
2610.34260.abstract_en: Skill documents are becoming the default adaptation surface for frozen large language model (LLM) agents, but current skill generators face two key limitations. First, humans and different LLMs differ in how they organize procedural knowledge and approach task solving. Skills authored from a human or single-model perspective may therefore fail to align with the reasoning behaviors of other backbones, limiting cross-model generalization. Second, sequential skill descriptions inadequately represent procedures with parallel branches and explicit dependencies, while existing skill optimizers primarily operate on prose and lack explicit support for graph-structured skill evolution. We introduce MultiEvoSkill, a skill-optimization framework comprising three core components: 1) Skill compiler casts the skill as a typed graph with tailored operators, producing a compact, informative representation with explicit procedural topology; 2) Heterogeneous agent system proposes revision advices using collective intelligence, where minimal and informative issues are identified based on multiple sets of experiences. 3) Structure-aware debate and evolution mechanism organizes candidate edits into a heterogeneous graph, resolves them under dependency and importance constraints, and distills the collective proposal into the artifact. Multi-dimensional gating ensures the information gain and topological correctness of each evolution. Optimal skills are then obtained when the system converges at a consistent state. Various experiments and ablations against SOTA methods validate the effectiveness and generalization of MultiEvoSkill.
2610.34260.affiliation: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Tencent; Purdue (as listed)
2610.34260.update_target: Typed procedural skill graphs and their external revisions
2610.34260.mechanism_en: Heterogeneous agents identify experience-backed issues, debate dependent edits and compile them into a graph artifact. Multidimensional gates check information gain and topology before reuse.
2610.34260.result_en: The abstract reports experiments and ablations supporting effectiveness and cross-model generalization, without providing a numerical aggregate.
2610.34260.boundary_en: A structurally valid graph need not improve execution. Do not infer unreported effect sizes or global optimality from the abstract’s convergence language; graph compilation and debate incur overhead.
2610.34260.abstract_zh: 技能文档正在成为冻结大语言模型（LLM）智能体的默认适配界面，但现有技能生成器有两个关键局限。首先，人类和不同 LLM 在组织过程知识及解决任务的方式上存在差异。因此，从人类或单一模型视角编写的技能，可能无法匹配其他骨干模型的推理行为，限制跨模型泛化。其次，顺序式技能描述不足以表示具有并行分支和显式依赖的流程，而现有技能优化器主要处理散文，缺少对图结构技能演化的明确支持。我们提出 MultiEvoSkill，一个包含三个核心组件的技能优化框架：1）技能编译器以定制算子将技能转换为带类型图，生成具有显式流程拓扑的紧凑且信息丰富的表示；2）异构智能体系统利用集体智能提出修订建议，依据多组经验识别最小且有信息量的问题；3）结构感知的辩论与演化机制，将候选编辑组织成异构图，在依赖和重要性约束下解决编辑，并将集体建议提炼进产物。多维门控确保每次演化的信息增益和拓扑正确性。当系统收敛到一致状态时，得到最优技能。与先进方法比较的多种实验和消融，验证了 MultiEvoSkill 的有效性与泛化能力。

2610.34450.title: EvolveMAS: A Unified Self-Evolution Framework for Decentralized Multi-Agent Systems
2610.34450.authors: Yalun Wu , Qiwei Ma , Bingbing Xu , Dan Zhang , Long Bai , Boyang Wang , Jiatong Li , Zheqi Lv , Shaozu Yuan , Peiying Wang , Jiawei Wang , An Zhang , Tat-Seng Chua
2610.34450.abstract_en: Decentralized multi-agent systems (MAS) enable large language model agents to interact without centralized control. Agents need to adapt to other agents at test time and reuse accumulated experience to refine their interaction strategies for future interactions across cooperative, mixed-motive, and adversarial settings. However, existing approaches often develop adaptation mechanisms for particular interaction settings. This raises a central question: how can decentralized MAS support test-time adaptation and reliable experience reuse across interaction settings? We propose EvolveMAS, a unified self-evolution framework that supports experience-driven adaptation within and across episodes. EvolveMAS pairs each main agent with a dedicated MemoryAgent for test-time memory governance, which maintains isolated Structured Memory outside the main agent's reasoning context. EvolveMAS organizes adaptation into two complementary processes: Within-Episode Online Adaptation and Cross-Episode Knowledge Evolution. During Within-Episode Online Adaptation, MemoryAgent updates episodic, semantic, and working memory from interaction evidence to inform subsequent actions. During Cross-Episode Knowledge Evolution, the main agent uses memory and episode outcomes to distill reusable interaction knowledge comprising partner profiles and interaction strategies for subsequent episodes. Across five benchmarks and six evaluation configurations spanning the three interaction settings, EvolveMAS achieves the highest normalized average score of 77.2 among the compared methods. Ablations show that test-time memory governance and cross-episode knowledge reuse both improve performance. Interaction traces further illustrate how updated memory and distilled knowledge guide subsequent interactions. These results support experience-driven adaptation in decentralized MAS without updating model parameters.
2610.34450.affiliation: National University of Singapore; Hunan University; Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences; Xingchen AGI, China Telecom Artificial Intelligence Technology; Cornell University; Meituan; University of Science and Technology of China
2610.34450.update_target: Per-agent structured memory and reusable partner profiles/interaction strategies
2610.34450.mechanism_en: An isolated MemoryAgent updates observed episodic, semantic and working evidence within an episode; episode outcomes then distill cross-episode knowledge for future interaction.
2610.34450.result_en: Across five benchmarks and six configurations, normalized average score reaches 77.2, with ablations supporting memory governance and cross-episode reuse.
2610.34450.boundary_en: This is external test-time adaptation with fixed model parameters. Partner profiles and private observations must preserve visibility constraints; the public plug-in is not the complete experiment suite.
2610.34450.abstract_zh: 去中心化多智能体系统（MAS）使大语言模型智能体能够在没有集中控制的情况下交互。智能体需要在测试时适应其他智能体，并复用积累的经验，在合作、混合动机和对抗设置中完善未来交互策略。然而，现有方法往往针对特定交互设置开发适配机制。这引出一个核心问题：去中心化 MAS 如何支持跨交互设置的测试时适配和可靠经验复用？我们提出 EvolveMAS，一个统一自进化框架，支持回合内与回合间的经验驱动适配。EvolveMAS 为每个主智能体配备专门的 MemoryAgent 来治理测试时记忆，在主智能体的推理上下文之外维护隔离的结构化记忆。EvolveMAS 将适配组织成两个互补过程：回合内在线适配和跨回合知识演化。在回合内在线适配期间，MemoryAgent 根据交互证据更新情节、语义和工作记忆，为后续行动提供信息。在跨回合知识演化期间，主智能体利用记忆与回合结果，提炼包含伙伴画像及交互策略的可复用交互知识，用于后续回合。在覆盖三类交互设置的五个基准和六种评估配置中，EvolveMAS 在比较方法中取得最高的归一化平均分 77.2。消融表明，测试时记忆治理和跨回合知识复用都能改善表现。交互轨迹进一步展示，更新的记忆和提炼的知识如何指导后续交互。这些结果支持去中心化 MAS 无需更新模型参数即可实现经验驱动适配。

2610.34500.title: CaliMem: Search-Efficient Data Agent via Calibrated Memory
2610.34500.authors: Hanze Li , Athan Z. Li , Feiyang Kang , Jiachen T. Wang , Yuhan Chen , Ruishan Liu , Ruoxi Jia
2610.34500.abstract_en: Data curation is a first-order design choice in machine learning, yet tailoring training data to a downstream model and task remains costly in labor, expertise, and compute. Datasets are therefore often processed through fixed pipelines and reused across applications. We show that this assumption is fragile: across 55 dataset--model tasks spanning biological domains, the same curation recipe can help one model while hurting another. Effective curation must adapt to the downstream setting, motivating automated search over data recipes. We first build an agentic system that searches for curation policies at deployment, improving data utility via \textit{test-time curation (TTC)}. Although achieving performance gains, its search is driven largely by recent feedback and remains local. Adding persistent memory helps the agent retain evidence across iterations and reveals a deeper problem: it forms claims that extend beyond the conditions in which they were observed, sometimes abandoning an entire strategy after a single unsuccessful trial. To address this problem, we introduce CaliMem, a calibrated-memory agentic loop that requires the agent to predict the outcome of each proposed policy before executing it. Comparing this prediction with the observed result gives the agent a \textit{reality check} on the claims behind its proposal. It uses the prediction error to retain supported claims, revise mistaken ones, and specify the conditions under which a conclusion holds. This makes the agent's beliefs testable, reduces overgeneralization, and supports more effective long-horizon exploration. Across biological and LLM post-training tasks, CaliMem consistently outperforms fixed curation baselines and published methods, and exceeds full-data training by up to 19.4\%. Code is open-sourced.
2610.34500.affiliation: Virginia Tech; University of Southern California; Princeton University
2610.34500.update_target: Data-curation recipes and calibrated persistent claims about their applicability
2610.34500.mechanism_en: Before executing a recipe, the agent predicts its outcome. Prediction error then supports, revises or conditions stored claims, shaping later search rather than treating one failure as a universal rejection.
2610.34500.result_en: Across biological and LLM post-training tasks, CaliMem beats fixed curation and published comparators, exceeding full-data training by up to 19.4%.
2610.34500.boundary_en: The maximum gain is task-dependent; recipe evaluation includes downstream training. Better search memory does not establish improved general reasoning or eliminate validation overfitting.
2610.34500.abstract_zh: 数据整理是机器学习中的首要设计选择，但针对下游模型与任务定制训练数据，仍需昂贵的人力、专业知识和算力。因此，数据集往往通过固定流水线处理后，复用于不同应用。我们表明，这一假设并不稳固：在生物领域的 55 个数据集—模型任务上，同一整理配方可能帮助一个模型，却损害另一个。有效整理必须适应下游设置，这促使我们自动搜索数据配方。我们首先构建一个在部署时搜索整理策略的智能体系统，通过测试时整理（TTC）改善数据效用。尽管获得性能提升，其搜索主要由近期反馈驱动，仍停留于局部。加入持久记忆帮助智能体跨迭代保留证据，却也暴露出更深的问题：它形成的主张超出实际观测条件，有时仅因一次失败试验，就放弃整个策略。为解决这一问题，我们提出 CaliMem，一个校准记忆的智能体循环，要求智能体在执行每个候选策略前先预测结果。将预测与观测结果比较，为提案背后的主张提供“现实检验”。它利用预测误差保留有支持的主张、修订错误主张，并明确结论成立的条件。这使智能体信念可被测试，减少过度泛化，并支持更有效的长时程探索。在生物任务与 LLM 后训练任务上，CaliMem 始终优于固定整理基线和已发表方法，相比全数据训练最高提高 19.4%。代码已开源。

2610.34679.title: AT-AT: Automatic Tool Optimization from Agent Traces
2610.34679.authors: Maya Ravichandran , Pragya Tripathi , Dharamendra Kumar , Adith Swaminathan , Nathan Kallus
2610.34679.abstract_en: Efforts to improve LLM-based agents typically focus on modifying the agent itself, yet success also depends on the environment in which an agent acts. Tools mediate this interaction: a tool's description shapes how an agent calls it, and its implementation determines the results and errors the agent receives afterwards. Many tools, such as APIs and MCP servers, are shared by many agents and maintained by providers who cannot change those agents. We introduce AT-AT (Automatic Tool Optimization from Agent Traces), an agentic tool optimizer that improves a shared toolset offline from historical agent executions while holding the agents fixed. A lightweight coding agent reads agent trajectories and their evaluation results, and selectively edits tool descriptions and, when permitted, implementations. On $\tau^2$-bench-verified, AT-AT achieves the highest task completion rates in the Airline and Telecom domains at lower cost than strong prompt- and tool-optimizer baselines, and its Telecom gain is statistically significant under paired permutation tests. Optimizing the tools within a coding agent harness also improves held-out performance on TerminalBench-2 and TBLite. When applied to three production MCP servers at a large enterprise, AT-AT lowered cost or tool error rates on every server and increased held-out task passes on one. By turning accumulated execution traces into updates to shared tool environments, AT-AT provides a path toward continual improvement of agent systems through environment-side learning.
2610.34679.update_target: Shared tool descriptions and, where permitted, implementations; consuming agents fixed
2610.34679.mechanism_en: An offline coding agent reads historical trajectories and task rewards, then edits the tool environment. Held-out paired evaluations test whether those provider-side edits transfer to later executions.
2610.34679.result_en: AT-AT leads Airline/Telecom completion at lower cost, with significant Telecom gains; all three production MCP servers improve cost or tool errors, while only one improves held-out task passes.
2610.34679.boundary_en: Tool usability, error rate and final task correctness are different outcomes. This is environment-side optimization from traces, not weight learning; public code is a pre-release with external benchmark dependencies.
2610.34679.abstract_zh: 改进基于 LLM 的智能体通常聚焦修改智能体本身，但成功也依赖它所处的环境。工具介导这种交互：工具描述影响智能体如何调用它，而实现决定调用后收到的结果和错误。API 与 MCP 服务器等许多工具由多个智能体共享，其维护者无法改变这些智能体。我们提出 AT-AT（基于智能体轨迹的自动工具优化），一个智能体式工具优化器，在固定智能体的条件下，依据历史执行离线改进共享工具集。轻量编码智能体阅读智能体轨迹及其评估结果，选择性编辑工具描述，并在允许时编辑实现。在 τ²-bench-verified 上，相比强提示词优化和工具优化基线，AT-AT 以更低成本在 Airline 与 Telecom 领域取得最高任务完成率；配对置换检验表明，Telecom 增益具有统计显著性。在编码智能体运行框架内部优化工具，也能改善 TerminalBench-2 和 TBLite 的留出集表现。应用于一家大型企业的三个生产 MCP 服务器时，AT-AT 在每个服务器上均降低成本或工具错误率，并在其中一个服务器上提高留出任务通过率。通过将积累的执行轨迹转化为共享工具环境的更新，AT-AT 为通过环境侧学习持续改进智能体系统提供了一条路径。

2610.34724.title: Harness-Model Collaboration for Long-Horizon Continual Learning
2610.34724.authors: Zhen Bi , Zhizhi Peng , Yan Wang , Xueshu Chen , Haofei Zhang , Yaobo Zhang , Zeyu Yang , Qing Shen , Jungang Lou
2610.34724.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents continuously encounter reusable procedural knowledge, yet existing systems typically rely either on model adaptation or external memory, trading persistent learning for rapid reuse. This limitation is especially important for Web agents that repeatedly execute related multi-step workflows. We propose HaMo, a Harness-Model collaborative framework that combines fast non-parametric experience accumulation with slow parametric adaptation. HaMo distills trajectories into strategy-level experience cards for immediate retrieval, while an experience-conditioned continual learning objective trains the model to interpret, ground, and execute retrieved strategies across changing contexts. A retrieval-coverage-based selection mechanism further identifies compact and complementary trajectories for parameter updates. Experiments show that HaMo outperforms harness-only and model-only adaptation under within-domain and cross-domain shifts, improving both retention and adaptation. These results highlight the importance of jointly preserving procedural experience and internalizing the competence to transfer and execute it across tasks.
2610.34724.affiliation: Huzhou Normal University; Alibaba Group; Zhejiang University; Ningxia University
2610.34724.update_target: Fast external strategy cards and slower model-parameter updates
2610.34724.mechanism_en: Trajectories become immediately retrievable cards; experience-conditioned continual learning trains the model to execute them. Retrieval coverage selects compact complementary trajectories for updates.
2610.34724.result_en: Reported within-domain and cross-domain experiments outperform harness-only and model-only adaptation in retention and adaptation.
2610.34724.boundary_en: This trains model parameters as well as storing memory; it is not training-free. The abstract gives no numerical aggregate or hardware budget, so neither is inferred.
2610.34724.abstract_zh: 长时程智能体不断遇到可复用的过程知识，但现有系统通常只依靠模型适配或外部记忆，在持久学习与快速复用之间取舍。对于反复执行相关多步工作流的网页智能体，这一局限尤其重要。我们提出 HaMo，一个运行框架—模型协作框架，将快速的非参数经验积累与缓慢的参数适配结合起来。HaMo 将轨迹提炼为策略级经验卡，用于即时检索，同时通过经验条件化的持续学习目标，训练模型在变化的上下文中理解、落地和执行检索到的策略。一个基于检索覆盖率的选择机制进一步识别紧凑且互补的轨迹，用于参数更新。实验表明，在域内与跨域变化下，HaMo 均优于仅适配运行框架或仅适配模型，同时改善保留与适应能力。这些结果强调，既保留过程经验，又内化跨任务迁移和执行这些经验的能力，十分重要。

2610.34977.title: Adaptive Memory Index Evolution for Agents
2610.34977.authors: Yuntong Hu , Tongli Su , Yuanfu Sun , Shuo Ma , Qiaoyu Tan , Liang Zhao
2610.34977.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents continually accumulate experience, yet retaining a memory does not guarantee access when it is needed. Existing systems can adapt both memory content and access; we isolate persistent access updates as a separately controlled adaptation layer. We formulate this target as Memory Index Evolution and instantiate it with Adaptive Memory Index Evolution (AMIE), a lightweight plug-in layer that evolves per-memory access state from deployment retrievals without modifying stored content or retraining the host memory system. AMIE distils a semantic teacher's keep/suppress judgments into a retrieval-conditioned policy and accumulates its selective actions into bounded state that reweights subsequent host retrievals. Surprisingly, even a zero-call policy that simply accumulates retrieval frequency can match or outperform semantic policies in several settings, revealing retrieval traffic itself as a strong signal for access adaptation, while learned selectivity improves robustness when frequently retrieved memories remain useful. Across five retrieval-based hosts and three benchmarks, trained AMIE improves downstream F1 or accuracy in all 15 comparisons, by 0.70--3.37 percentage points (up to 25% relative), and improves retrieval in all 10 comparisons. Controlled analyses show that persistent competitor suppression can expose previously unseen evidence, while suppressing repeatedly useful memories creates the complementary failure mode. Together, these results establish persistent memory access as a practical adaptation layer, distinct from the content it serves, in retrieval-based agent memory systems.
2610.34977.affiliation: Emory University; New York University; Meituan
2610.34977.update_target: Persistent per-memory retrieval-access state and an optionally trained selection policy; stored content unchanged
2610.34977.mechanism_en: Deployment keep/suppress decisions accumulate into bounded reweighting of future retrieval. A teacher-distilled policy supplies selectivity, while a zero-call frequency policy provides a strong control.
2610.34977.result_en: Across five hosts and three benchmarks, trained AMIE improves all 15 downstream comparisons by 0.70–3.37 points and all ten retrieval comparisons.
2610.34977.boundary_en: The deployment layer avoids retraining the host, but its trained policy uses LoRA distillation. Suppressing frequently useful memories can hurt; access improvement is distinct from content learning.
2610.34977.abstract_zh: 长时程智能体不断积累经验，但保留一条记忆，并不保证需要时能访问它。现有系统能够同时适配记忆内容与访问方式；我们将持久访问更新隔离为一个独立受控的适配层。我们将这一目标表述为记忆索引演化，并以自适应记忆索引演化（AMIE）实现：这是一个轻量插件层，根据部署检索演化每条记忆的访问状态，不修改已存储内容，也不重新训练宿主记忆系统。AMIE 将语义教师的保留／抑制判断蒸馏为以检索为条件的策略，并将其选择性动作累积为有界状态，重新加权后续宿主检索。令人意外的是，仅积累检索频率、不调用模型的策略，在多种设置中也能匹配或超越语义策略，表明检索流量本身就是访问适配的强信号；而当频繁检索的记忆仍然有用时，学习到的选择性能够改善稳健性。在五个基于检索的宿主和三个基准上，训练后的 AMIE 在全部 15 项比较中提高下游 F1 或准确率，增益为 0.70—3.37 个百分点（相对提升最高 25%），并在全部 10 项比较中改善检索。受控分析表明，持久抑制竞争记忆能够暴露此前未见证据，而抑制反复有用的记忆会造成相应的失败模式。综合来看，这些结果确立了持久记忆访问是基于检索的智能体记忆系统中的一个实用适配层，与其服务的内容相区别。

2610.35598.title: Evolve on Graph: Self-Evolving Knowledge Graph Reasoning without Question Annotations
2610.35598.authors: Zongyuan Sun , Shuai Zhao , Ke Shu , Ziyue Zhu , Shangyang Wu , Yuanlin Lin , Tao Wang , Shiyue Li , Yingjun Du , Anh Tuan Luu , Haoran Luo
2610.35598.abstract_en: Knowledge graphs (KGs) provide reliable external knowledge for multi-hop factual reasoning with large language models (LLMs), yet most KGs in real-world domains such as finance and industry lack question--answer (QA) annotations. Without such annotations, existing methods struggle to improve LLM graph reasoning: training-free agents cannot improve their exploration through interaction; reinforcement learning (RL) agents depend on QA data annotated by humans or synthesized by closed-source models; and training data is typically built offline, so its topology mix is fixed and cannot follow the agent's ability. We propose Evolve on Graph (EoG), a framework that lets an LLM self-evolve its graph reasoning without any QA annotations. Through Graph Self-Play, a single LLM alternates between a Proposer that poses questions and a Solver that answers them. To make questions verifiable, Symbolically Verifiable Topology Synthesis (SVTS) samples reasoning topologies on the KG and executes the corresponding first-order logic queries, yielding topology skeletons with correct and complete answer sets; guided by a skeleton, the Proposer explores the graph to pose a multi-hop question. To let task topologies follow the Solver, a Boundary-Aware Graph Curriculum rewards the Proposer by the Solver's score variance, keeping questions at the Solver's capability boundary so that complex topologies enter training as the Solver improves. On six benchmarks over Freebase, Wikidata, and an industrial KG, EoG consistently outperforms prompting-, retrieval-, and agent-based methods, showing that LLM graph reasoning can improve through self-play without QA annotations. Our code is available at this https URL
2610.35598.affiliation: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications; University of Helsinki; University of Amsterdam; Nanyang Technological University
2610.35598.update_target: Proposer/solver training and a graph-topology curriculum
2610.35598.mechanism_en: Symbolically executed graph queries provide complete answer sets for generated tasks. Self-play alternates proposing and solving, with solver score variance keeping the curriculum near its capability boundary.
2610.35598.result_en: Across six benchmarks on Freebase, Wikidata and an industrial KG, the authors report consistent gains over prompting, retrieval and agent baselines without QA annotations.
2610.35598.boundary_en: Annotation-free still relies on graph facts, executable topology and training. The linked repository postpones SVTS synthesis code, task sets and checkpoints; it is not treated as a complete Code release.
2610.35598.abstract_zh: 知识图谱（KG）为大语言模型（LLM）的多跳事实推理提供可靠外部知识，但金融与工业等真实领域的大多数知识图谱缺乏问答（QA）标注。没有这些标注，现有方法难以改进 LLM 图推理：免训练智能体不能通过交互改善探索；强化学习（RL）智能体依赖人工或闭源模型合成的 QA 数据；训练数据通常离线构建，其拓扑组合固定，无法跟随智能体能力变化。我们提出 Evolve on Graph（EoG），一个无需任何 QA 标注即可让 LLM 自进化图推理的框架。通过图自博弈，单个 LLM 交替扮演提出问题的 Proposer 与回答问题的 Solver。为使问题可验证，符号可验证拓扑合成（SVTS）在知识图谱上采样推理拓扑，并执行对应的一阶逻辑查询，产生带有正确且完整答案集合的拓扑骨架；Proposer 在骨架引导下探索图谱，提出多跳问题。为让任务拓扑跟随 Solver，边界感知图课程根据 Solver 得分方差奖励 Proposer，使问题保持在 Solver 能力边界，随着 Solver 进步让复杂拓扑进入训练。在 Freebase、Wikidata 和一个工业知识图谱上的六个基准中，EoG 始终优于基于提示、检索和智能体的方法，表明 LLM 图推理无需 QA 标注即可通过自博弈改进。代码可在原文所附的 HTTPS 链接获取。
