2610.33029.title: Lessons from Luck: Do LLM-Written Lessons Carry Chance into an Agent's Next Decision?
2610.33029.categories_text: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
2610.33029.abstract_en: Self-improving agents write lessons from the outcomes of their runs; when outcomes are noisy, a lesson can carry chance into later decisions. We measure one link of this chain in a registered study. In 256 synthetic worlds, each a recurring task with two interchangeable tools of recorded reliability, a scripted previous run used the more reliable tool (a good decision) or the less reliable one (a bad decision), with an assigned outcome: success or a transient failure. A model wrote a lesson from the run with ReasoningBank's memory-writing instruction; a fresh session of the same model, holding the authoritative log and the previous result, chose the next run's first tool with one memory item: that lesson, the lesson from the other outcome, an irrelevant item, or an unreasoned directive. The protocol was frozen, deposited and timestamped before any confirmatory call; 11 LLM endpoints gave 90,084 answers. After a chance failure of the better tool, the panel's lessons carried the chance (registered reading luck-carrying; interaction +0.112, 95% interval [+0.097, +0.126]): readers named the worse tool in 11.6% of next runs with the lesson written from that failure, against 0.4% with an irrelevant item and 0.4% with the lesson written from a success. The effect was +0.042 where the log stated that failures are independent and +0.181 where it did not (descriptive). After a lucky success of the worse tool, the interaction was bounded below 0.10 (+0.002), a bound, not evidence of no harm. In exploratory readings, 6 endpoints carried the chance (up to +0.352); 5 were bounded below 0.10. In secondary comparisons, a three-sentence decision-quality note in the writing instruction lowered the worse-tool rate after a chance failure to 7.5%, and one instruction for both outcomes with a no-change option to 3.1%; neither met the registered harm-reduction rule at every such endpoint.
2610.33029.update_target: Outcome-derived lesson text affecting a later tool-choice decision
2610.33029.mechanism_en: Registered synthetic worlds separate a good/bad prior decision from lucky/unlucky outcomes. Fresh same-model readers receive authoritative logs plus controlled lesson variants; matched contrasts test whether chance becomes guidance.
2610.33029.result_en: Across 90,084 answers, a chance failure of the better tool yields 11.6% worse-tool choices with its lesson versus 0.4% under irrelevant or success-derived memory; the registered interaction is +0.112.
2610.33029.boundary_en: This measures one memory-to-decision link, not end-to-end long-horizon RSI. A bounded effect is not proof of no harm; proposed writing fixes fail the registered harm-reduction rule at some endpoints.
2610.33029.abstract_zh: 自改进智能体根据运行结果撰写经验教训；当结果带有噪声时，一条经验可能把偶然因素带入后续决策。我们在一项注册研究中测量这条链条的一个环节。在 256 个合成世界中，每个世界都是一项反复执行的任务，含两个可互换且可靠性已有记录的工具。一个脚本化的先前运行使用更可靠工具（好决策）或较不可靠工具（坏决策），并被指定为成功或暂时失败。模型使用 ReasoningBank 的记忆撰写指令，根据这次运行写一条经验；同一模型的新会话持有权威日志及先前结果，并带着一个记忆项选择下一次运行的首个工具：该经验、另一结果下写出的经验、无关项，或无推理指令。协议在任何确认性调用之前便已冻结、存档并加上时间戳；11 个 LLM 端点共给出 90,084 个回答。在较好工具偶然失败后，整个端点组的经验携带了偶然因素（注册判读为“携带运气”；交互效应 +0.112，95% 区间 [+0.097, +0.126]）：使用根据该失败写出的经验时，读者在 11.6% 的后续运行中选择较差工具；使用无关项或根据成功写出的经验时，均为 0.4%。日志说明失败相互独立时，效应为 +0.042；未说明时为 +0.181（描述性结果）。较差工具侥幸成功后，交互效应被界定为低于 0.10（+0.002）；这是一个界限，不是没有危害的证据。在探索性判读中，6 个端点携带偶然因素（最高 +0.352），5 个被界定为低于 0.10。在次要比较中，撰写指令中加入三句话的决策质量说明，使较好工具偶然失败后的较差工具选择率降至 7.5%；对两种结果使用同一指令并提供“不改变”选项时，降至 3.1%；但两者都没有在每个此类端点上满足注册的减害规则。

2610.33528.title: SkillShift-Bench: Benchmarking Skill Learning under Environment Evolution for Web Agents
2610.33528.authors: Bo-Yu Chen , Zhi Zhou , Yu-Feng Li
2610.33528.abstract_en: Skill learning enables web agents to reuse prior experience for long-horizon interactive tasks. However, learned skills are typically evaluated in closed environments, overlooking the fact that real-world web deployment involves continuous shifts in invocation context, perceptual grounding, and execution feasibility. To this end, we introduce SkillShift-Bench, the first benchmark for evaluating skill learning with controlled open-environment shifts. SkillShift-Bench simulates Contextual Shift, Perceptual Shift, and Execution Shift across three self-hosted web systems, and evaluates agents with diagnostics covering task success, interaction cost, skill use, and skill failure. Comprehensive experiments reveal systematic robustness degradation under controlled shifts, characterized by lower success rates, higher interaction costs, and more frequent skill failures, with Execution Shift exerting the strongest pressure. We further formulate shifted skill execution as a nonstationary local executability problem and provide both a dynamic-regret analysis and a practical test-time adaptation method, demonstrating the feasibility of improving learned-skill execution without relearning the skill library. Code, tasks, environments, documentation, and the leaderboard are available at this https URL .
2610.33528.update_target: Evaluation of reusable web skills under contextual, perceptual and execution shifts
2610.33528.mechanism_en: Three self-hosted systems provide controlled environment changes, task/cost/skill-failure diagnostics, a dynamic-regret analysis and test-time execution adaptation without relearning the library.
2610.33528.result_en: Success degrades and costs/skill failures increase under shifts; execution shifts create the strongest pressure in the reported experiments.
2610.33528.boundary_en: Controlled shifts support robustness diagnosis rather than all real-world web drift. A local executability repair does not establish persistent skill-library evolution.
2610.33528.abstract_zh: 技能学习使网页智能体能够为长时程交互任务复用先前经验。然而，学习到的技能通常在封闭环境中评估，忽略真实网页部署中调用上下文、感知落地和执行可行性的持续变化。为此，我们提出 SkillShift-Bench，首个通过受控开放环境变化来评估技能学习的基准。SkillShift-Bench 在三个自托管网页系统中模拟上下文变化、感知变化和执行变化，并通过任务成功、交互成本、技能使用与技能失败等诊断指标评估智能体。综合实验揭示，受控变化下出现系统性稳健性退化，表现为成功率降低、交互成本上升，以及技能失败更频繁，其中执行变化施加的压力最强。我们进一步将变化后的技能执行表述为非平稳的局部可执行性问题，提供动态遗憾分析和实用的测试时适配方法，展示无需重新学习技能库，也能改善已学技能执行的可行性。代码、任务、环境、文档与排行榜可在原文所附的 HTTPS 链接获取。

2610.33624.title: RSI Arena: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement with Human Feedback
2610.33624.authors: Yue Huang , Yanbo Wang , Lichi Li , Yuanyuan Chen , Andreas Haupt , Xiaonan Luo , Zheyuan Liu , Jihye Choi , Felix Juefei-Xu , Xiangliang Zhang , Radha Poovendran , Misha Sra , Ying Liu , Ben Burtenshaw , Thomas Wolf , Alex Pentland , Zichen Chen , Zhangchen Xu
2610.33624.abstract_en: Can AI agents autonomously train useful language models and improve them using feedback from users? We introduce RSI Arena, a two-stage study of autonomous post-training as a step toward recursive self-improvement. Ten frontier models act as training agents, each starting from NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B Base. During a six-day first stage, each agent has 1,000 GPU-hours and $300 in API credit on a shared 64-GPU cluster, independently selecting data, implementing training procedures, and choosing checkpoints. We evaluate their models on 20 benchmarks and through blind human evaluations. All ten agents produce working assistants, with the strongest model, trained by GPT-6 Astra, closing a median of 76% of the base-to-Instruct gap across 12 capability benchmarks. Its human-preference rating is also close to NVIDIA Instruct after statistical adjustment for answer length and formatting. In Stage 2, each agent receives the comparison records and votes involving its Stage 1 model and is given three additional days for further training. Using NVIDIA Instruct as a common reference across the two evaluation rounds, we observe an improvement from Stage 1 to Stage 2 in the style-adjusted relative rating of eight of the ten models. We show that benchmark gains were modest, with no clear link to preference gains, while some agents encouraged longer responses and one model showed increased harmful compliance on StrongREJECT. RSI Arena provides an auditable setting for studying how human feedback can guide autonomous model development. It takes a step toward recursive self-improvement with human feedback (RSIHF), in which people help define what improvement means for the AI systems they use.
2610.33624.update_target: Agent-designed post-training data, training code and model checkpoints, with second-stage human feedback
2610.33624.mechanism_en: Ten agents train a common base model, receive votes/comparison records on their own first-stage output and train again. A common reference and style-adjusted human ratings compare stages.
2610.33624.result_en: The best stage-one system closes a median 76% of the base-to-Instruct gap across 12 capability tests. Eight of ten improve style-adjusted relative ratings after feedback, with modest benchmark gains.
2610.33624.boundary_en: Each first-stage agent gets 1,000 GPU-hours and $300 API credit; this is not a low-compute recipe. Preference, benchmark and safety gains diverge, and stronger human ratings do not certify a self-improving successor.
2610.33624.abstract_zh: AI 智能体能否自主训练有用的语言模型，并利用用户反馈改进它们？我们提出 RSI Arena，一项关于自主后训练的两阶段研究，作为迈向递归自改进的一步。十个前沿模型充当训练智能体，每个都从 NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B Base 开始。在为期六天的第一阶段，每个智能体在共享的 64 GPU 集群上拥有 1,000 GPU 小时和 300 美元 API 额度，独立选择数据、实现训练流程并选择检查点。我们通过 20 个基准和盲测人工评估检验所得模型。十个智能体都产出可工作的助手，其中 GPT-6 Astra 训练的最强模型在 12 个能力基准上，弥合了基座模型到 Instruct 模型差距的中位数 76%。在对回答长度和格式进行统计调整后，其人类偏好评分也接近 NVIDIA Instruct。在第二阶段，每个智能体收到涉及自己第一阶段模型的比较记录和投票，再获得三天进行进一步训练。使用 NVIDIA Instruct 作为两轮评估的共同参照，我们观察到十个模型中有八个，其风格调整后的相对评分从第一阶段到第二阶段有所提升。我们表明，基准增益有限，与偏好增益没有明确联系；一些智能体鼓励更长回答，一个模型在 StrongREJECT 上表现出更高的有害顺从性。RSI Arena 为研究人类反馈如何指导自主模型开发提供了可审计设置。它向基于人类反馈的递归自改进（RSIHF）迈出一步，让人们参与定义他们所使用 AI 系统的“改进”意味着什么。

2610.33956.title: Continual Learning Exam: Benchmarking Long-Horizon RSI and Experiential Learning in LLM Agents
2610.33956.authors: Haoyu Zhao , Sitian Tu , Yuxuan Huang , Huichi Zhou , Zhangyue Yin , Jiahao Huang , Jingyuan Xu , Tianmiao Shi , Jin Shi , Nianxi Zhang , Yangmiao Zhang , Zhuolang Chan , Huiyan Hu , Chenchao Sheng , Yaqing Luo , Yue Chen , Huaxiu Yao , Meng Fang , Jun Wang
2610.33956.categories_text: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
2610.33956.abstract_en: Continual learning is the ability of LLM agents to improve over time by acquiring, refining, and applying knowledge from experience while retaining useful prior knowledge. It is essential for agents learning over long time horizons, yet current evaluations largely assess individual task performance rather than improvement through accumulated experience. We introduce Continual Learning Exam (CLE), a large-scale benchmark developed by 50+ domain experts to measure experience-driven improvement in realistic professional workflows. CLE comprises 120 human-authored tasks, each organised as a five-level ladder, yielding 600 levels spanning 89 professional roles across 12 occupational domains. Agents must pass each level to unlock the next, with later levels building on experience accumulated during earlier assignments. An evaluation agent assesses each submission against human-authored rubrics. We compare a single-submission setting with one that provides diagnostic feedback after failure and allows one revision. Across 17 harness-model configurations using frontier LLMs, feedback and revision yield a median completion gain of 5.3 percentage points. Yet the best-performing system clears only 47.7% of levels and completes all five levels in just 23.3% of tasks, highlighting the difficulty of sustained learning from experience for existing frontier LLMs. As such, the dataset can also be used to post-train LLMs to strengthen their continual learning capabilities.
2610.33956.affiliation: University College London; University of Liverpool; Imperial College London; University of Electronic Science and Technology of China; Peking University; University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
2610.33956.update_target: Evaluation of experience reuse across five-level professional-task ladders
2610.33956.mechanism_en: Passing a level unlocks the next; an evaluator applies human-authored rubrics. A second setting permits diagnostic failure feedback and one revision, enabling comparison of accumulated experience and feedback access.
2610.33956.result_en: CLE has 120 tasks/600 levels across 89 roles and 12 domains. Median feedback gain is 5.3 points; the best configuration passes 47.7% of levels and all levels of 23.3% of tasks.
2610.33956.boundary_en: Ladder completion and a one-revision gain do not isolate persistent learning from context, feedback or selection. Judge reliability and unlocked-task exposure matter; no independent continual-learning experiment was run here.
2610.33956.abstract_zh: 持续学习是 LLM 智能体通过获取、完善和应用经验知识，并保留有用旧知识，随时间不断改进的能力。这对长时程学习的智能体至关重要，但当前评估大多测量单项任务表现，而非经验积累带来的改进。我们提出 Continual Learning Exam（CLE），一个由 50 多位领域专家开发的大规模基准，用于测量真实专业工作流中的经验驱动改进。CLE 包含 120 个由人类编写的任务，每项组织为五级阶梯，共 600 个等级，涵盖 12 个职业领域中的 89 种专业角色。智能体必须通过当前等级才能解锁下一级，后续等级以先前任务积累的经验为基础。评估智能体依据人工编写的评分细则评估每次提交。我们比较单次提交设置与失败后提供诊断反馈并允许修订一次的设置。在使用前沿 LLM 的 17 种运行框架—模型配置中，反馈和修订带来中位数 5.3 个百分点的完成率提升。然而，最佳系统也只能通过 47.7% 的等级，仅在 23.3% 的任务中完成全部五级，凸显现有前沿 LLM 从经验中持续学习的困难。因此，该数据集也可用于 LLM 后训练，以增强持续学习能力。

2610.34073.title: Memory Tax: Dissecting the Net Value of Agent Memory
2610.34073.authors: Xuan He , Sining Zhoubian , Ruozhen Yang , Yuhao Wen , Zhineng Wang , Yuyang Hu , Ke Yang , Yuyu Zhang , Ping Nie , Jiawei Han , ChengXiang Zhai
2610.34073.abstract_en: Memory is increasingly used in long-horizon agents, yet the net value of building memory over direct retrieval from raw history remains largely unclear. Through a large-scale evaluation across multiple benchmarks and model backbones, we find many dedicated memory systems underperform naive RAG in many cases, indicating a negative net value. Taking RAG as a reference, we dissect the net value of memory into the gains and losses over direct retrieval, termed memory benefit and memory tax. These gains and losses arise because memory process changes how the raw information is organized and accessed. We view such changes as the double-edged deviations from the raw history. They are originally designed and introduced to benefit the task, for example by reorganizing facts or distilling preferences, but some may also remove or obscure evidence, giving rise to memory tax. Since memory benefit reflects the expected gains of its design, we then focus more on the overlooked memory tax, study how it arises from the system and evaluation side, and generalize the concept to more application scenarios of memory. We hope the notion of memory tax can provide a new lens and shift more attention from standalone performance to the net value of memory, informing more reliable memory designs and evaluations. We will open-source the code and results to the community. Project Page: this https URL
2610.34073.affiliation: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign; Tsinghua University; Renmin University of China; Verdent.ai; University of Waterloo
2610.34073.update_target: Evaluation of net memory value relative to retrieval from raw history
2610.34073.mechanism_en: The analysis separates memory benefit from memory tax: reorganization can help but may erase or obscure evidence. A naive RAG reference tests whether memory processing actually adds value.
2610.34073.result_en: Across multiple benchmarks/backbones, many dedicated memory systems underperform naive RAG in many cases; the abstract does not report one universal deficit.
2610.34073.boundary_en: This is not evidence that all memory is harmful. Retrieval budgets, corpus visibility, construction costs and benchmark design determine the relevant comparison.
2610.34073.abstract_zh: 记忆越来越多地用于长时程智能体，但构建记忆相对于直接从原始历史检索的净价值，仍很不明确。通过跨多个基准和骨干模型的大规模评估，我们发现，许多专门记忆系统在不少情况下不如朴素 RAG，意味着净价值为负。以 RAG 为参照，我们将记忆净价值分解为相对于直接检索的收益和损失，分别称为记忆收益与记忆税。产生这些收益和损失，是因为记忆处理改变了原始信息的组织和访问方式。我们将这些变化视为偏离原始历史的双刃剑。这些偏离原本为帮助任务而设计，例如重新组织事实或提炼偏好，但有些也会移除或遮蔽证据，产生记忆税。由于记忆收益反映其设计的预期增益，我们进一步聚焦被忽视的记忆税，研究它如何从系统侧和评估侧产生，并将概念推广到更多记忆应用场景。我们希望记忆税能提供新视角，将更多注意力从孤立性能转向记忆净价值，为更可靠的记忆设计与评估提供指导。我们将向社区开源代码和结果。项目页面见原文所附的 HTTPS 链接。

2610.34386.title: ParetoRSI-Gym: Can AI Agents Improve Language Models Across Multiple Domains?
2610.34386.authors: Haojin Wang , Yangzhen Wu , Zeyi Chen , Jian Xie , Jiaying Ye , Lili Meng , Shuyun Tang , Shangding Gu , Dawn Song
2610.34386.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires an agentic system to design, train, and evaluate its own successor. Data-driven post-training is a central part of that loop, yet existing evaluations measure it on a single benchmark, where an agent selects from a static pool or distills a stronger model to push one score up in one run. Real post-training is multi-domain, and a gain in one domain has to be weighed against a regression in another. We propose ParetoRSI-Gym, in which an agent searches for data, curates it, trains, reads back per-domain results, and repeats, with everything but the data held fixed: the initial LLM, the five domains (math, code, finance, medicine, science), the toolset, and the SFT pipeline. Generalization benchmarks in each domain separate capability gains from overfitting to the scores the agent optimizes against. Across three agent systems, three base models, five rounds and multiple seeds, the strongest system, Claude Code with Opus-5, raises the generalization scores of its proxy-best checkpoint by 9.2% relative to the starting model (+2.3 absolute points), averaged with equal weight over three base models and five domains, with a single-domain relative gain of up to 63% (medicine on Ministral-3-3B). Further analysis shows that the harness matters as much as the model it drives, and that each agent keeps a unique data selection strategy. We see our work as a step towards evaluation of RSI systems in real-world machine learning engineering.
2610.34386.affiliation: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign; University of California, Berkeley; The Ohio State University; University of Washington; Google
2610.34386.update_target: Multi-domain data-curation and post-training loop; fixed base models, tools, domains and SFT pipeline
2610.34386.mechanism_en: Agents search/curate data, train and read five-domain proxy results over five rounds. Hidden generalization benchmarks assess proxy-best checkpoints and domain tradeoffs.
2610.34386.result_en: The strongest system raises equal-weight generalization scores by 9.2% relative (+2.3 absolute points) across three base models and five domains; the largest single-domain relative gain is 63%.
2610.34386.boundary_en: A best checkpoint selected by proxy differs from best hidden-test selection. LoRA/model training changes weights even when the data is the only agent-controlled variable; benchmark files are not yet in the release.
2610.34386.abstract_zh: 递归自改进（RSI）要求智能体系统设计、训练和评估自己的后继系统。数据驱动的后训练是这一循环的核心部分，但现有评估通常只测量单个基准：智能体从静态池中选择数据，或蒸馏更强模型，在一次运行中提升一个分数。真实后训练涉及多个领域，一个领域的增益必须与另一个领域的退化权衡。我们提出 ParetoRSI-Gym，智能体在其中搜索数据、整理数据、训练、读取各领域结果并重复；除数据之外，一切保持固定：初始 LLM、五个领域（数学、代码、金融、医学、科学）、工具集和 SFT 流水线。每个领域的泛化基准将能力提升与对智能体所优化分数的过拟合区分开。在三个智能体系统、三个基础模型、五轮和多个随机种子的实验中，最强系统 Claude Code 配合 Opus-5，使其代理分数最佳检查点的泛化分数相对于初始模型提高 9.2%（绝对增加 2.3 个点），该平均值对三个基础模型及五个领域等权计算；单领域相对增益最高达 63%（Ministral-3-3B 的医学领域）。进一步分析表明，运行框架与其驱动的模型同样重要，每个智能体也保持独特的数据选择策略。我们将本工作视为迈向真实机器学习工程中 RSI 系统评估的一步。

2610.34577.title: Rethinking Verification in Agent Harnesses
2610.34577.authors: Zhengxin Zhang , Erkang Zhu , Yin Lin , Claire Cardie , Bolin Ding , Jingren Zhou
2610.34577.abstract_en: Agent harnesses enable large language models to act through tools, observe the results, and iteratively work toward a task goal. Verification checks and revises agents' work to improve output quality. Yet there is limited guidance on how harnesses should organize this effort. We study verification as an axis of test-time scaling by examining when to intervene, who checks the work, and how checking leads to revision. Our framework spans four layers of the agent lifecycle: initial instructions, mid-turn reminders, completion gates, and independent review. We compare 17 designs across seven frontier coding models on Terminal-Bench (TB) and SWE-bench Verified (SWE), and introduce VisualBench for expert evaluation of visual and interactive artifacts. Initial instructions and execution-time reminders yield modest, model-dependent average gains on the coding benchmarks, without substantially increasing average output token use. Completion gates can yield larger gains but may substantially increase cost. Independent review by a critic offers a more favorable accuracy-cost tradeoff, improving average accuracy by 5.9-9.5 percentage points on TB and 3.9-6.6 on SWE at 1.13-1.25 and 1.00-1.04 times baseline cost, respectively. On VisualBench, independent review achieves net preferences of 13.2-23.8 points over the baseline across its four designs, exceeding the evaluated L0-L2 designs. Additional review rounds or independent critics further improve average TB accuracy by up to 3.5 percentage points. Together, these results provide empirical guidance for verification design in agent harnesses and support independent review as a practical axis of test-time scaling.
2610.34577.update_target: Task-local verification/revision effort across four harness lifecycle layers
2610.34577.mechanism_en: Seventeen designs vary instructions, reminders, completion gates and independent review. Matched coding tests and expert visual judgments compare accuracy with cost rather than presuming more checking helps.
2610.34577.result_en: Independent review gains 5.9–9.5 points on TB and 3.9–6.6 on SWE, at 1.13–1.25× and 1.00–1.04× baseline cost; VisualBench also favors it.
2610.34577.boundary_en: Test-time revision is not persistent self-improvement unless its lessons are retained and validated on later tasks. Gains and review costs vary by model and benchmark.
2610.34577.abstract_zh: 智能体运行框架使大语言模型能够通过工具行动、观察结果，并迭代推进任务目标。验证通过检查和修订智能体工作来改善输出质量。但对于运行框架应如何组织这种努力，目前指导有限。我们从何时介入、由谁检查，以及检查如何引发修订三个方面，研究将验证作为测试时扩展轴。我们的框架覆盖智能体生命周期的四层：初始指令、回合中提醒、完成关卡和独立审查。我们在 Terminal-Bench（TB）和 SWE-bench Verified（SWE）上，跨七个前沿编码模型比较 17 种设计，并引入 VisualBench，用于专家评估视觉和交互产物。初始指令与执行时提醒在编码基准上带来适中且依赖模型的平均收益，没有大幅增加平均输出 token 用量。完成关卡可能带来更大增益，但也可能显著增加成本。由批评者进行独立审查，具有更有利的准确率—成本权衡：在 TB 上平均准确率提高 5.9—9.5 个百分点，成本为基线的 1.13—1.25 倍；在 SWE 上提高 3.9—6.6 个百分点，成本为 1.00—1.04 倍。在 VisualBench 上，独立审查的四种设计相对基线取得 13.2—23.8 个点的净偏好，超过被评估的 L0—L2 设计。更多审查轮次或独立批评者，可进一步将 TB 平均准确率最多提高 3.5 个百分点。综合来看，结果为运行框架的验证设计提供了实证指导，并支持将独立审查作为实用的测试时扩展轴。

2610.34634.title: AgentProofBench: Benchmarking Reusable Verifiers for Web Agents
2610.34634.authors: Jingjie Ning , Xueqi Li , Yi Lu , Yibo Kong
2610.34634.categories_text: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
2610.34634.abstract_en: Reusable Web-agent verification requires a rule to follow changing requirements and support subsequent execution. We introduce AgentProofBench, which connects paired tests of a frozen acceptance rule to execution from identical saved openings. The resource spans 97 tasks, 79 families, and four Web services. Experiments with DeepSeek Flash/Pro establish two linked measurements. Across 48 families, complete-panel and decision-replay tests retain 82/96 Flash and 79/96 Pro source programs; paired reuse-rebuild BA intervals are [-5.47, 1.57] and [-10.16, 0.00] percentage points. Across 22 execution families, deployment-state panel correctness separates program assignments whose two saved openings are both delivered correctly: 32/33 assignments with error-free panels, versus 1/11 with panel errors. All reference-defined program-gate regressions and withheld deliveries occur in the latter group. Neutral continuation attains the highest correct delivery under the tested generic feedback, providing a concrete baseline for measuring the value added by a gate. Released instructions, states, programs, reference rules, and trajectories connect each test failure to its execution consequences. AgentProofBench makes reusable verification assessable at both the requirement and policy levels.
2610.34634.update_target: Frozen reusable acceptance programs tested against changed requirements and subsequent policy execution
2610.34634.mechanism_en: Paired program panels and decision replay are linked to fresh execution from identical saved openings. Neutral continuation tests whether a gate adds value over simply letting the agent proceed.
2610.34634.result_en: Across 22 execution families, both openings are delivered correctly for 32/33 assignments with error-free panels versus 1/11 with panel errors; all reported reference-defined regressions lie in the latter group.
2610.34634.boundary_en: Verifier reuse is a hypothesis, not a certificate. Program correctness and delivery correctness are distinct units; associations across the tested assignments are not universal causal guarantees.
2610.34634.abstract_zh: 可复用网页智能体验证，需要规则能够适应需求变化，并支持后续执行。我们提出 AgentProofBench，将对冻结验收规则的配对测试，与从相同保存起点开始的执行联系起来。该资源包含 97 个任务、79 个任务族和四个网页服务。使用 DeepSeek Flash/Pro 的实验建立了两项相连的测量。在 48 个任务族中，完整面板测试和决策重放测试分别保留了 Flash 的 82/96 个与 Pro 的 79/96 个源程序；复用相对重建的配对平衡准确率（BA）区间分别为 [-5.47, 1.57] 与 [-10.16, 0.00] 个百分点。在 22 个执行任务族中，部署状态面板正确性能够区分两种保存起点都被正确交付的程序分配：面板无错误时为 32/33，而面板有错误时为 1/11。所有由参考规则定义的程序关卡退化与未交付，都发生在后一组。在被测试的通用反馈下，中性继续执行获得最高正确交付率，为测量关卡增加的价值提供了具体基线。发布的指令、状态、程序、参考规则和轨迹，把每次测试失败与其执行后果联系起来。AgentProofBench 使可复用验证能够同时在需求和策略层面接受评估。

2610.34767.title: The Right Fact, the Wrong Decision: SciValidityBench for Scientific Agent Memory
2610.34767.abstract_en: Most agent-memory benchmarks frame long-term memory as retrieval: can an agent recover the relevant record from a long and evolving history? Scientific agents face a stricter problem: a correctly remembered fact may still be invalid to use. The same reported test result can support confirmation when the outcome and stopping rule were fixed in advance, yet only exploration when the outcome was selected from twenty inspected results. We call this scientific use validity: whether remembered evidence is eligible to influence a decision under the state governing its interpretation. We introduce SciValidityBench, an executable benchmark factory with 64 TaskSpecs spanning five validity modules and six scientific domains. TaskSpecs couple generated experimental histories with scientific-state definitions, programmatic decision oracles, controlled interventions, and automatic scoring. The SciStateForge compiler-reader framework turns distributed histories into explicit decision-governing state. Counterfactual pairs and targeted corruption-repair controls then test whether models use those dependencies and localize failures. Across four model families, compiled scientific state improves valid decision-making by 9.2-18.8 percentage points over a generic Event Graph. Retrieval alone does not reproduce this cross-family gain, while content-identical flat and typed views show that the improvement comes from exposing governing state rather than a particular graph serialization. SciValidityBench thus shifts memory evaluation from finding the right fact to deciding whether that fact should control the decision.
2610.34767.affiliation: Tsinghua University; University of Science and Technology of China
2610.34767.mechanism_en: An executable factory creates histories, deterministic oracles and controlled counterfactual/repair tests. State compilation exposes dependencies such as selection and stopping rules before evidence is used.
2610.34767.result_en: Across four model families, compiled scientific state improves valid decisions by 9.2–18.8 points over a generic Event Graph; content-identical flat/typed controls isolate state exposure.
2610.34767.boundary_en: Correct retrieval can still license an invalid inference. These are synthetic scientific-state tests, not a validation of autonomous discoveries in laboratories.
2610.34767.abstract_zh: 多数智能体记忆基准将长期记忆表述为检索：智能体能否从漫长且持续变化的历史中恢复相关记录？科学智能体面临更严格的问题：正确记住的事实仍可能不适合使用。同一个报告的检验结果，如果结局和停止规则事先固定，可以支持确认；但若结局从已查看的二十个结果中挑选，就只能支持探索。我们称之为科学使用有效性：在支配其解释的状态下，记住的证据是否有资格影响决策。我们提出 SciValidityBench，一个可执行的基准工厂，包含跨五个有效性模块和六个科学领域的 64 个 TaskSpec。TaskSpec 将生成的实验历史与科学状态定义、程序化决策判定器、受控干预和自动评分相结合。SciStateForge 编译器—读取器框架将分散历史转化为显式的决策支配状态。反事实配对和定向破坏—修复对照随后测试模型是否利用这些依赖，并定位失败。跨四个模型家族，编译的科学状态相对通用事件图，使有效决策提高 9.2—18.8 个百分点。单靠检索不能复现这一跨家族增益，而内容相同的平面与带类型视图表明，改进来自暴露支配状态，而非某种特定图序列化。因此，SciValidityBench 将记忆评估从找到正确事实，转向决定该事实是否应该控制决策。

2610.34938.title: How Do Coding-Agent Harnesses Self-Evolve? An Empirical Study of Retrospective Adaptation
2610.34938.abstract_en: Coding agents can adapt their harnesses, the software, configuration, and instructions used to run them, based on experience from earlier tasks, but whether these adaptations improve their behavior on later tasks remains unclear. We study \retro, a skill that asks an agent to review a completed session and propose harness changes, and ask what changes it proposes and whether implemented changes reduce repeated work on later tasks. We ran Claude Code on 30 SWE-bench Verified issues, qualitatively coded the 125 proposals from \retro, implemented 24, and evaluated 12 harness changes on later issues from the same repositories in fresh sessions with and without each change. Most proposals referred to an event in the session, but 18 of 43 lint-related proposals recommended a practice regardless of what had happened. Among the seven evaluations in which sessions without the change encountered the targeted problem, two changes eliminated the targeted action, one reduced its occurrence, four showed no reduction, and some changes added work on unrelated issues. Harness self-evolution requires more than generating and implementing changes: it needs ways to establish whether a change helps on later tasks and to revise or remove changes that do not.
2610.34938.update_target: Evaluation of retrospective coding-harness proposals and their later-task effects
2610.34938.mechanism_en: Thirty sessions produce 125 proposals; 24 are implemented and 12 changes tested on later same-repository issues in fresh sessions with/without the change. Recurrence and actual consultation are measured.
2610.34938.result_en: Of seven informative evaluations, two changes eliminate targeted work, one reduces it and four do not; some add work on unrelated issues.
2610.34938.boundary_en: A proposal count is not a learning gain. Targeted issue selection, small samples and one agent/version limit inference; the method needs continued validation and retirement of stale changes.
2610.34938.abstract_zh: 编码智能体能够根据先前任务经验，适配其运行框架，即运行它们的软件、配置和指令，但这些适配是否改善后续任务中的行为仍不明确。我们研究 /retro这一技能，它要求智能体回顾已完成会话并提出运行框架改动；我们考察它提出什么改动，以及实施后能否减少后续任务中的重复工作。我们在 30 个 SWE-bench Verified 问题上运行 Claude Code，对 /retro 产生的 125 个提案进行定性编码，实施 24 个，并在相同仓库的后续问题上，通过有改动与无改动的全新会话评估 12 个框架改动。多数提案提及会话中的某个事件，但 43 个 lint 相关提案中有 18 个，无论实际发生什么都推荐同一做法。在无改动会话遇到目标问题的七项评估中，两项改动消除了目标行动，一项降低其出现次数，四项没有减少，而一些改动还给无关问题增加了工作。运行框架自进化不只是生成并实施改动：还需要建立方法，判断改动是否帮助后续任务，并修订或移除无效改动。

2610.35193.title: Trustworthy Recursive Self-Improvement in the Era of Large Models: Foundation, Risks, Evaluation and Open Challenges
2610.35193.authors: Jiayue Pu , Ang Gao , Jinyi Bai , Qipeng Wang , Tongyu Wen , Jiahao Zhao , Keyu Qu , Junhao Zhang , Chenglei Shen , Zhongxiang Sun , Jun Xu , Xiao Zhang
2610.35193.abstract_en: AI systems built around large models increasingly use experience and feedback to make persistent changes to models, prompts, memories, tools, and workflows. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) extends this process to inductive biases and to the mechanisms that govern future updates, which can themselves be revised and reused across improvement cycles. Yet self-modification alone does not guarantee trustworthy improvement. Reported gains may reflect flawed evaluations, previously acquired capabilities may deteriorate, and compliance with behavioral constraints may weaken. Compromised artifacts or sensitive information may also persist in successor systems. Changes to improvement mechanisms may invalidate earlier verification results and make human oversight less effective. This survey presents an operational definition and process framework for RSI and organizes the requirements for trustworthy RSI into four interconnected themes: genuine and sustained improvement; behavioral constraints, alignment, and fairness; system security and privacy; and transparency and controllability. We examine these themes from three perspectives: Improvement Validity, Constraint Preservation, and Effective Oversight. This analysis covers improvement diagnosis, proposal generation, proposal evaluation, and update implementation (S1--S4), including the recursive application of these stages to improvement mechanisms (RI). We review risks, safeguards, and evaluation evidence for individual updates, effects inherited by successor systems, and revisions to improvement mechanisms, while distinguishing direct RSI findings from evidence in related systems. Finally, we examine evaluation settings, identify requirements for independent and longitudinal assessment, and discuss applications and open research problems.
2610.35193.affiliation: Renmin University of China; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
2610.35193.update_target: Conceptual evaluation of persistent updates and revisions to improvement mechanisms
2610.35193.mechanism_en: The survey separates diagnosis, proposal, evaluation and implementation, plus recursion over those stages. Improvement validity, constraint preservation and effective oversight organize longitudinal evidence requirements.
2610.35193.result_en: The contribution is an operational framework and synthesis of risks/safeguards; it is not a new controlled experiment showing sustained RSI.
2610.35193.boundary_en: Direct RSI evidence is distinguished from adjacent systems. Definitions and process diagrams do not certify a specific system’s reliability or repair an invalid evaluator.
2610.35193.abstract_zh: 围绕大模型构建的 AI 系统，越来越多地利用经验与反馈，对模型、提示词、记忆、工具和工作流作出持久改变。递归自改进（RSI）将这一过程扩展至归纳偏置，以及支配未来更新的机制；这些机制本身也能跨改进周期修订和复用。但自修改本身不保证可信改进。报告的增益可能反映有缺陷的评估，先前获得的能力可能退化，对行为约束的遵守也可能减弱。受损产物或敏感信息还可能在后继系统中持续存在。改进机制的变化可能使先前验证结果失效，也可能削弱人类监督。这篇综述提出 RSI 的操作性定义与流程框架，将可信 RSI 要求组织为四个相互关联主题：真实且持续的改进；行为约束、对齐与公平；系统安全与隐私；透明度与可控性。我们从改进有效性、约束保持和有效监督三个视角考察这些主题。分析涵盖改进诊断、提案生成、提案评估与更新实施（S1—S4），以及这些阶段对改进机制的递归应用（RI）。我们回顾单次更新、后继系统继承效应，以及改进机制修订中的风险、防护与评估证据，同时区分直接 RSI 发现和相关系统证据。最后，我们考察评估设置，识别独立与纵向评估的要求，并讨论应用和开放研究问题。

2610.35215.title: SkillLifeBench: Benchmarking Security Across the Lifecycle of Agent Skills
2610.35215.authors: Chenxu Zhang , Zhou Liu , Wu Xin , Wentao Zhang
2610.35215.abstract_en: Web agents reuse skills whose stored code, selected version, and loaded implementation can diverge across tasks and updates. SkillLifeBench links these states to task outcomes in 388 paired scenarios spanning implementation, interface, runtime, composition, and version changes. We evaluate 14 models on two paired decision tracks: 89 runtime tasks and 60 autonomous lifecycle tasks spanning 12 templates derived from introduced cases. Lifecycle tasks allow agents to inspect, select, and reconfigure skills while completing verifiable user requests. Joint success requires task completion without the registered attack goal. GPT-5.6-Sol and Sonnet 4.6 both achieve 82.0% on runtime tasks, but reach 96.7% and 56.7% on lifecycle tasks. Across lifecycle evaluations, challenged task success is 77.5%, while joint success is 65.2%; 103 runs complete the task and the attack goal. Adding execution provenance in a matched recovery study raises utility joint success from 49.35% with logs and metadata to 65.58%. A deterministic execution-consistency rule reaches 64.94% with higher benign utility, while full restoration reaches 69.48%. Lifecycle tasks distinguish models with similar runtime scores, and execution evidence improves recovery.
2610.35215.update_target: Skill lifecycle state: stored code, selected version and loaded implementation
2610.35215.mechanism_en: Paired runtime/lifecycle tasks couple executable requests with registered attack goals; recovery interventions test provenance and deterministic execution consistency.
2610.35215.result_en: Across lifecycle evaluations, challenged task success is 77.5% but joint success 65.2%; execution provenance raises recovery joint success from 49.35% to 65.58%.
2610.35215.boundary_en: Task completion alone can coexist with an attack. The 388 source scenarios, 89 runtime tasks and 60 lifecycle tasks are different units; summarize security outcomes without operational attack instructions.
2610.35215.abstract_zh: 网页智能体复用技能时，所存代码、所选版本和实际加载实现可能在任务与更新之间发生分歧。SkillLifeBench 在 388 个配对场景中，将这些状态与任务结果联系起来，场景覆盖实现、接口、运行时、组合和版本变化。我们在两个配对决策轨道上评估 14 个模型：89 个运行时任务，以及 60 个自主生命周期任务，后者跨越根据引入案例构建的 12 个模板。生命周期任务允许智能体在完成可验证用户请求的同时，检查、选择和重新配置技能。联合成功要求完成任务，且不达成注册的攻击目标。GPT-5.6-Sol 和 Sonnet 4.6 在运行时任务上都达到 82.0%，但在生命周期任务上分别为 96.7% 和 56.7%。跨生命周期评估，受挑战任务成功率为 77.5%，联合成功率为 65.2%；103 次运行同时完成任务与攻击目标。在匹配恢复研究中，加入执行来源证据，使效用联合成功率从仅有日志与元数据时的 49.35% 提高到 65.58%。一个确定性执行一致性规则达到 64.94%，且正常任务效用更高；完全恢复达到 69.48%。生命周期任务能够区分运行时得分相近的模型，而执行证据能改善恢复。

2610.35579.title: Infinity Machine: a self-improving AI agent for research
2610.35579.abstract_en: We present the Infinity Machine, a self-improving AI agent that we use for research on problems whose answers aprogram or data can check. Each candidate solution is produced by a full tool-using agent that works for up to an hour in a fresh sandbox; proposers see only a public score, and a private split decides what counts. The harness itself(prompts, tools, skills, playbook, meta agent) is an editable genome, changed only through a kernel-enforced gate with held-out and cost checks. An autonomous mode goes from a plain-text goal to a verified report with no human step: an agent picks an open problem and writes its verifier, the kernel calibrates it, an adversarial agent audits it, and an agent that never sees the verifier re-checks the result. Across fourteen problems in six days, for about $180 of model usage, the system produced four results beyond the published state of the art on catalogued open problems in quantum information: a certified depolarizing-channel threshold point p = 0.064966, a qutrit positivity frontier of 0.2910672, a 44-gate depth-6 Golay state preparation, and a stabilizer-rank bound chi(T^7) <= 10. It also cut SABRE qubit-routing overhead from 68,559 to 12,087 added gates. In hardware, it cut the energy per MAC of an open 8x8 INT8 systolic tile by 77.7% through a full open RTL-to-GDS flow, bit-exact. Three fully autonomous runs ended in honestties with public records; one audit caught a stale record, and one agent-written score pointing the wrong way went unnoticed. We report the failures as carefully: the one self-derived harness generation was rejected on cost, proposers gamed lenient scorers four times, and operator changes were decisive for several results.
2610.35579.update_target: Editable research-agent genome behind an immutable evaluation/cost kernel
2610.35579.mechanism_en: Fresh sandbox proposers see public scores, while private checks gate genome changes. Autonomous verifier construction adds calibration, adversarial auditing and a separate rechecker.
2610.35579.result_en: The authors report computational and hardware-design advances at about $180 model usage, but the one self-derived harness generation is rejected on cost; scorer gaming and decisive operator changes are explicitly reported.
2610.35579.boundary_en: Better research artifacts do not prove improved self-improvement. $180 is model usage, not full compute/labor cost; hardware energy comes from an RTL-to-GDS design flow, not fabricated-chip measurement.
2610.35579.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Infinity Machine，一个自改进 AI 智能体，用于研究答案可由程序或数据检查的问题。每个候选解都由完整的工具使用智能体产生，在全新沙箱中工作最多一小时；提案者只能看到公开得分，由私有划分决定哪些结果有效。运行框架本身（提示词、工具、技能、行动手册、元智能体）是可编辑基因组，只有通过内核强制执行的留出集与成本检查关卡才能改变。一个自主模式可从纯文本目标推进到经验证报告，无需人类步骤：智能体挑选开放问题并编写验证器，内核校准它，对抗智能体审计它，另一个从未见过验证器的智能体重新检查结果。在六天的十四个问题上，系统使用约 180 美元模型调用，在已编目的量子信息开放问题中得到四项超越已发表最佳结果的成果：经认证的退极化信道阈值点 p = 0.064966、三能级量子系统的正性前沿 0.2910672、44 门且深度为 6 的 Golay 态制备，以及稳定子秩上界 χ(T⁷) ≤ 10。它还将 SABRE 量子比特路由的额外门数从 68,559 降至 12,087。在硬件方面，它通过完整开放的 RTL 到 GDS 流程，在保持逐比特精确的条件下，将一个开放 8×8 INT8 脉动阵列单元的每 MAC 能耗降低 77.7%。三次完全自主运行最终诚实地与公开纪录持平；一次审计发现了过时纪录，而一个智能体写出的评分方向错误未被察觉。我们同样仔细报告失败：唯一自行推导的运行框架代际因成本被拒绝，提案者四次钻宽松评分器的空子，而且操作者改动对数项结果起了决定性作用。

2610.35604.title: RoboDoctor: Training-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Robot Policies
2610.35604.authors: Heyang Yu , Haomin Li , Sihang Li , Jixin Yan , Shiyun Peng , Wanqi Zhong , Tianyu Xin , Yuan Yao , Xiaoyu Tian , Yiming Li
2610.35604.categories_text: Robotics (cs.RO) ; Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
2610.35604.abstract_en: Generalist robot policies and language-model agents provide complementary capabilities, but completing a task also requires adapting their use to the consequences of physical interaction. We study execution as a locus of adaptation: feedback guides the current action and supplies evidence for revising subsequent decisions under fixed model weights. We introduce RoboDoctor, a training-free framework that connects diagnosis, grounded action, and persistent experience across three revision targets. The harness allocates control between policy and agent; intervention determines when to assist while preserving useful policy behavior; and operation refines physical methods through observed effects. Linked experience records retain the reason for a decision, the attempted method, its outcome, and conditions for reuse. On a curated archive of 54 RoboDojo-Sim task entries, RoboDoctor achieves a five-dimension mean score of 57.10, with a native success rate of 49.44%. Recorded interactions illustrate strategy changes, selective correction, and grasp revision. These findings characterize execution-time adaptation in the evaluated system; controlled trials remain necessary to isolate the contribution of cross-episode experience.
2610.35604.affiliation: Tsinghua University; New York University; Northwestern University
2610.35604.update_target: Fixed-weight execution harness, intervention policy and operation methods with linked experience
2610.35604.mechanism_en: Diagnosis connects decisions, attempted actions, outcomes and reuse conditions. Stored interactions illustrate changes to control allocation, selective assistance and physical-method reasoning.
2610.35604.result_en: On a curated 54-entry RoboDojo-Sim archive, the five-dimension mean is 57.10 and native success 49.44%.
2610.35604.boundary_en: The paper explicitly requires controlled trials to isolate cross-episode experience. These simulation-archive scores and interaction examples are not evidence of a causal lifelong-learning gain or independent real-robot replication.
2610.35604.abstract_zh: 通用机器人策略与语言模型智能体提供互补能力，但完成任务也需要根据物理交互的后果调整其使用方式。我们将执行研究为适配发生的位置：在模型权重固定时，反馈指导当前行动，也为修订后续决策提供证据。我们提出 RoboDoctor，一个免训练框架，跨三种修订目标连接诊断、有依据行动与持久经验。运行框架在策略与智能体之间分配控制权；干预决定何时协助，同时保留有用策略行为；操作则根据观测效果完善物理方法。相互关联的经验记录保留决策理由、所尝试方法、结果及复用条件。在一个包含 54 个 RoboDojo-Sim 任务条目的整理档案上，RoboDoctor 获得五维平均分 57.10，原生成功率 49.44%。记录的交互展示策略变化、选择性纠正和抓取修订。这些发现描述了被评估系统中的执行时适配；仍需受控试验来隔离跨回合经验的贡献。

2610.35716.title: Audit Where Hacks Pay: Budgeted Strong-Verifier Audits Against Reward Hacking in GRPO
2610.35716.authors: Shurun Li , Michael Hua Wang , Haibo Zeng , Long Wang
2610.35716.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards trains on cheap checks, such as unit tests, that a policy can learn to game, while a stronger check is too expensive to run on every rollout. We study how to spend a limited strong-verifier budget in GRPO, separating which weakly passing rollouts to audit from what reward a caught hack receives. At a fixed policy state with centered advantages, the expected update depends on a design only through each rollout's marginal audit probability and correction; reflecting a caught hack's reward about the failure reward negates the advantages of an all-hack group; and auditing whole groups with the fewest weak passes first (low-pass budgeted audits, LB) minimizes the advantage mass left on hacks among pass-count designs with a fixed correction when a label's value falls with the pass count. We tested this analysis in actual LLM training: from each run's starting state, the sign of this mass on a frozen panel predicted whether hacking would be suppressed in 33 of 39 runs, including 13 of 16 preregistered ones. In LeetCode (Wong et al., 2026) and Countdown-Code (Khalifa et al., 2026), LB drives hacking to near zero, while random audits with the same penalty and budget do not and use more labels. We also find that the randomness of the update affects training: in Countdown-Code, two unbiased corrections, per-item reward-level IPW and a group-level advantage correction, bring hacking down too but end 6.1-11.8 and 8.0-11.5 points lower in held-out accuracy than LB at the same budget. A full audit, which the group-level correction reproduces in expectation, stays within about two points of LB in three seeds, while LB uses 28% of its labels, and allocating the same correction by pass count recovers most of the loss (one seed). Training outcomes thus depend not only on the expected update but also on the randomness of its estimate.
2610.35716.update_target: Strong-verifier audit allocation and reward corrections during GRPO weight training
2610.35716.mechanism_en: A fixed-state analysis separates marginal audit probability from correction. Low-pass group audits prioritize weakly passing groups whose remaining hack advantage is most costly; actual training tests the prediction.
2610.35716.result_en: The frozen-panel sign predicts suppression in 33/39 runs, including 13/16 preregistered runs. LB nearly eliminates hacking in two environments while using 28% of full-audit labels in a reported comparison.
2610.35716.boundary_en: The optimality statement is conditional on a frozen-state objective and audit-design assumptions. Equal expected updates can have different training outcomes because variance matters; label savings are not total compute savings.
2610.35716.abstract_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习使用单元测试等廉价检查训练策略，而策略可能学会钻检查的空子；更强检查却因成本过高，无法对每个 rollout 执行。我们研究如何在 GRPO 中分配有限的强验证器预算，将审计哪些弱检查通过的 rollout，与抓获作弊后给予何种奖励分开考虑。在使用中心化优势的固定策略状态下，某种设计的期望更新，仅通过每个 rollout 的边际审计概率及修正值取决于该设计；将被抓获作弊的奖励关于失败奖励作镜像反射，会将全作弊分组的优势取反；当一个标签的价值随通过数下降时，在固定修正及预算的按通过数设计中，优先整体审计弱通过数最少的分组（低通过数预算审计，LB），能最小化留给作弊的优势总量。我们在实际 LLM 训练中测试了分析：从每次运行的初始状态出发，冻结面板上这一总量的符号，在 39 次运行中的 33 次预测了作弊是否会被抑制，其中包括 16 次预注册运行中的 13 次。在 LeetCode（Wong 等，2026）和 Countdown-Code（Khalifa 等，2026）上，LB 将作弊率降至接近零，而使用相同惩罚与预算的随机审计未能做到，并消耗更多标签。我们还发现，更新的随机性影响训练：在 Countdown-Code 上，逐项奖励级 IPW 和分组优势修正这两种无偏修正也能降低作弊，但相同预算下，最终留出准确率分别比 LB 低 6.1—11.8 和 8.0—11.5 个百分点。分组修正在期望上重现的全量审计，在三个种子中与 LB 相差约两个百分点以内，而 LB 只使用其 28% 的标签；按通过数分配同样修正可挽回大部分损失（一个种子）。因此，训练结果不仅取决于期望更新，也取决于其估计的随机性。

2610.35866.title: Auto-Research Arena: Benchmarking and Advancing Auto-Research in Language Modeling
2610.35866.authors: Xi Chen , Chongjian Ge , Yiran Xu , Yiqun Mei , Henrik I. Christensen , Hao Tan , Ziwen Chen , Hanwen Jiang
2610.35866.abstract_en: As autonomous research systems become more capable, benchmarks must both evaluate their performance and support meaningful research progress. We introduce Auto-Research Arena, a multi-target benchmark for evaluating autonomous research systems and discovering ideas in language modeling. Arena supports diverse research objectives within a shared experimental environment by separating admissibility from improvement: model quality and resource constraints determine whether a result qualifies, while the selected target measures progress among admissible results. We instantiate Arena in language model pretraining with nine targets spanning model, data, training, and inference efficiency, and evaluate seven research harnesses using two foundation models. Arena clearly differentiates existing harnesses across research objectives, with several sophisticated methods outperformed by our simple sequential search baseline, indicating substantial headroom in current auto-research systems. Beyond evaluation, Arena reveals a substantially broader frontier of model and system ideas aligned with active research directions. Reusing these discoveries in a new quality-driven search yields lower training loss under matched data and FLOPs and lower held-out BPB at the same model size. Together, Arena provides a common framework for benchmarking autonomous research and expanding its scope in language modeling. The code is available at this https URL
2610.35866.affiliation: University of California San Diego; Adobe Research
2610.35866.update_target: Evaluation of research-generated model/data/training/inference changes and later reuse of discoveries
2610.35866.mechanism_en: Nine targets separate admissibility constraints from progress metrics. Seven research harnesses with two foundation models search a shared environment; discoveries are reused in a fresh quality-driven search.
2610.35866.result_en: Several sophisticated systems lose to simple sequential search. Reused ideas lower training loss at matched data/FLOPs and held-out BPB at fixed model size.
2610.35866.boundary_en: No single target measures all research value. The inspected HTML is v2 while abstracts retain the saved New listing; constraints and search expenditure matter when comparing efficiency claims.
2610.35866.abstract_zh: 随着自主研究系统能力增强，基准必须既评估其表现，又支持有意义的研究进展。我们提出 Auto-Research Arena，一个用于评估自主研究系统并发现语言建模思路的多目标基准。Arena 在共享实验环境中支持多种研究目标，将合格条件与改进分开：模型质量与资源约束决定结果是否合格，而选定目标衡量合格结果间的进展。我们在语言模型预训练中实现 Arena，包含跨模型、数据、训练和推理效率的九个目标，并使用两个基础模型评估七个研究运行框架。Arena 清楚地区分了现有运行框架在各研究目标上的表现；数种复杂方法不如我们的简单顺序搜索基线，表明当前自动研究系统仍有很大改进空间。除评估之外，Arena 揭示了与活跃研究方向相符、显著更宽广的模型与系统思路前沿。在新的质量驱动搜索中复用这些发现，可在匹配数据量和 FLOPs 时降低训练损失，并在相同模型大小下降低留出集 BPB。综合来看，Arena 为自主研究基准评估和扩展其在语言建模中的范围，提供了共同框架。代码可在原文所附的 HTTPS 链接获取。

2610.36068.title: Rollback: Experience Backtracking in World Models for Policy Improvement
2610.36068.authors: Jiayi Luo , Yang Zhang , Liliang Chen , Nan Wang , Chen Gao , Boxiang Qiu , Zhuoxuan Li , Baorui Peng , Chuankang Li , Yuxiang Yan , Si Liu , Qingyun Sun , Shuicheng Yan , Maoqing Yao , Jianxin Li , Guanghui Ren
2610.36068.abstract_en: Action-conditioned world models offer a scalable alternative to costly real-world interaction for improving robot policies. However, existing world-model-based methods largely treat world models as forward-only surrogates of the physical environment, leaving untapped a capability no physical environment affords: rewinding to past decision points to explore counterfactual futures. We introduce Rollback, a policy improvement paradigm that turns world models from passive simulators into counterfactual engines: it rolls back to critical decision points, branches into alternative actions, and contrasts their outcomes to attribute success to individual decisions. This concentrates imagination where it matters most and distills counterfactual outcomes into fine-grained, action-level supervision without a separately learned value model. We build a scalable training system that unifies distributed world-model search with asynchronous real-robot execution, forming a self-reinforcing cycle: real-world experience continually sharpens the world model, and a sharper world model in turn drives further policy improvement. We term the world-model side of this cycle test-time physics grounding, a capability that hand-built physics simulators lack: while the world model serves as the training environment, real transitions from the policy it trains correct its dynamics through a lightweight LoRA pipeline. Experiments on three challenging real-world tasks show that Rollback improves success rates over the strongest baseline by an absolute 10.67%, 11.11%, and 11.85% on block extraction, ball tossing, and tabletop curling, respectively, while achieving more stable improvement throughout training. Although initialized from teleoperated demonstrations far below human level, Rollback surpasses the average success rate of human players on both ball tossing and tabletop curling within 8 hours of training.
2610.36068.update_target: Robot-policy learning and LoRA updates to an action-conditioned world model
2610.36068.mechanism_en: World-model rollback branches at critical decisions and converts counterfactual outcomes into action supervision. Real policy transitions then correct model dynamics, supporting another round of policy improvement.
2610.36068.result_en: Three real-robot tasks improve by absolute 10.67%, 11.11% and 11.85% over the strongest baseline. Ball tossing and tabletop curling exceed average human-player success within eight hours of training.
2610.36068.boundary_en: These are author-reported physical experiments initialized from teleoperation, not independent reproduction. Counterfactual labels depend on model fidelity; training time and real interaction are not free.
2610.36068.abstract_zh: 动作条件化世界模型为改进机器人策略提供了可扩展的途径，可替代昂贵的真实世界交互。然而，现有基于世界模型的方法，大多将世界模型视为物理环境的单向前向替代物，没有利用物理环境不具备的一种能力：回退到过去的决策点，探索反事实未来。我们提出 Rollback，一种策略改进范式，将世界模型从被动模拟器转变为反事实引擎：它回退到关键决策点，分支探索替代动作，并对比结果，将成功归因到单个决策。这使想象集中于最重要的位置，并在无需单独学习价值模型的条件下，将反事实结果提炼为细粒度的动作级监督。我们构建可扩展训练系统，统一分布式世界模型搜索与异步真实机器人执行，形成自我强化循环：真实经验不断改善世界模型，而更准确的世界模型又推动策略进一步改进。我们将循环中世界模型这一侧称为测试时物理落地，这是人工构建的物理模拟器所缺乏的能力：当世界模型作为训练环境时，它所训练策略产生的真实转移，通过轻量 LoRA 流水线纠正模型动力学。在三个具有挑战性的真实世界任务上的实验表明，Rollback 相比最强基线，在积木抽取、抛球和桌面冰壶上的成功率分别绝对提高 10.67%、11.11% 和 11.85%，且训练过程中的改进更稳定。尽管从远低于人类水平的遥操作示范初始化，Rollback 在八小时训练内，便在抛球和桌面冰壶上超过人类玩家的平均成功率。

2610.36077.title: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
2610.36077.authors: Weidong Tang , Ruiheng Wang , Jingxuan Zhang , Hexin Wang , Haoyuan Chen , Zhengfeiyang Zhang , Yixing Ma , Zichen Jiang , Ziyu Guo , Haodong Li , Zhengbo Jiao , Zhiqing Cui , Xinxiang Yin , Shuo Liang , Zhenglin Wan , Hongzhan Lin , Wangbo Zhao Kaipeng Zhang , Pengfei Zhou , Odin Zhang , Yang You
2610.36077.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
2610.36077.abstract_en: Multimodal intelligence can be viewed as human-guided co-evolution between worlds and agents through interaction. However, scaling this process faces two bottlenecks: constructing heterogeneous, verifiable environments is costly, and manual Harness iteration cannot keep pace with growing task diversity and complexity. A key insight is that tasks with different modalities and surface forms can share the same underlying capability requirements. We therefore introduce The Trinity, a recursive self-improvement framework coupling world generation with Harness evolution through three roles: Creator, Explorer, and Evolver. Drawing on verified execution trajectories, Evolver shifts the basis of task organization from surface categories to shared requirements, reorganizing the original task tree into a hierarchical capability tree. We introduce Capability-Driven Real2Sim2Real: for heterogeneous tasks at the same node, Creator abstracts their common requirements into simplified, verifiable simulated worlds for capability learning, while evaluation on original tasks measures transfer. Along this capability tree, Explorer progressively evolves reusable capability modules through selective inheritance, forming a Harness tree whose validated updates accumulate across iterations within a fixed topology. The resulting Harnesses specialize in different capabilities, motivating a Capability-Aware Harness Router that uses public task information to select compatible module configurations from the tree. Our evolved Harnesses improve mean performance by 34 points across 28 training benchmarks and 26 points across 18 unseen benchmarks, including two real-world embodied tasks.
2610.36077.affiliation: InfRec; Xidian University; Tongji University; National University of Singapore; University of California, Berkeley; The Chinese University of Hong Kong; The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology; The University of Hong Kong; Shanghai Innovation Institute
2610.36077.update_target: Verified simulated worlds, reusable capability modules and a routed external harness tree
2610.36077.mechanism_en: Creator abstracts shared capability requirements into worlds; Explorer evolves modules through selective inheritance; Evolver uses verified traces to reorganize tasks into capabilities. Validated updates accumulate within a fixed tree topology.
2610.36077.result_en: Mean performance gains are 34 points across 28 training benchmarks and 26 across 18 unseen benchmarks, including two real-world embodied tasks.
2610.36077.boundary_en: The tree topology is fixed during accumulation, and capability routing uses public task information. Finite benchmark transfer does not prove unbounded recursion; the inspected repository says code is coming soon.
2610.36077.abstract_zh: 多模态智能可被视为世界与智能体通过交互、在人类引导下共同演化。然而，扩展这一过程面临两个瓶颈：构建异构且可验证的环境成本高，人工迭代运行框架无法跟上不断增加的任务多样性与复杂度。一个关键认识是，不同模态和表面形式的任务，可能共享相同的底层能力要求。因此，我们提出 The Trinity，一个通过 Creator、Explorer 和 Evolver 三种角色，将世界生成与运行框架演化耦合的递归自改进框架。Evolver 利用经过验证的执行轨迹，将任务组织依据从表面类别转向共享要求，把原始任务树重组为分层能力树。我们提出能力驱动的 Real2Sim2Real：对于同一节点的异构任务，Creator 抽象其共同要求，生成简化且可验证的模拟世界来学习能力，同时在原始任务上评估迁移。沿着能力树，Explorer 通过选择性继承，逐步演化可复用能力模块，形成运行框架树；其中已验证更新在固定拓扑内跨迭代累积。所得运行框架分别专长于不同能力，因此我们设计能力感知的运行框架路由器，使用公开任务信息，从树中选择兼容的模块配置。演化后的运行框架在 28 个训练基准上的平均表现提高 34 个点，在 18 个未见基准上提高 26 个点，其中包含两个真实世界具身任务。

2610.36188.title: Skill Dreaming: Evolving Repository Skills through Pull Request Streams
2610.36188.authors: Xinyuan Song , Hasibul Haque , Jay Somasundaram , Ryan Turner , Bowen Zhu , Liang Zhao
2610.36188.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on reusable skills for complex software engineering tasks, making skill libraries essential for repository development and maintenance. However, repository-specific skills must evolve with changing code structures, implementation conventions, and maintenance requirements. Pull requests (PRs) provide a natural source of such knowledge by recording how repositories evolve through implementation and review. Meanwhile, new PRs must follow repository-specific implementation patterns, modify related components consistently, and ensure that existing tests continue to pass while adding coverage for new functionality. This creates a mutually reinforcing cycle: PRs provide knowledge for updating skills, while these skills improve future PRs, maintain repositories, and support further skill evolution. To enable this co-evolution of PRs, repositories, and skills, we propose Skill Dreaming, a framework that learns from PR streams to guide continuous repository development and maintenance. Given a repository and its PR history, Skill Dreaming builds a repository-specific skill library by extracting executable knowledge from validated PRs and continuously refines the skills as new PR information becomes available. These skills guide coding agents not only in implementing requested features but also in maintaining associated tests, documentation, compatibility, and repository conventions. By integrating PR analysis, skill management, code execution, and continuous integration, Skill Dreaming provides an end-to-end workflow for applying learned skills to repository changes and incorporating subsequent PR outcomes into future skill updates.
2610.36188.update_target: Repository-specific procedural skills maintained from validated pull-request streams
2610.36188.mechanism_en: PR implementation/review evidence becomes executable knowledge. Skills guide subsequent code, tests, documentation and compatibility changes; later execution/CI outcomes feed the next skill update.
2610.36188.result_en: The abstract describes an end-to-end PR/skill/repository co-evolution workflow without a quantitative controlled performance result.
2610.36188.boundary_en: A plausible feedback loop is not itself an established gain. Separate skills learned from prior validated PRs from target-PR leakage, and validate changed conventions rather than retaining them indefinitely.
2610.36188.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越依赖可复用技能来完成复杂软件工程任务，使技能库成为仓库开发与维护的重要组成部分。然而，仓库特定技能必须随着代码结构、实现惯例和维护要求变化而演化。拉取请求（PR）记录仓库如何通过实现与审查演变，为此类知识提供自然来源。同时，新 PR 必须遵循仓库特定的实现模式，一致地修改相关组件，并在为新功能增加覆盖的同时，确保既有测试继续通过。这形成一个相互强化的循环：PR 为更新技能提供知识，而技能改善未来 PR、维护仓库并支持进一步技能演化。为使 PR、仓库和技能能够共同演化，我们提出 Skill Dreaming，一个从 PR 流中学习、指导持续仓库开发与维护的框架。给定仓库及其 PR 历史，Skill Dreaming 从经过验证的 PR 中提取可执行知识，构建仓库特定技能库，并随着新的 PR 信息到来持续完善技能。这些技能指导编码智能体，不仅实现所请求功能，也维护相关测试、文档、兼容性和仓库惯例。通过整合 PR 分析、技能管理、代码执行和持续集成，Skill Dreaming 提供端到端工作流，将学习到的技能应用于仓库改动，并把后续 PR 结果纳入未来技能更新。

2610.36469.title: CoHARL: Co-Evolving Agent Policies and Executable Harnesses with Reinforcement Learning
2610.36469.authors: Jianwen Chen , Peng Xia , Kaide Zeng , Siwei Han , Zhen-Yu Zhang , Charles Fleming , Xinyu Ye , Huaxiu Yao
2610.36469.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents interact with their environments through executable harnesses that govern tool use and feedback. Optimizing a harness for a fixed policy overlooks how its behavior changes during learning, while training a policy under a fixed harness leaves the interface that generates its training experience unchanged. This motivates adapting the harness throughout policy training. We introduce CoHARL, a population-based reinforcement learning framework that co-evolves a shared policy and a population of executable harnesses. The policy learns from rollouts across the population, and a proposer uses its execution traces to revise harness code during training. CoHARL achieves a 27.6% mean resolved rate on SWE-rebench, improving over harness-only search by 6.4 percentage points. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.0 show gains in software engineering and terminal-based tasks. Under matched training budgets, CoHARL also outperforms searching for a harness once before RL and alternating policy updates with revisions to a single active harness.
2610.36469.affiliation: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill; RIKEN; Cisco
2610.36469.update_target: A shared RL policy and a population of executable harness code
2610.36469.mechanism_en: Policy rollouts across harnesses train the policy, while a proposer revises harness code from current execution traces during training. Population feedback prevents an interface from remaining fixed as the policy changes.
2610.36469.result_en: CoHARL reaches 27.6% mean resolved rate on SWE-rebench, 6.4 points above harness-only search, and beats once-before-RL search and single-active-harness alternation under matched training budgets.
2610.36469.boundary_en: This updates model parameters as well as external code. Budget-matched comparisons and generalization tests are essential; a harness-only result cannot substitute for a jointly trained-policy comparison.
2610.36469.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体通过可执行运行框架与环境交互，框架管理工具使用与反馈。为固定策略优化框架，会忽视策略在学习中的行为变化；而在固定框架下训练策略，又使产生训练经验的接口保持不变。因此，应在策略训练全过程中适配框架。我们提出 CoHARL，一个基于种群的强化学习框架，共同演化共享策略与可执行运行框架种群。策略从整个种群的 rollout 中学习，提案者则利用其执行轨迹，在训练期间修订框架代码。CoHARL 在 SWE-rebench 上达到 27.6% 的平均解决率，比仅搜索框架提高 6.4 个百分点。SWE-bench Verified 和 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上的实验展示了软件工程和终端任务上的收益。在匹配训练预算下，CoHARL 也优于在 RL 前只搜索一次框架，以及交替进行策略更新与单个活动框架修订的方法。

2610.36578.title: AudioRSI: Recursively Self-Improving Audio Reasoners
2610.36578.authors: Jiajun Fan , Roger Ren , Jingyuan Li , Rahul Pandey , Prashanth Gurunath Shivakumar , Ankur Gandhe , Yile Gu , Ge Liu , Ivan Bulyko
2610.36578.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has made Audio Large Language Models (Audio LLMs) better reasoners, but the reward that drives it still comes from outside the model: a final-answer check, a hand-crafted process score, or an external LLM judge that stays fixed while the policy improves. We show that an Audio LLM can supply this reward itself, and can do so recursively: each improved model becomes the critic that trains its successor, so the training signal improves along with the model. We introduce AudioRSI (Recursively Self-Improving Audio Reasoners), a reinforcement learning framework in which a single model plays two roles: as an actor it generates reasoning paths, and as a critic it compares them pairwise, turning its own judgments into a process-level reward. The critic is periodically replaced by the current policy, which closes the recursive loop. Because the critic hears the same recording as the actor, it can reject reasoning that cites acoustic evidence the audio does not contain, rather than reward reasoning that merely sounds plausible. The recursion is what sustains progress: under a frozen external judge, out-of-distribution accuracy plateaus during training, while a critic refreshed from the improving policy keeps it rising. Across four out-of-distribution benchmarks, all disjoint from the AVQA training distribution, AudioRSI outperforms strong baselines including Audio Flamingo 3 and Gemini 2.5 Pro on MMAU test-mini, ranks first on MMSU, achieves a clear lead on the challenging Multi-Audio split of MMAU-Pro, and leads the 7B open-source tier on MMAR among methods without external reward models. With no reward specifying how to reason, AudioRSI also develops structured reasoning behaviors (logical reasoning, perception-aware analysis, and reduced hallucination), corroborated by an external LLM-as-Judge evaluation and a keyword-based behavior analysis.
2610.36578.update_target: Audio reasoning policy weights and the periodically refreshed critic supplying process rewards
2610.36578.mechanism_en: One model generates reasoning as actor and pairwise-judges paths as critic. Refreshing the critic from the current policy makes the next training signal depend on the improved model and the same audio evidence.
2610.36578.result_en: Across four benchmarks disjoint from AVQA training, reported results lead several open-source/reward-model-free comparisons; a fixed-judge control plateaus while refreshed-critic performance continues improving.
2610.36578.boundary_en: Self-judgment is not ground truth or independent verification. External LLM judging and keyword analysis support behavior claims but do not prove universal acoustic faithfulness or unlimited improvement.
2610.36578.abstract_zh: 强化学习让音频大语言模型（Audio LLM）成为更好的推理器，但驱动训练的奖励仍来自模型外部：最终答案检查、人工设计的过程分数，或在策略进步时保持固定的外部 LLM 评判器。我们表明，Audio LLM 可以自行提供奖励，而且可以递归进行：每个改进后的模型都成为训练其后继模型的批评者，因此训练信号与模型一同改善。我们提出 AudioRSI（递归自改进音频推理器），一个强化学习框架，由单个模型扮演两种角色：作为行动者生成推理路径，作为批评者进行路径两两比较，将自己的判断转化为过程级奖励。批评者定期被当前策略替换，从而闭合递归循环。由于批评者听到与行动者相同的录音，它能够拒绝引用音频中不存在的声学证据的推理，而非奖励仅听起来合理的推理。递归使进展得以持续：使用固定外部评判器时，分布外准确率在训练中趋于平台，而从改进中的策略刷新批评者，则使其继续上升。在四个均与 AVQA 训练分布不相交的分布外基准上，AudioRSI 在 MMAU test-mini 上优于包括 Audio Flamingo 3 和 Gemini 2.5 Pro 在内的强基线，在 MMSU 上排名第一，在 MMAU-Pro 具有挑战性的 Multi-Audio 划分上明显领先，并在不使用外部奖励模型的方法中，领跑 MMAR 的 7B 开源模型组。在没有奖励规定如何推理的情况下，AudioRSI 还发展出结构化推理行为，包括逻辑推理、感知依据分析和减少幻觉；外部 LLM 评判器评估与基于关键词的行为分析为此提供了佐证。

2610.36618.title: Dream-COP: Guiding Algorithm Discovery for Combinatorial Optimization Problems in an Experience World
2610.36618.authors: Kuan Xu , Jianming Wang , Ni Zhang , Yaoxin Wu , Yong Wang , Zhiguang Cao
2610.36618.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) enable algorithm discovery for combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) through iterative program generation and evaluation. A central challenge is how to organize search to discover better algorithms within a limited budget. Our key insight is that past search trajectories and their recorded outcomes form an experience world, which can be used to facilitate the COP solving through replay. We introduce Dream-COP, in which a \emph{policy agent} learns executable policies through \emph{dreaming} in this experience world to guide a \emph{discovery agent} in generating and refining COP programs. Specifically, policy replay provides feedback on the quality of the programs revealed and the search steps used, to guide policy selection more effectively. Across five COPs, \textsc{Dream} discovers better algorithms than fixed exploration in both heuristic component design and complete solver generation. Particularly, it matches the optimal values on KP and reduces the gap on OBPP from 2.112\% to 1.199\% while using 42.5\% fewer search requests. Moreover, the learned exploration policies transfer effectively across different COPs with the assitance of the experience world.
2610.36618.affiliation: Singapore Management University; University of Science and Technology of China; Eindhoven University of Technology; Central South University
2610.36618.update_target: Executable exploration policies guiding combinatorial-program discovery
2610.36618.mechanism_en: Recorded searches form an experience world. A policy agent replays exploration strategies against program quality and search-step cost, then transfers selected policies to guide later program proposals.
2610.36618.result_en: Across five COPs, Dream-COP improves heuristic-component and complete-solver search; OBPP gap falls from 2.112% to 1.199% with 42.5% fewer search requests, while KP matches optimal values.
2610.36618.boundary_en: The changed policy is an executable search procedure, not necessarily LLM-weight training. Experience replay and its construction have costs; cross-COP transfer remains bounded by the evaluated tasks.
2610.36618.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）通过迭代程序生成与评估，为组合优化问题（COP）的算法发现提供了能力。核心挑战是如何组织搜索，在有限预算内发现更好算法。我们的关键认识是，过去搜索轨迹及其记录结果构成一个经验世界，可通过重放促进 COP 求解。我们提出 Dream-COP，其中策略智能体通过在这一经验世界中“做梦”，学习可执行策略，指导发现智能体生成和完善 COP 程序。具体来说，策略重放提供关于所揭示程序质量及所用搜索步骤的反馈，以更有效地指导策略选择。在五个 COP 上，Dream-COP 在启发式组件设计与完整求解器生成中，都比固定探索发现更好的算法。特别是，它在 KP 上匹配最优值，将 OBPP 上的差距从 2.112% 降至 1.199%，同时减少 42.5% 的搜索请求。此外，在经验世界帮助下，学习到的探索策略能够有效迁移到不同 COP。

2610.36660.title: The View from Nowhere: Population-Centered Agent Evolution
2610.36660.authors: Shuo Yan , Ningning Hou , Haoyu He , Haochen Pei , Shang Gao
2610.36660.abstract_en: Self-improving AI systems can revise the designs that govern their own behavior. Yet existing approaches center improvement on selected parent agents and their evolutionary experience, leaving the broader population largely underused. We identify a substantial gap between population coverage (i.e., the tasks solved by at least one evolved variant) and the performance of the best individual agent. This gap shows that useful capabilities and diagnostic evidence emerge across the population without being consolidated into its leading agents. These observations motivate the view from nowhere, a principle for agent evolution: an agent should be improved by interpreting its behavior through population-wide patterns of success, failure, and prior self-modification. We instantiate this principle as Population-Centered Evolution (PCE). PCE distils task records and modification histories from the population into a population block, which captures recurring failures, complementary successes, and the effects of previously attempted modifications to guide improvements to a selected parent's harness. Under matched models, initial harnesses, and evolution schedules, PCE achieves 72.1% success on SWE-bench Verified and 96.7% on Polyglot, improving over a strong group-evolution baseline by 3.2 and 5.9 percentage points. In our evaluation, PCE reduces the gap between population coverage and best-agent performance by one-third on SWE-bench and closes it on Polyglot. These results suggest that treating the population as evidence--not merely as candidates for selection--provides a complementary principle for agent evolution.
2610.36660.update_target: Parent-agent harness revisions informed by population-wide task and modification records
2610.36660.mechanism_en: A distilled population block combines recurring failures, complementary successes and effects of previous modifications. The selected parent uses this evidence to revise its harness for subsequent evolution.
2610.36660.result_en: Matched comparisons report 72.1% SWE-bench Verified and 96.7% Polyglot success, 3.2/5.9 points above the group-evolution baseline; the coverage-to-best-agent gap shrinks or closes.
2610.36660.boundary_en: Population coverage is an oracle union, not deployable single-agent success. Distillation and evaluation cost must be counted; the released setup requires substantial disk and multi-day benchmark runs.
2610.36660.abstract_zh: 自改进 AI 系统能够修订支配自身行为的设计。然而，现有方法将改进集中于选定的父智能体及其进化经验，未充分利用更广泛的种群。我们发现，种群覆盖率，即至少有一个演化变体能解决的任务比例，与最佳单个智能体表现之间存在显著差距。这表明，有用能力和诊断证据已在整个种群中出现，却未被整合到领先智能体中。这些观察促成“无处之视”这一智能体演化原则：改进智能体时，应通过整个种群的成功、失败及既往自修改模式来解释其行为。我们将该原则实现为以种群为中心的演化（PCE）。PCE 把种群任务记录与修改历史提炼为一个种群信息块，捕捉反复失败、互补成功及先前修改的影响，以指导选定父智能体运行框架的改进。在模型、初始框架和演化日程匹配的条件下，PCE 在 SWE-bench Verified 和 Polyglot 上分别达到 72.1% 和 96.7% 的成功率，比强分组演化基线分别提高 3.2 和 5.9 个百分点。在我们的评估中，PCE 将 SWE-bench 上种群覆盖率与最佳智能体表现的差距缩小三分之一，并在 Polyglot 上消除这一差距。这些结果表明，将种群视为证据，而非仅作为供选择的候选，提供了一种互补的智能体演化原则。

2610.36811.title: Weakness Localization Is Not Enough: State-Aware Recursive Knowledge Improvement for Large Language Models
2610.36811.authors: Runze Jiang , Yan Wang , Boran Jin , Bingyu Zhu , Longtao Huang
2610.36811.abstract_en: Knowledge improvement in large language models is shifting from predefined knowledge incorporation pipelines toward evaluation-guided updating. Existing methods use evaluation to localize model-specific knowledge weaknesses and guide targeted post-training. However, identifying what to improve does not necessarily provide sufficient information for deciding how to improve it. The same localized weakness can be compatible with distinct operational knowledge states: the relevant knowledge may be unavailable, available but difficult to access reliably, or accessible but ineffective for downstream use. We call this ambiguity knowledge-state aliasing. When compatible states favor different interventions, greater diagnostic resolution alone is insufficient for intervention selection. Moreover, model updates can change the underlying knowledge state before the observed weakness disappears, such that an intervention appropriate in one round may no longer address the bottleneck in the next. To address these challenges, we propose Recursive Knowledge Improvement (RKI), which formulates knowledge improvement as a sequential, state-aware intervention process. RKI organizes knowledge into graph-structured units that provide a shared basis for diagnostic evaluation and targeted intervention across rounds. At each round, RKI localizes knowledge weaknesses, estimates the model's operational knowledge state from diagnostic evidence and intervention history, selects a corresponding intervention, and re-evaluates the updated model before determining the next intervention. On HotpotEval and SafeInternalEval, RKI outperforms existing knowledge incorporation methods by 18.41 points on average. Further analyses show that knowledge states provide additional guidance for intervention selection beyond weakness localization and can change across model updates even when the observed weakness persists.
2610.36811.affiliation: Peking University; Alibaba Group; Delft University of Technology
2610.36811.update_target: Model knowledge via state-conditioned post-training interventions and persistent intervention history
2610.36811.mechanism_en: Graph units connect diagnosis to intervention. Each round estimates availability, accessibility or usability, chooses corresponding knowledge exposure/CPT/SFT and re-evaluates before choosing the next update.
2610.36811.result_en: RKI improves over knowledge-incorporation methods by 18.41 points on average on HotpotEval and SafeInternalEval; analyses show state can change while the same weakness persists.
2610.36811.boundary_en: Knowledge-state labels are diagnostic estimates, not direct observation of internal truth. A persistent low score does not imply an unchanged bottleneck, and the method includes weight-training costs.
2610.36811.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的知识改进，正在从预定义的知识纳入流水线转向由评估引导的更新。现有方法利用评估定位模型特定的知识弱点，并指导针对性后训练。然而，确定改进什么，并不一定提供足够信息来决定如何改进。同一局部弱点可能对应不同的操作性知识状态：相关知识可能不可用，可能可用但难以可靠访问，也可能可访问却无法有效支持下游使用。我们将这种歧义称为知识状态混叠。当兼容的状态偏好不同干预时，仅提高诊断分辨率不足以选择干预。此外，在观测到的弱点消失之前，模型更新可能已改变底层知识状态，因此某一轮适用的干预，在下一轮可能不再针对真正瓶颈。为应对这些挑战，我们提出递归知识改进（RKI），将知识改进表述为顺序的、状态感知的干预过程。RKI 将知识组织成图结构单元，为跨轮诊断评估和针对性干预提供共同基础。每一轮中，RKI 定位知识弱点，根据诊断证据和干预历史估计模型操作性知识状态，选择对应干预，并重新评估更新后的模型，再决定下一次干预。在 HotpotEval 和 SafeInternalEval 上，RKI 平均比现有知识纳入方法提高 18.41 个点。进一步分析表明，除了弱点定位外，知识状态能为干预选择提供额外指导；即使观测到的弱点持续存在，知识状态也可能随着模型更新而变化。

2610.36826.title: When the Critic Falls Behind: Co-Evolving Rubrics and Harnesses for Continual Agent Self-Improvement
2610.36826.authors: Hao Chen , Yukun Yan , Ziyu Han , Ye He , Chuanzhe Guo , Shangzhan Li , Qi Shi , Qingfu Zhu , Maosong Sun , Wanxiang Che
2610.36826.abstract_en: Autonomous agents increasingly depend on harnesses that govern interaction, memory, tools, and execution around large language models (LLMs). While recent work has begun to evolve these harnesses from execution experience, the supervision used to guide evolution often remains relatively static, making it difficult to track changing behavioral weaknesses across rounds and potentially limiting generalization to unseen tasks. To address this issue, we propose RuHarness, a rubric--harness co-evolution framework for continual agent self-improvement. RuHarness continually discovers and reassesses behavioral criteria from execution trajectories, prioritizes the most relevant unresolved weaknesses, and uses them to guide targeted harness updates while keeping the task objective fixed. Extensive experiments across diverse agent tasks and backbone models show that RuHarness outperforms strong harness-evolution baselines, particularly on unseen held-out tasks. Further analyses show that adaptive rubric prioritization tracks shifting weaknesses and supports more sustained improvement and stable generalization across evolution rounds.
2610.36826.affiliation: Harbin Institute of Technology; Tsinghua University
2610.36826.update_target: External behavioral rubrics, their priorities and the harness they supervise
2610.36826.mechanism_en: Execution trajectories continually reveal/reassess criteria and unresolved weaknesses. Prioritized rubrics target the next harness update while the task objective remains fixed.
2610.36826.result_en: Across tasks and backbone models, the authors report stronger held-out performance and more sustained/stable evolution than static-supervision harness baselines; no numerical aggregate appears in the abstract.
2610.36826.boundary_en: Updating a rubric must preserve the fixed objective rather than lower standards. Model-based supervision can drift; no independent long-run validation was performed for this digest.
2610.36826.abstract_zh: 自主智能体越来越依赖运行框架，管理大语言模型（LLM）周围的交互、记忆、工具和执行。尽管近期工作开始根据执行经验演化这些框架，用于指导演化的监督往往仍相对静态，难以跟踪跨轮变化的行为弱点，并可能限制向未见任务的泛化。为解决这一问题，我们提出 RuHarness，一个用于持续智能体自改进的评分细则—运行框架共同演化框架。RuHarness 持续从执行轨迹中发现并重新评估行为标准，优先处理最相关且尚未解决的弱点，并在保持任务目标固定的同时，用这些标准指导针对性框架更新。跨多种智能体任务和骨干模型的广泛实验表明，RuHarness 优于强框架演化基线，尤其在未见留出任务上。进一步分析表明，自适应细则优先级能够跟踪变化的弱点，并支持跨演化轮次更持续的改进和稳定泛化。
